title: The Effect of Artificial Intelligence Technology on the Returns to Human Capital (Empirical Study)

detail.title: The Effect of Artificial Intelligence Technology on the Returns to Human Capital (Empirical Study)
detail.abstract: This paper examines how artificial intelligence (AI) technology is associated with changes in the wage returns to education and labour market experience among U.S. workers. Using Current Population Survey Basic Monthly microdata from 2015 to 2025 merged with an occupational AI exposure index constructed from O*NET Work Activities data following the Pew Research Center (2023) methodology, I employ an event-study difference-in-differences design that exploits variation in AI exposure across occupations following the public release of advanced generative AI systems. Education and experience outcomes are estimated in separate models, each including year-by human-capital two-way interactions that absorb economy-wide secular changes in the returns to education and experience common to all occupations. The results show that the clearest and most robust AI-associated pattern is in the returns to education, not experience. Among knowledge workers, the differential return to education in high-AI versus low-AI occupations is flat and statistically insignificant throughout 2015–2023, then rises sharply and significantly in 2024–2025, implying an approximately 14.7 per cent college-premium differential by 2025. This pattern is corroborated, in attenuated form, in the broader all-occupations sample (approximately 7.6 percent by 2025) and, more weakly and only at the 10 percent level, among salaried workers (approximately 8.6 percent). By contrast, the differential return to labour market experience is much weaker: it reaches statistical significance only in the knowledge-worker sample by 2025 (an implied 8.4 percent differential for 20 years of experience) and in the all-occupations sample (3.2 percent), and is statistically indistinguishable from zero in every year for salaried full-time workers. Log-weekly-earnings results show no consistent post-2023 pattern for either outcome. These results are consistent with AI complementing formal education more clearly and more robustly than it complements accumulated work experience, though the observational nature of the design precludes causal claims and some pre-treatment coefficients in the broader samples are not perfectly flat, which qualifies the identifying assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2015-2025年美国当前人口调查（CPS）微观数据，结合基于O*NET构建的职业AI暴露指数，采用事件研究双重差分设计，考察AI技术与教育回报和工作经验回报变化之间的关系。研究发现，AI对教育回报的影响最为显著——2024-2025年知识工作者中高AI暴露职业的教育溢价差异急剧上升（约14.7%），而对经验回报的影响较弱且不稳定。
AI.research_question: 人工智能技术的普及如何影响美国工人的教育回报和经验回报？AI对正式教育和工作经验这两种人力资本维度的互补效应是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI系统（如ChatGPT）于2022年底公开发布，劳动力市场可能发生结构性变化。已有研究多关注AI对就业总量或工资水平的影响，但很少系统考察AI如何改变教育回报与工作经验回报的相对价值，这一问题对理解人力资本投资方向和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技能偏向型技术变革（SBTC）和任务互补理论，将AI视为与特定人力资本维度（正式教育 vs. 工作经验）存在差异互补性的通用技术。通过比较高AI暴露与低AI暴露职业间教育回报和经验回报的差异化变动来识别AI的影响。
AI.method: 事件研究双重差分（event-study difference-in-differences）设计。利用不同职业在AI暴露程度上的差异，以2022年底生成式AI公开发布为冲击事件。基于Pew Research Center (2023)方法论，使用O*NET工作活动数据构建职业AI暴露指数。教育与经验在分离模型中分别估计，均包含年份×人力资本的交互项以吸收总体趋势。
AI.findings: （1）教育回报变化最为显著：知识工作者样本中，2024-2025年高AI暴露职业的大学教育溢价差异急剧上升，2025年约达14.7%；全职业样本约7.6%；受薪工人样本约8.6%（仅10%显著性水平）。（2）经验回报变化较弱：仅在知识工作者样本（20年经验溢价差异8.4%）和全职业样本（3.2%）中于2025年达到统计显著，受薪全职工人样本中每年均不显著。（3）对数周收入结果在2023年后无一致模式。（4）结果表明AI对正式教育的互补效应强于对工作经验的互补效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI时代人力资本回报结构变化提供了系统性实证证据，区分了AI对教育回报与经验回报的差异化影响，表明AI与技术变革的研究需要将人力资本维度细分化而非笼统地考察"技能回报"。
AI.practical_contributions: 对教育投资决策和政策制定有参考价值：强调正式教育在AI时代的价值提升，同时提示工作经验积累的相对回报可能下降；为企业和个人在AI时代的人力资本投资策略提供证据基础。

title: "Ethical Implications of AI-driven Ad Targeting and Personalization (ATP): A Multiple Case Analysis of UK-based Digital Marketing Agencies"

detail.title: "Ethical Implications of AI-driven Ad Targeting and Personalization (ATP): A Multiple Case Analysis of UK-based Digital Marketing Agencies"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any organisations discussed in this research that could be perceived to have influenced the study. During the preparation of this dissertation, the author used Grammarly (AI-assisted writing and editing) and Canva's design tools (including AI-assisted features for visual elements). This use was consistent with the academic integrity declaration submitted as part of the original assessment. AI tools were not used to generate research findings, analysis, or substantive content.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used only secondary, publicly available data (agency websites, privacy policies, blog content) with no primary data collection or direct participant involvement. Ethical approval was granted by the University of Salford Business School Research Ethics Panel (Reference: 7671, Favourable Opinion, 25 June 2025).
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The dissertation was completed as part of a self-funded MSc programme at the University of Salford.

detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to reshape digital marketing, the ethical implications of ad targeting and personalization (ATP) have become increasingly significant. This dissertation investigates how selected UK-based digital marketing agencies approach ethical concerns surrounding AI-driven advertising practices. Drawing on secondary data from eleven agencies, including website, privacy policies, blog content, and public reports, this study adopts a multiple case study design grounded in the interpretivist paradigm and abductive reasoning.
The analysis identifies six key ethical themes: transparency, user consent, fairness, accountability, inclusivity, and ethical alignment. While several agencies demonstrated a strong commitment to transparency and consent, others revealed inconsistent or minimal engagement with ethical frameworks. Notably, hybrid human-AI strategies were present across some agencies, yet formal mechanisms for accountability, inclusivity, ethical alignment, and fairness were underdeveloped or vaguely articulated.
This study contributes to the evolving conversation on responsible AI in marketing by highlighting the fragmented landscape of ethical practices. It concludes with recommendations for industry practitioners to adopt clearer standards and for future researchers to engage more deeply with user-centric and cross-cultural perspectives. The findings emphasize the urgent need for actionable, transparent, and inclusive ethical strategies as AI technologies become more embedded in consumer experiences.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于对英国11家数字营销机构的二手数据分析（包括网站、隐私政策、博客和公开报告），采用多案例研究设计，探讨AI驱动的广告定向与个性化（ATP）实践中的伦理问题。研究识别出六大伦理主题（透明度、用户同意、公平性、问责制、包容性和伦理一致性），发现各机构对伦理框架的投入程度差异显著，尤其在问责制、包容性和公平性等正式机制方面发展不足。研究呼吁行业制定更清晰的标准，并建议未来研究关注用户中心和跨文化视角。
AI.research_question: 英国数字营销机构如何在AI驱动的广告定向与个性化（ATP）实践中处理伦理问题？
AI.motivation: 随着AI不断重塑数字营销格局，广告定向与个性化中的伦理影响日益显著，但业界对伦理框架的实际应用情况尚不清楚，需要深入了解营销机构如何应对这些伦理挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 解释主义范式（interpretivist paradigm）；溯因推理（abductive reasoning）；多案例研究设计
AI.method: 采用多案例研究设计，基于11家英国数字营销机构的二手数据（网站、隐私政策、博客内容、公开报告）进行质性分析。
AI.findings: 识别出六大关键伦理主题：透明度、用户同意、公平性、问责制、包容性和伦理一致性。部分机构在透明度和同意方面表现出较强承诺，但其他机构对伦理框架的参与不一致或极少。部分机构采用了人机混合策略，但问责制、包容性、伦理一致性和公平性的正式机制发展不足或表述模糊。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过突显伦理实践的碎片化格局，为营销领域负责任AI的持续讨论做出贡献，揭示了AI伦理从理论框架到实际落地之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行业从业者提出采纳更清晰伦理标准的建议；为未来研究者指出应更深入探索用户中心和跨文化视角的方向；强调随着AI技术日益嵌入消费者体验，迫切需要可操作的、透明的、包容性的伦理策略。

title: Which A/B Tests Still Need to Run? Simulation-Guided Screening of Headline Experiments
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Which A/B Tests Still Need to Run? Simulation-Guided Screening of Headline Experiments
detail.abstract: Language models that simulate audience behavior are usually evaluated on prediction accuracy: can the model pick the A/B test winner? But no sane team would let a model replace testing at the accuracy levels current models reach. The realistic deployment is screening: a team drafts n candidate headlines, has budget to field only k, and uses the model to choose which k enter the real test. We evaluate that decision problem directly on 4,000 held-out headline experiments from the Upworthy Research Archive (never used during any model development), comparing a small LLM fine-tuned on 2,599 disjoint experiments, a gradient-boosted trees baseline, a zero-shot LLM, and random screening. Screening quality is measured by winner retention (is the true best headline among the fielded k?) and click-through regret (how much CTR is lost when it is not). At k = 2, fine-tuned-LLM screening retains the true winner in 63.8% of tests (78.3% of statistically decisive tests) against 45.5% for random screening, and cuts mean relative CTR regret from 13.2% to 6.9%. The zero-shot model provides almost no screening value. Simulation at current quality does not replace experiments, but it buys back roughly half of a fixed testing budget at a small, quantifiable regret, and the value comes from fine-tuning on real outcomes, not from the base model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个更现实的LLM预测用例：不是让模型直接替代A/B测试选择赢家，而是让模型从n个候选标题中筛选出k个进入真实测试。基于Upworthy Research Archive中4,000个未用于模型开发的标题实验，对比了微调LLM、梯度提升树、零样本LLM和随机筛选四种方法的筛选质量。结果显示微调LLM在k=2时将真实赢家保留率从随机筛选的45.5%提升至63.8%，将平均相对点击率遗憾从13.2%降至6.9%。零样本模型几乎没有筛选价值，价值主要来自在真实结果上的微调。
AI.research_question: 当LLM用于"筛选"（从n个候选标题中选出k个进入真实A/B测试）而非直接预测赢家时，其筛选质量如何？不同模型的筛选效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统评估LLM模拟受众行为的方式是预测准确性（能否选出A/B测试赢家），但这不符合实际部署场景——没有团队会仅凭当前准确率让模型完全替代真实测试。实际场景是筛选：团队草拟n个候选标题，预算只够测试k个，用模型选出进入测试的k个。因此需要直接评估筛选决策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策理论框架下的筛选与排序问题，以赢家保留率（winner retention）和点击率遗憾（click-through regret）作为筛选质量的核心指标。
AI.method: 使用Upworthy Research Archive中4,000个未用于模型开发的标题实验进行评估。对比四种方法：在2,599个不重叠实验上微调的小型LLM、梯度提升树基线、零样本LLM、随机筛选。测量指标包括赢家保留率（真实最佳标题是否进入被筛选的k个）和点击率遗憾（未保留赢家时损失多少CTR）。
AI.findings: 当k=2时，微调LLM在63.8%的测试中保留了真实赢家（在78.3%的统计决定性测试中），而随机筛选仅为45.5%。微调LLM将平均相对CTR遗憾从13.2%降至6.9%。零样本模型几乎提供不了筛选价值，筛选价值主要来自在真实结果上的微调而非基座模型本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个更贴近实际部署的评估框架——将LLM评估从"预测赢家"重构为"筛选候选进入测试"的决策问题，给出了赢家保留率和CTR遗憾这两个更贴合实际业务价值的评估指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了在当前的模型质量水平下，LLM模拟无法完全替代真实实验，但可以将固定测试预算的效果回收约一半，且遗憾成本小而可量化。这一结果为企业内容测试、标题优化等场景提供了可操作的筛选策略指导。

title: Economic and Business Impacts of School Meal Programmes: A Cross-Country Meta-Aggregation
affiliations: , IPB University, Bogor Agricultural University (IPB University), IPB University and IPB University

detail.title: Economic and Business Impacts of School Meal Programmes: A Cross-Country Meta-Aggregation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational relationships that could be perceived as having influenced or biased this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a systematic literature review and meta-aggregation using entirely published secondary data; it did not involve primary data collection, human participants, or clinical trials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted at the School of Business, IPB University. The intellectual foundation and academic experience supporting this study were funded and supported by the Indonesian International Student Mobility Award (IISMA) program from the Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology (MOECRT) of the Republic of Indonesia.

detail.abstract: School meal programmes are increasingly framed as economic instruments, yet the evidence on their impacts is geographically fragmented and metrically incommensurable, which impedes cross-country comparison. This study identifies the characteristics of that literature and constructs the architecture of categories, synthesised findings, and transmission pathways through which the impacts arise. A Boolean search of Scopus retrieved 3,064 records, screened under PRISMA 2020 to 50 studies published between 2016 and 2026, of which 41 contributed findings to an adapted meta-aggregative synthesis graded through ConQual. Aggregation resolved the evidence into 25 categories and seven synthesised findings across three pathways: procurement and household carry two findings each, human capital one, and two are cross-pathway. Confidence proves systematically uneven along the demand-supply division. Only maternal labour supply and bargaining position attain a High grade; budget substitution and long-run human capital returns attain Moderate; multipliers, family farm integration, and governance attain Low; and fiscal incidence, resting on two categories, Very Low. The justification most invoked for expanding local procurement therefore rests on the weakest evidence in the corpus.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统性文献综述（PRISMA 2020），对2016-2026年间50篇关于学校餐计划经济影响的研究进行了元聚合综合，识别出25个类别和7项综合发现，涵盖采购、家庭、人力资本三条传导路径。证据质量在供需两侧存在系统性不均：仅母亲劳动力供给和议价能力达到高质量等级，而最常被引用的本地采购扩张理由（财政归宿）证据等级极低。
AI.research_question: 学校餐计划作为经济工具的影响证据在文献中呈现何种特征？其影响类别、综合发现与传导路径如何架构？不同影响维度的证据置信度如何分布？
AI.motivation: 学校餐计划日益被定位为经济工具，但现有证据在地理上碎片化、度量上不可通约，阻碍了跨国比较与政策决策。需要系统性地整合并评估该领域文献的证据基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元聚合综合（meta-aggregative synthesis）方法框架；ConQual证据分级框架；学校餐计划影响的需求-供给分析框架。
AI.method: 在Scopus进行布尔检索获取3,064条记录，依据PRISMA 2020筛选出2016-2026年间发表的50项研究；其中41项研究贡献发现，采用改编的元聚合综合法进行证据聚合，并通过ConQual进行证据质量分级。
AI.findings: 证据聚合为25个类别和7项综合发现，涵盖三条路径：采购与家庭各含2项发现，人力资本1项，跨路径2项。证据置信度沿需求-供给分界呈系统性不均：母亲劳动力供给和议价能力达到High级；预算替代和长期人力资本回报为Moderate级；乘数效应、家庭农场整合和治理为Low级；财政归宿（仅基于2个类别）为Very Low级。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了学校餐计划经济影响的类别架构与传导路径图谱，揭示了证据置信度在需求侧与供给侧之间的系统性不均衡，挑战了以财政归宿论证本地采购扩张的合理性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了学校餐计划经济影响证据的分级图谱，明确指出本地采购扩张的财政归宿论证缺乏可靠证据支撑，提示政策决策应基于更扎实的证据基础。

title: AI-Driven Destination Discovery in China: Positioning Iran in the Chinese Generative AI Tourism Ecosystem

detail.title: AI-Driven Destination Discovery in China: Positioning Iran in the Chinese Generative AI Tourism Ecosystem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest or financial relationships that could have influenced this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly consulted as a first stage of destination discovery, yet destination-marketing research has no established way of distinguishing whether a destination is known to such a system from whether it is surfaced or recommended by it. This study examines how six Chinese-language generative AI platforms (DeepSeek, Doubao, ERNIE Bot, Kimi, Qwen, and Yuanbao) represent Iran as an outbound tourism destination for the Chinese market, coding 660 platform-prompt observations across thirteen thematic axes for two independent outcomes: Mention, whether Iran appeared in a response, and Recommendation, whether a mentioned Iran was put forward as a suggested choice. Mention reached 100% on every axis where a prompt named Iran directly, but collapsed sharply on open-ended axes that did not — a Recognition–Discovery Gap between a platform's retrievable knowledge and its unprompted surfacing behavior. Among 383 observations in which Iran was mentioned on a recommendation-relevant axis, an unconditional positive recommendation followed only 35.8% of the time, and 33.4% were explicitly declined, establishing recognition and recommendation as separable outcomes — the Recognition–Recommendation distinction. A cluster-robust regression and a mixed-effects model with a random intercept for prompt agreed on the direction and significance of every effect examined: platform differences were modest at the mention stage but substantial and robust at the recommendation stage, particularly under safety- and risk-oriented framing — platform-dependent destination visibility. Together, these three contributions indicate that Generative Engine Optimization for a destination such as Iran must address retrievability, credibility, and recommendability as distinct, separately measurable properties rather than a single undifferentiated notion of AI visibility.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察六个中文生成式AI平台（DeepSeek、豆包、文心一言、Kimi、通义千问、元宝）如何呈现伊朗作为中国出境旅游目的地，通过660个平台-提示观察编码，区分了"提及"（Mention）与"推荐"（Recommendation）两个独立结果，发现认知-发现差距（Recognition–Discovery Gap）和认知-推荐区分（Recognition–Recommendation distinction），并提出生成式引擎优化需分别处理可检索性、可信度与可推荐性。
AI.research_question: 目的地是否被生成式AI系统"知晓"（known）与其是否被"浮现或推荐"（surfaced or recommended）之间如何区分？六个中文生成式AI平台如何代表伊朗作为中国出境旅游目的地？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统日益成为目的地发现的第一个阶段，但目的地营销研究尚无既定方法区分"系统知晓目的地"与"系统推荐目的地"，这一区分对目的地营销至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知-发现差距（Recognition–Discovery Gap）、认知-推荐区分（Recognition–Recommendation distinction）、平台依赖的目的地可见性（platform-dependent destination visibility）
AI.method: 对六个中文生成式AI平台进行660个平台-提示观察，沿十三个主题轴编码两个独立结果（提及与推荐）；使用聚类稳健回归和带提示随机截距的混合效应模型。
AI.findings: 在直接命名伊朗的提示中提及率达100%，但在开放式提示中急剧下降（认知-发现差距）；在383个提及伊朗的推荐相关观察中，无条件积极推荐仅占35.8%，33.4%被明确拒绝（认知-推荐区分）；平台差异在提及阶段较小，但在推荐阶段显著且稳健，尤其在安全与风险导向框架下。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立"提及"与"推荐"作为可分离结果的实证框架，提出"认知-发现差距"和"认知-推荐区分"两个概念，揭示AI可见性是多维而非单一概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为目的地如伊朗的生成式引擎优化（GEO）提供指导：必须将可检索性、可信度和可推荐性作为独立且可分别测量的属性来处理，而非笼统的AI可见性。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based on a narrative literature review and did not involve human participants or the collection of personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Digital commerce ecosystems increasingly depend on the alignment between social media advertising formats and digital payment systems, yet existing research has examined these mechanisms in isolation, overlooking their combined influence on consumer behaviour, conversion, and long-term value creation. This study addresses that gap by developing an integrative conceptual framework that examines how advertising formats and payment infrastructures jointly shape sustainable digital monetisation within an Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) framework. Methodologically, the study adopts a structured narrative literature review of interdisciplinary peer-reviewed studies and selected high-quality institutional reports, drawn from Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and Google Scholar, covering publications from 2015 to April 2026. A four-stage PRISMA-adapted selection protocol was applied to ensure transparency, replicability, and analytical rigour across the review process. The findings demonstrate that advertising formats including native advertising, influencer marketing, user-generated content, short-form video, live streaming, and augmented reality drive consumer attention and purchase intention, while payment systems encompassing digital wallets, BNPL services, and in-platform checkout shape transactional trust and friction. Conversion and customer lifetime value emerge as joint outcomes of this interaction, mediated by consumer trust and transaction friction. The study further identifies key sustainability tensions related to digital carbon footprints from data-intensive formats, financial vulnerability associated with frictionless credit tools, and governance concerns surrounding transparency, privacy, and platform power concentration. The study contributes an integrative conceptual model linking advertising formats, payment systems, consumer behaviour, and ESG dimensions within a unified framework, supported by six theoretically grounded hypotheses (H1-H6) to guide future empirical research in sustainable digital commerce.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，构建了一个整合广告格式与支付系统如何共同影响消费者行为、转化率及长期价值的理论框架，并将可持续数字商业置于ESG框架下审视。研究发现广告格式与支付系统通过消费者信任和交易摩擦的中介作用共同影响转化率和客户终身价值，同时揭示了碳足迹、金融脆弱性和治理等可持续性张力，提出了六项可检验的理论假设。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体广告格式与数字支付系统如何联合塑造可持续的数字货币化，并影响消费者行为、转化率和长期价值创造？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将社交媒体广告格式与数字支付系统分开考察，忽视了二者的联合效应对消费者行为、转化与长期价值创造的综合影响，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合性概念框架，将广告格式、支付基础设施、消费者行为与ESG维度统一在一个框架中，以消费者信任和交易摩擦为中介机制。
AI.method: 结构化叙述性文献综述，采用四阶段PRISMA改编筛选协议，基于Scopus、Web of Science Core Collection和Google Scholar中2015年至2026年4月的同行评审研究和高质量机构报告。
AI.findings: （1）各类广告格式（原生广告、网红营销、用户生成内容、短视频、直播、增强现实）驱动消费者注意力和购买意愿；（2）支付系统（数字钱包、BNPL服务、平台内结账）塑造交易信任与摩擦；（3）转化率和客户终身价值是两者交互的联合结果，以消费者信任和交易摩擦为中介；（4）识别出数字碳足迹、金融脆弱性、治理关注（透明度、隐私、平台权力集中）等可持续性张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个整合广告格式、支付系统、消费者行为与ESG维度的统一概念模型，并提出六个理论假设（H1-H6）以指导未来实证研究，填补了广告与支付机制孤立研究的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字商业平台在广告与支付协同设计中提供理论依据，帮助企业在实现商业目标的同时关注碳足迹、消费者金融保护和治理透明度等ESG议题，促进可持续的数字货币化实践。

title: AI Citations are Not Permanent: Citation Volatility, Half-Life, and What Actually Predicts Citation Persistence Across AI Platforms
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI Citations are Not Permanent: Citation Volatility, Half-Life, and What Actually Predicts Citation Persistence Across AI Platforms
detail.abstract:
Purpose: This paper documents and quantifies the temporal instability of AI citations across major AI search platforms-ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini-and identifies the factors that predict citation persistence. 

Design/Methodology/Approach: Drawing on the largest publicly available citation datasetsencompassing 3.5 million tracked citation events (Scrunch/Stacker, September 2025-March 2026), a 28-day longitudinal persistence study across five AI engines (Digital Authority Partners, 2026), a synthesis of 680 million citations (5W AI Communications, 2026), and complementary research from Profound, Semrush, BrightEdge, and peer-reviewed comparative audit work (Chen, Wang, Chen & Koudas, 2026)-this paper calculates platform-specific citation half-life, monthly rotation rates, 28-day URL persistence statistics, and identifies six empirically-supported predictors of citation frequency and persistence. 

Findings: The median citation half-life across AI platforms is 4.5 weeks. ChatGPT cycles through sources fastest at a median of 3.4 weeks; Perplexity holds citations longest at 5.8 weeks. Only 10.6% of URLs cited by AI engines persist across a 28-day window. Monthly citation rotation ranges from 40-60% across platforms. Six factors predict citation persistence: brand search volume (0.334 correlation), original research content (82% citation rate), third-party attribution (6.5× more citations than self-referential content), content freshness (3.2× citation lift on Perplexity for pages updated within 30 days), schema markup completeness, and Bing Webmaster Tools verification. The paper also identifies four categories of volatility causes: platform and model updates, content freshness decay, competitive displacement, and zero-citation response emergence. 

Practical Implications: AI citation is not a destination-it is a frequency problem requiring ongoing investment in content refresh, citation monitoring, and cross-platform entity verification. A one-time technical implementation produces citations that decay by design. Brands that treat AI SEO as a one-time setup will consistently underperform brands that build citation frequency programmes with monitoring infrastructure and platform-specific publishing cadences. 

Originality/Value: This paper is the first to synthesise platform-specific citation half-life data, 28day URL persistence statistics, and monthly rotation rates into a unified citation volatility framework, and the first to identify brand search volume as the strongest empirical predictor of AI citation likelihood-stronger than backlinks or technical signals. The Structural Citation Persistence Framework provides practitioners with a three-layer programme design that addresses volatility at the foundation, content, and monitoring levels.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地量化了五大AI搜索平台（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews、Microsoft Copilot和Gemini）中AI引用的时间不稳定性，发现AI引用中位半衰期仅为4.5周，仅10.6%的URL能在28天内持续被引用，并识别出品牌搜索量等六个预测引用持久性的关键因素，提出了三层结构引用持久性框架。
AI.research_question: AI搜索平台（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews、Microsoft Copilot、Gemini）的引用在时间维度上有多不稳定？哪些因素能够预测AI引用的持久性？
AI.motivation: 现有AI SEO研究主要关注哪些内容会被引用，但忽略了引用在时间维度上的波动性。AI引用并非持久不变的，而是会快速衰减和轮换，这对依赖AI引用的品牌传播策略构成重大挑战，亟需系统性量化和理论化这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引用持久性框架（Structural Citation Persistence Framework），该框架从基础层（foundation）、内容层（content）和监测层（monitoring）三个层面应对引用波动性。
AI.method: 基于多个大型公开数据集进行纵向分析，包括：1）350万条追踪引用事件数据；2）跨五大AI引擎的28天纵向持久性研究；3）6.8亿条引用综合数据集；4）补充研究：Profound、Semrush、BrightEdge及同行评审比较审计。计算平台特定引用半衰期、月度轮换率、28天URL持久性统计，并识别引用频率和持久性的预测因素。
AI.findings: 1）AI平台引用中位半衰期为4.5周，ChatGPT最快（3.4周），Perplexity最慢（5.8周）；2）仅10.6%的URL能在28天内持续被引用；3）月度引用轮换率为40-60%；4）六个预测因素：品牌搜索量（相关系数0.334，最强预测因子）、原创研究内容（82%引用率）、第三方归因（比自我引用多6.5倍）、内容新鲜度（30天内更新页面在Perplexity上引用提升3.2倍）、Schema标记完整性和Bing网站管理员工具验证；5）识别四类波动原因：平台和模型更新、内容新鲜度衰减、竞争性置换和零引用响应出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将平台特定引用半衰期数据、28天URL持久性统计和月度轮换率整合为统一的引用波动性框架；2）首次识别品牌搜索量为AI引用可能性最强经验预测因子，其强度超过反向链接或技术信号；3）提出结构引用持久性框架，为理解AI引用波动提供了三维理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示AI引用本质上是频率问题而非一次性目标，需要持续投入内容刷新、引用监测和跨平台实体验证；2）为品牌提供了可操作的方案：将AI SEO从一次性技术实现转变为持续引用频率项目；3）提供平台特定的内容发布节奏建议（如30天内更新可显著提升Perplexity上的引用）；4）指出一次性技术实施会导致引用的设计性衰减，帮助品牌避免低效投入。

title: Building and Evaluating a Legal RAG Pipeline for the EU AI Act: From Embedding Selection to Evaluation Bias Quantification

detail.title: Building and Evaluating a Legal RAG Pipeline for the EU AI Act: From Embedding Selection to Evaluation Bias Quantification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This work was conducted independently, with no funding, sponsorship, or commercial relationship with any provider whose models, vector databases, or tools were evaluated (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Voyage AI, Alibaba Cloud, Cohere, Qdrant, Pinecone, MongoDB, Oracle, Supabase, n8n). We used publicly available free-tier allowances during experimentation; we computed all reported costs at published list prices, as described in Section 2.2.5.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants, animal subjects, or personal or identifiable data. The corpus consists exclusively of publicly available European Union regulatory documents and publicly published legal commentary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All infrastructure and API costs were borne by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a systematic methodology for building, optimising, and evaluating a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for legal question answering in accordance with the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act). Through three progressive evaluation phases comprising over 90 configurations, we identify an optimal pipeline combining gemini-embedding-001 embeddings, GPT-5-mini for response generation, and Anthropic's Contextual Retrieval enrichment, achieving 84.0% peak accuracy and 80.13% mean accuracy across 10 independent trials. The pipeline is fully orchestrated via n8n workflows, using Supabase/pgvector as the vector store. Key contributions include: a triple cross-checking cascade using three LLM families for synthetic FAQ validation with an absolute rejection criterion; a comparative evaluation of five vector databases showing negligible accuracy differences under controlled conditions; a concordance analysis revealing significant evaluator bias in LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks; and the identification and quantification of structural bias in expert-authored benchmarks, where approximately 34% of reference content is not derivable from the indexed corpus. We propose and empirically validate a normalisation methodology for RAGAS metrics that accounts for this structural ceiling, enabling fair interpretation of context recall and factual correctness in domain-specific evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套系统化的方法论，用于构建、优化和评估符合欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）的法律问答检索增强生成（RAG）管道。通过超过90种配置的三阶段渐进式评估，确定了最优管道组合（gemini-embedding-001嵌入、GPT-5-mini生成、Anthropic的Contextual Retrieval增强），达到84.0%峰值准确率和80.13%平均准确率。关键贡献包括三重交叉验证级联、五种向量数据库的对比评估、LLM评估者偏见分析，以及结构上限的识别与RAGAS指标归一化方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建、优化和评估一个符合欧盟AI法案要求的法律问答RAG管道？在领域特定评估中，如何解决结构偏差和评估者偏见所带来的指标失真问题？
AI.motivation: 法律领域的高风险性要求RAG系统满足严格的AI治理合规要求；同时，现有评估框架（如LLM-as-a-Judge和RAGAS指标）在领域特定场景中可能存在系统性偏差，需要识别并校正这些偏差以获得可靠的评估结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）管道架构理论；欧盟AI法案合规框架；LLM-as-a-Judge评估范式；RAGAS指标评估框架；结构上限理论（benchmark内容可推导性限制）。
AI.method: 三阶段渐进式评估（超过90种配置）；使用三种LLM家族进行合成FAQ验证的三重交叉检查级联（含绝对拒绝标准）；五种向量数据库的对比实验；LLM-as-a-Judge一致性分析；对专家编写基准的结构偏差量化分析（约34%参考内容不可从索引语料中推导）；RAGAS指标归一化方法论的提出与实证验证。
AI.findings: 最优管道组合（gemini-embedding-001 + GPT-5-mini + Contextual Retrieval）达到84.0%峰值准确率和80.13%平均准确率；五种向量数据库在受控条件下准确率差异可忽略；LLM-as-a-Judge框架中存在显著的评估者偏见；专家编写的基准中约34%的参考内容无法从索引语料库推导，形成评估的"结构天花板"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地量化了领域特定RAG评估中的结构天花板效应；提出并验证了RAGAS指标归一化方法论，使上下文召回率和事实正确性在领域特定情境下可公平解读；识别并量化了LLM-as-a-Judge框架中的评估者偏见。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了合规法律QA RAG管道的完整构建和优化方案（含具体技术选型）；建立了三重交叉验证级联方法用于合成FAQ验证；提供了向量数据库选型的实证依据；提出了可操作的RAGAS指标归一化方法，帮助实践者更准确地解读评估结果。

title: Energy Consumption Across the Generative Artificial Intelligence Lifecycle
affiliations: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Energy Consumption Across the Generative Artificial Intelligence Lifecycle
detail.abstract:
Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed digital systems, but its environmental impact has become an important concern. This study examines the energy consumption of generative AI by analysing its complete lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, deployment, and inference. Instead of focusing only on model training, this research highlights how each stage contributes to overall energy demand and carbon emissions.
The study shows that AI development requires significant computational resources, including large datasets, powerful hardware, storage systems, and electricity. Model training remains one of the most energy-intensive stages due to the use of advanced accelerators and long computational processes. However, the energy cost does not end after training. Continuous model deployment and large-scale user interactions can create substantial energy demands during inference.
This research further explores different strategies to reduce AI-related environmental impacts. These include improving data quality, reducing unnecessary data, managing dark data, selecting efficient models, using parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, optimizing hardware utilization, and improving inference efficiency. Such approaches can reduce unnecessary computation while maintaining model performance.
Overall, this study emphasizes that sustainable AI development requires a lifecycle-based approach rather than focusing on a single stage. Future AI systems should consider not only accuracy and performance but also energy efficiency and environmental responsibility. By adopting better technical practices and resource management strategies, the AI industry can move toward more sustainable and responsible innovation.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了生成式人工智能（AI）全生命周期的能源消耗与碳排放，涵盖数据准备、模型训练、微调、部署和推理各阶段。研究发现模型训练仍是能源最密集的环节，但推理阶段的持续部署和用户交互同样产生大量能耗。文章提出通过改进数据质量、采用参数高效微调、优化硬件利用率和推理效率等策略来降低环境影响，强调可持续AI发展需要基于全生命周期的系统性方法。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能在不同生命周期阶段的能源消耗和碳排放情况如何？以及应采取哪些策略来减少其环境影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已迅速改变数字系统，但其环境足迹日益受到关注。现有研究往往仅聚焦于模型训练阶段的能源消耗，忽视了推理、部署等其他生命周期阶段的能耗贡献，缺乏对全生命周期的系统性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究采用全生命周期分析方法（Lifecycle-based Approach），将生成式AI的能源消耗划分为数据准备、模型训练、微调、部署和推理五个关键阶段进行系统性审视。
AI.method: 本文采用生命周期分析框架，对生成式AI各阶段的能源需求与碳排放进行系统评估，并归纳比较多种减排策略的效果与适用性。
AI.findings: （1）模型训练由于使用先进加速器和长时间计算，仍是能源最密集的阶段；（2）模型部署和推理阶段的大规模用户交互同样产生显著能耗；（3）数据质量提升、减少无关数据、管理暗数据、选择高效模型、参数高效微调、优化硬件利用率和推理效率等策略可有效减少不必要的计算。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将研究视角从单一的训练阶段扩展至AI全生命周期，首次系统性地将推理和部署阶段纳入能耗评估框架，丰富了可持续AI研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为AI开发者和企业提供了贯穿全生命周期的可操作减排策略清单，包括数据管理、模型选择、硬件优化和推理效率提升等方面，为AI产业实现绿色可持续发展提供实践指导。

title: What is Tokenization, Really? A Structural Account of Registered Money and Control

detail.title: What is Tokenization, Really? A Structural Account of Registered Money and Control
detail.abstract:
Tokenization is commonly defined as the representation of assets on programmable platforms. It is also associated with faster or potentially 24/7 settlement and programmable payments. But that definition does not explain what tokenization changes architecturally to produce those benefits. This paper asks that question.

In conventional architectures, the institution maintaining monetary state also determines which external context can become operative against it. Users can program against a potentially rich but prearranged menu of controls.

Tokenization changes that relationship. An issuer’s claims Registry and rules operate on a shared external system, with monetary positions recorded under system-wide references. Under the same references, users can directly establish the conditions under which their authority becomes operative: their Control State.

Programmability itself is not the novelty. Even in conventional architectures, a program can observe external context and subsequently propose a payment. Tokenization instead allows users to establish commitments directly against their monetary positions and condition them on a wider range of contexts drawn from shared and user-introduced state. Doing so does not require the issuer first to incorporate every relevant source or condition into its own prearranged menu. What tokenization changes is who can make which contexts operative over money, and where.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了代币化的架构本质，指出其核心创新不在于可编程性本身，而在于改变了"谁"以及"在哪里"可以使外部情境对货币产生效力——即用户能够在共享外部系统上直接建立对其货币头寸的控制状态（Control State），而无需发行人预先将其纳入预设的控制菜单。
AI.research_question: 代币化在架构层面改变了什么，从而产生了更快或7×24小时结算及可编程支付等效益？
AI.motivation: 现有对代币化的定义仅停留在"资产在可编程平台上的表示"及"更快结算"等表面描述，未能解释其在架构层面究竟发生了什么变化以产生这些效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币架构理论、控制状态（Control State）概念、发行者登记册（Registry）与规则（Rules）的分离架构。
AI.method: 概念性/架构性分析：对比传统架构与代币化架构在货币状态维护、外部情境对货币头寸发挥效力方面的结构性差异。
AI.findings: 传统架构中，维护货币状态的机构决定哪些外部情境可以对其产生效力，用户只能在预设控制菜单内编程；代币化使发行者的注册表和规则运行在共享外部系统上，用户能在系统级引用下直接建立其控制权生效的条件（控制状态），且可基于共享及用户引入的状态条件化其货币头寸，无需发行人预先纳入相关情境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"控制状态"这一概念来精确定义代币化的架构创新，区分了"可编程性"与"代币化"的本质差异，将代币化的核心贡献定位于"谁能使何种情境对货币生效以及在哪里生效"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解代币化对支付系统、结算基础设施及货币发行架构的设计提供了架构层面的指导，有助于政策制定者和从业者更准确地定位代币化的价值及其对现有金融基础设施的影响。

title: Sustainability Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Data Centers Operations
affiliations: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Sustainability Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Data Centers Operations

keywords: Comparative carbon intensity of electricity generation
AI Water Use Across the Lifecycle

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) has become an important technology in modern digital systems, but its rapid growth has created new environmental challenges. This study examines the sustainability impacts of AI data centers by focusing on electricity consumption, carbon emissions, water use, and electronic waste. AI systems depend on large-scale data centers that require continuous power for servers, storage, networking, cooling, and advanced computing operations. As generative AI applications expand, these facilities create increasing pressure on global energy resources.
The study highlights that the environmental impact of AI data centers extends beyond electricity demand. The carbon footprint depends on both energy consumption and the source of electricity. Data centers powered by fossil fuels can generate higher emissions compared with those using renewable energy sources. In addition, cooling systems create significant water demands, while frequent hardware upgrades increase electronic waste and material consumption. This research also explores sustainable strategies to reduce the environmental burden of AI infrastructure. These strategies include improving energy efficiency, adopting cleaner electricity sources, developing advanced cooling technologies, managing water resources responsibly, extending hardware lifecycles, and strengthening recycling practices. Such approaches can support the continued growth of AI while reducing its ecological impact.
Overall, this study shows that AI sustainability requires a broader approach that considers energy, carbon, water, and material impacts together. Future AI development should not focus only on performance and innovation but also on environmental responsibility. Building efficient and sustainable data-center infrastructure will be essential for ensuring that AI growth remains reliable, practical, and environmentally responsible.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了AI数据中心的可持续性影响，涵盖电力消耗、碳排放、水资源使用和电子废弃物四大维度，并提出提高能效、采用清洁能源、先进冷却技术、水资源管理、延长硬件寿命和强化回收等可持续策略，主张AI发展应兼顾性能与环境责任。
AI.research_question: 人工智能数据中心的可持续性影响是什么？如何减轻AI基础设施对环境造成的负担？
AI.motivation: 人工智能技术快速发展带来数据中心规模扩张，对全球能源和环境造成日益增大的压力，但以往研究多聚焦AI性能与创新，对AI基础设施可持续性影响关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境可持续性理论，涵盖能源消耗、碳排放、水资源和电子废弃物等多维度环境影响评估框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与系统性分析，对AI数据中心的电力消耗、碳排放、用水量和电子废弃物进行多维度影响分析，并归纳可持续策略。
AI.findings: AI数据中心的环境影响包括持续电力需求、碳排放（取决于能源来源）、冷却系统的高耗水量以及频繁硬件升级产生的电子废弃物；可持续策略包括提升能效、采用可再生能源、先进冷却技术、水资源管理、延长硬件生命周期和强化回收。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI可持续性需要综合考量能源、碳、水和材料等多维影响的整体性框架，突破了仅关注单一环境维度的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据中心运营者、政策制定者和AI开发者在实践中实现环境友好型AI基础设施建设提供具体策略建议，助力AI发展兼顾环境责任。

title: Marketplace or Reseller? Optimal Platform Model under Disintermediation
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Marketplace or Reseller? Optimal Platform Model under Disintermediation
detail.abstract: This paper examines how a platform facing disintermediation (marketplace leakage) optimally deploys a hybrid business model that combines marketplace and reseller functions. We develop a game-theoretic framework featuring a monopolistic platform and an integrated supplier acting as a wholesaler to the platform and a retailer to consumers. Consumers who discover the supplier on the marketplace can bypass the platform and purchase from the supplier's direct channel, creating a leakage problem for the platform. Additionally, demand uncertainty exposes the platform to inventory risk, which prevents it from adopting a pure reseller mode. In equilibrium, the supplier sets a wholesale price such that the platform optimally deploys the hybrid model, balancing the risk-free marketplace mode and the higher-margin reseller mode. Notably, the platform's reseller intensity, measured by its equilibrium procurement quantity, exhibits an inverted-U relationship with consumers' leakage propensity: beyond a threshold, a worsening leakage problem shifts the platform back toward the marketplace mode. Extending the baseline analysis, we further examine scenarios in which the platform may implement a non-hybrid business model. In particular, the platform deviates to a pure reseller mode if the supplier can costlessly provide a product return policy, but prefers a pure marketplace mode when it can invest in transaction benefits at a sufficiently low cost or when it faces fierce supplier competition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了面临去中介化（市场泄漏）问题的平台如何最优地部署混合商业模式（同时包含市场和转售功能）。通过博弈论框架发现，供应商设定的批发价格使平台在无风险的市场模式和更高利润的转售模式之间取得平衡。平台转售强度与消费者泄漏倾向呈倒U型关系。在扩展分析中，平台在供应商可免费提供退货政策时转向纯转售模式，在投资交易收益成本足够低或面临激烈供应商竞争时偏好纯市场模式。
AI.research_question: 面临市场泄漏（去中介化）的平台应如何最优部署混合商业模式（市场模式与转售模式的组合）？在什么条件下平台会选择非混合的业务模式？
AI.motivation: 平台面临消费者绕过平台直接从供应商购买（去中介化）的问题，同时需求不确定性使平台面临库存风险，这使其无法采用纯转售模式。现有研究缺乏对平台在这两种模式间最优权衡的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架；涉及垄断平台与一体化供应商（同时作为平台批发商和消费者零售商）的博弈分析，结合需求不确定性下的库存风险建模。
AI.method: 构建包含垄断平台和一体化供应商的博弈论模型，分析均衡状态下平台的商业模式选择。
AI.findings: （1）平台在均衡中采用混合模式，平衡低风险市场模式和高利润转售模式；（2）平台转售强度与消费者泄漏倾向呈倒U型关系，超过阈值后泄漏问题恶化会使平台回归市场模式；（3）供应商可免费提供退货政策时平台转向纯转售模式；（4）平台能以足够低成本投资交易收益或面临激烈供应商竞争时偏好纯市场模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平台混合商业模式选择提供了理论分析框架，揭示了去中介化（泄漏）对平台商业模式决策的非线性影响，拓展了平台经济中关于市场模式与转售模式权衡的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了在面临消费者绕过平台（去中介化）时如何选择商业模式（混合模式、纯转售或纯市场）的决策参考，包括考虑退货政策、交易收益投资和供应商竞争等实际因素。

title: Small Models, Big Budgets: Open LLMs for Aligning Public Finance with the SDGs
affiliations: , United Nations Development Programme and

detail.title: Small Models, Big Budgets: Open LLMs for Aligning Public Finance with the SDGs
detail.abstract: Aligning public budgets with the Sustainable Development Goals requires detailed expenditure tagging, yet manual classification remains labour-intensive and difficult to sustain in resource-constrained administrations. This paper presents a local AI approach for automating SDG and national-development tagging of the Dominican Republic's budget using openly available large language models (LLMs). We propose a reproducible two-stage model selection procedure combining qualitative criteria-including Spanish-language support, local deployability, logit access, compact size, openness, and licensing-with quantitative evaluation against an expert-tagged benchmark. We also introduce a three-step prompting protocol and two output-distribution-based uncertainty measures. Qwen3 outperforms competing small models across multiple metrics and transfers robustly from SDG tagging to the National Development Strategy agenda, exceeding previously reported results from supervised-learning and LLM-based approaches. The findings show that small open LLMs can reduce tagging costs while supporting human review of uncertain cases and strengthening transparent, sustainable public financial management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种本地AI方法，利用开源大语言模型自动对多米尼加共和国预算进行SDG和国家发展战略标签标注。通过可复现的两阶段模型选择程序、三步提示协议和两种基于输出分布的不确定性度量，Qwen3在多个指标上优于其他小型模型，并超越了此前监督学习和基于LLM的方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用本地部署的开源大语言模型，实现对多米尼加共和国预算支出的SDG和国家发展战略自动化标签标注，同时保证可复现性、成本效益和人类审查支持？
AI.motivation: 将公共预算与可持续发展目标对接需要详细的支出标签标注，但人工分类劳动强度大，且在资源受限的行政机构中难以持续。需要一种自动化且可持续的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开源大语言模型（LLMs）的本地AI部署方法，结合两阶段模型选择框架（定性标准与定量评估），以及输出分布不确定性度量理论。
AI.method: 采用两阶段模型选择程序：(1)定性筛选标准（西班牙语支持、本地可部署性、logit访问、紧凑尺寸、开放性和许可）；(2)基于专家标注基准的定量评估。同时引入三步提示协议和两种基于输出分布的不确定性度量方法。
AI.findings: Qwen3在多个指标上优于竞争的小型模型，并能稳健地从SDG标签标注迁移到国家发展战略议程，超过了此前监督学习和基于LLM方法的结果。小型开源LLM可以降低标签标注成本，同时支持对不确定案例的人工审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可复现的两阶段模型选择程序和两步不确定性度量方法，为预算标签标注领域的LLM应用提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源受限的行政机构提供了本地可部署的AI预算标签标注方案，降低了SDG对齐的成本，增强了透明和可持续的公共财政管理。

title: The Billion-Dollar Bailout: How AI Licensing Replaced Copyright Litigation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Billion-Dollar Bailout: How AI Licensing Replaced Copyright Litigation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The era of scraping the internet for free is dead. Tech giants built generative AI empires on a legal gray area, hoovering up copyrighted texts under the guise of fair use. They called it machine learning. Media executives called it theft. Now, in 2026, the courts and regulators have finally caught up. This paper dissects the collapse of the tech industry's favorite legal defenses, the brutal multidistrict litigation between The New York Times and OpenAI, and the media industry's massive pivot from copyright crusaders to content toll collectors. But the licensing windfall hides a much darker reality. Publishers secured their intellectual property rights just in time to face the zero-click apocalypse.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2026年生成式AI行业版权法律范式的崩溃，聚焦《纽约时报》与OpenAI的多地区诉讼，以及媒体行业从版权维权者转变为内容授权收费者的过程，同时揭示授权收入背后隐藏的"零点击"危机。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI公司与媒体行业之间的版权争端如何重塑两者的法律与商业模式？媒体行业在赢得版权授权收入后，将面临怎样的深层危机？
AI.motivation: 科技巨头在"合理使用"掩护下大规模抓取受版权保护内容构建生成式AI模型，但随着2026年法院和监管机构的介入，这一法律灰色地带正在崩塌，亟需系统审视这一历史性转折及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合理使用原则（Fair Use Doctrine）、版权法、知识产权理论与媒体商业模式演变理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析（聚焦《纽约时报》诉OpenAI多地区诉讼）、行业动态追踪与政策分析。
AI.findings: 1）科技行业依赖的版权法律辩护（合理使用）正在全面崩溃；2）《纽约时报》与OpenAI的多地区诉讼代表了版权争端的激烈化；3）媒体行业从版权维权者转型为内容许可收费者；4）然而授权收入掩盖了"零点击"危机——读者不再通过点击链接访问内容，导致媒体面临更深层的商业模式困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生成式AI时代的版权法实践提供了新的案例研究，揭示法律滞后于技术发展时产生的制度性冲突，拓展了知识产权与AI技术交叉领域的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体行业生成式AI时代的生存策略提供警示，揭示单纯依赖内容授权收入而忽视用户流量获取的根本性风险；为政策制定者理解AI版权争端的复杂性提供参考。

title: Mission-critical Connectivity Resilience and SLA Governance

detail.title: Mission-critical Connectivity Resilience and SLA Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study did not involve human participants, personal data, clinical research, or animal subjects. The paper presents a conceptual framework and a generalized illustrative vignette.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Mission-critical enterprise sites depend on telecommunications connectivity for continuous financial, governmental, security, educational, and operational services. Yet resilience programs frequently equate redundancy with resilience and treat service-level agreement (SLA) compliance as an after-the-fact reporting exercise. This paper develops a practice-informed, design-science-based framework for governing end-to-end connectivity resilience across four interdependent layers: access-path diversity, radio-coverage diversity, site-power continuity, and customer-premises equipment readiness. The framework links these technical layers to four auditable outcomes—availability, mean time to restore, SLA compliance, and recurring-fault rate—and embeds them within critical-site classification, common-cause analysis, governed failover testing, and a temporary-to-permanent risk-treatment process. A generalized vignette illustrates how a multi-network router may provide controlled interim protection where permanent coverage or an independent fixed path is not immediately available. Eight testable propositions and a future empirical evaluation protocol are derived. The contribution is not a claim of measured performance improvement; rather, it is a transparent design artifact that connects architecture, operations, contractual evidence, and investment governance. The framework is intended for telecommunications operators, managed-service providers, banks, public-sector programs, and large distributed enterprises. It argues that temporary protection is legitimate only when its residual risk, owner, evidence, review date, and permanent exit path remain visible.

AI.tldr: 本文基于设计科学方法，开发了一个实践导向的端到端连接韧性治理框架，涵盖四个相互依赖的技术层（接入路径多样性、无线覆盖多样性、站点连续供电、客户驻地设备就绪性），并将其与四个可审计的结果（可用性、平均恢复时间、SLA合规性和重复故障率）相关联，嵌入关键站点分类、共因分析、受控故障转移测试以及临时至永久风险处理流程中。论文提出八个可检验命题和未来实证评估协议，主张临时保护仅在残余风险、责任方、证据、审查日期和永久退出路径保持可见时才具有合法性。
AI.research_question: 如何在关键型企业站点中建立一套实践知情、基于设计科学的端到端连接韧性治理框架，以系统性地管理电信连接韧性而非仅将其等同于冗余或SLA事后报告？
AI.motivation: 关键型企业站点（金融、政府、安全、教育等）严重依赖电信连接提供持续服务，但现有的韧性方案常常将冗余等同于韧性，并将SLA合规视为事后报告练习，缺乏将技术架构、运营、合同证据和投资治理相连接的系统性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学方法（design science）；韧性治理框架（resilience governance framework）；分层韧性模型（four interdependent layers）
AI.method: 基于设计科学的框架开发方法，通过实践信息构建框架，使用广义小插图（generalized vignette）说明多网络路由器的临时保护应用，推导出八个可检验命题和未来实证评估协议。
AI.findings: 论文提出一个四层技术框架（接入路径多样性、无线覆盖多样性、站点供电连续性、客户驻地设备就绪性），连接到四个可审计结果（可用性、平均恢复时间、SLA合规性、重复故障率），并嵌入关键站点分类、共因分析、受控故障转移测试和临时至永久风险处理流程。多网络路由器可在无法立即获得永久覆盖或独立固定路径时提供受控的临时保护。提出八个可检验命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个透明的设计工件（design artifact），将架构、运营、合同证据与投资治理连接起来，挑战了将冗余等同于韧性的简化观点，建立了韧性框架的治理维度，并提出了可检验的命题供后续实证研究验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信运营商、托管服务提供商、银行、公共部门项目和大型分布式企业提供了一套可操作的韧性治理框架；明确了临时保护的合法性条件（残余风险可见、责任方明确、证据存在、审查日期设定、永久退出路径清晰）；提供了关键站点分类、共因分析、受控故障转移测试等具体治理工具。

title: Commercial Credit Intelligence: A Framework for Enterprise Debt Portfolio Management

detail.title: Commercial Credit Intelligence: A Framework for Enterprise Debt Portfolio Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of LORIQ Technologies, which develops commercial credit intelligence technology related to concepts discussed in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Corporate borrowers manage an increasingly complex web of credit facilitiesterm loans, revolving lines, equipment financing, commercial real estate mortgages, and government-guaranteed programs-yet the tools available to them for managing that debt have lagged far behind the analytical infrastructure available to their lenders. While banks deploy sophisticated credit risk models, covenant surveillance systems, and portfolio analytics, the typical middle-market borrower monitors its own debt obligations through spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and institutional memory. This paper introduces Commercial Credit Intelligence as an emerging discipline: the systematic, borrower-side aggregation, monitoring, and analysis of an enterprise's complete debt portfolio and the financial information that supports it. We situate the discipline within the established literatures on financial covenants, creditor control rights, relationship lending, and corporate liquidity management, and we develop a conceptual framework organized around five capabilities: portfolio consolidation, covenant lifecycle management, financial information integrity, proactive risk surveillance, and capital structure decision support. We argue that the informational asymmetry traditionally analyzed in credit markets-lenders knowing less than borrowers about firm prospects-coexists with a second, underappreciated asymmetry: borrowers frequently know less than their lenders about the state, terms, and interactions of their own credit agreements. Technology platforms operating within this framework, of which LORIQ is one example, aim to close that second gap. We discuss implications for corporate treasury practice, covenant compliance, lender relationships, and the emerging role of artificial intelligence in borrower-side credit management, and we identify limitations and directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"商业信贷智能"（Commercial Credit Intelligence）这一新兴学科，即从借款人视角系统性地整合、监控和分析企业全部债务组合及其支撑性财务信息。文章将这一学科置于财务契约、债权人控制权、关系型贷款和企业流动性管理等已有文献中，构建了一个围绕五项核心能力的概念框架：投资组合整合、契约生命周期管理、财务信息完整性、主动风险监控和资本结构决策支持。文章核心论点是：信贷市场中除了传统认知的"贷方信息劣势"外，还存在一种被忽视的"第二重信息不对称"——借款人对其自身信贷协议的状态、条款和交互关系的了解，往往少于其贷款人。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地从借款人视角管理日益复杂的企业债务组合？商业信贷智能这一新兴学科的概念框架、理论基础与实践意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业借款人面临日益复杂的信贷工具组合（定期贷款、循环额度、设备融资、商业地产抵押贷款和政府担保项目），但管理这些债务的工具远落后于贷款人所拥有的分析基础设施。银行拥有复杂的信用风险模型、契约监控系统和组合分析工具，而典型的中端市场借款人仅靠电子表格、文件柜和机构记忆来监控自身债务，形成了被忽视的"第二重信息不对称"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文建立在以下文献基础上：财务契约（financial covenants）、债权人控制权（creditor control rights）、关系型贷款（relationship lending）和企业流动性管理（corporate liquidity management）。核心概念是"双重信息不对称"——除传统的"贷方对借款方前景了解较少"外，还存在"借款方对其自身信贷协议了解也少于贷方"的第二重不对称。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性/理论性研究方法，构建了商业信贷智能的概念框架，提出五项核心能力（portfolio consolidation, covenant lifecycle management, financial information integrity, proactive risk surveillance, capital structure decision support），并以LORIQ平台作为技术平台实例加以说明。
AI.findings: 本文识别出信贷市场中长期被忽视的"第二重信息不对称"：借款人对其自身信贷协议的状态、条款和交互关系的了解往往少于其贷款人。文章论证了技术平台（如LORIQ）能够在商业信贷智能框架内缩小这一信息差距，并探讨了对企业财资管理实践、契约合规、贷款人关系以及人工智能在借款方信贷管理中新兴角色的启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统上从贷方视角分析的信贷信息不对称问题翻转，提出并系统化了"借款人侧信息劣势"这一新概念；将分散在财务契约、债权人控制权、关系型贷款和流动性管理等多支文献中的洞见整合为一个统一的"商业信贷智能"学科框架；提出了五项能力维度作为该领域的概念支柱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业司库部门提供了系统化债务管理的能力框架与实施路径；为技术平台开发商（如LORIQ）明确了产品设计的概念基础；为企业改善契约合规、增强与贷款人谈判地位、优化资本结构决策提供了实践指导；指出了人工智能在借款方信贷管理中的潜在应用方向。

title: Connecting People and Spreading Ideas: Unraveling the Impact of Ride-Hailing on Knowledge Flows
affiliations: National University of Singapore,  and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Connecting People and Spreading Ideas: Unraveling the Impact of Ride-Hailing on Knowledge Flows
detail.abstract: This study examines how ride-hailing services affect localized knowledge flows among firms. Leveraging the staggered entry of Uber and Lyft across U.S. counties, we construct a panel dataset of within-city patent citations to measure interfirm knowledge flows. Using a difference-indifferences design, we find that the entry of ride-hailing services significantly increases local knowledge flows. Mechanism analyses using county-level traffic data and micro-level mobility data suggest that this effect operates through improved urban mobility: the entry of ride-hailing increases local traffic flows and facilitates opportunities for interactions across organizational boundaries. Consistent with this mechanism, we observe that the effect is stronger for firms that experience greater travel-time savings when using car-based transportation. Additional analyses show that ride-hailing entry disproportionately benefits firms with lower prior innovation output and fosters collaborative innovation. Overall, our findings indicate that, unlike physical infrastructure that creates new transportation links or relocates firms, ride-hailing platforms foster localized knowledge exchange and innovation by improving the use of existing urban transportation networks and enabling interpersonal interactions among geographically separated firms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国各县Uber和Lyft分批进入的时间差异，构建差分模型，发现网约车服务显著促进了企业间的本地知识流动，其机制在于改善了城市交通流动性，促进了跨组织边界的互动机会。
AI.research_question: 网约车服务如何影响企业间的本地知识流动？
AI.motivation: 以往研究关注物理交通基础设施（如新建交通线路或企业迁移）对知识流动的影响，但尚未考察网约车这类共享出行平台如何通过优化现有城市交通网络的使用来促进知识流动和创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市流动性理论、知识流动与创新的地理邻近性理论、组织边界互动理论
AI.method: 利用Uber和Lyft在美国各县分批进入的准自然实验，构建城市内专利引用的面板数据集，采用双重差分（DID）设计，并结合县级交通数据和微观出行数据进行机制检验。
AI.findings: 网约车进入显著增加了本地企业间的知识流动；机制上是通过提升城市交通流量和跨组织边界的互动机会实现的；效应在依赖汽车出行的企业中更强；对创新产出较低的企业有更大的促进效应，并促进了协作创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将网约车平台纳入知识流动与创新的研究中，揭示了共享出行平台作为一种新型"软性"交通基础设施，通过改善现有交通网络的使用效率促进本地知识交换的机制，拓展了交通条件影响创新的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通政策制定者提供了证据，表明除修建实体交通基础设施外，发展共享出行平台也是促进本地创新生态和知识交流的有效手段。

title:
From Event Labels to Transaction Topology: An RHIS Analysis of Enron Email 
A Blinded Same-Input Comparison with Human Event Judgments, Residual Mechanisms, and Transaction Basis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
From Event Labels to Transaction Topology: An RHIS Analysis of Enron Email 
A Blinded Same-Input Comparison with Human Event Judgments, Residual Mechanisms, and Transaction Basis
detail.abstract: Enterprise email rarely arrives pre-partitioned into transactions. A message may contain several matters, while one matter may extend across people, messages, attachments, calendars, and systems. This paper reports a mechanism pilot of the Refine Humanistic Intelligence System (RHIS) on public Enron email. The study compares an RHIS-driven AI model with released human annotations from MAILEX under a blinded, same-input protocol. Six threads were selected deterministically from 106 eligible MAILEX test threads without reading event labels. The model and the human gold standard were attached to the same 13 ordered turns comprising 976 tokens; headers, external Enron information, and gold examples were withheld. Predictions were frozen and hash-certified before the encrypted human labels were revealed. RHIS predicted 39 local events against 45 human events. Matching on turn and event type produced micro precision 0.564, recall 0.489, and F1 0.524; trigger-token overlap F1 was 0.325 and same-role argument-token overlap F1 was 0.332. These values evaluate compatibility with the MAILEX event ontology, not complete transaction-topology accuracy. Beyond local events, RHIS produced 36 evidence fragments, 17 transaction candidates, 16 relations, 27 unresolved-register items, and 16 right-censored transactions. Four of six threads contained multiple transaction candidates. Case analysis shows that disagreements are not a unitary error class. They combine ontology choice, event granularity, span convention, factual interpretation, and the treatment of social information. RHIS Analysis of Enron Email Working Paper RHIS Research Program The paper therefore introduces an RHIS-specific residual decomposition that distinguishes individual social attributes, common social rules, person-rule bindings, and meta-judgment rules. It defines a proposed social-disturbance invariant together with common-rule equivariance and binding-limited sensitivity. These concepts are post-hoc theoretical products of the pilot, not confirmatory findings. Their practical implication is a Transaction Basis Engine: a system that supplies traceable fact topology, applicable rules, verified authority bindings, unresolved conditions, and action qualifications rather than only a fluent conclusion. The pilot also demonstrates a hash-gated, goalbounded autonomous evaluation chain with no human-authored midcourse prompt before gold reveal.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了RHIS（Refine Humanistic Intelligence System）在公开Enron邮件数据集上的机制试点研究。在盲法、同输入协议下，将RHIS驱动的AI模型与MAILEX人工标注进行比较。模型在6个测试线程上预测了39个本地事件（人工为45个），微F1为0.524。研究还提出了一种残差分解方法，区分社会属性、公共规则、人-规则绑定和元判断规则，并引入社会扰动不变性、公共规则等变性和绑定有限敏感性等理论概念，以及事务基础引擎的实际应用。
AI.research_question: 企业电子邮件中的事务如何被AI模型自动识别和解析，以及RHIS系统预测的事件结构与人工标注的兼容程度如何？
AI.motivation: 企业邮件很少预先划分事务边界，一条消息可能包含多个事项，一个事项可能跨越多个人、消息、附件、日历和系统。现有研究缺乏对AI模型与人工事务标注兼容性的系统性评估，需要一种严格的方法来验证AI在盲审条件下的事务识别能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: RHIS残差分解框架：区分个体社会属性、共同社会规则、人-规则绑定和元判断规则；提出社会扰动不变性（social-disturbance invariant）、公共规则等变性（common-rule equivariance）和绑定有限敏感性（binding-limited sensitivity）三个理论概念。
AI.method: 从106个符合条件的MAILEX测试线程中确定性选取6个线程，模型与人工金标准在相同13个有序轮次（共976个token）上运行，隐藏邮件头、外部Enron信息和金标准示例。预测结果在加密人工标签揭示前冻结并哈希认证，采用盲法、同输入对照协议。
AI.findings: RHIS预测39个本地事件（人工为45个）；按轮次和事件类型匹配，微精确率0.564、召回率0.489、F1=0.524；触发器token重叠F1=0.325，同角色参数token重叠F1=0.332。此外生成36个证据片段、17个事务候选、16个关系、27个未解析登记项和16个右删失事务。6个线程中4个含多个事务候选。分歧并非单一错误类型，而是本体选择、事件粒度、跨度约定、事实解释和社会信息处理等因素的组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了RHIS特有的残差分解框架，区分社会属性的个体性、规则的公共性及其绑定关系；首次提出社会扰动不变性、公共规则等变性和绑定有限敏感性三个形式化概念；这些是试点后验理论产物，而非确证性发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出事务基础引擎（Transaction Basis Engine）：提供可追溯的事实拓扑、适用规则、验证的权威绑定、未解析条件和行动限定，而非仅给出流畅结论；展示了哈希门控、目标受限的自主评估链，在揭示金标准前无人工中途提示。

title: The AI-Ready Data Diagnostic (ARDD): A Maturity Assessment Model for the Data Foundation of Enterprise AI

detail.title: The AI-Ready Data Diagnostic (ARDD): A Maturity Assessment Model for the Data Foundation of Enterprise AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: The author developed the artefact described in this paper, is in practice its most likely assessor, and may deliver advisory work of the kind a low score would recommend; section 6.3 names the structural form this interest takes for any assessor, and section 8.1 states why it is sharpened here.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Organisations are committing capital to artificial intelligence faster than their data can support it, and existing instruments do not measure the gap directly: they treat data as one factor among several, or address only part of what an AI-ready data foundation requires at organisational scale. This paper reports the first cycle of a design-science artefact built to close that gap: the AI-Ready Data Diagnostic (ARDD), a maturity assessment model for the data foundation of enterprise AI. ARDD decomposes that foundation into nine independently scored dimensions, scored against the organisation's named priority use cases and aggregated through a non-compensatory floor rather than an averaged index, so that the reported band is set by the weakest dimension of the weakest use case, alongside two further scored dimensions, activation readiness and delegated authority, excluded from the index and the floor because neither measures the state of the data itself: each bridges the data foundation to the governance that acts on it. It was derived bottomup from practice and the data management literature, then revised against six reference frameworks and standards. It is evaluated by a coverage mapping run in both directions against seven references, showing where its dimensions correspond to concerns the field already names and what each omits. No empirical validation of ARDD has been carried out: no inter-assessor reliability study, no field application, and no convergent-validity comparison against an existing instrument, and the mapping itself checks content validity, not measurement performance.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了AI就绪数据诊断（ARDD）设计科学工具的第一个迭代周期。ARDD是一个成熟度评估模型，将企业AI的数据基础分解为九个独立评分维度，针对组织指定的优先用例评分，并通过非补偿性下限（而非平均指数）聚合，同时排除两个桥接数据与治理的维度。该工具从实践和数据管理文献中自下而上推导，并对照六项参考框架修订，通过双向覆盖映射对七项参考进行评估。论文坦承尚无实证验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够直接衡量组织AI就绪数据基础（AI-ready data foundation）差距的成熟度评估模型？
AI.motivation: 组织在AI上的资本投入速度超过了其数据支撑能力，而现有工具要么将数据视为众多因素之一，要么只覆盖AI就绪数据基础在组织规模上所需的部分内容，缺乏直接衡量该差距的测量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学（Design Science）方法；成熟度评估模型（Maturity Assessment Model）；数据管理文献；覆盖映射（Coverage Mapping）
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法：从实践和数据管理文献中自下而上推导ARDD维度，再对照六项参考框架和标准进行修订；通过双向覆盖映射对七项参考文献进行评估，检验内容效度。
AI.findings: ARDD将企业AI数据基础分解为九个独立评分维度，以组织命名优先用例为评分对象，通过非补偿性下限（最弱维度决定报告等级）聚合；另有激活就绪度和委派权限两个附加维度被排除在指数和下限之外，因为它们衡量的是数据与治理的桥接而非数据本身状态。双向覆盖映射显示ARDD维度与领域已有关注点的对应关系及各参考框架的遗漏。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将企业AI数据基础分解为九维度、采用非补偿性下限聚合的成熟度评估框架，并明确区分数据本身状态维度与数据-治理桥接维度，为AI就绪数据评估提供了新的概念化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了直接衡量AI数据基础差距的诊断工具原型，帮助组织识别最薄弱的数据维度，从而有针对性地进行数据基础建设投资。

reference: Journal of Research, Innovation, and Strategies for Education (RISE), volume 3, issue 4, 2026[10.70148/rise.v3i4.9]
title: Digital Divide and Educational Inequality in Asia: A Cross-Country Secondary Data Analysis of Connectivity, Access, and Student Achievement
affiliations: and National University– Manila

detail.title: Digital Divide and Educational Inequality in Asia: A Cross-Country Secondary Data Analysis of Connectivity, Access, and Student Achievement

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study adhered to ethical standards for secondary data research. All data used in the analysis were obtained from publicly available and reputable institutional sources, including the World Bank, OECD PISA, and the International Telecommunication Union(ITU). The datasets are aggregated at the country level and do not contain personally identifiable information. As such, the study posed no risk to human participants and did not require formal ethical approval. Proper citation and acknowledgment of all data sources were maintained to ensure transparency, integrity, and responsible use of data.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Research, Innovation, and Strategies for Education (RISE), volume 3, issue 4, 2026[10.70148/rise.v3i4.9]

detail.abstract: The increasing reliance on digital technologies in education has intensified concerns regarding unequal access to digital resources across countries, particularly in developing regions. While digital connectivity has the potential to enhance learning opportunities, disparities in internet access and technological infrastructure may contribute to unequal educational outcomes. This study examines the relationship between the digital divide and educational inequality in Asia through a crosscountry secondary data analysis of connectivity, access, and student achievement. Using publicly available datasets from the World Bank, the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), and the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the study analyzes key indicators of internet access, digital infrastructure, student achievement, and educational inequality across selected Asian countries. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and multiple regression models were employed to examine structural associations among variables. The results indicate that internet access is positively associated with student achievement and negatively associated with educational inequality. Digital infrastructure also demonstrates positive associations with educational performance and lower levels of inequality. In contrast, rural population is negatively associated with student achievement and positively associated with educational inequality. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of digital connectivity and technological capacity in shaping both the quality and equity dimensions of education systems across diverse national contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过跨国二手数据分析，考察了亚洲国家数字鸿沟与教育不平等之间的关系，发现互联网接入和数字基础设施与学生成绩正相关、与教育不平等负相关，而农村人口比例则相反。
AI.research_question: 数字鸿沟（互联网接入、数字基础设施）与教育不平等之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 教育领域对数字技术的依赖日益增加，但不同国家（尤其是发展中地区）在数字资源获取上存在不平等，这种数字鸿沟可能加剧教育结果的不平等，需要系统性的跨国研究来揭示其关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字鸿沟理论（Digital Divide Theory），涉及技术接入层面和数字基础设施层面。
AI.method: 跨国二手数据分析：使用世界银行、OECD和ITU的公开数据集，采用描述性统计、相关分析和多元回归模型，分析亚洲多国互联网接入、数字基础设施、学生成绩与教育不平等之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）互联网接入与学生成绩正相关，与教育不平等负相关；（2）数字基础设施与教育表现正相关，与不平等水平负相关；（3）农村人口比例与学生成绩负相关，与教育不平等正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字鸿沟理论提供了亚洲跨国实证证据，揭示数字鸿沟在教育和公平两个维度上的结构性影响，拓展了数字鸿沟与教育不平等关系的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，强调提升数字连接和技术基础设施对改善教育质量与促进教育公平的重要性，尤其对农村地区具有政策启示。

title: Strategic Format Choice Under Mandatory Machine-Readable Disclosure: Evidence and Theory from Hospital Price Transparency
affiliations: and

detail.title: Strategic Format Choice Under Mandatory Machine-Readable Disclosure: Evidence and Theory from Hospital Price Transparency
detail.abstract: Every United States hospital must disclose its negotiated prices in a common, machine-readable schema, yet federal auditors find over a third of sampled hospitals noncompliant and cannot confirm the files' usability. This paper models a choice the schema leaves open: report a negotiated rate as a plain dollar figure or as a percentage or algorithm with statistics summarizing its variation. A game-theoretic model shows the optimal format follows a single complexity threshold, its rent disciplined by the dispersion statistics required alongside it. When file production is delegated to a shared compliance platform, whether a hospital's strategic behavior remains visible in its disclosure depends on the platform, a joint product of vendor design and client sorting, not the hospital alone. Two collection waves over a national earlyadopter sample (195 and 299 hospitals) show both patterns: vendor and corporate platforms account for 75.4 and 86.3 percent of the waves by headcount, several show near-zero crosshospital dispersion, one corporate template withholds dollars for two thirds of its rates across 92 facilities, and one vendor's template reveals real hospital-specific complexity while codisclosing dollars. The paper contributes a mandatory-disclosure model whose only strategic margin is format, a boundary condition under which a shared platform's design determines whether the firm-level mechanism remains observable, a welfare analysis showing equilibrium format choice is socially excessively opaque, with a closed-form corrective penalty, and exploratory early-adopter evidence quantifying how much of a live mandate's observed variation is a property of the disclosure software rather than of the regulated entity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国医院价格透明化法规（要求医院公开协商价格）中，医院在信息披露格式上的策略性选择。研究发现医院选择以普通美元数字或带统计摘要的百分比/算法格式报告价格，其最优格式遵循一个复杂度阈值。当披露文件生产外包给共享合规平台时，医院策略行为是否可见取决于平台设计。基于两轮全国早期采用者样本（195和299家医院）的实证证据表明，观察到的价格披露变异很大程度上是披露软件（平台）的属性，而非被监管实体本身。
AI.research_question: 在强制性价格披露监管下，医院如何策略性地选择披露格式（美元数字 vs. 百分比/算法形式），以及当披露生产委托给共享合规平台时，医院层面的策略行为是否仍然可观察？
AI.motivation: 美国联邦审计发现超过三分之一的抽样医院不合规，且无法确认文件可用性。监管法规在格式上留有选择空间——医院可以选择以普通美元数字或带统计摘要的百分比/算法形式报告协商价格，这为策略性披露提供了新的边际。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型：分析医院在披露格式选择上的策略行为，包括复杂度阈值、租金约束（由离散度统计约束）、以及共享平台作为联合产物（供应商设计与客户端排序）的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论模型）+ 两轮全国性早期采用者样本的实证分析（195家和299家医院），考察供应商和企业平台的市场份额、跨医院离散度、以及模板特征。
AI.findings: 厂商和公司平台分别占两轮样本的75.4%和86.3%的人数份额；多个平台显示接近零的跨医院离散度；一个公司模板在92家设施中对其三分之二的费率隐瞒美元数字；一个厂商模板在同时披露美元的情况下揭示了真实的医院特定复杂度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个唯一策略边际为格式的强制披露模型；界定了一个边界条件——共享平台的设计决定企业层面机制是否可观察；福利分析表明均衡格式选择在社会上过度不透明，并给出了闭式修正惩罚。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了早期采用者的探索性证据，量化了现行法规中观察到的变异有多少是披露软件的属性而非被监管实体的属性，为监管者审核合规性和改善价格透明政策提供依据。

title: Agentic AI and Autonomous Decision-making Systems: Architectures, Trust, Accountability, and Governance for Responsible Machine Autonomy

detail.title: Agentic AI and Autonomous Decision-making Systems: Architectures, Trust, Accountability, and Governance for Responsible Machine Autonomy
detail.abstract: Agentic AI is ushering in a new era of autonomous decision-making and action, moving beyond prediction, classification, and recommendation to digital systems that can plan, reason, act on the digital environment, and execute actions on their own (Kolt, 2025; Raza et al., 2026). This article aims to explore this shift through a conceptual synthesis of the research literature and a structured review of key conceptual ideas, focusing on agent architectures, autonomous decision processes, human-AI interaction, explainability and accountability, privacy, cyber security and governance trends, among others, published over the last 6 years (2021-2026). Five main findings are identified as a result of the synthesis. Agentic AI is a vast addition to the existing AI landscape because agents are able to break down goals into a series of steps, instead of just recommendations (Kolt, 2025; Raza et al., 2026). Second, the performance of autonomous decisions is not only dependent upon the intelligence of the model, but also on the ability to integrate reliable data, maintain persistent memory, plan, use external tools, interact with the environment and obtain feedback. Third, greater autonomy brings novel accountability and responsibility gaps as decision-making power can be spread among human operators, AI agents, data sources, models and technological infrastructures (Santoni de Sio & Mecacci, 2021). Fourth, humans are still needed, especially in a high-impact or consequential decision space (Popa & Rothkrantz, 2021; Alon-Barkat & Busuioc, 2023). Fifth, the trustworthiness, the explainability, the privacy, the security and the governance of the system should be part of the agent architectures in their design, not an afterthought as a post-deployment control (Walmsley, 2021). The results thus show an inherent contradiction in the shape of the greater the autonomy, the more accountability mechanisms are required. The responsible and autonomous approach to decision-making should not aim for full dehumanization of the decision-making process, but should be based on a model of controlled autonomy in which agents make autonomous decisions within specific boundaries and escalation mechanisms, auditability, transparency and human accountability are retained (Alon-Barkat & Busuioc, 2023; Santoni de Sio & Mecacci, 2021). The solution offers a starting point for adopting agentic AI and maintaining operational independence while adhering to responsible governance principles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概念综合和结构化文献综述，系统探讨了代理式AI（Agentic AI）在2021-2026年间的研究进展，识别出五大关键发现，并指出自主性与问责机制之间存在内在矛盾，提出"受控自主"（controlled autonomy）模型作为负责任的决策框架。
AI.research_question: 代理式AI如何从根本上改变AI在自主决策与行动中的角色？其核心架构、决策过程及治理挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 代理式AI正从预测、分类和推荐转向自主规划、推理和行动的数字系统，这一转变带来新的机会与治理挑战，亟需对现有文献进行系统梳理和概念综合，以理解其全貌并指导负责任的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念综合方法（conceptual synthesis of research literature）；结构化文献综述（structured review of key conceptual ideas）；责任分散理论（accountability gaps across human operators, AI agents, data sources, models and infrastructures）；受控自主模型（controlled autonomy model）
AI.method: 对2021-2026年间发表的研究文献进行概念综合与结构化综述，聚焦代理架构、自主决策过程、人机交互、可解释性与问责、隐私、网络安全和治理趋势等主题。
AI.findings: 五大核心发现：1）代理式AI是现有AI领域的重大扩展，因代理能将目标分解为一系列步骤；2）自主决策性能不仅依赖模型智能，还依赖可靠数据整合、持久记忆、规划、外部工具使用、环境交互和反馈获取；3）更大自主性带来新型问责与责任缺口，决策权分散于多方主体；4）人类在高影响或重大决策空间中仍然不可或缺；5）可信度、可解释性、隐私、安全和治理应内嵌于代理架构设计中而非事后追加控制。此外，研究揭示了"自主性越大，问责机制需求越强"的内在矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"受控自主"（controlled autonomy）决策模型，强调代理在特定边界和升级机制内做自主决策，同时保留可审计性、透明度和人类问责，为代理式AI的负责任设计提供了理论框架；系统整合了2021-2026年间多学科文献，填补了代理式AI概念化研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织采用代理式AI提供了起点性指导，帮助其在保持运营自主性的同时遵守负责任治理原则；明确了治理和安全机制应从设计阶段就嵌入代理架构，而非部署后的补充控制；为高影响决策领域的从业者提供了人机协同的边界设定参考。

title: The Enterprise AI Culture Playbook
affiliations: The Digital Economist

detail.title: The Enterprise AI Culture Playbook
detail.abstract:
Eighty-eight percent of organizations now use AI. Yet only 6 percent can demonstrate measurable financial returns from their investments.
Why are so many companies investing in AI while so few are creating value?
The Enterprise AI Culture Playbook answers that question with a research-backed framework built for CEOs, board directors, and executive leaders navigating enterprise transformation. Drawing on findings from McKinsey, Boston Consulting Group, Harvard Business Review, PwC, Prosci, WRITER, and Informatica, Sandy Carter reveals the three pillars that consistently separate AI leaders from AI laggards: Change Management, Data Foundation, and Business Outcome Discipline.
Through real-world examples from Qualcomm, JPMorgan Chase, and Walmart, the playbook demonstrates how organizations can move beyond experimentation and build the culture, governance, and operating discipline required to scale AI successfully.
The paper also introduces AI Hollowing, a new organizational risk in which companies cut institutional knowledge in pursuit of AI efficiency, weakening their ability to realize AI value in the process.
The next phase of AI competition will not be won by organizations with the most advanced models. It will be won by organizations that master the 70 percent of transformation that technology alone cannot solve.
The question is no longer whether your company is investing in AI.
The question is whether it will join the 6 percent who win.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"企业AI文化剧本"框架，基于麦肯锡、BCG、哈佛商业评论等机构的研究发现，识别出区分AI领导者与落后者的三大支柱：变革管理、数据基础和业务成果纪律。通过高通、摩根大通和沃尔玛等真实案例，展示了企业如何超越实验阶段，构建规模化AI成功所需的文化、治理和运营纪律。文章还引入"AI空心化"这一新概念，指企业在追求AI效率过程中削减机构知识而削弱自身实现AI价值能力的组织风险。
AI.research_question: 为什么88%的组织在使用AI，但只有6%能展示可衡量的财务回报？哪些关键因素区分了AI领导者与落后者？
AI.motivation: 大量企业在AI上投入巨资却鲜有创造实际价值，CEO、董事会和高级管理者在AI转型中缺乏可操作的研究支撑框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变革管理理论、数据基础能力理论、业务成果纪律理论，以及"AI空心化"这一新提出的组织风险概念。
AI.method: 基于McKinsey、BCG、HBR、PwC、Prosci、WRITER和Informatica等多家机构的研究发现进行综合提炼，结合高通、摩根大通和沃尔玛等企业的真实案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 持续区分AI领导者与落后者的三大支柱是：变革管理、数据基础和业务成果纪律。AI竞争的下一个阶段将由掌握技术无法解决的70%转型部分（即文化和组织层面）的组织获胜。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"AI空心化"这一新的组织风险概念，描述企业在追求AI效率时削减机构知识从而削弱AI价值实现能力的现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CEO、董事会成员和高管提供基于研究支撑的企业AI转型框架，通过真实案例展示如何构建规模化AI所需的文化、治理和运营纪律。

title: AI Alignment with Human Preferences
affiliations: The Digital Economist

detail.title: AI Alignment with Human Preferences
detail.abstract:
AI Alignment with Human Preferences examines how the rapid advancement of generative AI and large language models has intensified the need to align AI systems with human values, intentions, and societal expectations. Written by Manas Talukdar, the paper surveys the evolving landscape of AI alignment research, tracing both the technical foundations of alignment methodologies and the ethical, governance, and operational challenges associated with integrating human preferences into AI systems. Drawing from academic literature and industry practice, it explores key approaches including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), direct preference optimization (DPO), constitutional AI, and human-in-the-loop systems, while analyzing their trade-offs in scalability, performance, safety, and implementation complexity.

The paper argues that AI alignment is not solely a technical optimization problem, but a broader socio-technical challenge involving questions of value representation, accountability, fairness, cultural relativism, privacy, and long-term societal impact. It highlights how the growing scarcity of high-quality training data has elevated the importance of human feedback and expert judgment in shaping next-generation AI systems. At the same time, it examines emerging risks such as reward hacking, distribution shift, adversarial manipulation, value lock-in, and scalable oversight limitations, positioning alignment as a critical frontier for the safe deployment of increasingly capable AI systems.

Intended for researchers, policymakers, technologists, and industry practitioners, the paper provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of AI alignment while identifying future research directions in mechanistic interpretability, adaptive alignment, multi-agent systems, governance frameworks, and aligned AGI development. Rather than presenting a single dominant solution, the paper concludes that effective alignment will likely depend on combining multiple methodologies within carefully designed institutional, technical, and ethical frameworks capable of evolving alongside increasingly advanced AI capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI对齐与人类偏好研究的现状，涵盖监督微调、RLHF、DPO、宪法AI和人机协同等方法的权衡，并论证AI对齐不仅是技术优化问题，更是涉及价值表征、问责、公平、文化相对主义等的社会技术挑战，提出有效对齐依赖于多种方法在制度、技术和伦理框架内的综合运用。
AI.research_question: AI系统如何与人类价值观、意图和社会期望对齐？当前对齐方法的技术基础与伦理治理挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和大语言模型的快速发展加剧了AI系统与人类价值观对齐的紧迫性，同时高质量训练数据日益稀缺，使人类反馈和专家判断的重要性上升，需要全面审视AI对齐的研究现状与未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论视角，将AI对齐视为涉及价值表征、问责、公平、文化相对主义、隐私和长期社会影响的多维度挑战，而非单纯的技术优化问题。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合学术文献与行业实践，对监督微调、RLHF、DPO、宪法AI和人机协同等对齐方法进行比较分析，评估其在可扩展性、性能、安全性和实施复杂性方面的权衡。
AI.findings: AI对齐不存在单一主导解决方案；有效对齐需依赖多种方法在制度、技术和伦理框架内的综合运用；新兴风险包括奖励黑客、分布漂移、对抗操纵、价值锁定和可扩展监督限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI对齐从纯技术问题重新定位为社会技术挑战，系统梳理了多种对齐方法的技术权衡，并识别了价值锁定、可扩展监督等前沿理论问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、政策制定者、技术人员和行业从业者提供AI对齐的全面概览，指出未来研究方向（机械可解释性、自适应对齐、多智能体系统、治理框架和对齐AGI开发），为AI安全部署提供实践指引。

title: Marketplace Integration and Rating Inflation: Evidence from Online Review Platforms
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong,  and University of Wisconsin-Madison - Wisconsin School of Business

detail.title: Marketplace Integration and Rating Inflation: Evidence from Online Review Platforms
detail.abstract: Online review platforms may monetize their user bases through marketplace integration, allowing brands to sell products directly through the platform. Such marketplace integration may affect reviews through two channels: by creating direct commercial incentives for manipulation and through changes in the composition of contributors. This study examines how marketplace integration through product onboarding affects product reviews. We examine these mechanisms on a leading K-beauty review platform that introduced a transaction marketplace. Leveraging the staggered onboarding of products for sale and granular review and clickstream data, we estimate the effects of product onboarding on subsequent review generation. We find that product onboarding increases review volume and inflates average ratings. Also, new reviews are less informative: they are shorter, contain fewer photos, and are written with less effort. We find no evidence that rating inflation results from seller manipulation, platform-led solicitation through product trials, or reviews by verified purchasers. Instead, onboarding changes who contributes reviews. It attracts more first-time and non-dedicated reviewers while reducing the share of dedicated, experienced reviewers. Because first-time reviewers tend to give higher ratings than dedicated reviewers, this compositional shift produces aggregate rating inflation. Our findings highlight an important consequence of marketplace integration: it can reshape user participation, leading to higher aggregate ratings and less informative reviews even in the absence of manipulation by sellers or the platform.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用韩国美妆评论平台引入交易市场的准自然实验，发现产品上架（marketplace integration）会通过改变评论者构成而非操纵行为，导致评论数量增加、平均评分虚高、评论信息量下降。
AI.research_question: 在线评论平台引入市场交易功能（marketplace integration）后，产品上架如何影响后续的产品评论产生？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在线评论平台越来越多地通过市场化整合实现变现，但这一商业行为可能通过两条渠道影响评论：（1）直接商业激励导致的操纵；（2）评论者构成的改变。现有研究尚未厘清这两条渠道的相对作用，且缺乏对市场化整合如何重塑用户参与模式的系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评论操纵理论（商业激励渠道）与评论者构成变化理论（参与者异质性渠道），结合平台生态系统与用户参与的相关理论。
AI.method: 利用韩国领先美妆评论平台引入交易市场的准自然实验，采用交错式产品上架（staggered onboarding）设计，结合细粒度评论数据和点击流数据（clickstream data），估计产品上架对后续评论生成的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）产品上架增加了评论数量并抬高了平均评分；（2）新评论信息含量降低：更短、照片更少、撰写努力更少；（3）评分虚高并非源于卖家操纵、平台主导的产品试用征集或已验证买家的评论；（4）上架改变了评论者构成：吸引更多首次评论者和非专职评论者，同时减少专职资深评论者的比例；（5）由于首次评论者往往比专职评论者给出更高评分，这种构成性转变产生了总体评分虚高。
