title: US vs. China, Round Two: China's Shifting AI and Supply Chain Strategy and Korea's Response

detail.title: US vs. China, Round Two: China's Shifting AI and Supply Chain Strategy and Korea's Response

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/MER/07/01
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
US-China competition has moved past its first round, a contest of trade and technology pressure fought over tariffs and core technologies, and is evolving into a race to capture the global AI ecosystem of the physical AI era and to set the standards for industrial architecture. China is pursuing three shifts in its AI and supply chain strategy. First, as the effectiveness of US export controls erodes, it is building both leverage over demand markets and a semiconductor ecosystem of its own. Second, as the only country that covers every branch of industry in the UN industrial classification, it is applying AI to upgrade even its traditional manufacturing sector, turning manufacturing as a whole into a strategic asset. Third, it is using physical AI to extend its manufacturing and process-based standards worldwide. 

The second round of this competition calls for a Korean response that goes beyond a defensive diversification of supply chains. That response should center on three lines of action: building a K-manufacturing architecture that vertically integrates chokepoint assets with a manufacturing large language model (LLM) trained on the judgment data of demanding production processes; upgrading the K-materials industry by applying AI to traditional flagship industries; and pursuing the architectural assetization of K-manufacturing by binding Korea's separate strengths in technology, production capacity, standards, and shop-floor data into a single asset system. The indispensable assets developed in this way should in turn support deeper strategic partnerships, ones in which Korea participates in the technology ecosystems of major economies as a co-designer rather than a component supplier.

This paper was translated from the original Korean using the Claude Opus 5 large language

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美中竞争已从关税和核心技术领域的第一轮博弈，演变为围绕物理AI时代全球AI生态系统和工业架构标准的第二轮竞争。中国正通过三大战略转型（构建自主半导体生态、用AI升级传统制造业、以物理AI输出制造标准）重塑全球产业格局。文章提出韩国应以三大行动路线应对：构建纵向整合K-制造架构（结合瓶颈资产与制造大语言模型）、用AI升级K-材料等行业、实现K-制造的架构资产化，从而从组件供应商转变为技术生态的共同设计者。
AI.research_question: 美中竞争进入以物理AI生态系统和工业架构标准为核心的第二轮竞争后，韩国应如何制定超越防御性供应链多元化的应对战略？
AI.motivation: 美中竞争已从关税和核心技术的压力竞争转向争夺物理AI时代全球AI生态系统和工业架构标准设定权的竞争。中国正在实施三大战略转型（杠杆化需求市场、AI升级传统制造业、物理AI输出标准），对韩国构成重大战略挑战，亟需提出超越被动防御的应对方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于地缘经济竞争理论、产业架构理论（architectural assetization）、以及AI赋能制造业的技术经济范式转型视角，分析大国竞争与产业生态重构之间的关系。
AI.method: 本文为战略分析类论文，采用案例比较和战略推演方法，分析中国AI与供应链战略的三大转型方向，并据此推导韩国的应对策略框架。
AI.findings: （1）中国正通过三大转型抢占物理AI时代竞争优势：利用美出口管制效力衰减构建需求市场杠杆和自主半导体生态；作为唯一覆盖联合国工业分类全部门的国家，以AI升级传统制造业使制造成为战略资产；以物理AI将制造和工艺标准推广至全球。（2）韩国需以三大行动路线应对：构建K-制造架构，纵向整合瓶颈资产与基于高要求生产流程判断数据训练的大语言模型；以AI升级K-材料等传统旗舰产业；通过将技术、产能、标准和车间数据绑定为单一资产系统实现K-制造的架构资产化。（3）由此形成的不可或缺资产应支撑韩国作为共同设计者而非组件供应商参与主要经济体的技术生态系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了"架构资产化"（architectural assetization）这一概念，将技术、生产容量、标准和现场数据绑定为单一资产系统，拓展了产业架构理论在AI时代地缘经济竞争中的应用；同时将物理AI与传统制造业升级纳入大国竞争的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国提供了超越防御性供应链多元化的三大战略行动路线：K-制造架构的纵向整合、K-材料产业的AI升级、K-制造的架构资产化，并指明了韩国从组件供应商转向生态系统共同设计者的路径选择。

title: The Golden Era’s Guide To Entrepreneurship
affiliations: , 36N9 GENETICS LLC and 36N9 GENETICS LLC

detail.title: The Golden Era’s Guide To Entrepreneurship

declarations.funderStatement: 36N9 GENETICS LLC Glen Arthur Vickery

detail.abstract:
This manual establishes a comprehensive architectural methodology for global corporate structuring, moving beyond conventional tax-haven heuristics to treat multi-jurisdictional design as a rigorous engineering discipline. Focusing on the composition rules that govern legal systems, vehicles, and financial rails, the text introduces the Multiplexing Doctrine—a analytical framework demonstrating that nominal entity or jurisdictional counts frequently overstate real structural independence.

The work develops a quantitative taxonomy for evaluating international structures, utilizing the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) to measure jurisdictional concentration on both a naive basis and a bloc-collapsed, stress-tested basis. It addresses the systemic risks of coordinated asset freezes and payment interruptions across global economic perimeters, mapping the distinct interactions between common-law trusts, civil-law foundations, Sharia-compliant waqfs, and multi-tier corporate vehicles. Emphasizing an absolute disclosure test as a design constraint, the manual provides practical decision models—including break-even hazard pricing for optional legal legs and gated phasing playbooks—to align corporate form with economic reality across 245 distinct jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套全面的全球企业架构方法论，将跨国司法管辖区设计视为严格的工程学科，而非传统的避税天堂启发式方法。论文引入"多路复用原则"作为分析框架，证明名义上的实体或司法管辖区数量往往高估了真实的结构独立性。研究使用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）在不同基础上量化评估国际结构的司法集中度，并系统分析资产冻结与支付中断的协同风险。
AI.research_question: 如何将全球公司架构设计从传统的避税天堂启发式方法转变为严格的工程学科，并建立量化评估跨国司法管辖区结构独立性和系统风险的框架？
AI.motivation: 传统跨国企业架构设计依赖避税天堂的简易规则，缺乏对多司法管辖区结构的系统性工程分析。论文旨在纠正这一缺陷，提供一个严谨的方法论来评估名义上的实体数量与实际结构独立性之间的差距，并应对全球资产冻结等系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论框架包括：(1) 多路复用原则（Multiplexing Doctrine）——揭示名义实体/司法管辖区数量可能高估真实结构独立性；(2) 赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）——量化司法集中度，分别在朴素基础与集团合并压力测试基础上评估；(3) 绝对披露测试（Disclosure Test）——作为设计的刚性约束条件；(4) 各类法律工具（普通法信托、大陆法基金会、伊斯兰法瓦克夫、多层公司工具）的交互映射。
AI.method: 本文采用定量的工程分析方法：利用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数对司法管辖集中度进行双轨测量（朴素基础和集团合并压力测试基础）；建立系统性风险分析框架以考察协调性资产冻结与支付中断的影响；提供实际决策模型，包括可选法律分支的盈亏平衡风险定价和门控分阶段实施手册（gated phasing playbooks）；覆盖245个不同的司法管辖区进行综合比较分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现名义实体与司法管辖区数量经常高估真实的结构独立性（多路复用原则的验证）；HHI在不同测量基础上揭示了司法集中度的显著差异，特别是在集团合并和压力测试情境下；不同法律传统（普通法信托、大陆法基金会、伊斯兰瓦克夫、多层公司）在面对系统性风险时表现出不同的脆弱性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于提出"多路复用原则"这一新的分析概念，挑战了传统上以实体和司法管辖区数量衡量结构多元性的假设；将赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数从产业组织经济学引入跨国法律架构分析领域；将绝对披露测试确立为跨国结构设计的核心约束条件，丰富了国际公司法的分析工具库。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：提供覆盖245个司法管辖区、可操作的跨国架构设计方法论；建立盈亏平衡风险定价模型，帮助企业决策是否增加可选法律分支；提供门控分阶段实施手册，指导企业逐步调整公司形式以适应经济现实；识别全球支付中断和资产冻结的系统性风险，帮助企业设计更具韧性的跨国架构。

title: Who Watches the Science Watchdogs? Accountability, Disclosure, and Due Process in Independent Research Integrity Criticism
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Who Watches the Science Watchdogs? Accountability, Disclosure, and Due Process in Independent Research Integrity Criticism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This Perspective does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or new empirical data. It analyses publication-ethics principles, publicly available web materials, and published research-integrity guidance.

detail.abstract: Independent research-integrity commentators, blogs, post-publication-comment websites, social-media accounts, image-forensics posts, journal alerts, and related networks increasingly influence how allegations about the scholarly record are framed and circulated. Their visibility does not itself establish scientific qualification, methodological reliability, ethical legitimacy, or authority to make reputation-affecting judgments. Public concerns can become searchable, amplified, financially supported, repeated by anonymous or pseudonymous actors, cited by journalists, and treated as de facto findings before a competent assessment has occurred. Some commentators also combine public accusation with donation support, speaking fees, confidential consultancy, access to detection tools, media visibility, and platform-based influence. Using publicly available materials from Science Integrity Digest, PubPeer-related practice, and wider researchintegrity guidance, this Perspective examines whether such actors meet defensible standards of disclosure, methodological transparency, evidentiary threshold, language calibration, right of reply, moderation, conflictof-interest management, and reputational repair. The analysis rejects any presumption that visibility, previous publicity, platform access, or association with corrections confers authority. Where qualifications cannot be verified, methods cannot be reproduced, conflicts cannot be assessed, accusations exceed the evidence, or correction and remedy are inadequate, claims to expertise and legitimacy should not be accepted by journals, institutions, journalists, or the public.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨独立科研诚信评论者、博客、出版后评论网站、社交媒体、图像取证帖子等角色在学术不端指控传播中的影响力，并评估他们是否达到披露、方法透明、证据门槛、语言校准、答辩权、审核、利益冲突管理和声誉修复方面的可辩护标准。文章拒绝将曝光度、平台访问权或与更正记录关联视为权威的依据。
AI.research_question: 独立科研诚信评论者及其相关网络是否具备科学资质、方法可靠性、伦理合法性和权威性来做出影响声誉的判断？他们是否满足披露、方法透明、证据门槛、语言校准、答辩权、审核、利益冲突管理和声誉修复等可辩护标准？
AI.motivation: 科研诚信评论者及其网络日益影响学术不端指控的框架和传播，但其可见性并不等同于科学资质或方法可靠性。公共关注可能在合格评估之前就被搜索引擎化、放大、获得资金支持，并被当作事实结论对待，因此亟需审视这些行为者是否值得被授予权威。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科研诚信评估的规范性标准框架，涵盖披露标准、方法透明性、证据门槛、语言校准、答辩权、审核机制、利益冲突管理和声誉修复等多个维度。
AI.method: 采用Perspective（观点/透视）研究方式，基于Science Integrity Digest、PubPeer相关实践和更广泛的科研诚信指导等公开材料进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 可见性、过往曝光、平台访问权或与更正记录相关联都不能赋予权威性。当资质无法验证、方法无法复现、利益冲突无法评估、指控超出证据范围或更正与补救不足时，期刊、机构、记者和公众不应接受这些行为者的专业性和合法性主张。
AI.theory_contributions: 对科研诚信评价生态中新兴的非正式行为者提出了系统性的规范性评估框架，反驳了"可见性即权威"的错误前提，为科研诚信治理提供了理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊、学术机构、记者和公众提供了甄别科研诚信评论者是否值得信任的具体标准清单，有助于防止未经证实的指控被当作既定事实对待，保护科研人员的声誉权利。

title: The Value of (Sub) Specialization: Evidence from Oncology
affiliations: , , ,  and Harvard University - Harvard Medical School

detail.title: The Value of (Sub) Specialization: Evidence from Oncology
detail.abstract: We estimate the returns to specialization in medical oncology, in which subspecialists focus on specific cancer types. Using 2.2 million Medicare chemotherapy episodes from 2008–2020, we instrument for subspecialist access with differential distance to cancer-type-specific subspecialists versus general oncologists. Access to a relevant subspecialist reduces three-year mortality by 4.5 percentage points (10 percent), without increasing Medicare spending or measured provider fragmentation. Subspecialists also increase the use of newer therapies and diagnosis-specific clinical trials. These findings show that specialization raises productivity when expertise is closely matched to the task.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2008-2020年220万例Medicare化疗病例，通过工具变量法估计医学肿瘤学中亚专科化的回报。研究发现，获得相关亚专科医生诊治可使三年死亡率降低4.5个百分点（约10%），且不增加Medicare支出或医疗服务碎片化。亚专科医生还会更多使用新疗法和针对特定诊断的临床试验。
AI.research_question: 在医学肿瘤学领域，亚专科化（医生专攻特定癌症类型）对患者健康结果、医疗支出和护理质量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨专业化是否以及何时能提高生产率——当专业知识与任务紧密匹配时，专业化能否带来实质性的产出改善。医学肿瘤学提供了一个理想的检验场景，因为亚专科医生专注于特定癌症类型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业化经济学理论——专业化（分工）能够提高生产率，但前提是专业知识与任务紧密匹配。该理论源自Smith的分工理论，本文检验了"紧密匹配"这一关键条件在医疗领域的适用性。
AI.method: 使用2008-2020年220万例Medicare化疗病例，采用工具变量法（IV），以患者到达特定癌症类型亚专科医生与普通肿瘤科医生的差异距离作为工具变量，来识别亚专科化对治疗结果的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）获得相关亚专科医生诊疗可使三年死亡率降低4.5个百分点（约10%）；（2）这一改善未伴随Medicare支出的增加或医疗服务碎片化的上升；（3）亚专科医生更倾向于使用更新疗法和针对特定诊断的临床试验。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"专业化提高生产率"这一经济学理论提供了医疗领域的因果证据，特别验证了"专业知识与任务紧密匹配"是专业化收益实现的关键条件。研究表明，当专业化与具体任务高度对应时，能显著提升产出质量而不增加成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗资源配置和肿瘤学人才培养提供政策启示：增加癌症类型特异性亚专科医生的可及性可显著改善患者生存率，且不增加医疗成本或护理碎片化，支持在医疗体系中扩大亚专科化服务的覆盖范围。

title: Social Institutions, Parental Investments and Educational Attainment: Evidence from Age-sets in Uganda
affiliations: University of Galway, University of Galway and University of Zurich

detail.title: Social Institutions, Parental Investments and Educational Attainment: Evidence from Age-sets in Uganda
detail.abstract: Education is widely seen as a key driver of economic growth, yet social institutions may mediate efforts to improve outcomes. We study how age-set organisation---where societies are structured into age-based social groups---shapes parental human capital investments and children’s educational attainment. Children in age-set societies receive greater investments, improving health and schooling at younger ages. Yet effects on education dissipate between the ages of 13-16, coinciding with the timing of age-set initiation. We also find that universal secondary education raised schooling only in non-age-set societies. These findings highlight how the impacts of social institutions can vary across the life-cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究年龄组制度（age-set organisation）如何影响父母的人力资本投资和儿童教育成就。年龄组社会的儿童在幼年获得更多投资、健康和教育更好，但13-16岁（与年龄组入会时间重合）后教育优势消失；此外，普及中学教育仅在非年龄组社会中提升教育水平。
AI.research_question: 社会制度（具体为年龄组制度）如何调节父母的人力资本投资与儿童教育成就之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 教育被广泛视为经济增长的关键驱动力，但社会制度可能调节改善教育成果的努力；年龄组组织作为一种重要但研究不足的社会制度，可能深刻影响教育投资与教育成果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会制度与人力资本投资关系的理论视角，关注年龄组制度作为社会结构如何通过影响父母投资决策来影响儿童教育成果。
AI.method: 实证分析，比较年龄组社会与非年龄组社会中儿童的教育投资和教育成就差异，同时利用普及中学教育的政策变化进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）年龄组社会的儿童获得更多父母投资，幼儿期健康和入学状况更好；（2）但这种教育优势在13-16岁（与年龄组入会时间重合）后消失；（3）普及中学教育仅在非年龄组社会中提升教育水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会制度对教育成果的影响具有生命周期异质性，补充了社会制度与人力资本形成之间关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策设计提供启示：在年龄组社会中推行教育政策需要考虑制度背景，单一的政策干预在教育效果上可能存在制度性差异。

title: Capable but Not Deployable: Institutional Constraints on AI Exposure in Finance
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE and

detail.title: Capable but Not Deployable: Institutional Constraints on AI Exposure in Finance
detail.abstract: Empirical measures of AI exposure ask language models to score O*NET tasks for technical feasibility. In finance, technically feasible tasks must still pass through review, documentation, supervision, confidentiality controls, and accountable human sign-off before entering production. We measure the gap between feasibility and institutional deployability using 2,199 O*NET tasks across 99 finance-and-insurance occupations. We score each task with eight frontier models and a prompt ladder that moves from bare capability to finance-industry context and named regulatory regimes. The within-model institutional markdown is about one-fifth of the mean feasibility score, and positive for all eight models. The markdown is largest for regulated, client-facing credit and advice roles and smallest for marketing, software, and support roles. Cross-model agreement also declines as finance context is added: models agree more about what AI can do than about what financial institutions can deploy. Mapping exposure to publicly traded firms through pre-ChatGPT staffing shares, we find that the pricing content resides in the institutional layer: firms in the top half of the markdown distribution underperform the bottom half by roughly 25 percentage points in market-adjusted cumulative abnormal returns over the three years after ChatGPT, while sorting on technical exposure alone produces no gap. The differential lies outside the range the same design produces over every pre-ChatGPT window of equal length, though with one event window and few subsector clusters we read it as evidence on where return information resides rather than as a causal estimate. Especially in regulated industries, deployable exposure rather than technical feasibility is the more relevant measure of AI exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2,199个O*NET任务和八个前沿模型，衡量了金融保险业中AI技术可行性（feasibility）与制度可部署性（institutional deployability）之间的差距。研究发现制度性折价约为可行性评分的五分之一，且跨模型一致。将暴露度映射到上市公司后，制度层面的暴露度能预测ChatGPT后三年的股票回报差异（高低组差约25个百分点），而纯技术可行性暴露度则无预测能力，表明在受监管行业中制度可部署性才是更相关的AI暴露度量。
AI.research_question: 在金融行业，AI暴露度应如何衡量？技术可行性与制度可部署性之间的差距有多大，以及哪种度量更能解释上市公司的市场回报差异？
AI.motivation: 现有AI暴露度研究普遍使用语言模型直接对O*NET任务进行技术可行性评分，但在金融等受监管行业中，技术上可行的任务仍需经过审查、文档记录、监督、保密控制和问责审批才能投入生产。因此仅衡量技术可行性可能严重高估实际的AI暴露度，需要一种能反映制度约束的度量方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI技术可行性（technical feasibility）与制度可部署性（institutional deployability）的区分框架；基于任务级的AI暴露度度量方法（O*NET任务评分）。
AI.method: 使用2,199个O*NET任务覆盖99个金融保险职业，用八个前沿模型对每个任务评分，采用递进的提示阶梯（从纯能力到金融行业背景再到具体监管制度）；计算制度性折价（markdown）；通过ChatGPT前的就业份额将暴露度映射到上市公司，进行事件研究分析市场调整后的累计异常收益（CAR）。
AI.findings: （1）八个模型的制度性折价均为正，约为平均可行性评分的五分之一；（2）折价在受监管、面向客户的信贷和咨询岗位最大，在营销、软件和支持岗位最小；（3）加入金融背景后，跨模型一致性下降——模型对AI能做什么的分歧小于对金融机构能部署什么的分歧；（4）制度层暴露度位于前50%的企业相较于后50%的企业，在ChatGPT后三年市场调整CAR低约25个百分点，而仅按技术暴露度排序无差异；（5）该差异远超ChatGPT前等长窗口的同类设计结果，但由于仅有一个事件窗口和少量子行业聚类，作者将其视为收益信息位置的证据而非因果估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证区分了AI技术可行性暴露与制度可部署性暴露两个概念，证明在受监管行业中制度约束是AI暴露度度量的关键维度，为AI暴露度文献提供了新的度量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融行业企业、投资者和政策制定者提供了更准确的AI暴露度评估工具；表明仅依赖技术可行性评分可能误导投资决策，制度可部署性才是股市定价中蕴含的信息；对受监管行业（如金融保险）的AI风险评估具有直接实践指导意义。

title: Trade Fragmentation, International Cartels, and Welfare: How Does Domestic Market Structure Matter?
affiliations: , LeBow College of Business, Drexel University and Drexel University - Department of Economics & International Business

detail.title: Trade Fragmentation, International Cartels, and Welfare: How Does Domestic Market Structure Matter?
detail.abstract: We characterize collusive pricing in an international cartel spanning two host countries and pooling incentive constraints across markets, under general demand restricted only by a mild curvature condition that admits constant elasticity. Under domestic monopoly, fragmentation can weaken collusion and raise host welfare, whereas richer profit opportunities abroad strengthen collusion and may lower it; hosts prefer moderate barriers to either free trade or complete separation. Under domestic competition both results reverse. Whether fragmentation disciplines cartels thus depends on market structure in their home countries. Since collusion requires no trade between members, prices rather than trade flows carry the identifying information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个跨越两个东道国的国际卡特尔，在成员国之间无贸易的背景下，分析市场分割（fragmentation）如何通过跨市场的激励约束汇集影响合谋定价。研究发现，卡特尔合谋的稳定性与强度取决于母国市场结构：在国内垄断下，市场分割可能削弱合谋并提高东道国福利，而国外更丰厚的利润机会则可能强化合谋并降低东道国福利，东道国偏好适度的贸易壁垒；在国内竞争下，上述结果完全反转。
AI.research_question: 市场分割（fragmentation）在国际卡特尔中如何影响合谋定价与东道国福利？其作用方向是否取决于卡特尔成员母国的市场结构（垄断 vs 竞争）？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对市场分割如何影响国际卡特尔合谋存在争议，且缺乏在一般需求条件下、跨越多个东道国并汇集跨市场激励约束的分析框架。本文旨在提供一个更一般的理论刻画，揭示市场结构如何决定分割政策对合谋的影响方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复博弈下的合谋理论（collusion theory）、跨市场激励约束汇集（pooling incentive constraints across markets）、温和曲率条件下的需求一般化框架（允许常弹性需求）
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建一个跨越两个东道国的国际卡特尔模型，在一般需求函数（仅受温和曲率条件约束，允许常弹性）下，比较国内垄断与国内竞争两种市场结构下的均衡合谋定价与福利结果。
AI.findings: （1）在国内垄断下，市场分割可削弱合谋并提高东道国福利；国外更丰厚的利润机会则强化合谋、降低东道国福利；东道国偏好适度壁垒（介于自由贸易与完全隔离之间）。（2）在国内竞争下，上述两个结论均反转。（3）由于卡特尔成员之间无需贸易，识别合谋的信息载体是价格而非贸易流。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场分割对国际卡特尔合谋的影响纳入统一的一般需求框架，首次系统揭示母国市场结构（垄断 vs 竞争）是决定分割政策效应的关键调节变量，并推广了此前仅适用于特定需求函数的结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东道国反垄断与贸易政策设计提供指导：在卡特尔成员国内垄断情形下，适度分割（贸易壁垒）可增进福利；而国内竞争情形下应采取相反策略。同时提示执法机构应以价格信号（而非贸易流）作为识别国际卡特尔合谋的证据。

title: Perceived Protection: Tariff Spillovers to Product Substitutes in the Used Car Market
affiliations: Drexel University, Drexel University,  and Drexel University - Department of Economics & International Business

detail.title: Perceived Protection: Tariff Spillovers to Product Substitutes in the Used Car Market
detail.abstract: We study the spillover effects of the 2025 “Liberation Day” automotive tariffs on the untaxed U.S. used-car market. Using over eight million weekly listings and a VIN-based crosswalk identifying each vehicle’s country of assembly, we document an immediate and persistent 0.2–0.6% increase in the prices of foreign-brand used vehicles relative to domestic-brand vehicles. The effect is concentrated among the newest vehicles — the closest substitutes for new cars — consistent with demand-side substitution. We also find that foreign-brand vehicles produced in the U.S. appreciate as much as those assembled abroad, suggesting that the perceived foreignness of used vehicles may be largely independent of true production location. Neglecting tariff pass-through to untaxed product substitutes understates overall consumer incidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2025年"解放日"汽车关税对美国未征税二手车市场的溢出效应，利用超过800万条周度挂牌数据和基于VIN的产地对应表，发现关税导致外国品牌二手车价格相对国产品牌上涨0.2-0.6%，且效应集中在新车最相似的近期车型上，符合需求侧替代逻辑；在美国本土生产的外国品牌车辆同样升值，表明感知的"外国性"与实际产地关系不大。
AI.research_question: 2025年"解放日"汽车关税如何影响未征税的美国二手车市场？具体而言，关税是否通过需求替代渠道对二手车价格产生溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 研究表明忽视关税对未征税替代品的传导将低估消费者的整体负担，因此需要实证检验关税对二手车这一未征税替代品市场的溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求侧替代理论——新关税使新车价格上涨，消费者转向二手车这一替代品，从而推高二手车价格。
AI.method: 使用超过800万条周度二手车挂牌数据，通过基于VIN的对应表识别每辆车的组装国，比较外国品牌与国产品牌二手车价格的差异变化。
AI.findings: （1）关税导致外国品牌二手车相对国产品牌价格立即且持续上涨0.2-0.6%；（2）效应集中在新近车型（新车最接近的替代品）；（3）美国本土生产的外国品牌车与境外组装的车升值幅度相同，表明感知"外国性"与实际生产地关系不大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了关税对未征税替代品的溢出效应，证明忽视此类传导会低估关税的整体消费者负担；同时发现消费者对"外国品牌"的感知可能独立于实际生产地点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税真实影响提供依据，表明关税的消费者福利成本不仅限于被征税商品本身，还通过替代品价格传导扩大。

title: Air Pollution and Learning
affiliations: , ,  and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Air Pollution and Learning
detail.abstract: Nearly the entire world’s population breathes air exceeding WHO pollution guidelines, but the extent to which that exposure impairs the accumulation of human capital is not well understood. We study this using longitudinal PSAT data on nearly 10 million U.S. high school students, comparing the same student’s scores across attempts preceded by differing air quality and instrumenting for local PM2.5 with smoke from distant wildfires. A year of observed pollution exposure reduces learning by 0.04-0.06 standard deviations, or 14-19% of typical annual score growth. The damage comes almost entirely from moderate pollution days (8–12 μg/m3), below the EPA’s historical standard, and from exposure during the school year rather than summer, pointing to instructional disruption as a mechanism. Effects are three times larger in disadvantaged schools and among Black and Hispanic students, who are harmed more by the same exposure. Exposure to air pollution widens achievement gaps.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国近1000万名高中生的纵向PSAT考试数据，通过比较同一学生在不同空气质量下的多次考试成绩，并以远处野火产生的烟雾作为PM2.5的工具变量，发现一年的污染暴露会使学习收益降低0.04-0.06个标准差（占年典型成绩增长的14-19%）。损害几乎全部来自中等污染天数（低于EPA历史标准），且主要来自学年期间的暴露而非暑假，表明教学中断是重要机制。在弱势学校和黑人或西班牙裔学生中影响大三倍，空气污染扩大了成就差距。
AI.research_question: 空气污染暴露在多大程度上损害了人力资本的积累，以及这种损害通过何种机制产生、在不同群体中如何分布？
AI.motivation: 全球几乎所有人口都呼吸着超过WHO指南标准的空气，但空气污染暴露损害人力资本积累的程度尚不清楚。以往研究缺乏对同一学生长期追踪的准实验证据，也未能清晰识别污染影响学习的机制及不平等分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本积累理论、空气污染健康经济学（污染暴露影响认知功能与学习能力）、教学中断机制假说
AI.method: 利用近1000万美国高中生的纵向PSAT数据，采用学生固定效应模型（比较同一学生多次考试的成绩差异），以远处野火烟雾作为PM2.5的局部工具变量进行因果识别，并区分不同污染浓度区间、时段（学年vs暑假）以及不同学校和学生群体进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 一年的污染暴露使学习收益降低0.04-0.06个标准差（占年成绩增长的14-19%）；2) 损害几乎全部来自低于EPA历史标准的中等污染天（8-12 μg/m³）；3) 损害主要来自学年期间而非暑假暴露，指向教学中断机制；4) 影响在弱势学校和黑人或西班牙裔学生中大三倍，后者受相同暴露的伤害更大；5) 空气污染扩大了成就差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 为空气污染损害人力资本积累提供了大规模因果证据；识别了教学中断这一关键机制；揭示污染损害的不平等分布，丰富了对环境不平等如何转化为教育不平等（成就差距）的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明EPA历史标准未能保护学生认知发展（中等污染浓度即有害），为修订空气质量标准提供证据支持；提示政策制定者关注空气质量与教育公平的交叉关系，可通过改善污染暴露缩小成就差距。

title: Kumon Up: Private Tutoring Centers and Student Achievement
affiliations: and

detail.title: Kumon Up: Private Tutoring Centers and Student Achievement
detail.abstract: Private tutoring chains like Kumon and Sylvan have expanded rapidly in recent decades. Combining data on business locations, household spending, and district test scores, we study who uses these centers and how they affect academic skills. Nearly half of tutoring users are from the top income decile, with Asian and White households five and two times as likely to purchase tutoring as Black and Hispanic households. A staggered differences-in-differences design shows the opening of a district's first chain center raises district-wide math and reading scores by 0.02-0.03 standard deviations, at a much lower cost than public spending typically producing similar gains. Math effects are largest for White and Asian students, so that center entry widens racial achievement gaps, though less so in more racially integrated districts. These private investments help their users, deepen educational inequality, and shape outcomes by which state accountability systems and families judge schools.

AI.tldr: 本文利用企业位置、家庭支出和学区考试成绩数据，研究连锁私立辅导中心（如Kumon和Sylvan）的使用者特征及其对学业成绩的影响。研究发现近半数使用者来自收入最高的十分之一家庭，亚裔和白人家庭使用概率远高于黑人和西班牙裔家庭。通过交错双重差分设计，发现学区首家辅导中心开设使全区数学和阅读成绩提升0.02-0.03个标准差，但数学效应在白人和亚裔学生中最大，从而扩大了种族成绩差距。
AI.research_question: 谁在使用连锁私立辅导中心？这些私营教育投资如何影响学业成绩和教育不平等？
AI.motivation: 连锁私立辅导机构在过去几十年快速扩张，但缺乏对其使用者构成和学业影响的系统性证据，特别是对教育不平等的潜在影响需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育生产函数理论；教育不平等与种族差异理论；市场化的私营教育服务与公共教育系统的互动。
AI.method: 结合企业位置数据、家庭支出数据与学区考试成绩数据的多源数据整合；交错双重差分（staggered differences-in-differences）因果识别设计。
AI.findings: 1）近半数辅导使用者来自收入顶层十分之一家庭；亚裔和白人家庭使用概率分别是黑人和西班牙裔家庭的5倍和2倍。2）学区首家连锁辅导中心开设使全区数学和阅读成绩提升0.02-0.03个标准差，成本远低于公共支出产生类似提升的代价。3）数学效应在亚裔和白人学生中最大，导致中心进入扩大了种族成绩差距，但在种族融合程度更高的学区中差距扩大幅度较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示私营连锁辅导机构对教育生产函数的影响及其通过市场机制加剧教育不平等的路径；拓展了关于私营教育服务与教育不平等关系的理论理解；识别了学区种族构成对私营教育不平等效应的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于私立辅导中心扩张对教育公平影响的实证证据；提示需要关注私营教育投资对不同种族和收入群体学业差距的扩大效应；为教育问责制度和家庭择校判断提供参考信息。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Optimal Income Redistribution in Anglo-Saxon and Continental Economies
affiliations: and University of Münster - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: A Quantitative Analysis of Optimal Income Redistribution in Anglo-Saxon and Continental Economies
detail.abstract: We develop a medium-scale overlapping-generations model with endogenous labour supply and skill premium to study optimal income redistribution using progressive labour income taxes and pensions. The model is calibrated to the four countries USA, Great Britain, Italy and Germany which differ substantially in their tax and pension systems, demographics, and skill shares among workers. Optimal pension benefits are proportional to lifetime contributions in all four countries, while the optimal degree of income progressivity varies systematically with country characteristics such as the size of the social security system, demographics or the skill share in the labour force. Optimal income taxes should be more progressive in the United States and Great Britain and much less progressive in the continental countries, Italy and Germany. Population ageing further reduces the optimal extent of income redistribution.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含内生劳动供给和技能溢价的中等规模世代交叠（OLG）模型，研究通过累进劳动所得税和养老金进行最优收入再分配的问题。模型校准于美国、英国、意大利和德国四个在税收、养老金制度、人口结构和技能占比方面差异显著的国家。研究发现四个国家的最优养老金福利均与终身缴费成比例，而最优所得税累进程度则因国家特征（社会保障规模、人口结构、劳动力技能占比）而异。美国应提高税收累进性，意大利和德国则应大幅降低；人口老龄化会进一步降低最优收入再分配程度。
AI.research_question: 在存在内生劳动供给和技能溢价的情况下，各国最优的累进劳动所得税和养老金再分配政策应如何设计？不同制度、人口结构特征的国家之间应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 不同国家在税收和养老金制度、人口结构及劳动力技能构成上存在显著差异，但缺乏一个统一的框架来分析这些差异如何影响最优收入再分配政策的设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世代交叠（OLG）模型；内生劳动供给；技能溢价；最优税收理论
AI.method: 构建中等规模OLG模型，纳入内生劳动供给与技能溢价，将模型分别校准到美国、英国、意大利和德国四个国家的数据，并进行政策比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）四个国家的最优养老金福利均与终身缴费成比例；（2）最优所得税累进程度随国家特征系统性地变化，美国应提高累进性，英国提高程度较小，而意大利和德国应大幅降低累进性；（3）人口老龄化会降低最优收入再分配的程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将OLG模型框架与内生劳动供给和技能溢价相结合，为分析跨制度差异下的最优收入再分配提供统一理论框架，揭示了国家特征（社会保障规模、人口结构、技能占比）对最优税收政策的结构性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同制度背景的国家提供有针对性的税收和养老金政策建议，明确指出各国应调整累进程度的方向，并提示人口老龄化对再分配政策的制约效应，对政策制定具有直接参考价值。

title: Controlling Calamity: Avoiding the Economic Implications of a Constitutional Realization Requirement

detail.title: Controlling Calamity: Avoiding the Economic Implications of a Constitutional Realization Requirement
detail.abstract: Taxation in the United States is sacred-if only because everyone hates it. Taxes serve critical economic functions for society: raising revenue, redistributing income, controlling externalities, and maintaining economic stability and growth. Yet those persuasive justifications have never been sufficient to confer carte blanche taxing authority to the federal government. That is, the constitutional power to tax income is constrained. The Sixteenth Amendment authorizes Congress to tax income "from whatever source derived, without apportionment," but courts have limited that authority to income that has been "clearly realized." Charles and Kathleen Moore thought the Mandatory Repatriation Tax circumvented that limitation. Believing their burden under the new tax to be unjust, the Moores challenged the tax in the federal judiciary, culminating in a Supreme Court decision. But this challenge-supported in part by political interest groupsreflected callousness and risked eroding the positive economic functions associated with "pass-through" taxation. Fortunately, the Supreme Court saw through their arguments to the "fiscal calamity" that could result if "pass-through" taxation were functionally eliminated. Nevertheless, the Moores challenge was not all dubious provenance, and its substance merits attention. That is, the Moores contended that a tax burden should not exist where a party has no control over the distribution of foreign income on which it must pay tax. This argument warrants a closer look. But rather than relying on the judiciary, the legislature offers a better forum for modifying U.S. taxation of foreign entities and ensuring shareholders only pay the "pass-through" tax when they have control over the distribution of their foreign income. Under the reforms advanced in this Note, the administration of foreign taxation may be made to align better with actual control while protecting the economic interests in the tax system and thereby controlling calamity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国宪法对联邦征税权的限制，以Moore夫妇挑战强制性遣返税（MRT）的诉讼为切入点，分析"已明确实现"收入原则与"穿透式"征税（pass-through taxation）之间的矛盾。作者认为最高法院的裁决避免了财政灾难，但Moore案提出的"无控制权则不应课税"的主张值得重视，并主张通过立法改革而非司法途径，使外国收入的征税与实际控制权更好对齐。
AI.research_question: 当纳税人对外国收入的分配没有控制权时，是否应承担相应的"穿透式"税负？如何在税收征收与实际控制权之间取得平衡，同时保护税收系统的经济功能？
AI.motivation: Moore夫妇案凸显了美国宪法第十六修正案对税收权的限制（"已明确实现"收入原则）与现代国际税收实践之间的矛盾。该案若裁决不当可能导致"穿透式"税收被实质废除，造成"财政灾难"，但其核心主张——无控制权不课税——又具有正当性，值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法税收权理论（第十六修正案与"已明确实现"收入标准）、税收经济学理论（税收的经济功能：收入筹集、再分配、外部性控制、经济稳定与增长）、"穿透式"税收理论
AI.method: 案例分析法——以Moore诉美国案的诉讼过程和最高法院判决为核心展开法律分析；规范性法律论证——提出立法改革建议。
AI.findings: 最高法院的裁决避免了因废除"穿透式"税收而导致的财政灾难，但Moore案提出的问题仍有实质价值：纳税人在无权控制外国收入分配的情况下承担税负，确实有失公允。司法途径并非解决该问题的最佳场域，立法改革更为合适。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文从理论与实践两个层面评估了"已明确实现"原则在现代国际税收情境下的适用边界，揭示了宪法税收权限制与经济发展需求之间的张力，丰富了关于"穿透式"税收正当性的法理讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的立法改革方向：改革外国实体税收管理，使征税与实际控制权更好对齐，同时保护税收系统的经济功能，避免财政灾难。

title: Event-Spread Perpetuals under Asynchronous Finality: Joint-State Risk, Residual Exposure, and Settlement Design

detail.title: Event-Spread Perpetuals under Asynchronous Finality: Joint-State Risk, Residual Exposure, and Settlement Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with the Research Department of Devnull FZCO and leads the ForesightFlow research programme. No external sponsor influenced the research design, analysis, interpretation, or decision to publish. The article does not evaluate a commercial product or make investment recommendations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex were used for editorial and technical assistance during manuscript preparation. The author made all substantive research decisions, reviewed the final manuscript, and assumes full responsibility for its contents.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
An event spread links two bounded claims, but the legs need not become final at the same time or through the same state path. Once one leg is final, the contract ceases to be a symmetric two-leg spread and becomes a residual single-leg exposure whose direction, margin, liquidity, and capital lock depend on which leg finalized first and at what payout. A scalar ``resolution time'' therefore cannot specify the risk of the instrument.

This paper develops a formal and empirical design for event-spread perpetuals under asynchronous Oracle, adapter, protocol, and realization states. The terminal payoff is defined over a semantic support set rather than the unrestricted Cartesian product of two binary outcomes. We prove support-monotonicity of the pathwise collateral floor, exact residual single-leg equivalence after first finality, insufficiency of one aggregate finality gap, layer-specific order inversion, and an exact decomposition of collateral released when the first leg becomes fixed. We then derive claim-conversion identities and show that leveraged conversion cannot manufacture the adverse-outcome collateral missing from a synthetic account.

The empirical layer begins with 108,638 exact-linked Paper 5 condition legs. Frozen historical metadata are available for 103,529 of them; 60,978 legs belong to 8,173 exact multi-leg parent events, producing 353,186 unique exact-parent-event candidate pairs. Conservative adjudication treats exact common parent-event membership as evidence of co-membership, not of payoff implication or restricted terminal support. Accordingly all 353,186 accepted pairs are Grade C descriptive/common-factor pairs; no Grade A or Grade B semantic-support pair is asserted.

The resulting joint-state census contains 353,186 pairs, 60,978 unique condition legs, 8,173 parent-event clusters, and 1,412,744 pair-by-clock observations. Among complete pairs, the median absolute gap is 620 seconds at the observed condition-resolution/protocol-event clock, 1,772 seconds to first observed redemption, and 1,946 seconds to first positive-payout redemption. The corresponding 95th percentiles are 712,524, 1,061,643, and 984,130 seconds. At the condition-resolution/protocol-event clock, 153,195 pairs are A-first, 151,989 B-first, 17,694 cofinal, 24,619 right-censor the second leg, and 5,689 lack an evaluable pair clock. The compact evidence does not separately identify an Oracle event, an adapter event, or a secondary same-timestamp order key, so no independent Oracle-versus-protocol ordering claim is made.

This gate outcome materially narrows the empirical claim. The data establish descriptive asynchronous finality among exact same-event candidate pairs, but not semantic payoff restriction, collateral relief, executable residual liquidity, funded conversion, trigger welfare, or shared-capacity feasibility. Experiments E2–E6 therefore remain not evaluated rather than being approximated on Grade C pairs. The contribution is a precise boundary between formal multi-leg mechanism results, observed pair-level timing, and operational claims that require stronger semantic and execution evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了事件价差永续合约在异步Oracle、适配器、协议和实现状态下的风险与机制问题。形式上证明了支持集单调性、第一条腿终局后的残余单腿等价性、聚合终局间隙的不足性等关键定理；实证上对108,638个条件腿进行分析，识别出353,186个精确同父事件候选对，但仅能确认描述性异步终局，无法断言语义支付限制或运营性主张。
AI.research_question: 事件价差永续合约在异步终局（asynchronous finality）条件下，其风险特征如何变化？各层状态（Oracle、适配器、协议、实现）之间的时序异步如何影响合约的抵押、流动性和偿付结构？
AI.motivation: 一旦事件价差合约的一条腿终局，合约就从对称双腿价差转变为残余单腿敞口，其方向、保证金、流动性和资本锁定取决于哪条腿先终局及支付金额。传统的标量"解析时间"无法刻画该工具的风险，需要形式化和实证化的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 支持集（Semantic Support Set）理论；路径条件抵押下限（pathwise collateral floor）；单腿等价性定理；支持单调性（support-monotonicity）；聚合终局间隙的充分性分析；索赔转换恒等式。
AI.method: 形式化数学证明与大规模实证分析相结合。实证部分使用108,638个精确链接的条件腿，筛选出353,186个精确同父事件候选对，基于保守裁决方法仅将其归类为Grade C描述性/共同因子对。
AI.findings: 在353,186个候选对中，完整对的中位绝对间隙在条件决议/协议事件时钟为620秒。153,195对为A-first，151,989对为B-first，17,694对为cofinal，24,619对右截断第二条腿。数据仅能确立描述性异步终局，无法支撑语义支付限制、抵押减免、可执行残余流动性等更强主张。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了支持单调性、第一条腿终局后的精确残余单腿等价性、单一聚合终局间隙的不充分性、逐层顺序反转、以及第一条腿固定时抵押释放的精确分解。推导了索赔转换恒等式，证明杠杆转换无法制造合成账户中缺失的不利结果抵押。
AI.practical_contributions: 为事件价差永续合约的风险管理提供了精确的边界划分：形式化多腿机制结果、观察到的配对级时序、以及需要更强语义和执行证据的运营主张之间的明确区分。实证门控（gating）方法有助于避免在证据不足时过度断言。

title: Trade Secret Protection in the Indian Software Industry: Examining Legal Gaps and Their Implications on Innovation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Anna University - Department of Computer Science and Engineering

detail.title: Trade Secret Protection in the Indian Software Industry: Examining Legal Gaps and Their Implications on Innovation
detail.abstract: In India's software industry, increasingly depends on valuable intellectual assets such as proprietary source code, algorithms, technical know-how and other confidential information. While existing intellectual property laws provide different forms of protection under section 3(k) of the Indian patent Act, 1970 that aligned with Trips Article 27, computer program per se and algorithms are excluded from patent protection. Although patent Act provides patent for certain software programs it does not define, within the statutory provision itself resulting in reliance of guidelines and judicial precedents. Furthermore, while the copyright Act, 1957 protects original source code, it covers only literal expression, leaving underlying functional logic and algorithms vulnerable to reverse engineering. These limitations make the protection of confidential software information particularly significant. Although Article 39 of the Trips Agreement mandates robust protection for undisclosed information, India lacks a dedicated sui generis trade secret statute, relying instead on contract law, common law breach of trust and the Information Technology Act, 2000. This research employs a Doctrinal research methodology, this study analyses primary domestic statutes, international treaties, judicial precedents and the 22 nd Law Commission's 289 th report. This paper demonstrates the urgent need for a codified trade secret law in India to resolve existing legal uncertainties and fulfil India's commitments under Trips Article 39.

AI.tldr: 本文通过教义学研究方法，分析印度软件行业商业秘密保护的现状与不足，论证印度亟需制定一部专门的商业秘密成文法，以解决现有法律框架下的不确定性并履行TRIPS协定第39条的承诺。
AI.research_question: 印度在TRIPS协定第39条框架下，是否有必要制定一部专门的商业秘密成文法以有效保护软件行业的保密信息？
AI.motivation: 印度软件行业高度依赖源代码、算法、专有技术等知识产权资产，但专利法排除计算机程序本身和算法的保护，版权法仅覆盖字面表达而无法保护功能逻辑，缺乏专门的商业秘密成文法使保密信息保护存在法律不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: TRIPS协定（第27条和第39条）、印度专利法1970年第3(k)条、印度版权法1957年、信息技术法2000年、合同法与普通法违反信托原则、第22届法律委员会第289号报告
AI.method: 教义学研究方法（Doctrinal Research），分析国内主要立法、国际条约、司法判例及法律委员会报告
AI.findings: 印度现有法律框架（专利法、版权法、合同法、信息技术法）无法为软件商业秘密提供充分且确定的保护，缺乏专门的商业秘密成文法导致法律不确定性，亟需立法弥补这一缺口以履行TRIPS第39条义务。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了印度软件商业秘密保护的法律框架缺口，论证了TRIPS第39条与印度国内法之间的实施差距，为印度商业秘密专门立法提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度立法机关制定专门的商业秘密成文法提供政策建议，帮助软件企业明确商业秘密保护路径，降低因法律不确定性导致的商业秘密泄露风险。

title: The Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection: From Deterministic to Stochastic, Fisher to Bayes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection: From Deterministic to Stochastic, Fisher to Bayes
detail.abstract:
Fisher's Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection asserts that the additive genetic variance is the total rate of change of mean fitness. The assertion is false, as Kimura showed in 1958 and as Ewens (2024) sets out definitively. This paper asks what the falsehood costs, why sixty-six years of correction failed to displace it, and what should replace it. The deterministic half rests on a lemma. The average effects are the coefficients of an orthogonal projection of fitness onto a fixed subspace taken in a moving inner product, so Fisher computed the rate of change of Π t m as though Π t were constant. With δ the residuals, d m/dt = σ 2 A + g Ṗg δ g holds for arbitrary paths and for the whole genome, and the remainder vanishes exactly when the motion is tangential to the manifold of gene-frequency product measures: Fisher's claim is that a population never departs from Hardy-Weinberg proportions and linkage equilibrium. Whenever the distribution moves inside an exponential family whose main effects are the gene contents, the remainder factorizes over the transverse coordinates alone; at a biallelic locus that sum has one term and equals D α I(α) in Lindley's (1988) coordinates, the fitness curvature times the velocity of the disequilibrium coefficient times the Fisher information about it, whence Fisher's 1941 constant genic environment condition is necessary as well as sufficient there. A two-locus system has σ 2 A ≡ 0 while mean fitness falls twenty percent, and at quasi-linkage equilibrium the relative error is ϵ √ p A q A p B q B , independent of the recombination rate: recombination destroys the disequilibrium and leaves the error untouched.
The stochastic half asks what data can say. Fisher’s claim is the hypothesis κℓ = 1
on a shrinkage weight. Jeffreys’ Bayes factor shows it can be refuted but never confirmed,
and detection at one locus needs n ≈ 50 s−4 zygotes per genotype. Global-local shrinkage
estimates the distribution of κ and finds Fisher right at almost every locus, wrong in aggregate
by the entire quantity. The horseshoe places Jeffreys’ binomial prior on κ, with Haldane’s
as the improper limit; Haldane’s 1932 spike-and-slab on Primula linkage anticipated the
machinery inside genetics; and the Ewens Sampling Formula is itself a marginal likelihood,
Kingman’s paintbox playing the role of de Finetti’s theorem. We close with the consequences
for practice and the one measurement that would settle the question.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示Fisher基本自然选择定理的错误：加性遗传方差并不等于平均适应度总变化率。论文从确定性和随机性两个层面分析错误根源、为何66年未被纠正，以及应该用什么替代。确定性部分证明Fisher的错误在于将时变内积下的正交投影系数当作常数；随机性部分则用贝叶斯方法检验Fisher假说，发现其在逐位点水平上几乎正确但在总体水平上完全错误。
AI.research_question: Fisher基本自然选择定理（加性遗传方差=平均适应度变化率）是错误的，这个错误代价是什么？为何66年来未被纠正？应该用什么替代它？
AI.motivation: Kimura在1958年和Ewens在2024年已明确证明Fisher基本定理是错误的，但该定理仍在遗传学中被广泛引用。本文旨在探究错误根源、错误为何持续存在，并提供正确的替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 正交投影与内积空间的数学框架；2. Hardy-Weinberg平衡和连锁平衡流形理论；3. 指数族分布理论；4. 贝叶斯推断（Jeffreys贝叶斯因子、全局-局部收缩先验、马蹄形先验）；5. Ewens采样公式与Kingman paintbox理论
AI.method: 确定性部分：通过引理证明平均适应度变化率分解为加性遗传方差与余项之和，证明余项仅在哈迪-温伯格平衡和连锁平衡时才消失。随机部分：使用Jeffreys贝叶斯因子检验收缩权重假设κℓ=1，采用全局-局部收缩估计和马蹄形先验估计κ的分布，并通过位点检测所需的样本量n≈50s⁻⁴来计算。
AI.findings: 1. Fisher的错误是计算dm/dt时将Πt视为常数（时变内积下的投影系数被当作固定值）；2. 余项在双等位基因位点等于D·α·I(α)（适应度曲率×连锁不平衡系数速度×Fisher信息）；3. 双位点系统中加性遗传方差为零但平均适应度下降20%；4. 准连锁平衡时相对误差与重组率无关；5. Fisher假说κℓ=1可被拒绝但永不能被确认；6. 单个位点检测需要约n≈50s⁻⁴个合子；7. Fisher在几乎每个位点上正确，但在总体水平上完全错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 给出了Fisher基本定理错误的严格数学证明，揭示了错误根源在于时变内积下不恰当的常数化处理；2. 证明了Fisher 1941年"恒定基因环境"条件的充要性；3. 建立了错误项与适应度曲率、连锁不平衡系数和Fisher信息之间的精确关系；4. 连接了Haldane的spike-and-slab先验、Jeffreys贝叶斯因子与Ewens采样公式，统一了种群遗传学的贝叶斯推断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实践提供正确的预测框架，避免基于错误定理的误导性结论；2. 给出了检测Fisher假说所需的实际样本量估计（n≈50s⁻⁴）；3. 提出了一项可以最终解决该问题的测量方案；4. 对育种和进化生物学实践中使用遗传方差估计适应度变化提供了修正指导。

title:
Where the Primes Hide 
Miyatake's kernel, Pólya's theorem, and Thorin measures
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title:
Where the Primes Hide 
Miyatake's kernel, Pólya's theorem, and Thorin measures

keywords: Bessel Function of the Second Kind

detail.abstract: Miyatake (1951) splits the Riemann Ξ-kernel into a superposition ψ 1 of generalised inverse Gaussian kernels and an explicit correction R(n 2 π, t). This is exactly the split a Thorin programme wants, since ψ 1 is hyperbolically completely monotone and R is not, and it seems to be the only place where the arithmetic and the Thorin structure are written side by side in closed form. I show that it is useless, and that the reason is structural rather than quantitative. The correction is exact but never a perturbation: sup n |R n (t)| = ∞ for every t. More decisively, the half of the representation that carries the Thorin structure is arithmetically empty. I prove, in closed form, sup | Im z|≤3 |ξ 1-ξ * | ≤ 1.02 × 10-8 , where ξ * is Pólya's function, and convert it by Rouché into a proof that ξ 1 has exactly one zero within 0.5 of each of 8.99281, 19.0654, 24.4748 and none within 1 of 14.1347 or 21.0220. The cause is a dichotomy: the onesided kernel e-λe t is covariant under t → t + c, which is what turns n into a Dirichlet series and hence into ζ, while the symmetrised kernel is not. No kernel has both structures, so the decomposition trades the arithmetic for the probability instead of separating them. Three things corroborate this. For the weight n k the arithmetic factor is ζ(z + 9 2-k), trivially nonvanishing precisely when k ≤ 3: Theorem II is free, Theorem I buys the honest weight k = 4 by amputating ζ to a finite Euler product, and ξ 1 would need a zero-free region reaching Re s = 1-ε. Miyatake's phase is the Riemann-Siegel theta function, so his O(1) occupies the slot of S(T), which is bounded for a finite Euler product and unbounded for ζ. And one parameter governs both halves at once: the ratio controlling the Mellin expansion of the n-th Bessel term is 2κ n exactly, with κ n = π 2 n 4 /y the saddle-point size of the correction, so arithmetic visibility and negligible correction hold on the same range n ≲ y 1/4 , whereas the Riemann-Siegel sum needs y 1/2. Where the dictionary does apply it is exact. Pólya's theorem is the statement that w → ξ * (0)/ξ * (i √ w) is a genuine GGC Laplace transform; RH is the same statement for Ξ, failure meaning a signed Thorin measure; and the law in question is an infinite convolution of exponentials whose rates are the squared zeros and whose cumulants are the secondary zeta values. Two of the open problems this leaves are then settled. RH is equivalent to positive semidefiniteness of the Hankel forms (S i+j+1) and (S i+j+2) built from those values-not a new equivalence in strength, but literally the positivity of that Thorin measure. And the Euler product route is closed, since ζ(σ + s)/ζ(σ) is the transform of an infinitely divisible law whose Lévy measure is atomic on {k log p}, whereas a GGC Lévy measure is absolutely continuous. Arithmetic is atoms, GGC structure is continuity, and RH is the positivity of one particular atomic measure. All identities are verified numerically to 40 digits.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析Miyatake（1951）将Riemann Ξ-核分解为广义逆高斯核叠加ψ₁与显式修正项R(n²π,t)的结构。作者证明该分解在实践中无用，原因是结构性的而非数量性的：修正项精确但绝非微扰（sup|Rₙ(t)|=∞），且承载Thorin结构的半部分在算术上是空的。核心矛盾在于单边核e^{-λe^t}在平移下协变（这使其成为Dirichlet级数从而联系ζ函数），而对称化核不具备此性质，没有任何核能同时拥有两种结构。作者进一步用Rouché定理证明ξ₁的零点分布，并解决两个开放问题：RH等价于由次级zeta值构造的Hankel形式的半正定性；Euler积路径被封闭，因为ζ(σ+s)/ζ(σ)是Lévy测度在{k log p}上的无穷可分律的变换，而GGC Lévy测度是绝对连续的。算术是原子性的，GGC结构是连续性的，RH是某个特定原子测度的正性。
AI.research_question: Miyatake分解将Riemann Ξ-核拆分为广义逆高斯核叠加与修正项，这种分解在Thorin程序中是否有效？其结构与RH（Riemann假设）的关系如何？
AI.motivation: Miyatake分解似乎是唯一一处算术结构与Thorin结构以闭式形式并排书写的地方，若能有效分离两种结构，将为RH提供新的视角。但作者的初步观察表明该分解可能无实际用处，需要从结构性角度给出严格证明，并以此阐明算术与概率结构之间的根本张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: Thorin程序（超完全单调性/GGC理论与广义χ²分布）、Riemann Ξ函数理论、Pólya函数与Pólya定理、Rouché定理（复分析零点计数）、Mellin变换与Dirichlet级数、无限可分分布与Lévy测度、Hankel形式与正半定性、次级zeta值、Euler积
AI.method: 闭式证明（sup范数估计、零点分布分析）、复分析工具（Rouché定理、解析延拓）、Mellin/Bessel展开技术、数值验证（40位精度）、Pólya定理的Laplace变换表述、无穷可分律与GGC测度的Lévy-Khinchin分析
AI.findings: （1）Miyatake分解无用，原因是结构性的：修正项精确但supₙ|Rₙ(t)|=∞，且Thorin结构所在半边算术上是空的；（2）闭式证明sup|Im z|≤3|ξ₁-ξ*|≤1.02×10⁻⁸，并由Rouché定理证明ξ₁在8.99281、19.0654、24.4748附近0.5内有且仅有一个零点，在14.1347、21.0220周围1内无零点；（3）单边核e^{-λe^t}满足平移协变性从而产生Dirichlet级数连接ζ，对称化核不满足，二者不可兼得；（4）RH等价于Hankel形式(S_{i+j+1})和(S_{i+j+2})的半正定性，即Thorin测度的正性；（5）Euler积路径封闭：ζ(σ+s)/ζ(σ)的Lévy测度在{k log p}上是原子的，而GGC Lévy测度绝对连续，故二者不可兼容。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了Miyatake分解的结构性缺陷，阐明了算术结构（Dirichlet级数/原子性）与Thorin概率结构（连续性/GGC）之间的根本不可调和性；（2）给出了RH与Thorin测度正性的严格等价表述，将RH转化为特定Hankel形式的半正定性问题；（3）通过Pólya定理的GGC Laplace变换视角统一了Pólya函数与Ξ函数的结构差异；（4）封闭了通过Euler积构造Thorin结构的路径，清晰刻画了算术原子性与GGC连续性之间的不可逾越的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了ξ₁与Pólya函数的精确数值逼近估计（误差≤1.02×10⁻⁸），并精确刻画了ξ₁的零点分布位置与个数；（2）所有恒等式均经40位数字数值验证，为后续研究提供了可靠的数值基准；（3）明确了RH研究的可行方向：关注Hankel形式半正定性及Thorin测度的正性，而非Euler积路径。

title: Stress-Testing the Estimator: Diagnosing Placebo and Bandwidth Instability in a Regression Discontinuity Design on Live Trading Data

detail.title: Stress-Testing the Estimator: Diagnosing Placebo and Bandwidth Instability in a Regression Discontinuity Design on Live Trading Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of DeepAlgo Sovereign, the production trading system whose live gate is the subject of this analysis. The author has a financial interest in DeepAlgo Sovereign's commercial success. No third party had any role in the design, analysis, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — this study involves no human participants or patient data. All data are automated trading-system decision logs and market price data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Applied regression discontinuity design (RDD) studies routinely report a standard four-part robustness battery — density-manipulation, covariate-balance, placebo-cutoff, and bandwidth-sensitivity checks — and move on once all four pass. Far less is documented about what to do when they do not, and how to distinguish a genuine problem with the underlying result from a problem with the checking procedure itself. This note works through a real case where two of the four checks failed on first application, and reports the full diagnostic process used to resolve it, as a portable protocol rather than a one-off fix. The setting is a live threshold rule inside a production algorithmic-trading gate — a lag-1 autocorrelation statistic used to block entries when adverse momentum is judged still persistent — analysed on 1,472 real, logged gate decisions. The pooled RDD estimate shows no statistically detectable discontinuity at the rule's cutoff, at either of two forward-return horizons. Subjecting that null to the standard robustness battery initially produced troubling results: placebo cutoffs that are not the real threshold registered as significant, and the point estimate's significance flickered across bandwidth choices. Two candidate explanations were formally pre-registered before testing began; the first (mass points in the running variable) was tested directly and disconfirmed by its own diagnostic — a real, disclosed self-correction, not a convenient result kept because it was convenient. The second (overlapping observations, a consequence of the gate re-evaluating each instrument roughly every 15–30 minutes against 20- and 80-hour outcome windows) fully explained the pattern: cluster-robust inference, clustered on instrument, resolves both failed checks completely. A third, independent implementation pitfall — a silent bandwidth-specification error in the estimator's own biascorrection step — was found and corrected along the way, and is documented separately since it generalises beyond this application. The result is distilled into a five-step diagnostic protocol, reusable on any RDD analysis built on event-log data with forward-looking outcome windows, independent of the specific finding reported here.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个真实案例，展示了当回归不连续设计（RDD）的标准四件套稳健性检验（密度操纵、协变量平衡、安慰剂断点、带宽敏感性）失败时，如何系统性地诊断和解决问题。该案例涉及一个生产环境算法交易门控规则，其RDD估计显示无显著不连续性，但初始稳健性检验出现异常。最终发现根本原因是观测重叠（overlapping observations），通过聚类稳健推断完全解决。作者将其提炼为可复用的五步诊断协议。
AI.research_question: 当RDD标准稳健性检验中的两项（安慰剂断点检验和带宽敏感性检验）失败时，如何区分是潜在结果本身存在问题，还是检验程序本身存在问题？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大量记录了RDD稳健性检验的标准做法（"四件套"），但极少讨论当这些检验失败时应该如何处理。研究者通常只报告检验通过的结果，而对检验失败的情况缺乏系统性指导。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个可移植的诊断协议。
AI.theoretical_framework: RDD（回归不连续设计）框架；稳健性检验体系（密度操纵检验、协变量平衡检验、安慰剂断点检验、带宽敏感性检验）；聚类稳健推断理论；观测重叠（overlapping observations）的统计推断问题。
AI.method: 使用1,472个真实交易门控决策的日志数据，对滞后一期自相关统计量的阈值规则进行RDD分析。采用预注册的两阶段诊断方法：(1) 直接检验"运行变量存在质量点"假设并予以否证；(2) 检验"观测重叠"假设，通过按工具（instrument）进行聚类稳健推断解决；同时发现并修正了一个独立的带宽规格错误。
AI.findings: (1) 汇集的RDD估计在两个远期收益视野下均未显示统计上可检测的不连续性；(2) 初始诊断显示安慰剂断点显著、估计值显著性随带宽变化而闪烁；(3) 质量点假说被其自身诊断测试否证；(4) 观测重叠假说完全解释了异常——按工具聚类后，两项失败的检验均完全解决；(5) 发现并记录了一个独立的带宽规格误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为RDD诊断程序提供了系统化的方法论贡献：提出了一个可复用的五步诊断协议，适用于基于事件日志数据、具有前瞻性结果窗口的RDD分析；区分了"结果的问题"与"检验程序的问题"两种情境；展示了预注册诊断假说在稳健性检验失败情境中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了具体可操作的五步诊断流程，帮助其在RDD稳健性检验失败时进行系统性排查；特别为使用事件日志数据和重叠观测窗口的应用场景（如算法交易、高频金融决策）提供了实践指导；记录了一个可能影响广泛应用的带宽规格错误陷阱。

title:
From Gamma Mixtures to Gamma Convolutions: 
Thorin Measures and the Riemann Xi Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title:
From Gamma Mixtures to Gamma Convolutions: 
Thorin Measures and the Riemann Xi Function
detail.abstract: Set Λ(s) = ξ(1/2 + √ s)/ξ(1/2). The Riemann Hypothesis holds if and only if 1/Λ is the Laplace transform of a generalized gamma convolution whose Thorin measure is carried by the squared ordinates of the zeros, equivalently if and only if the associated variable is the infinite convolution of exponentials γ>0 ε γ /γ 2. This is one case of a dictionary between the Laguerre-Pólya class and the Thorin class for even entire functions of order one. Three consequences are drawn. The Stieltjes density of log Λ is N (√ u)/u with N the Riemann-von Mangoldt counting function, and its boundary values on the cut are πN , so the Nevanlinna-Pick property of log Λ is the argument principle for ξ. The Lévy density is the Cramér heat trace x-1 γ>0 e-γ 2 x , which is where the primes enter. And Riemann's kernel is a mixture of gamma laws of shape 1 4 and rates πn 2 , each a single Thorin atom, so the Riemann Hypothesis is a transfer from mixture to convolution, from arithmetic locations πn 2 to spectral locations γ 2. Read this way, Pólya's symmetrization replaces every gamma component by a generalized inverse Gaussian, the term Miyatake subtracts is π sech(πw) with every Thorin atom negative, and his count of the zeros that fail to be real is an S-function estimate, bounding the non-real atoms by (4/π) √ N / log N .

AI.tldr: 本文建立了Riemann zeta函数与广义gamma卷积（Thorin类）之间的完整对应关系，证明Riemann假设成立当且仅当1/Λ是某个广义gamma卷积的Laplace变换，其Thorin测度由零点的纵坐标平方承载。该文构建了Laguerre-Pólya类与Thorin类之间的"字典"，并由此推导出三个重要推论：Stieltjes密度、Lévy密度（涉及素数）以及Riemann核的gamma混合表示。
AI.research_question: Riemann假设能否等价地转化为广义gamma卷积（Thorin类）框架下的条件？具体而言，1/Λ是否为某个广义gamma卷积的Laplace变换，其Thorin测度由零点纵坐标平方承载？
AI.motivation: Riemann假设是数学中最核心的未解决问题之一。本文试图从一个全新的概率论视角（广义gamma卷积与Thorin类）来重新表述Riemann假设，从而建立素数分布与谱（零点）分布之间的深层联系，为理解Riemann假设的实质提供新的概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架包括：(1) 广义gamma卷积（Generalized Gamma Convolution）与Thorin类；(2) Laguerre-Pólya类（偶阶整函数）；(3) Laplace变换与Stieltjes密度理论；(4) Riemann-von Mangoldt计数函数；(5) Cramér热核；(6) Nevanlinna-Pick性质与辐角原理；(7) Pólya对称化与广义逆高斯分布；(8) S函数估计。
AI.method: 本文采用解析数论与概率论相结合的数学分析方法。通过构造Λ(s)=ξ(1/2+√s)/ξ(1/2)，建立函数变换与广义gamma卷积之间的对应关系，利用Laplace变换、Stieltjes变换等解析工具进行分析，并结合计数函数、热核、Gamma分布混合等工具推导结论。
AI.findings: 主要发现：(1) Riemann假设等价于1/Λ是广义gamma卷积的Laplace变换，Thorin测度由零点纵坐标平方承载；(2) log Λ的Stieltjes密度为N(√u)/u，其切割上的边界值为πN，Nevanlinna-Pick性质即为ξ的辐角原理；(3) Lévy密度为Cramér热迹x^{-1}Σe^{-γ²x}，素数的来源在于此；(4) Riemann核是形状参数1/4、速率πn²的gamma律混合，每个都是一个Thorin原子；(5) Riemann假设本质上是"从算术位置πn²到谱位置γ²"的从混合到卷积的转换；(6) Pólya对称化的作用与Miyatake修正项的S函数估计给出了非实原子数量的上界(4/π)√N/log N。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：(1) 建立了Laguerre-Pólya类与Thorin类之间关于偶阶一阶整函数的系统性"字典"；(2) 为Riemann假设提供了全新的广义gamma卷积等价表述；(3) 揭示了Riemann假设作为"从混合到卷积"的转换这一深层结构，将算术位置与谱位置统一在同一框架下；(4) 阐明了Stieltjes密度、Lévy密度与素数分布之间的内在联系；(5) 给出了Pólya对称化和Miyatake方法在Thorin框架下的新解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 实际贡献：(1) 为Riemann假设的研究提供了新的概率论工具和表述框架；(2) 给出了非实零点数量的S函数估计上界(4/π)√N/log N，可用于估计零点分布；(3) 建立了素数分布（通过Lévy密度中的Cramér热迹）与零点谱位置之间的量化联系；(4) 为数值验证Riemann假设提供了基于Thorin类性质的可检验条件。

title: Economic Impacts of Climate Change on Perennial Crops: Evidence from Wine Yields in Bordeaux's Red Appellations
affiliations: , Bordeaux School of Economics and University of Bordeaux

detail.title: Economic Impacts of Climate Change on Perennial Crops: Evidence from Wine Yields in Bordeaux's Red Appellations
detail.abstract: Most empirical evidence suggests that climate change will reduce annual crop yields, yet perennial crops have received comparatively little attention. This paper quantifies the projected mid-century impacts of climate change on wine yields across Bordeaux's red appellations. We first use agronomic phenological models to estimate the timing of grapevine developmental stages and construct historical weather indicators and projected climate indicator changes over biologically relevant periods. We then estimate the historical relationship between weather conditions and wine yields using appellation-level panel data and combine the estimated weather responses with the projected climate indicator changes. We find that temperature exhibits a strongly asymmetric relationship with wine yields, with spring frost and extreme heat causing substantial yield losses, whereas moderate warmth provides modest yield gains. By contrast, the effects of precipitation vary over the growing season. When applied to projected mid-century climate changes, these estimated weather responses imply an average increase in wine yields of approximately 3.7%. These findings highlight that climate change may affect perennial crops differently from staple crops and underscore the importance of broadening climate impact assessments beyond annual cropping systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文量化了气候变化对波尔多红葡萄酒产区中期（本世纪中叶）产量影响的预测。作者利用农学物候模型估算葡萄发育阶段的时间，构建历史天气指标和生物相关时期的气候指标变化预测，然后通过产区层面面板数据估计历史天气与葡萄酒产量的关系，并将估计的天气响应与预测的气候指标变化相结合。研究发现温度与葡萄酒产量存在强烈不对称关系——春季霜冻和极端高温造成显著减产，而温和温暖带来适度增产；降水影响随生长季变化。将这些天气响应应用于预测的中期气候变化后，葡萄酒产量预计平均增加约3.7%。
AI.research_question: 气候变化将如何影响波尔多红葡萄酒产区中期（本世纪中叶）的葡萄酒产量？
AI.motivation: 大多数实证证据表明气候变化会降低一年生作物产量，但多年生作物（如葡萄）受到的关注相对较少。评估气候变化对葡萄酒等多年生作物的潜在影响，弥补现有研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农学物候模型（用于估算葡萄发育阶段）；天气-产量响应关系估计框架
AI.method: 首先使用农学物候模型估算葡萄发育阶段时间，构建生物相关时期的历史天气指标及预测的气候指标变化；随后利用产区层面面板数据估计历史天气与葡萄酒产量的关系；最后将估计的天气响应与预测的气候指标变化相结合，预测未来产量影响。
AI.findings: 温度与葡萄酒产量呈强烈不对称关系：春季霜冻和极端高温导致显著减产，而温和温暖带来适度增产；降水影响随生长季变化。将估计的天气响应应用于预测的中期气候变化后，葡萄酒产量预计平均增加约3.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候变化对多年生作物（葡萄）的潜在影响不同于一年生作物，强调了拓宽气候影响评估范围至多年生种植系统的重要性，弥补了此前研究对多年生作物关注不足的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波尔多葡萄酒产区的生产者、政策制定者提供了中期气候变化条件下葡萄酒产量变化的定量预测，有助于其采取适应性管理措施。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and the Allocation of Time over the Life Cycle: A Generational Perspective
affiliations: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM)

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and the Allocation of Time over the Life Cycle: A Generational Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper develops a framework to examine how artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics may transform the allocation of time over individuals' lifetimes. Rather than focusing on employment, wages, or job displacement, the analysis considers the distribution of lifetime hours among work, education and training, commuting, necessary activities, and discretionary leisure. A lifetime time-allocation model is calibrated for historical and prospective cohorts, spanning 1700 to 2050, using stylised assumptions on life expectancy, labour-market entry and retirement, working time, education, training, commuting, and postretirement employment. Two 2050 scenarios illustrate the potential effects of different degrees of technological progress and adoption of AI and humanoid robotics. The results indicate a substantial longterm decline in the share of lifetime devoted to work and a corresponding increase in discretionary leisure, which could exceed half of expected lifetime hours under the one of the scenarios. The paper also discusses the implications for welfare analysis when work and education have intrinsic value.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个框架，研究人工智能和机器人技术如何改变个体一生中的时间分配。研究聚焦于寿命中工作、教育、通勤、必要活动和闲暇的时间分布，而非就业、工资或岗位替代。通过校准1700至2050年的历史与前瞻队列模型，并设定两种2050年技术情景，发现工作时间占比长期大幅下降，闲暇时间占比上升，在某一情景下闲暇可超过预期寿命小时数的一半。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和机器人技术如何改变个体一生中的时间分配结构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于AI对就业、工资或岗位替代的影响，缺乏对个体终身时间分配（工作、教育、闲暇等）的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 终身时间分配模型（lifetime time-allocation model）
AI.method: 构建终身时间分配模型，对1700至2050年的历史及前瞻队列进行校准，基于预期寿命、劳动力市场进入与退休、工作时间、教育、培训、通勤及退休后就业等假设，设置两种2050年技术进度情景进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 工作时间占寿命的比重长期显著下降，而闲暇时间相应增加；在一种2050年情景下，闲暇时间可超过预期寿命小时数的一半。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI与机器人对劳动的影响从就业/工资视角拓展到终身时间分配视角，并讨论了当工作和教育具有内在价值时的福利分析含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和社会规划提供关于技术进步下个体时间分配变化的长期预测及福利评估参考。

title: The AI-Audit Pathway Model: A Conceptual Framework Linking Artificial Intelligence Adoption to Audit Quality and IFRS Compliance

detail.title: The AI-Audit Pathway Model: A Conceptual Framework Linking Artificial Intelligence Adoption to Audit Quality and IFRS Compliance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping how financial information is prepared, disclosed and audited, yet identical AI deployments produce markedly divergent audit-quality and IFRS-compliance outcomes across firms and jurisdictions. The literature cannot presently explain this divergence, because it treats governance and data quality as parallel enabling conditions rather than specifying the mechanism that links them. This paper develops a conceptual framework that supplies one. Following a theory-synthesis design for conceptual articles (Jaakkola, 2020), and disciplined by a structured search of peer-reviewed work published between January 2023 and March 2026 across Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar, it advances the AI-Audit Pathway Model (AAPM). The model integrates agency theory, information asymmetry, institutional theory and the Technology Acceptance Model with the COSO internal-control framework and the IIA Three Lines Model, linking antecedent adoption conditions, AI deployment mechanisms, and audit and reporting outcomes. Its central theoretical claim is that governance architecture and data-quality maturity are not parallel conditions but nested ones: governance functions as a higher-order moderator whose effect is transmitted through the maturity of the underlying data environment, captured here by an ordinal COSO-ICSR index. The model yields five falsifiable propositions, including a mediation claim tying AI’s marginal audit-quality gain to control-environment maturity, and it specifies the conditions under which that claim would be shown to be wrong. The supporting synthesis finds an evidence base concentrated in developed markets, dominated by cross-sectional designs, skewed towards positive findings and largely silent on individual standards such as IFRS 9, IFRS 15 and IFRS 16. The paper closes with a research agenda built directly on the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI-审计路径模型（AAPM），将治理架构与数据质量成熟度视为嵌套（而非平行）条件，解释为何相同AI部署在不同企业和司法管辖区产生迥异的审计质量与IFRS合规结果，并产出五个可证伪命题及研究议程。
AI.research_question: 为何相同的AI部署在不同企业和司法管辖区会产生显著不同的审计质量与IFRS合规结果？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将治理与数据质量视为平行的使能条件，未能指明连接二者的机制，因而无法解释AI部署结果的显著分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合代理理论、信息不对称理论、制度理论与技术接受模型（TAM），并结合COSO内部控制框架与IIA三道防线模型（Three Lines Model）。
AI.method: 采用理论综合设计（Jaakkola, 2020）的概念文章方法，对2023年1月至2026年3月间Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar收录的同行评审文献进行结构化检索与综合。
AI.findings: 提出AI-审计路径模型（AAPM）及其中心理论命题：治理架构是更高阶的调节变量，其效应通过底层数据环境的成熟度传导（以序数型COSO-ICSR指数衡量）；模型产出五个可证伪命题，包括AI边际审计质量收益受控制环境成熟度中介的论点。综合证据基础集中于发达市场、以横断面设计为主、偏向正面发现、对IFRS 9/15/16等具体准则关注不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理与数据质量从平行条件重新概念化为嵌套关系，提出治理作为高阶调节变量通过数据环境成熟度传导效应的新机制理论，并给出可证伪命题以明确理论的可检验边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和审计机构提供AI部署的治理-数据协同框架（COSO-ICSR索引），指出现有证据基础的空白（新兴市场、纵向设计、具体IFRS准则），并据此提出未来研究议程。

title: Induced Innovation under Competitive Pressure

detail.title: Induced Innovation under Competitive Pressure
detail.abstract: Because directed technical change has the potential to delink economic activity from environmental degradation, understanding the drivers of environment-related innovation is valuable to policy makers. This paper empirically investigates two drivers of clean innovation, energy prices and market competition, grounded in the induced innovation and inverted-U literature, respectively. Using a self-constructed dataset, I find evidence of the induced innovation hypothesis, but only when studying energy price changes, not when studying energy price levels. I do find some evidence for an inverted-U relationship between competition and innovation, although the relationship is statistically uncertain and disappears when the quadratic relationship is relaxed. When combining the two hypotheses, the results are inconclusive. I do not find consistent and significant evidence that market competition affects the induced innovation effect. While the induced innovation findings are robust against different econometric specifications and estimation methods, they vary depending on whether energy prices are first-differenced or not. The literature would benefit from foundations for clarifying which specification is preferred.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自建数据集，实证研究了能源价格与市场竞争对清洁创新的驱动作用。研究发现诱致性创新假说仅在能源价格变动（而非价格水平）下成立；竞争与创新之间存在统计上不确定的倒U型关系；两个假说的联合检验结果不具结论性。
AI.research_question: 能源价格和市场竞争如何影响环境相关创新（清洁创新）？
AI.motivation: 定向技术变革有可能将经济活动与环境退化脱钩，因此理解环境相关创新的驱动因素对政策制定者具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 诱致性创新假说（induced innovation hypothesis）与倒U型关系（inverted-U）文献
AI.method: 使用自建数据集，进行实证计量分析，检验能源价格（价格变动与价格水平）和市场竞争对清洁创新的影响；采用多种计量设定与估计方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）诱致性创新假说仅在研究能源价格变动时得到支持，在能源价格水平下不成立；2）竞争与创新之间存在倒U型关系的证据，但统计上不确定，且放宽二次关系后该关系消失；3）两个假说联合检验结果不具结论性；4）未发现市场竞争对诱致性创新效应有一致且显著的调节作用；5）能源价格是否进行一阶差分处理会影响结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了能源价格变动与价格水平对诱致性创新假说的不同影响，发现竞争与创新的倒U型关系在统计上不稳定，并指出能源价格是否一阶差分这一规范选择问题值得文献关注。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于能源价格政策与市场竞争环境如何影响清洁技术创新方面的实证证据，有助于设计促进环境创新的政策工具。

title: Unreal Estate: The Black Money Blocking Sustainable Growth in Pakistan
affiliations: and University of Management and Technology C II Johar Town Lahore Pakistan

detail.title: Unreal Estate: The Black Money Blocking Sustainable Growth in Pakistan
detail.abstract: Money laundering (ML) stifles and demeans all of an economic system's progressive efforts by siphoning off productivity and undermining the consequences of socioeconomic and regulatory efforts to achieve economic justice and social welfare. It not only usurps the economy's positive yield, but it also feeds and mutates with the socioeconomic structure and the practices that enable it to function. Money laundering is a 'systemic assault' on economic justice since it encourages illegitimate wealth accumulation, distorts markets, and perpetuates structural inequalities. Because of its high-value transactions, subjective valuation methods, and opacity in ownership structures, the real estate sector attracts criminal asset investments worldwide. It is regarded as a safe haven due to its potential to absorb not only the proceeds of corruption, drug trafficking, tax evasion, and market malpractice, but also to yield 'white' and laundered funds. In Pakistan, the real estate sector is among the major contributor to the economy and is regarded as a high-risk sector for money laundering due to its large non-conventional transactional pattern and lack of transparency. The sector's vulnerability to money laundering activities has far-reaching implications for Pakistan's economic justice and stability. Despite being a significant driver of economic expansion, Pakistan's real estate sector faces challenges related to transparency, accountability, and regulatory oversight. Money laundering chances exist due to the industry's lack of transparency and regulation, which can manipulate property values, cause loss to state revenue, inflate prices against the market trends, and jeopardize the sector's integrity and fair competition. Pakistan's real estate sector exemplifies how AML regulatory loopholes directly impair economic justice principles like distributive justice (equitable resource allocation), procedural justice (transparent institutions), and corrective justice (accountability for unlawful wealth). Real estate prices are artificially inflated by this capital distortion, which excludes qualified buyers and makes it possible for the wealthy to hide their money. The ensuing wealth disparity serves as an example of why targeted AML enforcement in the real estate industry is essential to achieving economic justice and goes beyond simple regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了巴基斯坦房地产行业中洗钱活动对经济正义的"系统性侵蚀"，指出该行业因高价值交易、主观估值和不透明所有权结构而成为洗钱高风险领域。文章主张针对房地产行业的反洗钱执法不仅是监管合规问题，更是实现经济正义（分配正义、程序正义、矫正正义）的必要条件。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦房地产行业的洗钱漏洞如何损害经济正义原则，以及为何针对该行业的反洗钱执法是实现经济正义的必要条件？
AI.motivation: 洗钱通过虹吸生产力、扭曲市场、助长结构性不平等，对经济系统构成"系统性攻击"。巴基斯坦房地产行业因其大规模非传统交易模式、缺乏透明度而成为洗钱高风险行业，其脆弱性对该国经济正义和稳定产生深远影响，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济正义理论框架，具体包括三个维度：分配正义（公平资源配置）、程序正义（透明制度）、矫正正义（对非法财富的问责）。
AI.method: 本文为概念分析/批判性评论文，通过理论框架（经济正义三原则）对巴基斯坦房地产行业洗钱风险进行系统性分析，并结合行业特征（高价值交易、主观估值、所有权不透明）进行论证。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦房地产行业存在严重反洗钱监管漏洞，这些漏洞直接损害了分配正义（人为推高房价排除合格买家）、程序正义（缺乏透明度与问责）和矫正正义（无法对非法财富追责）。洗钱导致的资本扭曲加剧了财富不平等，损害行业诚信与公平竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济正义的三个维度（分配正义、程序正义、矫正正义）作为分析框架应用于反洗钱领域，揭示了洗钱对经济系统的"系统性攻击"本质，论证了反洗钱执法不仅是合规问题，更是经济正义的核心议题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦乃至全球房地产行业的反洗钱监管提供了理论依据和紧迫性论证，指出针对房地产行业的定向反洗钱执法对于实现经济正义至关重要，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了行动方向。

title: Descriptive Principles of Regulatory Effectiveness: Gnōthi Seauton
affiliations: Universidade Presbiteriana Mackenzie and Universidad de Salamanca

detail.title: Descriptive Principles of Regulatory Effectiveness: Gnōthi Seauton

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: The contemporary debate on state regulation has consolidated a repertoire of prescriptive principles of regulatory quality, yet it has paid uneven attention to the empirical presuppositions that condition the effectiveness of the norm. This article proposes a rereading of regulatory effectiveness grounded in the distinction between prescriptive and descriptive principles and aims to systematize a matrix of descriptive principles of human behavior that complements, without replacing, the normative formulations disseminated by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD). The study is of a basic nature and qualitative approach, with exploratory and descriptive purposes, employing the doctrinal method in a hermeneutic and reconstructive register and a transdisciplinary orientation, in dialogue with law and economics, behavioral economics, responsive regulation theory, systems theory, and contributions from Medicine and Bioethics. The matrix gathers the principles of heterogeneity, interest, the law of least effort, the influence of control, the strength of mutually beneficial bilateral relations, isonomy, and the systemic integration, along with their conditioning factors and corollaries. It concludes that the quality of regulation depends not only on the formal correctness of its procedures or the legitimacy of its goals, but also on the adherence of its design to the regularities of the social reality upon which it bears, which reconnects regulatory law to a descriptive, empirically oriented foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以描述性原则与规范性原则的区分为基础重新解读监管有效性，系统整理了一套描述人类行为的描述性原则矩阵，以补充（而非取代）OECD传播的规范性监管质量原则，主张监管质量取决于监管设计与其所作用的社会现实规律的一致性。
AI.research_question: 监管有效性的实证前提是什么？如何系统地整理一套描述性原则矩阵来补充OECD的规范性监管原则？
AI.motivation: 当代关于国家监管的辩论已经整合了一套监管质量的规范性原则（如OECD原则），但对制约规范有效性的经验前提关注不足，需要弥补这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分规范性与描述性原则的概念框架；与法律经济学、行为经济学、回应性监管理论、系统论以及医学和生命伦理学的跨学科对话。
AI.method: 基础性研究，质性方法，探索性与描述性目的，采用教义学方法（诠释学与重建性路径），跨学科取向。
AI.findings: 整理出异质性、利益、最小努力法则、控制的影响、互利双边关系的强度、平等性（isonomy）和系统性整合等描述性原则及其条件因素和推论；结论是监管质量不仅取决于程序形式正确性和目标合法性，还取决于设计是否契合其所作用的社会现实规律。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管法重新连接到描述性的、以经验为导向的基础上，补充了现有以规范性为主导的监管有效性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管者提供了一套描述性原则矩阵，帮助其在监管设计中考虑人类行为的现实规律，从而提高监管的实际有效性。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as the research is purely theoretical and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions.

detail.abstract: AI firms increasingly rely on complements they do not govern: skills, repositories, tutorials, workflows, and standards. This Perspective explains how managers can preserve the generativity of external complement stock while selectively governing the layers-trust, access, discovery, certification, and standards-where control still creates strategic value.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了AI企业如何在不直接治理外部互补品（技能、代码库、教程、工作流和标准）的情况下，通过选择性治理信任、访问、发现、认证和标准五个层次，来保持外部互补生态的生成性（generativity），同时创造战略价值。
AI.research_question: 管理者如何在保持AI外部互补品生成性的同时，选择性治理关键层次以创造战略价值？
AI.motivation: AI企业越来越依赖于其不直接掌控的外部互补品（如技能、代码库、教程、工作流和标准），这带来了治理上的挑战——过度控制会抑制生成性，完全不控制又会失去战略价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于互补品生态系统理论和生成性（generativity）理论，提出分层治理框架。
AI.method: Perspective（观点性论文），基于行业观察和理论分析提出概念框架。
AI.findings: 管理者应在信任、访问、发现、认证和标准五个层次上进行选择性治理，而非对互补品本身进行控制，从而在保留生成性的同时获取战略价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI生态系统中"分层治理"的新概念框架，拓展了生成性与治理之间关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI企业管理者提供了可操作的分层治理策略，帮助其在开放互补生态与战略控制之间取得平衡。

title: Invisible Opportunity Cost: The Unmeasured Economic Consequence of Reasoning Fragmentation

detail.title: Invisible Opportunity Cost: The Unmeasured Economic Consequence of Reasoning Fragmentation
detail.abstract: Standard economic accounting is constitutively incapable of measuring the cost of the path not takenvalue that was never created because understanding was rebuilt rather than inherited. This paper names that cost: Invisible Opportunity Cost. It is not a gap in data collection that better instruments could close. It is a structural invisibility produced by measurement conventions built for a different economy-one in which the primary inputs to production were physical rather than cognitive, and in which the accumulation of reasoning coherence was not recognised as a form of capital. Drawing on the economics of intangible capital, the theory of opportunity cost, the productivity paradox literature, and the preceding papers in this series, the paper argues that Invisible Opportunity Cost is the largest unmeasured liability in the modern knowledge economy-and proposes a navigational framework for making it legible enough to act on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并命名了一个新概念——"隐形机会成本"（Invisible Opportunity Cost），指因知识被重建而非继承所导致的价值从未被创造的成本。作者认为这不是数据收集的缺陷，而是计量惯例的结构性盲区——现有经济计量体系是为以物质投入为核心的旧经济设计的，无法捕捉认知经济中推理连贯性作为一种资本形式的积累。论文主张这是现代知识经济中最大且未被计量的负债，并提出一个导航框架使其可见可操作。
AI.research_question: 为什么标准经济计量体系无法测量"未走之路"的成本——即因理解被重建而非继承所导致的价值损失？如何使这种结构性不可见的成本变得可衡量、可行动？
AI.motivation: 标准经济核算在方法论上根本无法衡量"未走之路"的成本——即因知识被重建而非继承所导致从未创造的价值。这种不可见性不是数据收集的工具能弥补的缺口，而是计量惯例的结构性缺陷——现有核算体系是为以物质投入为主、不把推理连贯性积累视为资本形式的旧经济设计的。这是现代知识经济中最大的未计量负债。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无形资产经济学（economics of intangible capital）、机会成本理论（theory of opportunity cost）、生产率悖论文献（productivity paradox literature），以及该系列论文的前序研究。
AI.method: 理论论证与概念构建：通过整合无形资产经济学、机会成本理论和生产率悖论文献，提出"隐形机会成本"这一新概念框架，并设计一个使其"可读"（legible）的导航框架。
AI.findings: "隐形机会成本"是标准经济核算的结构性盲区——它源于计量惯例为物质投入型经济而设计，无法捕捉认知经济中"推理连贯性积累"作为资本形式的价值。该成本被认定为现代知识经济中最大的未计量负债，并提出了使其可见可操作的导航框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 命名并概念化"隐形机会成本"（Invisible Opportunity Cost），将其界定为结构性不可见性而非数据采集缺口；将机会成本理论、无形资产经济学与认知价值创造逻辑整合，扩展了对知识经济中未计量价值的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一个导航框架（navigational framework），使"隐形机会成本"变得足够可读（legible）以支持行动决策，为组织和管理者在知识经济中识别和应对这类未计量成本提供实践路径。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Jevons Effects and Effective Demand: From a One-Sector Benchmark to a Production-Network Model
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and University of Warsaw, Faculty of Economic Sciences

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Jevons Effects and Effective Demand: From a One-Sector Benchmark to a Production-Network Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare they have no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No partient/partiticants in the paper
declarations.funderStatement: We received no funding

detail.abstract: This paper develops a Keynes-Jevons framework for analysing how artificial intelligence affects prices, demand and employment in an interconnected economy. A one-sector benchmark shows that employment is preserved only when the price-induced rebound and the expansion of effective demand offset the labour saved per unit of output. Embedding this mechanism in a multisector production network yields two principal results. First, the conventional unit-elasticity threshold is a special case: under heterogeneous productivity shocks, each sector's employment threshold depends on its own labour saving relative to the productivity gains embodied in its input supply chain. Second, reproduction and preservation of the initial employment level are distinct conditions. A wage-only benchmark is nested in a broader employment-preserving locus, and a local perturbation result shows that re-closure and employment preservation generally impose non-coincident firstorder restrictions. The paper also derives an exact decomposition separating the immediate wage-basket incidence of labour saving from subsequent changes in output, intermediate requirements and consumption patterns. Policy accommodation is therefore contingent on the nature of the AI shock, the transmission of cost reductions, the distribution of income and the composition of expenditure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个凯恩斯-杰文斯框架，分析人工智能如何影响互联经济中的价格、需求与就业。通过单部门基准模型和多部门生产网络模型，揭示了就业保全的条件取决于价格引致的回弹效应与有效需求扩张是否足以抵消单位产出所节省的劳动，并区分了再生产与就业保全两个不同条件。
AI.research_question: 人工智能冲击如何通过价格、需求和生产网络传导，从而影响经济中的就业水平？在什么条件下AI带来的劳动生产率提升不会导致就业净减少？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对AI对就业影响的分析往往局限于单部门或简单的弹性阈值判断（如单位弹性），缺乏考虑多部门生产网络、异质性生产率冲击以及杰文斯悖论（回弹效应）与凯恩斯有效需求扩张的交互作用，需要更完整的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯有效需求理论、杰文斯悖论（回弹效应）以及多部门生产网络理论（投入产出分析）。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建单部门基准模型和多部门生产网络模型，进行解析推导，包括异质性生产率冲击下的就业阈值分析、局部扰动分析以及精确分解方法。
AI.findings: （1）单部门模型中，就业保全要求价格引致的回弹效应与有效需求扩张抵消单位产出的劳动节省；（2）多部门模型中，传统单位弹性阈值仅仅是特例，各行业就业阈值取决于自身劳动节省与其投入供应链中生产率增益的关系；（3）再生产与就业保全是截然不同的条件，二者一般不会同时满足；（4）工资基准模型被嵌套在更广泛的就业保全轨迹中；（5）推导出精确分解，区分劳动节省的即时工资篮子效应与后续产出、中间投入和消费模式变化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将凯恩斯主义与杰文斯效应整合到统一的AI就业分析框架；（2）推广了传统的单位弹性就业保全阈值，揭示了多部门网络下的异质性条件；（3）首次明确区分了经济再生产与就业保全两个不同的理论条件；（4）提供了AI冲击效应的精确分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了AI冲击下就业政策的理论指导：政策调节取决于AI冲击的性质、成本削减的传导机制、收入分配格局和支出构成，有助于设计针对性的就业补偿与适应政策。
