AI.findings: 1. 印度存款市场在时间维度和银行集团间均表现出无弹性的需求；2. 私人银行面临的存款需求相对其他银行更富弹性；3. 离开某银行的储户，有4至11倍的概率流入同一银行集团内的其他银行；4. 提供了估计回购利率传导的保守卢比价值的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政府影响力（隐性担保）如何通过储户的银行集团偏好削弱存款市场竞争的价格纪律，补充了银行市场竞争与利率传导的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解放松利率管制的效果边界提供证据；为央行评估不同银行、年份或银行集团的回购利率传导幅度提供了可操作的保守估计方法。

title: A Theory of Two-Sided Directed Search

detail.title: A Theory of Two-Sided Directed Search
detail.abstract: In empirical research, two-sided directed models frequently incorporate taste shocks to match data, yet the resulting non-linear strategic feedback leaves equilibrium uniqueness unaddressed. We develop a general two-sided directed framework with constant-returns-to-scale matching, concave utility, and strictly convex search costs. We prove the existence of equilibrium in this model and derive global uniqueness conditions via Rosen (1965)'s game theory approach. The fundamental destabilizing force causing multiplicity is not cross-side interactions per se, but the residual cross-side interaction. Uniqueness is guaranteed when the stabilizing force dominates this residual. With this result, we prove the equilibrium is unconditionally unique under Cobb-Douglas matching form and constant surplus splitting. Through convex duality, our framework nests random utility models incorporating taste shocks, as exemplified by Galichon and Salanié (2022).

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个一般化的双边有向匹配框架（包含规模报酬不变的匹配函数、凹效用和严格凸搜索成本），证明了均衡存在性，并利用Rosen（1965）博弈论方法推导出全局唯一性条件。核心发现是：导致多重均衡的根本力量不是跨边交互本身，而是残余跨边交互（residual cross-side interaction）；当稳定力量主导该残余时，均衡唯一。在Cobb-Douglas匹配形式和恒定剩余分配下，均衡无条件唯一。通过凸对偶，该框架还可嵌套包含口味冲击的随机效用模型（如Galichon和Salanié 2022）。
AI.research_question: 在包含口味冲击（taste shocks）的双边有向匹配模型中，均衡的唯一性条件是什么？何种力量导致多重均衡？
AI.motivation: 实证研究中双边有向模型经常引入口味冲击以匹配数据，但由此产生的非线性策略反馈使均衡唯一性无法得到保证，而现有文献对此缺乏一般性理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Rosen（1965）博弈论方法、凸对偶理论、规模报酬不变的匹配函数、凹效用与严格凸搜索成本框架。
AI.method: 理论分析/数学证明：建立一般化双边有向匹配模型，通过博弈论方法证明均衡存在性，推导全局唯一性条件，并通过凸对偶将随机效用模型嵌入该框架。
AI.findings: （1）均衡存在性在一般条件下成立；（2）导致多重均衡的根本力量是残余跨边交互而非跨边交互本身；（3）当稳定力量主导残余跨边交互时均衡唯一；（4）Cobb-Douglas匹配形式与恒定剩余分配下均衡无条件唯一；（5）该框架通过凸对偶可嵌套含口味冲击的随机效用模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为双边有向匹配模型提供了均衡存在性和唯一性的一般化理论条件，澄清了多重均衡的根本来源是残余跨边交互，并建立了与随机效用模型（如Galichon和Salanié 2022）之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者在双边有向匹配模型中引入口味冲击时提供了均衡唯一性的可检验条件，增强了模型估计和结果解释的可靠性。

title: Efficiency, Redistribution, and Policy Assessments
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Department of Economics and Finance and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Efficiency, Redistribution, and Policy Assessments
detail.abstract: We develop an axiomatic theory of efficiency measurement that separates efficiency from redistribution. When efficiency is grounded in the aggregate resources required to sustain individual welfare, basic principles yield only a partial ordering; completing it requires an additional normative judgment. We propose a common-witness principle: equal efficiency must admit a common physical resource benchmark. Combined with commodity-space invariance, this principle uniquely identifies Debreu's coefficient of resource utilization, up to an increasing transformation. Under convexity, the identified ordering admits a price representation and a local Pareto-Negishi characterization whose welfare weights are determined endogenously rather than by distributive preferences. The analysis provides both a normative foundation for resource-based efficiency measurement and an operational criterion for constrained policy assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个效率测量的公理化理论，将效率与再分配分离。基于维持个体福利所需的总体资源来定义效率时，基本原则只能产生偏序；要完成排序需要一个额外的规范性判断。作者提出"共同见证原则"：相等效率必须承认一个共同的物理资源基准。结合商品空间不变性，这一原则唯一确定了Debreu资源利用系数（至多相差一个递增变换）。在凸性条件下，识别出的排序具有价格表示和局部Pareto-Negishi刻画，其福利权重由内生决定而非分配偏好决定。该分析为基于资源的效率测量提供了规范性基础，也为受限政策评估提供了操作性标准。
AI.research_question: 如何从公理化角度建立一种将效率与再分配分离的效率测量理论？什么样的规范性原则能够唯一确定资源基础的效率排序？
AI.motivation: 传统的效率测量（如帕累托效率）往往与分配问题纠缠在一起，而Debreu的资源利用系数虽然被广泛使用，但缺乏严格的公理化基础。作者希望为基于资源的效率测量建立一套完整的规范性理论，使其既能避免分配偏好的干扰，又能提供可操作的政策评估标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理化的效率测量理论、Debreu资源利用系数、福利经济学中的资源约束方法、Pareto-Negishi均衡理论
AI.method: 公理化的规范性分析方法，通过提出基本原则（如共同见证原则、商品空间不变性）来刻画效率排序，利用序数公理唯一化Debreu资源利用系数，并在凸性条件下建立价格表示和局部Pareto-Negishi特征刻画。
AI.findings: (1) 基于资源基础的效率测量在基本公理下只能得到部分排序；(2) 引入共同见证原则和商品空间不变性后，可以唯一确定Debreu资源利用系数（至多相差递增变换）；(3) 在凸性条件下，效率排序支持价格表示和局部Pareto-Negishi刻画，且福利权重由经济结构内生决定。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Debreu资源利用系数提供了严格的公理化基础；明确了效率测量中规范性判断的地位和作用；提出了共同见证原则这一新的规范性工具；建立了效率排序与内生福利权重之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受限政策评估提供了操作性标准；使政策制定者能够在不需要明确分配偏好设定的情况下进行资源效率比较；提供了可在具体经济环境中实施的价格表示方法。

title: The Storefront and the Repository: New Jersey's Authentic Relationships Act and the Collapse of the Distribution Point

detail.title: The Storefront and the Repository: New Jersey's Authentic Relationships Act and the Collapse of the Distribution Point
detail.abstract: New Jersey Assembly Bill 2710, the "Authentic Relationships Act," would bar any provider from designing, developing, marketing, or making available an artificial intelligence relationship simulation, subject to penalties of $25,000 per violation and a private right of action for emotional, financial, or relational harm. Its findings invoke the death of a New Jersey man drawn toward a meeting by a chatbot persona that told him it was real and gave him an address. The findings identify a deception. The text bans a genre. The doctrinal answer arrived a year before the bill did. In Free Speech Coalition, Inc. v. Paxton, the Supreme Court sustained an age verification requirement under intermediate scrutiny because it burdened adults only incidentally, and reconciled its four prior strict scrutiny decisions on the ground that each involved an outright ban on speech at most obscene only to minors. A2710 is that second kind of statute. The most permissive precedent a state regulating this field has received in a generation conditions its permission on the presence of an age line. A2710 has none, which forfeits both Paxton and Ginsberg v. New York and explains why every other legislature reaching this record drew the line New Jersey left out. Four further defects sit on the face of the statute. New Jersey is a categorical outlier: at least fourteen states enacted companion chatbot legislation in 2026, and every one chose disclosure, crisis protocol, and design duty over prohibition. Section 5 already reaches the deception the findings describe, with a scienter requirement, making the section 4 ban the state's own demonstration that a narrower rule was available. Section 4(c) dispenses with the ascertainable loss threshold New Jersey courts spent three decades building into the Consumer Fraud Act, in the same bill invoking that Act by name. And the four prohibited verbs presuppose a distribution point that dissolved while the bill sat in committee, so the statute sorts defendants by collectability rather than conduct, clearing the field of the providers a regulator can serve and leaving the artifacts it cannot. The Commentary states the case for A2710 at its strongest across five theories, including that model output is not covered speech, and answers each against the scholarship on constitutional coverage for generative output. It closes by specifying the statute New Jersey could have written instead.

AI.tldr: 本文分析新泽西州A2710号法案《真实关系法》的合宪性问题。该法案旨在全面禁止人工智能关系模拟，但作者论证其存在四大结构性缺陷：缺乏年龄限制条款（违背最高院Paxton先例）、与至少14个州的法规方向背道而驰、与州内既有的消费者欺诈法案冲突、以及动词界定已过时。文章还通过五种理论回应了法案的辩护理由，并提出替代立法方案。
AI.research_question: 新泽西州A2710号法案禁止人工智能关系模拟的规定在宪法和立法技术上是否存在根本性缺陷？该法案应如何被规范地重构？
AI.motivation: 该法案源于新泽西州一名男子因聊天机器人诱导而走向死亡的真实事件，法案以全面禁令回应了这一社会悲剧，但作者认为这一立法路径与现行宪法判例和全国立法趋势严重不符，需要系统的法律分析来揭示其问题所在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法第一修正案言论自由理论（基于Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton和Ginsberg v. NewYork先例的中间/严格审查标准）；未成年人保护与成人言论负担的区分理论；立法必要性（narrowly tailored）原则；州消费者保护法律框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（statutory analysis）加判例法论证。具体包括：宪法审查标准比对、跨州比较立法研究、州内法律体系内部一致性检验、以及立法技术（动词定义与产业结构的匹配性）分析。
AI.findings: (1) A2710缺乏年龄限制，不符合Paxton先例确立的合宪路径；(2) 至少14个州选择披露、危机协议和设计义务而非全面禁令，新泽西成为异类；(3) 第5条已能覆盖法案所述欺诈行为且附有明知要件，第4条禁令是过度的；(4) 第4(c)条绕过了消费者欺诈法案三十年积累的可确定损失门槛；(5) 法案的四个被禁止动词依赖已过时的分发模型，无法有效规制实际责任主体；(6) 五种支持法案的理论（包括"模型输出非受保护言论"）均无法在现存学术研究面前成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了生成式AI输出是否构成受第一修正案保护的言论的理论讨论，系统回应了五种反对将AI输出视为受保护言论的观点，为生成式内容在宪法言论保护框架中的定位提供了学术贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新泽西州立法者提供了一份可直接参考的替代立法方案，展示了如何以更合宪、更有效的监管方式（披露、危机协议、设计义务）应对AI伴侣关系的潜在危害，同时避免全面禁令带来的宪法风险和制度成本。

title: A Decolonial Feminist Intervention on Tax, Maize, and the Right to Eat on Our Own Terms
affiliations: University of Nairobi

detail.title: A Decolonial Feminist Intervention on Tax, Maize, and the Right to Eat on Our Own Terms
detail.abstract: Africa's food systems are shaped not only by climate, soil, and labour but by the fiscal architecture through which states raise revenue, distribute incentives, and negotiate with global capital. This policy brief follows the journey of maize, the continent's most politically and culturally significant staple, from mbegu (seed) to sahani (plate) to expose how corporate tax incentives, regressive consumption taxes, and the fiscal privileges afforded to multinational seed and agrochemical corporations systematically undermine food sovereignty, particularly for women wakulima (farmers) who produce the majority of the continent's food yet remain excluded from the fiscal bargain. Drawing on feminist political economy and decolonial fiscal analysis, the brief argues that tax justice is a food sovereignty issue, that the ongoing entry of genetically modified maize into African food systems through fiscal doorways demands urgent scrutiny, and that progressive alternatives, from rationalising agribusiness tax incentives to financing agroecological transition and making women's unpaid kazi (labour) visible in fiscal accounts are both necessary and achievable within the framework of SDGs 2, 16, and 17.

AI.tldr: 本文通过追溯玉米从种子到餐盘的旅程，揭示非洲粮食系统如何被财政架构（企业税收优惠、累退性消费税、跨国种业和农化公司的财政特权）所塑造，论证税收正义是粮食主权问题，并提出在SDG 2、16、17框架下实现渐进式替代方案的路径。
AI.research_question: 非洲的财政架构（税收激励、消费税、跨国企业的财政特权）如何系统性地削弱粮食主权，特别是对生产大部分粮食却被排除在财政契约之外的女性和农民的影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲粮食系统不仅受气候、土壤和劳动力影响，还受国家财政架构深刻塑造；转基因玉米正通过财政通道进入非洲粮食系统，亟需审视；女性农民生产了非洲大部分粮食却在财政体系中处于边缘地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义政治经济学（Feminist Political Economy）与去殖民化财政分析（Decolonial Fiscal Analysis）
AI.method: 政策简报（Policy Brief）形式，采用玉米从种子（mbegu）到餐盘（sahani）的追踪式叙事分析，考察企业税收激励、累退性消费税及跨国公司财政特权对粮食系统的塑造作用。
AI.findings: 企业税收激励、累退性消费税及跨国种子和农化公司的财政特权系统性地削弱非洲粮食主权；转基因玉米正通过财政通道进入非洲粮食系统；女性农民虽生产大多数粮食却被排除在财政契约之外；税收正义与粮食主权密不可分。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收正义概念引入粮食主权话语，通过女性主义政治经济学和去殖民化财政分析的交叉视角，揭示财政架构作为粮食系统塑造力量的理论维度，并将女性无偿劳动在财政核算中的可见性作为理论突破点。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议：合理化农业企业税收激励、为农业生态转型提供融资、在财政账户中使女性无偿劳动可见化，并在SDG 2（零饥饿）、16（和平正义与强大机构）和17（伙伴关系）框架内实施。

title: When Does Limit Order Book Information Constitute Tradable Alpha?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When Does Limit Order Book Information Constitute Tradable Alpha?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any person or organisation that could be perceived to have influenced this study. The research received no support from, and was not conducted on behalf of, any trading firm, exchange, or data vendor. The LOBSTER sample used is a free public academic dataset, and its provider had no role in the design, analysis, or reporting of this work.

detail.abstract: Limit order book signals are commonly reported on the strength of a rank correlation and a cumulative profit curve. Such reports frequently leave three questions open: whether the effect holds on each instrument in a panel or on the most active alone, whether the significance withstands the number of hypotheses evaluated, and whether the predicted movement exceeds the spread that must be crossed to trade it. This paper sets out a protocol that separates the three. Using five NASDAQ instruments from the LOBSTER sample (AAPL, AMZN, GOOG, INTC, and MSFT; 953,829 clean events), I evaluate four microstructure signals against four sequential gates: cross-sectional predictive power, Benjamini–Hochberg correction at the full hypothesis budget of 1,080, positive gross profit, and profitability net of a parameterised cost model. Order flow imbalance, queue imbalance, and micro-price deviation clear the first three gates, with rank information coefficients between 0.10 and 0.19 holding the same sign on all five instruments. None clears the fourth. The strongest signal reaches breakeven at 4.8% of the assumed half-spread, and costs account for 2,099% of gross profit under the baseline assumption. Two further results follow from the panel structure: queue imbalance and micro-price deviation function as a single signal, with a rank correlation of 0.969 and an incremental out-of-sample R2 of −0.0006; and order flow imbalance dominates on the wide-spread, thin-queue instruments while the top-of-book signals dominate on the penny-spread, deep-queue instruments, with the ordering reversing between the two groups. A Python implementation with 80 tests and synthetic controls of known ground truth accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套四阶段检验协议，用于严格评估限价订单簿微观结构信号的预测能力。作者使用5个NASDAQ工具（共953,829个干净事件）和1,080个假设预算，评估了四种微观结构信号。研究发现：订单流不平衡、队列不平衡和微价格偏差通过了前三个门槛（横截面预测力、Benjamini-Hochberg多重检验校正、正毛利润），但没有一个信号能在考虑到交易成本后实现净盈利。最强的信号仅需假设半价差的4.8%即可达到盈亏平衡，而成本占毛利润的2,099%。此外，研究还发现队列不平衡与微价格偏差实际上是同一信号（秩相关0.969），且不同信号在不同市场微观结构特征的工具上表现不同。
AI.research_question: 限价订单簿微观结构信号在严格的多重检验和交易成本检验下，是否具有真实的、可交易利用的预测能力？具体而言：效应是否在每个工具上都成立？显著性是否能经受大量假设检验的考验？预测的变动幅度是否超过交易所需跨越的价差？
AI.motivation: 现有文献报告限价订单簿信号时通常仅依赖秩相关和累计利润曲线，但这种方法存在三个未解决的问题：（1）效应是否在面板的每个工具上都成立，还是仅在最活跃的工具上成立；（2）显著性是否经受住了所评估假设数量的考验（多重检验问题）；（3）预测的价格变动是否超过交易所需跨越的价差（交易成本问题）。这些未解决的问题可能导致虚假发现和不可交易的信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于微观结构理论中的限价订单簿信息含量理论，包括订单流不平衡、队列不平衡和微价格偏差等信号的理论基础，并运用Benjamini-Hochberg多重检验校正方法、横截面预测能力检验以及参数化交易成本模型。
AI.method: 本文使用LOBSTER样本中五个NASDAQ工具（AAPL、AMZN、GOOG、INTC、MSFT）的953,829个干净事件，评估四种微观结构信号。方法核心是四阶段顺序门槛协议：（1）横截面预测力检验（每个工具上的秩信息系数）；（2）在1,080个完整假设预算下进行Benjamini-Hochberg校正；（3）正毛利润检验；（4）扣除参数化成本模型后的净盈利能力检验。此外还使用80个测试和已知真实结果的合成对照来验证协议的可靠性。
AI.findings: 研究发现：（1）订单流不平衡、队列不平衡和微价格偏差通过了前三个门槛，秩信息系数在0.10到0.19之间，且在五个工具上符号一致；（2）但没有一个信号能通过第四个门槛（净成本后盈利）——最强信号在假设半价差的4.8%处达到盈亏平衡，成本占毛利润的2,099%；（3）队列不平衡和微价格偏差实际上是同一个信号（秩相关0.969，增量样本外R²为-0.0006）；（4）订单流不平衡在宽价差、薄队列的工具上占主导，而顶格（top-of-book）信号在分币价差、深队列的工具上占主导，且两组之间的排序发生反转。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：（1）提出了一个可复制的四阶段检验协议，将横截面稳健性、多重检验校正和交易成本评估三个维度分离处理；（2）揭示了队列不平衡与微价格偏差实质上为同一信号，避免了重复计算和虚假发现；（3）发现不同微观结构信号在不同市场特征（价差宽度、队列深度）的工具上表现不同，为信号适用边界提供了理论洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：（1）提供了一个严格的信号评估框架，可供量化研究员和交易员用于筛选真正可交易的微观结构信号；（2）明确警告现有文献中报告的微观结构信号在纳入交易成本后可能完全不具盈利能力；（3）提供了包含80个测试和合成对照的Python实现，便于复现和推广使用；（4）提供了不同市场微观结构特征下选择何种信号的实操指导。

title: The Adaptation Rate Theorem: Predictable Lead Times in Multi-Scale Trailing Measures

detail.title: The Adaptation Rate Theorem: Predictable Lead Times in Multi-Scale Trailing Measures
detail.abstract:
We prove that for any quantity measured by trailing averages at two different timescales, the faster measure detects regime changes before the slower measure, with a lead time at the midpoint detection threshold of (w_slow - w_fast)/2 periods and, more generally, alpha  (w_slow - w_fast) at threshold fraction alpha. The bound is exact for step transitions under the simple moving average, extends to general weighted averages through an effective-lag formula, and is a property of weighted-sum arithmetic rather than of the statistical structure of the data. Its practical consequence is that the divergence between fast and slow measures provides earlier detection of regime transitions than the slow measure alone.

We test this on 24 pre-registered tests over 23 series across three domains under a pre-registered design with sign-test decision rules. The directional prediction - the raw divergence carries the sign of the slow measure's forward change - holds on 13 of 13 financial instruments, 7 of 7 economic tests, and 4 of 4 natural-science series: 24 of 24 pre-registered tests positive, with a combined two-sided sign-test probability of 1.2e-7 under the sign-symmetric null - and, since several instruments are near-duplicates of one another, 9.5e-7 after collapsing those pairs to 21 effective tests. On the headline external-event test, across 332 forward-volatility events the divergence's median advance notice is 90.0 calendar days (a lower bound, as over half the detections are censored at the scan-window edge) versus a median of 57.0 days for the slow measure's own threshold crossing, and the divergence beats the slow measure on 13 of 13 instruments. The divergence is positive strictly before 98.9% of internally defined regime onsets.

The mechanism is arithmetic, and the controls say so directly: on randomly permuted data - where all temporal structure is destroyed - the divergence fires before the onset at a pooled rate of 99.98%, at least as high as the real-data rate. We state the conditions under which the directional prediction fails (the Aliasing Condition), show, within the average-lag framework of Zakamulin (2017), that the commonly quoted Hull moving-average lag heuristic overstates the lag-additive value by a factor of two to three depending on window convention, and document a two-thirds law for the exponential moving average's realized lead. All numbers in this paper are regenerated on demand by a committed verification suite from hash-pinned data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个数学上的精确性质：在任何加权平均框架下，快速指标总比慢速指标更早检测到制度变化（regime change），领先时间取决于窗口长度差。这一性质纯粹源于加权求和的算术结构而非数据的统计特征。作者通过24项预先注册的测试（覆盖金融、经济和自然科学三个领域）验证了这一方向性预测，并报告了显著优于慢速指标的提前检测效果。该论文还指出了Hull移动平均滞后启发式的误差，并提供了一个可复现的验证体系。
AI.research_question: 快速移动平均指标相比于慢速移动平均指标，在检测制度变化（regime change）时是否具有确定性的提前检测优势？这种优势的数学基础和实证表现是什么？
AI.motivation: 交易和技术分析中广泛使用快慢均线的"金叉/死叉"来检测趋势变化，但缺乏严格的数学证明来解释为什么快速指标能提前检测到变化。作者希望从纯算术角度证明这一现象，并提供大规模预先注册的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动平均的加权算术性质、有效滞后（effective-lag）公式、Zakamulin（2017）的平均滞后框架、Aliasing Condition（方向预测失效条件）
AI.method: 数学推导证明（针对简单移动平均的精确边界及一般加权平均的推广）+ 24项预先注册的符号检验测试（覆盖13个金融工具、7个经济测试、4个自然科学序列）+ 随机置换数据对照实验 + 提交的验证套件确保可复现性
AI.findings: （1）在中点检测阈值下，快速指标领先慢速指标的精确时间为(w_slow - w_fast)/2期；（2）24/24预注册测试全部支持方向性预测，组合双侧符号检验p=1.2e-7；（3）在332个远期波动事件中，发散指标的中间提前通知为90天（下限），而慢速指标自身阈值交叉仅为57天；（4）在随机置换数据上发散指标仍然以99.98%的比率提前触发，证明该性质纯属算术而非统计结构；（5）Hull移动平均滞后启发式高估了滞后加性值的2-3倍。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从纯算术角度严格证明了快慢均线发散的提前检测性质，而非依赖数据的统计假设；（2）给出了该性质的精确数学边界（中点阈值的(w_slow - w_fast)/2领先时间）；（3）通过平均滞后框架修正了Hull移动平均启发式的倍率误差；（4）发现并形式化了方向预测失效的条件（Aliasing Condition）；（5）揭示指数移动平均实现领先的"三分之二定律"。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为交易者和分析师提供了快慢均线发散作为制度变化早期检测指标的理论依据；（2）提供了实证证据表明发散指标比慢速指标单独使用平均提前33天发出信号；（3）建立了一个完整的、可复现的验证体系（hash-pinned数据+提交验证套件）；（4）为跨领域（金融、经济、自然科学）的时间序列分析提供了通用的领先检测工具。

title: MSPCoL: Motion-Sensing Prototype Contrastive Learning for Imbalanced Micro-expressionRecognition
affiliations: Yunnan University, Yunnan University and Yunnan University

detail.title: MSPCoL: Motion-Sensing Prototype Contrastive Learning for Imbalanced Micro-expressionRecognition

keywords.keywords: Micro-expression recognitionClass imbalancePrototype contrastive learningDeep learning

detail.abstract: Micro-expression recognition (MER) aims to uncover genuine human emotions that are difficult to conceal, with important applications in psychology, security, and clinical diagnosis. However, existing methods still struggle under real-world scenarios due to two major limitations: first, they fail to learn balanced and robust representations of subtle dynamic features in micro-expressions, as models struggle to maintain stable attention on key motion regions; Second, most approaches are limited in addressing the decision bias induced by class imbalance. Thus, addressing subtle dynamic feature learning and class-imbalance bias within a unified framework remains a key challenge. To address the above challenges, we propose a novel \textbf{Motion-Sensing Prototype Contrastive Learning (MSPCoL) framework}. This framework consists of two core components: First, the Motion-Sensing Feature Extractor (MSFE) uses mutual-biased cross-attention among horizontal motion, vertical motion, and strain features to enhance sensitivity and robustness to subtle motion variations. Second, we introduce a Supervised Prototype-Adaptive Contrastive Learning (SPACoL) module, which uses Class-Adaptive Momentum(CAM) and a Dynamic-Static Prototype Fusion (DSPF) strategy to correct representation bias from data imbalance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed MSPCoL framework achieves superior performance in micro-expression recognition tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为MSPCoL（Motion-Sensing Prototype Contrastive Learning）的统一框架，用于解决微表情识别（MER）中两个核心挑战：细粒度动态特征学习不足导致的表征不鲁棒，以及类别不平衡引发的决策偏差。框架包含运动感知特征提取器（MSFE）和监督原型自适应对比学习模块（SPACoL）两大核心组件，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个统一框架内同时解决微表情识别中细粒度动态特征学习不足和类别不平衡导致的决策偏差两大问题？
AI.motivation: 现有微表情识别方法在真实场景下存在两大局限性：（1）模型难以在关键运动区域保持稳定注意力，无法学习到平衡且鲁棒的细微动态特征表示；（2）大多数方法未能有效处理类别不平衡引起的决策偏差。这两大问题需要在一个统一框架中共同解决，但当前缺乏这样的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于原型对比学习理论、交叉注意力机制以及动态-静态特征融合策略
AI.method: 提出MSPCoL框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）运动感知特征提取器（MSFE）：利用水平运动、垂直运动和应变特征之间的互偏交叉注意力，增强对细微运动变化的敏感性和鲁棒性；（2）监督原型自适应对比学习模块（SPACoL）：通过类自适应动量（CAM）和动态-静态原型融合（DSPF）策略，纠正数据不平衡导致的表征偏差。采用原型对比学习机制实现监督学习。
AI.findings: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MSPCoL框架在微表情识别任务中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一框架同时解决微表情识别中的细粒度动态特征学习和类别不平衡两大挑战；引入了运动感知的交叉注意力机制用于捕捉细微运动变化；提出了原型自适应对比学习与动态-静态原型融合策略来纠正类别不平衡偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为微表情识别在心理学、安全监控和临床诊断等实际应用场景中提供了更鲁棒和准确的技术方案，有助于提升真实环境下情绪识别的可靠性。

title: Molecular Subtyping of Breast Cancer by Immunohistochemistry, and Their Association with Histological Grade: A Large Tissue Microarray-Based Study in a Libyan Cohort

detail.title: Molecular Subtyping of Breast Cancer by Immunohistochemistry, and Their Association with Histological Grade: A Large Tissue Microarray-Based Study in a Libyan Cohort
detail.abstract: AbstractBackground: Breast cancer is the most common malignancy among women worldwide and a leading cause of cancer-related death. Its burden is rising across Africa, including Libya. In resource-limited settings, immunohistochemistry (IHC)-based assessment of estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2), and Ki-67 provides a practical surrogate for gene-expression-based molecular profiling, and tissue microarrays (TMAs) enable efficient, high-throughput biomarker evaluation. However, data on the distribution of IHC-based molecular subtypes of breast cancer in Libya remain limited. Aim: The present study aimed to characterize the distribution of immunohistochemistry-based surrogate molecular subtypes of breast cancer in a large Libyan cohort, investigate their associations with clinicopathological parameters, and evaluate the utility of tissue microarray-based immunohistochemistry as a practical platform for molecular stratification in a resource-limited setting. Materials & Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 1,073 archival breast cancer specimens evaluated by IHC for ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 using whole-tissue sections and TMA blocks. Tumors were classified into four IHC-based surrogate molecular subtypes: Luminal A, Luminal B, HER2-enriched, and triple-negative, using a Ki-67 cut-off of 14%. Associations between molecular subtypes and clinicopathological variables (age, sex, tumor grade, and receptor status) were assessed using chi-square/Fisher's exact tests, independent-samples t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation, and binary logistic regression, with significance set at p < 0.05. Results: The cohort was predominantly female (98.5%; n = 1,057), with a mean age of 52.8 ± 12.0 years and a peak frequency in the 45–59-year group (45.7%). Among 998 tumors with complete biomarker data, Luminal B was the most prevalent subtype (44.0%), followed by Luminal A (21.0%), HER2-enriched (20.8%), and triple-negative breast cancer (14.1%). Molecular subtype was significantly associated with tumor grade and with hormone receptor/HER2 status (all p < 0.001). Age showed a weak inverse correlation with Ki-67 (r = −0.099, p = 0.002), and ER-negative tumors showed significantly higher proliferative activity than ER-positive tumors (mean Ki-67 61.8% vs. 32.5%, p < 0.001). Multivariable logistic regression identified PR positivity, HER2 status, tumor grade, age, and sex as independent predictors of ER status (Nagelkerke R² = 0.721; overall accuracy 89.3%).Conclusion: The predominance of Luminal B tumors and their significant associations with clinicopathological characteristics indicate a comparatively more proliferative breast cancer profile in this Libyan cohort. Combined whole-section and TMA-based IHC proved feasible for large-scale molecular stratification in this resource-limited setting. These findings provide population-specific evidence to support prognostic stratification, personalized treatment planning, and future breast cancer research in Libya and comparable settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究对利比亚1,073例存档乳腺癌标本进行IHC分子分型，发现Luminal B型最为常见（44.0%），且分子亚型与肿瘤分级及受体状态显著相关。结合全片和TMA的IHC平台在资源有限环境下可有效进行大规模分子分层，为利比亚乳腺癌的预后分层和个体化治疗提供了人群特异性证据。
AI.research_question: 利比亚乳腺癌患者中基于免疫组化（IHC）的分子亚型分布特征是什么？这些亚型与临床病理参数有何关联？组织微阵列（TMA）为基础的IHC在资源有限环境中用于分子分层的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌在利比亚及非洲地区的负担日益加重，但关于利比亚乳腺癌IHC分子亚型分布的数据非常有限。在资源有限的环境中，IHC是基因表达分子分型的实用替代方法，而TMA可实现高通量的生物标志物评估，因此有必要对这一人群的分子亚型特征进行系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于免疫组化（IHC）的分子分型替代框架，将乳腺癌分为Luminal A、Luminal B、HER2富集型和三阴性四种亚型（以Ki-67 14%为临界值），作为基因表达分子分型的实用替代。
AI.method: 回顾性横断面研究。纳入1,073例存档乳腺癌标本，通过全组织切片和TMA芯片进行ER、PR、HER2和Ki-67的IHC检测。采用卡方检验/Fisher精确检验、独立样本t检验、单因素方差分析、Pearson相关和二元logistic回归分析分子亚型与临床病理变量的关联。
AI.findings: 利比亚乳腺癌队列以女性为主（98.5%），平均年龄52.8岁。在998例完整数据中，Luminal B型最常见（44.0%），其次为Luminal A（21.0%）、HER2富集型（20.8%）和三阴性（14.1%）。分子亚型与肿瘤分级及激素受体/HER2状态显著相关（p<0.001）。年龄与Ki-67呈弱负相关（r=−0.099），ER阴性肿瘤增殖活性显著高于ER阳性肿瘤。多变量logistic回归确定PR阳性、HER2状态、肿瘤分级、年龄和性别为ER状态的独立预测因子（Nagelkerke R²=0.721，总体准确率89.3%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了利比亚人群乳腺癌IHC分子亚型分布数据的空白，为非洲/中东地区乳腺癌分子流行病学提供了重要的人群特异性证据，验证了Luminal B型在资源有限地区占主导地位的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 证实了全片结合TMA的IHC平台在资源有限环境中进行大规模分子分层的可行性和实用性，为利比亚及类似地区的乳腺癌预后分层、个体化治疗方案制定和未来研究提供了实践指导框架。

title: Risk Measures for Stock-Bond Portfolios with Downward Stock Jumps at Bond Defaults
affiliations: University of Gothenburg - Department of Economics/Centre for Finance

detail.title: Risk Measures for Stock-Bond Portfolios with Downward Stock Jumps at Bond Defaults
detail.abstract: We study risk measures for stock-bond portfolios in which defaults of bond issuers generate both direct losses in the bond subportfolio and simultaneous downward jumps in stock prices. The resulting common default mechanism links equity and credit losses and can substantially increase portfolio tail risk. The default times may be generated by a broad class of credit portfolio models. We focus primarily on portfolios with a large homogeneous stock subportfolio and an arbitrary number of exchangeable defaultable bonds. For this setting, we derive computationally tractable approximations for the distribution and density of the stock-bond portfolio loss. These results provide the basis for computing risk measures such as Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall and depend on the default model through the default-count probabilities. The numerical analysis considers a one-factor Gaussian copula model for the default times and examines portfolio Value-at-Risk as a function of the default-dependence parameter, the time horizon, the confidence level, and the initial allocation between stocks and defaultable bonds. We compare the jump-at-default specification with a corresponding Black-Scholes benchmark in which the stock prices have the same diffusive parameters but do not jump at bond defaults. The results show that default-induced stock jumps can have a large effect on portfolio Value-at-Risk and that the effect of stronger default dependence can be non-monotone and varies substantially across confidence levels. These features are closely related to changes in the complete default-count distribution as the dependence parameter varies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究股票-债券组合的风险度量，其中债券发行人违约既直接造成债券子组合损失，又同时导致股票价格向下跳跃。这种共同违约机制将股权和信用损失联系起来，可能大幅增加组合尾部风险。针对大规模同质股票子组合与任意数量可交换违约债券的组合，推导出组合损失分布和密度的高效计算近似方法，为计算VaR和ES等风险度量提供基础。
AI.research_question: 在债券违约同时引发股票价格下跌的框架下，如何对股票-债券组合的损失分布进行有效近似计算，并分析违约依赖对组合风险度量（特别是VaR）的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统模型通常将股票和债券风险分开处理，忽略了债券违约对股票价格的直接冲击效应。实际上，债券发行人违约会同时导致债券损失和股票价格跳变，这种联动机制可能显著增加组合尾部风险，但现有文献对此研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用组合模型（宽泛的违约时间生成框架）、违约计数概率（default-count probabilities）、高斯copula模型、风险度量理论（VaR和Expected Shortfall）
AI.method: 针对大规模同质股票子组合与任意数量可交换违约债券的组合，推导组合损失分布和密度的解析近似。数值分析采用单因素高斯copula模型，将跳违约设定与Black-Scholes基准对比，分析VaR对违约依赖参数、时间跨度、置信水平和初始配置的敏感性。
AI.findings: （1）违约引发的股票跳跃对组合VaR有显著影响；（2）违约依赖增强的影响可能是非单调的，且在不同置信水平下差异显著；（3）这些特征与违约计数完整分布随依赖参数变化密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一框架，将股权和信用损失通过共同违约机制联系起来，拓展了组合风险度量的理论基础；证明了违约依赖对VaR的非单调效应与违约计数分布变化之间的内在联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算VaR和Expected Shortfall的高效数值方法，帮助金融机构更准确地评估股债混合组合的尾部风险，并深入了解违约依赖强度、时间跨度、置信水平和资产配置对风险的影响。

reference: Environmental and Resource Economics, volume 89, issue 8, 2026[10.1007/s10640-026-01111-3]
title: The Tragedy of the Commons in the Presence of Regime Shift Risk
affiliations: Université Paris Saclay and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Tragedy of the Commons in the Presence of Regime Shift Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Environmental and Resource Economics, volume 89, issue 8, 2026[10.1007/s10640-026-01111-3]

detail.abstract: Climate change poses substantial threats capable of triggering a drop in the renewability and quality of natural resources. In this paper, we extend standard stock-recruitment models to examine how the risk of this environmental event affects the tragedy of the commons associated with decentralized harvest decisions made by players exploiting a common pool renewable resource. We use general functional forms and allow for endogenous or exogenous hazard rates. Our analysis indicates that anticipating this environmental event critically affects harvest incentives. For instance, linear strategies may not hold in equilibrium when the hazard is stock dependent. The representative player can increase extraction today in response to a higher risk of decreased both resource renewability and quality. We find conditions under which environmental risk, in addition to inducing conservation, mitigates the tragedy of the commons. Calibrating our model to the Baltic Cod fishery, we find that players' strategic responses to the estimated endogenous regime shift risk may reverse the tragedy of the commons.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了标准种群补充模型，研究气候变化引发的环境事件风险如何影响公共池可再生资源的分散化开采决策中的"公地悲剧"。通过一般函数形式和内生/外生风险率设定，发现环境风险预期会显著改变开采激励，并在特定条件下反而缓解公地悲剧。以波罗的海鳕鱼渔业为校准案例，发现博弈者对内生制度转变风险的战略反应可能逆转公地悲剧。
AI.research_question: 气候变化引发的环境事件风险如何影响公共池可再生资源分散化开采决策中的公地悲剧？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对自然资源可再生性和质量构成重大威胁，但现有研究较少关注环境事件风险如何影响博弈者对公共池资源的开采激励及公地悲剧的程度。理解这一影响对资源管理和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的标准种群补充模型（stock-recruitment models）；公地悲剧理论（tragedy of the commons）；博弈论框架下的分散化开采决策模型；风险概率模型（内生/外生风险率）。
AI.method: 理论建模：使用一般函数形式扩展种群补充模型，允许内生或外生风险率设定；数值校准：将模型校准到波罗的海鳕鱼渔业数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）预期环境事件会显著影响开采激励，当风险率依赖种群存量时，线性策略在均衡中可能不成立；（2）面对资源可再生性和质量下降的更高风险，代表性博弈者可能增加当期开采；（3）环境风险在诱导保护的同时，在一定条件下可缓解公地悲剧；（4）在波罗的海鳕鱼渔业的校准中，博弈者对内生制度转变风险的战略反应可能逆转公地悲剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将环境事件风险引入标准种群补充模型，扩展了资源经济学中公地悲剧的理论框架；揭示了环境风险既可能加剧也可能缓解公地悲剧的条件，丰富了不确定性下公共资源博弈的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候变化背景下公共池可再生资源的可持续管理提供政策启示；通过波罗的海鳕鱼渔业的实证校准，为渔业资源管理在面临环境转变风险时的策略设计提供参考。

title: Algorithmic Bias in Predictive Policing and Sentencing: A Comparative Legal Analysis of the United States, New Zealand, and the Netherlands

detail.title: Algorithmic Bias in Predictive Policing and Sentencing: A Comparative Legal Analysis of the United States, New Zealand, and the Netherlands
detail.abstract: In October 2023, President Joe Biden signed an Executive Order on Artificial Intelligence (AI), reflecting growing federal attention to the technology's use across government. Although the order intends to oversee technology, it also brings into focus the prevalent biases in AI systems that dominate the criminal justice domain. 1 The use of (AI) in the United States' criminal justice system mainly through predictive policing and sentencing is seen as an improvement on efficiency though it raises questions about algorithmic bias. This research paper critically evaluates whether AI aggravates or minimises prejudice. It aims to achieve this by investigating how these algorithms are developed, and impact on bias and fair hearing. The work reveals the need for fair judicial processes regarding algorithmic bias through reviewing present technology and legal frameworks used by various nations. Therefore, this study focuses on discrimination inherent to tools like COMPAS, transparency problems related to algorithmic decision-making; and the importance of responsible AI methods. To address these problems, this research applies comparative analysis to contribute to the ongoing debate on AI's application in criminal law and suggesting ways of reducing prejudice generated from algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地评估了美国刑事司法系统中人工智能（主要通过预测性警务和量刑）是加剧还是减少了偏见。通过比较分析各国技术与法律框架，研究聚焦于COMPAS等工具的固有歧视、算法决策的透明度问题以及负责任AI方法的重要性，并提出减少算法偏见的建议。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在美国刑事司法系统中的应用是加剧了偏见还是减少了偏见？这些算法是如何开发并影响偏见与公正审判的？
AI.motivation: 2023年10月拜登总统签署人工智能行政命令，反映出联邦政府对AI技术应用的日益关注，但同时也凸显了刑事司法领域中AI系统普遍存在的偏见问题。尽管AI被视为提升效率的手段，但其算法偏见引发重大关切，亟需批判性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法偏见理论、公平审判原则、负责任AI框架、比较法律分析框架
AI.method: 比较分析方法：对各国现有技术与法律框架进行比较审视，重点分析预测性警务和量刑中的AI算法开发过程及其偏见影响。
AI.findings: AI在刑事司法中的应用虽然提升了效率，但COMPAS等工具存在固有的算法歧视；算法决策过程存在透明度不足的问题；不同国家对算法偏见的法律应对存在差异；需要负责任的AI方法来减少算法产生的偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判性地评估了AI在刑事司法中究竟是加剧还是减少偏见这一核心争议，丰富了算法偏见与司法公正关系的理论讨论，并为负责任AI在刑事法律领域的应用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和司法实践者提供了减少算法偏见的可行建议；通过比较各国法律框架为完善AI在刑事司法中的监管提供了参考；有助于推动更加公平透明的算法决策机制建设。

title: Technology and the Production of Justice: System-wide Effects of Indonesia's e-court Reform
affiliations: New Economic School (NES),  and Bocconi University

detail.title: Technology and the Production of Justice: System-wide Effects of Indonesia's e-court Reform
detail.abstract: Delays in judicial proceedings are a pervasive institutional challenge. We study how technology changes judicial production using Indonesia's e-court reform, which introduced e-filing, e-payments, and virtual hearings for civil but not criminal cases. Using case-level data linking trial decisions to appeals, we compare civil and criminal cases handled by the same judge in the same court before and after reform. E-courts reduced case duration by about 7 days, or 15 percent, while preserving judicial quality. If anything, appeals and reversals fell, judgments became more concise, and readability and statutory citations were unchanged. The gains extended through the judicial system: case duration in untreated appellate courts fell by about 9 days, or 20 percent. The pattern is consistent with the reform freeing judicial capacity for more complex disputes, highlighting the potential for technology to expand capacity by reorganizing judicial production and relieving system-wide congestion.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度尼西亚电子法院改革（e-court），通过比较同一法官在同一法院处理的民事与刑事案件，发现电子法院将案件审理时长缩短约7天（15%），同时保持了司法质量，上诉率和改判率甚至有所下降，判决更简洁，可读性和法条引用未变。改革效益还传导至未改革的上级法院，案件时长缩短约9天（20%），表明技术通过重组司法生产释放了司法能力，缓解了全系统拥堵。
AI.research_question: 技术（电子法院改革）如何改变司法生产的效率与质量？
AI.motivation: 司法程序延误是普遍的体制性挑战，理解技术能否以及如何提升司法生产效率具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法生产函数理论；司法能力与案件积压理论；技术进步的流程重组理论。
AI.method: 利用印度尼西亚电子法院改革（民事案件适用、刑事案件不适用）作为准自然实验，采用案件层面数据（关联审判判决与上诉），在法院-法官层面比较改革前后民事与刑事案件的处理差异（双重差分方法）。
AI.findings: （1）电子法院使案件时长缩短约7天（15%），且未损害司法质量；（2）上诉率和改判率下降，判决更简洁，可读性与法条引用不变；（3）改革效益外溢至未改革的上级法院，案件时长缩短约9天（20%）；（4）改革释放了司法能力，使其可处理更复杂的案件，缓解了全系统拥堵。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术通过重组司法生产流程（而非简单替代人力）来扩展司法系统能力的内在机制，论证了司法效率提升可以产生系统性的溢出效应，为技术进步与制度绩效的理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家司法系统的数字化转型提供了实证依据，表明电子法院改革可以在不牺牲司法质量的前提下显著缩短案件审理周期，并缓解全系统的案件积压问题，具有重要的政策参考价值。

title: Outcome Disclosure and Temporal Refinement in Multi-Battle Team Contests
affiliations: Shenzhen University, Shandong University, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics and School of Economics, Shandong University

detail.title: Outcome Disclosure and Temporal Refinement in Multi-Battle Team Contests
detail.abstract: A team-contest designer values output rather than expenditure; nonlinear conversion makes the distinction consequential. We study two non-pecuniary instruments in majority-rule contests decided by pairwise all-pay battles with private abilities: disclosing resolved outcomes and splitting the battle schedule into finer blocks. Neither changes a battle's average pivotality; each only redistributes it across histories. Under nested information structures, this redistribution makes equilibrium ability-scaled expenditure weakly more dispersed player by player without changing its mean; expected aggregate expenditure is invariant across all designs considered. The resulting convex-order comparison ranks expected total output: convex output costs favor no disclosure and coarser temporal structures, concave costs favor full disclosure and finer ones, and linear costs make both comparisons neutral. The rankings hold for finite-support and smooth continuous-type ability distributions. The mechanism extends to degree-zero component contest technologies with a unique equilibrium outcome distribution. No and full disclosure bound every admissible public garbling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多数规则竞赛中两种非金钱工具（披露已解决结果和将比赛日程细分为更小模块）如何通过重新分配历史间的中立性（pivotality），在不改变平均支出和预期总支出不变的前提下，影响能力缩放支出的分布，并基于凸序比较得出不同产出成本函数下的最优设计排序。
AI.research_question: 在由成对全付费战斗决定的多数规则竞赛中，披露结果和拆分比赛日程这两种非金钱工具如何影响均衡支出分布与预期总产出？
AI.motivation: 竞赛设计师关注的是产出而非投入，而非线性转换使得投入分布（而非仅均值）变得重要。需要理解信息结构与时序结构如何影响均衡支出的分散程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多数规则竞赛理论、全付费拍卖理论、凸序（convex order）比较、嵌套信息结构、博弈论均衡分析
AI.method: 理论建模与比较静态分析：构建嵌套信息结构下的博弈论模型，利用凸序比较方法分析均衡能力缩放支出的分布特征，并扩展至零次组件竞赛技术。
AI.findings: （1）披露结果和拆分日程均不改变一场战斗的平均中立性，仅将其在历史间重新分配；（2）在嵌套信息结构下，这种重新分配使均衡能力缩放支出在逐玩家基础上弱更分散，均值不变，预期总支出对所有设计不变；（3）凸序比较结果显示：凸产出成本偏好不披露和较粗时间结构，凹成本偏好完全披露和较细结构，线性成本下两种比较均中性；（4）结果对有限支撑和光滑连续型能力分布均成立；（5）该机制可扩展至具有唯一均衡结果分布的零次组件竞赛技术；（6）无披露和完全披露界定了所有可容许的公开噪声化方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将凸序比较引入多数规则竞赛研究，证明了信息/时间结构通过中立性重分配影响均衡支出分布的一般机制，并将结论推广至更广泛的零次组件竞赛技术，构建了披露方案的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞赛设计师提供了明确的设计指南：根据产出成本函数的凸性/凹性选择是否披露结果以及日程结构的粗细程度，以实现预期总产出的优化。

title: Simulating Firms' Inflation Expectations with a Multi-Agent AI Framework
affiliations: Department of Economics and Indiana University

detail.title: Simulating Firms' Inflation Expectations with a Multi-Agent AI Framework
detail.abstract: Firms' inflation expectations shape pricing, wages, and investment, yet the organizational process through which executive beliefs aggregate into a firm-level forecast remains unmodeled. We develop a multi-agent AI framework in which distinct executive roles produce role-specific inflation expectations, which a Chairman agent synthesizes into a single firm-level expectation. Simulating the Survey of Firms' Inflation Expectations across 32 quarterly waves from 2018 through 2026, automated firms track the main survey dynamics and generate interpretable withinfirm disagreement that widens during supply-driven inflation episodes. Role framing changes not only forecast levels but also the economic narratives used to support them. An out-of-sample exercise with staggered model cutoffs suggests that this alignment is not driven solely by memorization. Memory experiments further show that providing the historical path of past SoFIE responses substantially improves accuracy, while feeding back agents' own prior answers introduces anchoring rigidity during regime shifts. In a randomized information-treatment experiment, synthetic firms update beliefs in the direction of the information provided and differentiate between short-and long-horizon signals, demonstrating the framework's potential as a pre-experimental laboratory for information interventions. The framework also reveals systematic limitations: tail-risk probabilities are too high and cross-firm dispersion is substantially compressed. Together, the results show both the promise and the boundaries of multi-agent LLMs as tools for simulating organizational belief formation. 1

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个多智能体AI框架，模拟企业通胀预期的形成过程。在该框架中，不同高管角色产生各自的通胀预期，由"主席"智能体综合为单一企业层面预期。通过模拟2018-2026年32个季度的调查数据，框架成功追踪了主要调查动态，并展示了信息干预实验的潜力，同时也揭示了尾部风险概率过高和跨企业离散度被压缩等系统性局限。
AI.research_question: 高管信念如何通过组织过程聚合为企业层面的通胀预期？多智能体大语言模型能否有效模拟企业预期的组织形成过程？
AI.motivation: 企业的通胀预期影响定价、工资和投资决策，但现有研究缺乏对高管信念如何聚合为企业层面预测的组织过程的建模。作者希望用多智能体AI框架填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体AI框架（Multi-agent LLM framework）；组织信念聚合理论；企业通胀预期形成理论
AI.method: 构建多智能体AI框架，包含不同高管角色（各自产生角色特定的通胀预期）和主席智能体（综合为单一企业预期）；模拟2018-2026年32个季度的企业通胀预期调查；进行样本外测试、记忆实验和随机信息处理实验。
AI.findings: (1)自动化企业能追踪主要调查动态并产生可解释的企业内部分歧，在供给侧驱动的通胀时期分歧扩大；(2)角色框架不仅改变预测水平还改变支撑预测的经济叙事；(3)样本外测试表明对齐并非仅靠记忆；(4)提供历史调查路径大幅提高准确性，而反馈自身先前答案在制度转变时引入锚定刚性；(5)合成企业在信息干预实验中能按信息方向更新信念并区分短长期信号；(6)揭示系统局限：尾部风险概率过高、跨企业离散度被显著压缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将组织信念形成过程建模为多智能体过程，揭示了高管角色框架如何影响企业层面预期及其叙事支持；展示了多智能体LLM作为模拟组织信念形成工具的理论潜力与边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个"预实验实验室"，可在真实信息干预实施前测试其对企业通胀预期的影响；为理解企业通胀预期形成机制及信息政策设计提供参考。

title: The U.S.–China Trade War and the Geography of Global Production
affiliations: University of Vienna, University of Göttingen,  and University of Mannheim

detail.title: The U.S.–China Trade War and the Geography of Global Production
detail.abstract: We study how the U.S.–China trade war affected manufacturing activity in third countries using a novel plant-level dataset covering millions of establishments in 50 major economies, including affiliates of more than 200,000 multinational enterprises (MNEs). Combining establishment-level data with detailed tariff information, we estimate the effects of U.S. and Chinese punitive bilateral output and input tariffs on sales, employment, and establishments across countries, industries, and stages of production. We find that third-country effects of the trade war are highly heterogeneous and largely offsetting, yielding moderately negative net effects overall. Most of the adjustment is driven by multinational enterprises reallocating activity across affiliate networks, while domestic firms respond much less.

AI.tldr: 本文利用涵盖50个主要经济体、数百万家企业（包括20多万家跨国企业子公司）的工厂层面数据，研究美中贸易战对第三国制造业活动的影响。研究发现贸易战对第三国的影响高度异质且大体相互抵消，总体净效应为适度负面，且调整主要来自跨国企业在其子公司网络间的活动重新配置，而国内企业的反应较小。
AI.research_question: 美中贸易战如何影响第三国的制造业活动（销售、就业和企业建立）？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注贸易战对美国和中国的直接影响，缺乏对第三国溢出效应的系统分析。作者利用覆盖多国的大型工厂层面数据，填补了贸易战对第三方国家影响证据的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策溢出效应理论、跨国企业（MNE）内部网络配置理论、关税传导与投入产出关联分析
AI.method: 利用工厂层面的企业数据，结合美国和中国惩罚性双边产出关税与投入关税的详细信息，建立计量经济模型估计关税变化对各国、各行业及各生产阶段企业的销售、就业和建立数量的影响。
AI.findings: 1）贸易战对第三国的影响高度异质且大体相互抵消，整体净效应为适度负面；2）大部分调整由跨国企业通过子公司网络重新配置活动驱动；3）国内企业反应相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将跨国公司内部网络调整机制引入贸易战溢出效应的分析框架，揭示了跨国企业在第三国效应中的核心角色，丰富了贸易政策冲击国际传导的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府和政策制定者理解贸易战的第三方溢出效应提供实证依据，有助于评估贸易保护主义政策的全球影响，并为跨国企业的供应链区位决策提供参考。

title: Growth and (Re)distribution in China and Korea: Bayesian Estimation of a Non-Stationary Heterogeneous Agent Model

detail.title: Growth and (Re)distribution in China and Korea: Bayesian Estimation of a Non-Stationary Heterogeneous Agent Model
detail.abstract: I analyze growth and (re)distribution jointly in China (1982-2019) and Korea (1962-2019) inside a non-stationary heterogeneous-agent model. Two innovations make Bayesian estimation feasible: a certainty-equivalent-anchored quasi-rational equilibrium concept which replaces full rational expectations with a finite-horizon deterministic forecast; and a deep-learning pipeline that amortizes the agent's decision problem, the equilibrium computation, and the posterior itself. Counterfactual experiments find that TFP catch-up is the dominant driver of output growth yet leaves the wealth distribution untouched, that the education expansion and the fertility decline likewise buy per-capita growth with little distributional footprint, that state investment promotes growth while potentially concentrating wealth, that a thin social safety net buys growth at a large cost to consumption at the bottom, and that among the model's estimated primitives idiosyncratic labor-productivity risk has the largest marginal impact on wealth inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非平稳异质代理人模型，联合分析中国（1982-2019）与韩国（1962-2019）的增长与（再）分配问题。采用两项方法论创新使贝叶斯估计可行：一是以确定性等价为锚的拟理性均衡概念，用有限期界确定性预测替代完全理性预期；二是利用深度学习管线摊销代理人决策问题、均衡计算及后验估计。反事实实验发现：TFP追赶是产出增长的主导驱动力但对财富分配无影响；教育扩张与生育率下降带来人均增长但分配效应甚微；国家投资促进增长但可能加剧财富集中；薄社会安全网以牺牲底层消费为代价换取增长；在所有估计的结构参数中，个体劳动生产力风险对财富不平等的影响最大。
AI.research_question: 在中国和韩国的长期发展过程中，经济增长与财富（再）分配之间如何相互作用？各结构性因素（TFP、教育、生育率、国家投资、社会保障、个体劳动风险）对增长与不平等各自产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常将经济增长与收入/财富分配问题分开分析，而这两者在经济发展过程中相互交织。本文试图在一个统一的动态一般均衡框架下，对增长与分配进行联合量化分析，并利用中国和韩国两个典型追赶型经济体的长期数据回答这一关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非平稳异质代理人模型（non-stationary heterogeneous-agent model）；拟理性均衡（quasi-rational equilibrium）概念，以确定性等价为锚，用有限期界确定性预测替代完全理性预期；贝叶斯估计方法。
AI.method: 构建非平稳异质代理人动态一般均衡模型，联合估计中国和韩国的长期宏观数据。方法论上采用两大创新：（1）确定性等价锚定的拟理性均衡概念，降低计算复杂度；（2）深度学习管线，摊销代理人决策问题、均衡计算和后验估计，使大规模贝叶斯估计在计算上可行。在此基础上进行反事实实验，分解各结构性因素的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）TFP追赶是产出增长的主导驱动力，但对财富分配没有影响；（2）教育扩张与生育率下降促进人均增长，但分配效应很小；（3）国家投资促进增长但可能加剧财富集中；（4）薄社会安全网以底层消费大幅下降为代价换取增长；（5）在所有估计的结构参数中，个体劳动生产力风险对财富不平等的影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）方法论贡献：提出确定性等价锚定的拟理性均衡概念，使大规模非平稳异质代理人模型的贝叶斯估计变得可行；（2）引入深度学习管线摊销决策、均衡和后验计算，推进了计算方法论前沿；（3）理论上将增长与分配纳入统一分析框架，识别各因素对增长与不平等的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为理解中国和韩国追赶型增长模式的增长-分配权衡提供量化证据；（2）政策启示：国家投资增长伴随财富集中风险，薄社会保障以底层消费为代价，提示政策制定者需权衡增长目标与分配公平；（3）识别出个体劳动生产力风险是财富不平等的最重要驱动因素，为相关社会保障与保险政策设计提供依据。

title: Consumption as Absorption: Reinterpreting the Keynesian Consumption Function
affiliations: Nguyen Tat Thanh University

detail.title: Consumption as Absorption: Reinterpreting the Keynesian Consumption Function

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a structural reinterpretation of the Keynesian consumption function by embedding it within an accounting-consistent framework. Starting from the identity 𝐶 +𝑆 ≡ 𝑌, it argues that the conventional interpretation of autonomous consumption as an exogenous component of demand arises from treating the consumption function as a standalone behavioral equation. Once accounting consistency is imposed, the intercept term becomes an endogenous magnitude reflecting the allocation of income between consumption and saving. To clarify this structure, aggregate income is decomposed into a persistent state component and a deviation component. Consumption is then reformulated as an absorption mechanism operating through two distinct channels: state absorption governed by the average propensity to consume (APC), and deviation absorption governed by the marginal propensity to consume (MPC). Within this framework, adjustment terms are reinterpreted as coordinated mechanisms that reconcile consumption and saving, rather than as stochastic residuals. The analysis introduces the concept of absorption regimes, characterized by a regime weight capturing the relative dominance of state and deviation income. Changes in consumption are interpreted as either internal reallocations within a stable regime or structural transitions between regimes. The contribution is conceptual and methodological, offering an alternative to marginalist approaches that focus on estimating behavioral parameters. By shifting attention toward accounting consistency and structural absorption, the framework provides a coherent basis for analyzing consumption dynamics without reliance on econometric inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了对凯恩斯消费函数的结构性重新诠释，将其嵌入一个会计一致的框架中。通过从恒等式C+S≡Y出发，将截距项重新解释为收入在消费与储蓄间分配的内生量，并引入吸收机制（APC主导的状态吸收和MPC主导的偏差吸收），构建了吸收体制的概念框架，用以分析消费动态。
AI.research_question: 如何在会计一致性约束下重新诠释凯恩斯消费函数的结构，从而避免将自主消费视为外生需求成分的传统误解？
AI.motivation: 传统消费函数的解释将自主消费视为外生的需求组成部分，这源于将消费函数当作独立的行为方程来处理。这种处理忽略了消费与储蓄之间的会计恒等关系，导致对消费动态的片面理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于凯恩斯消费理论，结合会计恒等式C+S≡Y的会计一致性约束，引入平均消费倾向（APC）与边际消费倾向（MPC）的双渠道吸收机制，以及吸收体制（absorption regimes）的概念框架。
AI.method: 概念性与方法论分析，通过会计恒等式分解总收入为状态成分与偏差成分，并以此重构消费函数的结构，不依赖计量经济推断。
AI.findings: 截距项在会计一致性约束下为内生变量，反映收入在消费与储蓄间的分配；消费通过两条渠道运作——以APC为基础的状态吸收和以MPC为基础的偏差吸收；调整项被重新解释为协调消费与储蓄的机制，而非随机残差；引入吸收体制概念，消费变化可被理解为体制内再分配或体制间结构转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对凯恩斯消费函数的替代性结构性诠释，将注意力从估计行为参数转向会计一致性与结构性吸收；提出了吸收体制这一新概念，丰富了消费动态分析的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析消费动态提供了不依赖计量经济推断的连贯分析基础，有助于在缺乏计量数据或统计推断条件受限时进行消费结构分析。

title: Pricing, Hedging, and Securitizing AI Compute: A Non-Storable Commodity Framework for Infrastructure Risk
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: Pricing, Hedging, and Securitizing AI Compute: A Non-Storable Commodity Framework for Infrastructure Risk
detail.abstract: The financialization of artificial-intelligence (AI) compute is under way. In 2026 the first exchange-traded compute futures were announced, settling against daily GPU-hour rental benchmarks, and tens of billions of dollars of GPU-collateralized debt now sit inside bankruptcy-remote special-purpose vehicles. This paper builds a self-contained mathematical framework for that market. We treat a GPU-hour as a non-storable commodity: the spot price is a rental rate, and it cannot be inventoried. From that starting point we develop the pricing, hedging, and securitization theory such a market requires. We model the log spot rental rate as a seasonal Schwartz--Smith two-factor process, augmented by upward, fast-reverting price spikes. We attach a secondary token-price layer driven by downward algorithmic-efficiency jumps. Because the spot is perishable, it is not tradable, so the market is genuinely incomplete. We make this precise and quantify it. A single risk-neutral specification delivers all of our pricing results. We derive closed-form forward curves and characterize their contango, backwardation, Samuelson, and seasonal structure. We obtain fair swap rates and the term structure of the forward risk premium. We compute tail-risk measures for derivative sellers, and we show that expected shortfall can become infinite while value-at-risk stays finite. We derive no-arbitrage price intervals and utility-indifference prices for convex claims. We identify an irreducible basis between token and GPU-hour exposure, and we build a large-pool securitization model. The securitization analysis is the paper's cautionary core. In compute, collateral recovery falls together with default: an AI slowdown simultaneously depresses borrower cash flows, GPU resale value, and utilization. We prove that a fixed-recovery valuation systematically understates senior-tranche expected loss under these conditions. We also prove that under exponential depreciation, the overcollateralization needed to hold loss coverage fixed grows exponentially with tenor. A ten-experiment simulation suite, fully reproducible from a single script, validates every theorem and recovers the model's parameters from model-generated data. One tension unifies the paper: dilution versus amplification. Compute-linked structured products do disperse normal-time and moderate risk. But a Gaussian, average-recovery, point-forecast lens systematically understates the tail, and those are precisely the assumptions whose failure proved costly in earlier waves of financial engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了人工智能算力（GPU小时）金融化的自洽数学框架，涵盖定价、对冲与证券化理论。将GPU小时视为不可储存商品，以季节性Schwartz-Smith双因子过程加快速回复的价格尖峰建模，并叠加由算法效率提升驱动的代币价格层。核心发现包括：由于现货不可交易导致市场不完备；推导出远期曲线、互换利率、风险溢价的闭式解；证明期望短缺可以无限大而VaR有限；识别代币与GPU小时敞口之间不可消除的基差；以及证券化分析的核心警示——在算力场景下，抵押品回收与违约同时下降（AI放缓同时压低借款人现金流、GPU转售价值与利用率），固定回收率估值会系统性低估优先级档预期损失，且指数折旧下所需的超额抵押随期限呈指数增长。整体张力在于稀释与放大：结构化产品确实分散常规风险，但高斯化、平均回收率、点预测的视角会系统性低估尾部风险。
AI.research_question: 如何为人工智能算力（GPU小时）这一新兴金融化市场构建自洽的定价、对冲与证券化数学框架？特别是在现货不可储存、不可交易导致市场不完备的条件下，如何量化风险并设计合理的金融产品结构？
AI.motivation: AI算力金融化正在加速：2026年首个交易所交易算力期货推出，以日度GPU小时租金基准结算；数十亿美元的GPU抵押债务已嵌入破产隔离SPV中。然而该市场缺乏自洽的数学定价框架。算力现货具有不可储存性（租金不能库存），这使其与商品、证券等传统金融市场有本质差异，急需专门的定价与风险管理理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Schwartz-Smith两因子模型（季节性扩展版）用于刻画对数现货租金率；2. 快速回复价格尖峰（跳跃）过程；3. 不可储存/不可交易商品的非完备市场理论；4. 无套利定价与效用无差异定价；5. 风险中性定价（单一风险中性设定）；6. 抵押品证券化模型（巴塞尔式分层现金流模型）。
AI.method: 数学建模与理论推导为主的规范研究，辅以十项模拟实验套件（单脚本可完全复现）验证所有定理，并从模型生成数据中恢复模型参数。方法具体包括：闭式解推导（远期曲线、互换利率、风险溢价期限结构）、尾部风险度量计算（VaR与期望短缺ES）、无套利价格区间与效用无差异定价、可证明的证券化损失覆盖分析、以及参数反演模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 推导出闭环形式的远期曲线，并刻画其升贴水（contango/backwardation）、Samuelson效应与季节性结构；2. 获得公平互换利率与远期风险溢价的期限结构；3. 证明衍生品卖方的期望短缺（ES）可趋于无穷大而VaR保持有限；4. 推导凸性索取权的无套利价格区间与效用无差异价格；5. 识别代币与GPU小时敞口之间不可消除的基差；6. 核心警示性发现：在算力场景下，固定回收率估值系统性低估优先级档预期损失——因为AI放缓同时压低借款人现金流、GPU转售价值和利用率（回收率与违约同向下降）；7. 证明在指数折旧下，维持损失覆盖所需的超额抵押（overcollateralization）随期限呈指数增长；8. 十项模拟实验验证所有定理并成功恢复模型参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次为"算力天然商品"（不可储存的GPU小时）建立完整的定价-对冲-证券化理论框架；2. 将非完备市场理论精确化并量化（因现货不可交易）；3. 证明在算力特有的"回收率与违约正相关"场景下，传统固定回收率证券化估值理论的系统性失败；4. 揭示指数折旧下超额抵押需求的指数增长规律；5. 阐明算力结构化产品的"稀释与放大"张力：可分散常规风险但系统性低估尾部的理论根源。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为算力交易所（如2026年首批算力期货）提供定价基准与对冲工具设计指南；2. 为GPU抵押贷款与算力ABS的发起人和投资者提供正确的估值与风险度量方法（尤其尾部风险管理）；3. 提供了一套完全可复现的十项模拟套件，可用于模型校准、参数反演与压力测试；4. 警示证券化从业者避免重蹈"高斯化、平均回收率、点预测"假设失败的覆辙；5. 为监管者与评级机构评估算力衍生品与结构化产品的风险提供量化依据。

title: The Unconquered Frontier - Non-Financial Risk in Global Banking
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Unconquered Frontier - Non-Financial Risk in Global Banking
detail.abstract: For four decades the architecture of bank risk management has been built around financial risk - credit, market and liquidity - and the capital held against it. This paper argues that the binding frontier has shifted. The losses, enforcement actions and near-existential events that most threaten a modern institution’s capital, license and franchise increasingly originate not in the financial positions a bank chooses to hold, but in how it operates: its conduct, controls, technology, third parties, data and people. Drawing on loss data from the ORX global consortium, conduct-cost data from the CCP Research Foundation, regulatory enforcement records, the IBM/Ponemon cyber-cost series, Bank of England survey and financial-stability data and capital-composition analysis from the IMF and Basel Committee, the paper tests the claim that non-financial risk (NFR) has become the dominant risk frontier. The evidence is mixed but directionally clear: while credit risk still consumes the most capital on average, NFR now accounts for the largest idiosyncratic shocks, the most severe enforcement outcomes and the risks that supervisors and practitioners themselves rate as the hardest to manage. The paper’s central conceptual contribution is an analysis of NFR interplay - how operational, conduct, technology, third-party, financial-crime and model risks correlate, cascade and compound allowing risk to accumulate undetected until it crystallizes as a single large event. Two cross-verified case studies (the 2024 TD Bank antimoney-laundering failure and the 2024 CrowdStrike outage) narrate the background story on latent buildup and systemic concentration. The paper then proposes concrete governance reforms and examines the deeper question: whether financial and non-financial risk should converge into a single domain graded by a unified set of core metrics. It argues that full metric unification at the level of human judgement is neither achievable nor desirable, but that a unified risk-grading overlay - a common severity and resilience scale covering both domains is both possible and overdue. Finally, it asks whether the computational engine for that overlay already exists in modern machine learning i.e whether neural-network and gradient-boosting models, by ingesting the full heterogeneous feature space of a bank (financial metrics, control indicators, loss data, thirdparty network structure and unstructured text), can learn the cross-domain interactions that human aggregation misses and emit a single, continuously updated unified risk score. The paper develops a reference architecture for such a score and argues that its viability provides explainability: a black-box bank-risk score is inadmissible under the US SR 11-7, the PRA’s SS1/23 and the EU AI Act. It compares the two dominant explanation methods - LIME (local surrogate models) and SHAP (Shapley-value additive attribution) and concludes that SHAP’s additive, consistent decomposition is what executes the grading overlay, turning an opaque score into a defensible statement of how much each risk driver contributed, with LIME serving as an independent challenge tool. The paper’s final position is that AI is the right engine for commensurability and interaction detection but cannot be an autonomous fortune teller: the unprecedented nature of the most severe non-financial tail events places a hard ceiling on what any model trained on history can foresee, so the unified score must remain a governed, human-in-the-loop decision lens rather than a verdict.

AI.tldr: 本文论证非金融风险（NFR）已成为银行风险管理的新前沿。基于ORX损失数据、CCP行为成本数据、监管处罚记录、IBM/Ponemon网络成本系列及巴塞尔/IMF资本构成数据等多源实证，研究发现虽然信用风险仍平均占用最多资本，但NFR已构成最大的特质性冲击和最严重的监管处罚来源。论文提出NFR交互（interplay）概念框架，通过TD Bank反洗钱失败和CrowdStrike宕机两个案例说明风险如何潜伏累积。最终主张以SHAP等可解释机器学习构建统一的跨域风险评分覆盖层，但强调该评分须保持人在回路中的治理属性。
AI.research_question: 非金融风险是否已成为银行风险管理的主导前沿？金融与非金融风险能否在统一的风险评分体系下实现融合？机器学习能否作为这一统一评分的计算引擎，并满足监管可解释性要求？
AI.motivation: 四十年来银行风险管理架构围绕信用、市场和流动性等金融风险构建。但近年来威胁银行资本、牌照和特许经营权的重大损失、执法行动和近生存危机事件越来越多地源于运营风险（行为、控制、技术、第三方、数据和人），而非金融头寸本身。现有研究缺乏对NFR主导地位的实证检验和概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非金融风险（NFR）交互理论——操作风险、行为风险、技术风险、第三方风险、金融犯罪风险和模型风险之间的相关性、级联与复合效应分析；风险潜伏累积直至以单一重大事件爆发的机制。
AI.method: 多源数据实证分析（ORX损失数据、CCP行为成本、监管执法记录、IBM/Ponemon网络成本、英格兰银行调查、IMF和巴塞尔资本构成数据）+ 两个交叉验证的案例研究（2024 TD Bank反洗钱失败、2024 CrowdStrike宕机）+ 参考架构设计与解释方法比较（LIME vs SHAP）
AI.findings: 证据方向明确但存在混合性：信用风险仍平均占用最多资本，但NFR已成为最大的特质性冲击来源、最严重的执法后果来源，且被监管者和实务人员评为最难管理的风险。案例研究揭示了NFR的潜伏累积和系统性集中特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出NFR交互（interplay）概念框架，阐释操作、行为、技术、第三方、金融犯罪和模型风险如何相关、级联和复合；论证全指标统一在人类判断层面既不可行也不可取，但统一的风险分级覆盖层（共同严重性和韧性量表）是可能且必要的。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的治理改革建议；构建基于机器学习（神经网络和梯度提升模型）的统一风险评分参考架构；论证SHAP的可加性、一致性分解适合执行分级覆盖层，LIME作为独立挑战工具；明确模型受限于历史训练数据，统一评分须保持治理化的人机协作属性以满足SR 11-7、SS1/23和EU AI Act监管要求。

title: The Adaptation Tax: How Trailing Averages in Policy Tools Systematically Misprice Downturns

detail.title: The Adaptation Tax: How Trailing Averages in Policy Tools Systematically Misprice Downturns
detail.abstract:
Trailing averages are embedded in the institutional infrastructure that governs monetary policy, banking regulation, and retirement security. Because a trailing average mathematically converges toward the series it tracks, it absorbs economic shocks into its own definition of "normal" - understating downturns while they happen and overstating them afterward. This paper measures that bias in five institutional systems using only public data, under a pre-registered design with committed decision rules.

In our sample, the real-time Hodrick-Prescott inflation trend is revised asymmetrically by 0.60 percentage points between rising- and falling-inflation regimes (block-bootstrap p = 3.0e-03), and the trend itself performs 85.4% of the gap-closing work when inflation deviates from it. The Basel III credit-to-GDP gap absorbed 81.4% of the 2003-2007 credit expansion into trend, an understatement worth an estimated $154.73 billion in uncalled countercyclical capital on the primary Y-9C risk-weighted-asset series ($163.02 billion on the FDIC fallback). The Social Security COLA lagged actual inflation in 96% of rising-inflation years - a lag the statutory chain makes near-definitional in rising years, measured here to confirm it holds outside rounding, floor, and freeze artifacts. A quarterly application of the same statutory formula reduces tracking error by 38% at approximately zero cumulative cost; that improvement falls short of the pre-registered 50% assertion bar, so the design's own decision rule records the reform as neutral-but-not-better - a measured candidate, not a demonstrated fix. Public pension actuarial smoothing produced a median gap of 20.6% between reported and market asset values in fiscal 2009, with actuarial values exceeding market values in 8 of 8 downturn years. The GDP and CPI asymmetries replicate with the same sign in 5 of 5 and 5 of 5 economies tested (United States, United Kingdom, Euro Area, Japan, South Korea), with cross-country coefficients of variation of 14.0% and 46.8% - dispersion we read as consistent with a property of the filter rather than of any one economy. A conditional Monte Carlo stress exercise, run because the pre-registered falsifier board supported it, estimates the compound mispricing exposure at $116.36 per US household per year averaged across all households during moderate stress, concentrated at roughly $3,642 per affected homebuyer per year - an absolute-mispricing metric that sums transfers and losses alike (a rising-regime error favors the borrower at the other side's expense; incidence and conditionality are stated in Sections 3.4 and 8). For each in-scope system, the diagnostic that measures the bias is itself the proposed replacement, and each replacement is computable from public data in a spreadsheet.

The paper registers three dated, falsifiable forward predictions targeting the next downturn,
with explicit falsification criteria and full replication materials.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测量了"滚动平均"（trailing average）机制嵌入货币政策、银行监管和退休保障制度中所产生的系统性偏差。研究发现，滚动平均在数学上向其所追踪的序列收敛，会将经济冲击吸收进其自身的"正常"定义中——在经济下行时低估衰退、在事后高估衰退。论文基于预注册设计，使用公开数据对五个制度系统进行了偏差测量，包括Hodrick-Prescott通胀趋势、巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口、社会保障COLA滞后、公共养老金精算平滑，以及跨国GDP和CPI不对称性检验。
AI.research_question: 滚动平均（trailing average）制度嵌入在货币政策、银行监管和退休保障体系中所产生的系统性偏差有多大？这种偏差如何在五个具体制度系统中被量化和检验？
AI.motivation: 滚动平均数学上会向其追踪的序列收敛，从而将经济冲击吸收进其"正常"的定义中，导致对经济下行时的低估和事后高估。这种偏差嵌入在货币政策、银行监管和退休保障等核心制度基础设施中，但此前缺乏系统性的、预注册的量化测量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 滚动平均收敛的数学性质、Hodrick-Prescott滤波、巴塞尔III逆周期资本缓冲框架、社会保障COLA法定链式公式、公共养老金精算平滑理论、块自助法（block-bootstrap）统计推断
AI.method: 预注册设计（pre-registered design），使用公开数据对五个制度系统进行偏差测量：1) 实时Hodrick-Prescott通胀趋势的非对称修正测量；2) 巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口的趋势吸收效应与资本损失估算；3) 社会保障COLA在通胀上升年份的滞后测量；4) 公共养老金精算平滑的资产估值偏差测量；5) 跨国（美、英、欧元区、日、韩）GDP和CPI不对称性复制检验；6) 条件蒙特卡洛压力测试估计复合错误定价敞口。
AI.findings: 1) HP通胀趋势在通胀上升与下降制度间存在0.60个百分点的非对称修正（p=3.0e-03），趋势本身承担85.4%的缺口闭合工作；2) 巴塞尔III信贷/GDP缺口吸收了2003-2007年信贷扩张的81.4%进入趋势，造成约1547.3亿美元未征收的逆周期资本；3) 社会保障COLA在96%的通胀上升年份滞后于实际通胀；4) 公共养老金精算平滑在2009财年产生20.6%的报告与市场资产价值中位差距，8/8下行年份精算值超过市值；5) GDP和CPI不对称性在5/5和5/5个经济体中复制出相同符号；6) 中等压力条件下复合错误定价敞口估计为每美国家庭年均116.36美元，受影响的购房者年均约3642美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为"滚动平均偏差"提供了系统的、预注册的跨制度实证证据，揭示了滚动平均在数学收敛性质下将经济冲击纳入其自身基准所导致的系统性认知偏差。论文测量的每一项偏差诊断本身就是提议的替代方案，且各替代方案均可从公开数据在电子表格中计算，为制度设计理论提供了可操作的新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 对货币政策制定者和银行监管者提供滚动平均偏差的量化证据，有助于改进逆周期资本校准；2) 验证了社会保障COLA滞后并非四舍五入或下限的人为产物，而是法定公式的结构性特征，并提出季度应用可减少38%追踪误差（接近但未达到50%的预注册门槛）；3) 为养老金监管提供精算平滑与市场价值偏差的量化数据；4) 发布三个带明确证伪标准的、有日期的前瞻性预测和完整复现材料，推动制度改革的循证决策。

title: Moving Averages Follow Price: A Mathematical Proof and Empirical Validation of the Adaptation Property in Trailing Averages

detail.title: Moving Averages Follow Price: A Mathematical Proof and Empirical Validation of the Adaptation Property in Trailing Averages
detail.abstract: We argue that when a time series deviates from any causal trailing average, the subsequent gap closure is, on the data we examine, predominantly consistent with the mechanical adaptation of the average rather than reversion of the series toward the average. The result is algebraic: for any weighted moving average satisfying standard non-negativity conditions and any permanent displacement, the average converges to the new level with 100% of the gap closure attributable to filter movement and 0% to series movement (Lemmas 1-3). We extend this deterministic result to stochastic processes, proving that the aggregate filter share equals 1 under a random walk (Theorem 2) and providing convergence bounds in the adaptation regime for general stationary ergodic processes (Theorem 3). We validate the theory on 44 instrument-filter combinations spanning 11 financial instruments, six asset classes, four continents, and up to 155 years of daily data. The aggregate moving average share of gap closure exceeds 50% on all 44 combinations tested and exceeds 100% (indicating the series moved further away while the average converged) on 33 of 44 (75%). The next-bar direction test shows no systematic tendency for price to move toward its moving average: under Hull-50, toward rates cluster near 50% on 8 of 11 instruments with mild attraction (~53%) on three (uncorrected for multiplicity); under SMA-200, three instruments show mild repulsion (~47%), of which only one retains significance after a full-sample drift adjustment. Synthetic random walk and GARCH-calibrated controls confirm the decomposition methodology is approximately unbiased under zero attraction, so the elevated shares observed on real instruments are not metric artifacts. A Schelling Point test across 137 instrument-window-timeframe combinations finds no detectable self-fulfilling prophecy effect at popular moving average windows (delta = -0.005 pp, two-sided p = 0.78). Two findings carry forward-looking predictive content: large displacement from the moving average predicts elevated forward realized volatility (Spearman rho = +0.54 average across 11 instruments, positive on all 11; 33 of 38 tests - including every full-sample and out-of-sample test - remain significant under serial-dependence-corrected inference), and the S&P 500 shows genuine quarterly mean-reversion (r = -0.28 at 126 days), which operates at a different timescale and through a different mechanism than the mechanical adaptation that dominates at shorter horizons. The qualifications to "predominantly" are reported in full: the aggregate share falls below 50% in 5 of 18 rolling decade-windows on SPX (one negative, 1991-2001), and the modern era (1990-2026) shows mild but statistically significant attraction (toward rate 53.1%, p = 0.0089, not adjusted for multiplicity). The adaptation result itself is an attribution of past gap closure, not a forward predictor.

AI.tldr: 本文证明时间序列偏离因果移动平均后，缺口闭合主要由移动平均的机械适应（filter movement）驱动，而非序列向均线回归。通过代数引理和随机过程定理建立理论基础，在44种工具-过滤器组合（涵盖11种金融工具、6类资产、4大洲、最长155年日度数据）上验证，均线闭合份额超过50%，75%的组合超过100%。预测性发现包括：大幅偏离均线预测升高的前瞻已实现波动率（Spearman rho平均+0.54），以及标普500在126天时间尺度上存在真实的季度均值回归（r = -0.28）。
AI.research_question: 当时间序列偏离因果移动平均后，随后的缺口闭合究竟是由序列向均线回归（series movement）驱动，还是由均线向序列水平机械适应（filter movement）驱动？这种归因在确定性、随机过程以及真实金融数据三个层面上是否成立？
AI.motivation: 市场上广泛存在"价格会回归移动平均"的直觉和交易策略，但这一假设从未被严格检验。本文旨在通过数学证明和实证验证，澄清缺口闭合的真实机制——多数情况下并非均值回归，而是均线的机械适应，从而纠正普遍存在的认知偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论框架包括：(1) 代数归因框架——对任何满足标准非负条件的加权移动平均和任何永久位移，缺口闭合中100%归因于过滤器移动、0%归因于序列移动（Lemma 1-3）；(2) 随机过程扩展——在随机游走假设下，聚合过滤器份额等于1（Theorem 2）；(3) 收敛界——对一般平稳遍历过程提供适应机制的收敛界（Theorem 3）；(4) Schelling Point自我实现预言检验框架。
AI.method: 采用三类方法：(1) 数学证明：代数引理（Lemma 1-3）和随机过程定理（Theorem 2-3）建立理论归因框架；(2) 实证验证：在44种工具-过滤器组合（11种金融工具、6类资产、4大洲、最长155年日数据）上分解缺口闭合份额，实施next-bar方向检验、Schelling Point测试（137个工具-窗口-时间框架组合）；(3) 控制实验：合成随机游走和GARCH校准控制验证分解方法在零吸引条件下的无偏性，并进行序列依赖校正的推断和全样本漂移调整。
AI.findings: (1) 44种组合中，均线缺口闭合份额全部超过50%，75%的组合超过100%（表明序列反而离均线更远而均线在收敛）；(2) next-bar方向测试显示价格无系统趋向均线的趋势；(3) Schelling Point测试无自证预言效应（delta = -0.005 pp, p = 0.78）；(4) 大幅偏离均线预测升高的前瞻已实现波动率（所有11种工具相关性为正，平均rho = +0.54），33/38测试在序列依赖校正后仍显著；(5) 标普500在126天尺度上存在真实季度均值回归（r = -0.28），与短期机械适应机制不同；(6) 局限性：SPX的5/18滚动十年窗口中聚合份额低于50%，现代时期（1990-2026）存在轻微但统计显著的吸引效应（toward rate 53.1%, p = 0.0089）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次从数学上严格证明缺口闭合归因的"适应主导"性质，建立一般性代数引理和随机过程定理；(2) 区分均线"机械适应"与序列"均值回归"两种机制，澄清了长期被混淆的概念；(3) 提供了对任意满足标准条件的加权移动平均均成立的普适性结果；(4) 证明Schelling Point自我实现预言在流行的均线窗口中不成立，挑战了行为金融中关于交易者共识影响价格的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为交易者和量化投资者提供实证依据：基于"价格回归均线"的策略缺乏系统性支撑，尤其在短期时间尺度；(2) 大幅偏离均线可作为前瞻波动率的预测指标（rho=+0.54），具有风险管理应用价值；(3) 为标普500的季度均值回归交易提供实证支持（126天时间尺度，r=-0.28）；(4) 提供缺口闭合归因分解方法论，可作为技术分析评估的标准工具，帮助实践者避免归因偏差。

title: Returns to Caring? Health and Wellbeing Effects of Subsidized Long-Term Care
affiliations: London School of Economics,  and University of Murcia

detail.title: Returns to Caring? Health and Wellbeing Effects of Subsidized Long-Term Care
detail.abstract: We estimate the health and wellbeing effects of subsidized access to long-term care (LTC). Our analysis exploits the staggered implementation of Spain’s 2007 System of Autonomy and Care for Dependent People (SAAD), which expanded publicly funded and universal LTC subsidies and supports, as well as its subsequent reform. Using two decades worth of administrative and survey data and leveraging exogenous regional and individual-level variation in program exposure, we find that access to SAAD benefits reduces the care receiver’s depressive symptoms by about 1 percentage point, increases its survival probability by 2.6–3 percentage points, and raises its life satisfaction by 0.24–0.50 scale points. Cost-effectiveness estimates indicate that the implied cost per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gained lies below commonly accepted efficiency thresholds for public health spending in Europe. These findings document sizeable health returns and efficiency gains from publicly subsidized LTC provision

AI.tldr: 本文评估了西班牙2007年长期护理补贴政策（SAAD）对护理接受者健康与福祉的影响。利用行政和调查数据及区域/个体层面的外生变异，发现获得SAAD补贴可显著降低抑郁症状、提高生存概率并提升生活满意度，且成本效益比低于欧洲公共卫生支出的效率阈值，证明公共补贴长期护理具有可观健康回报和效率收益。
AI.research_question: 公共补贴的长期护理（LTC）获取对护理接受者的健康与福祉有何影响？其成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化加剧，长期护理需求激增，但关于公共补贴LTC对健康效果和成本效益的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是欧洲背景下的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康经济学中的公共健康干预成本效益理论；长期护理与健康结果（心理健康、生存率、生活满意度）的关系框架
AI.method: 利用西班牙2007年SAAD政策的交错实施作为准自然实验，结合二十年行政与调查数据，利用区域和个体层面项目暴露的外生变异进行因果识别，并进行成本效益分析（QALY）
AI.findings: 获得SAAD补贴使护理接受者抑郁症状降低约1个百分点；生存概率提高2.6-3个百分点；生活满意度提高0.24-0.50个量表分。每获得一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的成本低于欧洲公共卫生支出的公认效率阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共补贴长期护理的健康回报提供了严格的因果证据，填补了LTC政策效果评估的文献空白；引入QALY成本效益框架评估长期护理补贴效率，扩展了健康经济学中公共支出效率分析的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了公共补贴长期护理具有成本效益的实证依据，支持在老龄化社会背景下扩大或维持LTC公共投入；为LTC政策的资源分配和效率评估提供了可操作的方法论参考。

title: When Firms Wave the Flag: Corporate Nationalist Rhetoric as Geopolitical Risk Management
affiliations: University of Toronto and Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business

detail.title: When Firms Wave the Flag: Corporate Nationalist Rhetoric as Geopolitical Risk Management
detail.abstract: How do firms manage political risk amid geopolitical rivalry? We argue that firms increasingly use rhetorical nationalism-public signals of loyalty to the home state-as a cheap and flexible strategy, but global exposure complicates its use. Using Chinese listed firms from 2016 to 2023, we combine elite interviews with two original text-based measures of corporate nationalist rhetoric and firm-level political risk. Exploiting the U.S.-China trade war as the onset of broader geopolitical escalation, we find an overall rise in nationalist rhetoric but a non-monotonic response across firms with different levels of global exposure: nationalist signaling increases most among the least and most globalized firms and least among moderately globalized firms. This nonlinear adjustment is more evident among private firms than stateowned enterprises, consistent with private firms relying more heavily on political signaling to compensate for weaker political embeddedness. We further show that rhetorical nationalism is largely symbolic: changes in rhetoric are not accompanied by broad changes in substantive firm behavior. These findings show how firms calibrate low-cost political signals when a rapidly shifting and uncertain geopolitical environment leaves them caught between competing pressures at home and abroad.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在地缘政治竞争背景下，企业如何通过修辞性民族主义（向母国表达忠诚的公开信号）作为低成本灵活策略来管理政治风险。利用2016-2023年中国上市公司数据，结合精英访谈和两种原创文本测量方法，利用中美贸易战作为地缘政治升级的起点，发现民族主义修辞总体上升但呈非线性响应：全球化程度最低和最高的企业信号增加最多，中度全球化企业增加最少。这种非线性调整在民营企业中更明显，且修辞性民族主义主要是象征性的，未伴随实质性行为变化。
AI.research_question: 在地缘政治竞争加剧的背景下，企业如何管理政治风险？具体而言，企业如何利用修辞性民族主义作为应对政治风险的策略，以及全球化程度如何影响这一策略的使用？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治竞争日益加剧，企业面临母国和东道国之间相互冲突的压力。传统的政治风险管理策略（如政治游说、建立政治关联）成本高昂或灵活性不足，需要探索更廉价、更灵活的策略。然而，修辞性民族主义作为政治信号的使用及其与全球化暴露之间的关系尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治风险理论、信号理论（政治信号传递）、企业政治嵌入理论
AI.method: 混合方法：1）精英访谈获取质性洞察；2）两种原创的基于文本测量的企业民族主义修辞指标；3）企业层面的政治风险度量；4）利用中美贸易战作为准自然实验，采用差异化检验方法分析不同全球化程度企业的非线性响应。
AI.findings: 1）中美贸易战后，企业民族主义修辞总体上升；2）民族主义信号在不同全球化程度企业间呈U型非线性响应——全球化程度最低和最高的企业增加最多，中度全球化企业增加最少；3）这种非线性调整在民营企业中比国有企业更明显，因为民营企业更依赖政治信号来弥补较弱的政治嵌入；4）修辞性民族主义主要是象征性的，并未伴随企业实质行为的大范围改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）识别了修辞性民族主义作为企业应对政治风险的一种低成本、灵活策略，拓展了政治风险管理的理论框架；2）揭示了全球化暴露与企业政治信号策略之间的非线性关系，丰富了企业政治嵌入理论；3）区分了象征性信号与实质性行为，为理解企业政治信号的真实性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业管理者提供了在地缘政治不确定性下信号策略选择的参考；2）为政策制定者理解企业民族主义修辞的本质（象征性vs实质性）提供了依据；3）为投资者和分析师评估企业政治信号的真实含义提供分析框架。

title: Pure Risk
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Pure Risk
detail.abstract: We introduce a behavioral notion of domain-specific risk aversion that separates attitudes toward risk from deterministic utility: an agent is more pure risk averse in one domain than in another if, for prizes that are indifferent under certainty, he is more averse to risk in the former domain than in the latter. We develop a model that goes beyond expected utility by allowing risk attitudes to vary across domains, while preserving expected utility within each domain. The domains are subjective and need not be specified in advance; they are identified from choice behavior. We establish uniqueness of the model's parameters and provide an axiomatic characterization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种行为层面的"领域特定风险厌恶"概念，将风险态度与确定性效用分离：若一个体在确定性等价的奖品下，在某一领域比另一领域更厌恶风险，则称其在纯风险厌恶上存在领域差异。作者构建了一个超越期望效用理论的模型，允许风险态度在不同领域间变化，同时在每个领域内保持期望效用性质。该模型的领域是主观的，无需事先指定，可通过选择行为识别。文章确立了模型参数的唯一性并提供了公理化刻画。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越期望效用理论、允许风险态度在不同（主观且未知的）领域间变化，同时保持每个领域内期望效用性质的决策模型？
AI.motivation: 传统期望效用理论假设风险态度在不同领域间是一致的，但现实生活中个体可能在不同领域（如金融、健康、安全等）表现出不同的风险偏好。现有文献缺乏一个能同时实现以下目标的理论框架：(1)将风险态度与确定性效用分离；(2)允许风险态度跨领域变化；(3)领域是主观的、无需事先指定；(4)模型参数唯一且可公理化刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望效用理论（EU）；领域特定风险厌恶的行为概念；主观领域识别理论；公理化决策理论
AI.method: 理论建模与公理化方法。本文采用形式化决策理论框架，定义行为层面的领域特定纯风险厌恶概念，构建允许领域间风险态度异质性的效用模型，并通过公理化方法确立参数的唯一性。
AI.findings: (1) 成功定义了将风险态度与确定性效用分离的领域特定纯风险厌恶行为概念；(2) 建立了超越期望效用、允许跨领域风险态度变化的模型，同时在每个领域内保留期望效用性质；(3) 证明领域是主观的且可从选择行为中识别；(4) 确立了模型参数的唯一性并提供了完整的公理化刻画。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次提出行为层面的领域特定纯风险厌恶概念，实现了风险态度与确定性效用的清晰分离；(2) 构建的模型在理论上超越了期望效用理论，打破了"风险态度全局一致"的传统假设；(3) 领域的主观性和可从行为识别的性质，为决策理论提供了更灵活的建模工具；(4) 参数的唯一性结果和公理化刻画为后续理论发展和实证检验奠定了坚实基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模型可应用于需要识别和测量在不同领域（如金融投资、健康决策、保险选择等）中个体差异化风险态度的实际场景，帮助政策制定者和从业人员更好地理解和预测个体在特定领域中的决策行为。

title: Agriculture, Land Use and Optimal Second-Best Environmental and Climate Policy with Greenhouse Gas Leakage
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics, , University of Copenhagen - Institute of Food and Resource Economics and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Agriculture, Land Use and Optimal Second-Best Environmental and Climate Policy with Greenhouse Gas Leakage

keywords: climate and environmental policy towards agriculture

detail.abstract: Despite being a major source of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, agriculture remains one of the least regulated sectors in climate policy. Designing climate policy for agriculture is challenging due to the interaction between GHG emissions, emissions of other pollutants such as ammonia and nitrate, competing land uses, and the risk of GHG leakage. Within a general equilibrium framework, we analyze cost-effective climate policy for the entire economy with a focus on agriculture, assuming a national GHG emissions target and a target for limiting GHG leakage. The first-best policy requires a large set of tax and subsidy instruments to mitigate GHG leakage from all possible channels. We argue that this set of instruments is unlikely to be implemented in practice. We therefore focus on an implementable second-best policy. We show that accounting for all externalities and leakage effects, it is second-best optimal to differentiate GHG taxes across sectors and to allow taxes on other emissions to deviate from their Pigouvian level. To quantify the second-best policy, we simulate a calibrated version of our theoretical model, with leakage coefficients computed using a large-scale global general equilibrium model. Simulations indicate that the domestic environmental co-benefits of GHG reductions may be sufficiently large to ensure that overall household welfare improves even when disregarding global warming effects. However, the government faces a trade-off: if it wishes to limit GHG leakage, it will have to sacrifice the benefits to the domestic environment that could otherwise be gained from the second-best optimal unilateral climate policy.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个一般均衡框架下分析了农业部门的气候政策设计问题。由于农业同时涉及温室气体排放、氨和硝酸盐等其他污染物排放、竞争性土地利用以及温室气体泄漏风险，最优气候政策设计面临挑战。第一最优政策需要大量税收和补贴工具来缓解所有渠道的泄漏，但实践中难以实施；因此本文聚焦于可实施的第二最优政策，证明在考虑所有外部性和泄漏效应后，温室气体税收应在部门间差异化，其他污染物税收应偏离庇古水平。通过校准模型模拟发现，温室气体减排的国内环境协同效益足够大，即使不考虑全球变暖效应，家庭福利仍可改善；但政府面临权衡：若限制温室气体泄漏，则需牺牲第二最优单边气候政策带来的国内环境效益。
AI.research_question: 在一般均衡框架下，如何在考虑农业部门温室气体排放、其他污染物排放、竞争性土地利用及温室气体泄漏风险的情况下，设计可实施的次优（第二最优）气候政策？
AI.motivation: 农业是温室气体排放的主要来源之一，但却是气候政策中监管最少的部门之一。农业气候政策设计因温室气体排放与其他污染物（如氨和硝酸盐）排放之间的相互作用、竞争性土地利用以及温室气体泄漏风险而颇具挑战性，亟需系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论、庇古税理论、第二最优理论、外部性理论
AI.method: 理论建模（一般均衡框架下的第一最优与第二最优政策分析）+ 数值模拟（用大规模全球一般均衡模型计算泄漏系数，并对校准的理论模型进行模拟）
AI.findings: （1）第一最优政策需要大量税收和补贴工具，实践中难以实施；（2）第二最优政策要求温室气体税在部门间差异化，其他污染物税收可偏离庇古水平；（3）模拟表明，温室气体减排的国内环境协同效益可能足够大，即使不考虑全球变暖效应，整体家庭福利也能改善；（4）政府面临权衡：限制温室气体泄漏将牺牲第二最优单边气候政策本可带来的国内环境效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将温室气体泄漏、其他污染物排放（氨、硝酸盐）和竞争性土地利用同时纳入一般均衡框架，提出了可实施的第二最优气候政策设计原则，丰富了农业部门气候政策的经济理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在实践中设计农业部门气候政策提供了可操作的第二最优方案，阐明了部门间温室气体税差异化及非温室气体污染物税收调整的具体原则，并揭示了限制泄漏与实现国内环境协同效益之间的政策权衡。

title:
Albert and the Dinosaurs 
A Solution Concept for Decision Problems with Imperfect Recall
affiliations: University of Rochester

detail.title:
Albert and the Dinosaurs 
A Solution Concept for Decision Problems with Imperfect Recall
detail.abstract: We offer a solution concept for decision problems for agents with imperfect recall, such as Piccione and Rubinstein's absent-minded driver. The decision maker's limited memory holds a plan of action, which he revises at each decision point according to an updating procedure that is optimal given his (true) belief that the same procedure has governed his behavior in the past and will govern it in the future. Because present choices constrain future behavior through the contents of memory, the resulting concept differs from all others in the literature; we make the comparisons explicit and argue for the new concept's advantages. For a parameterized family of examples we compute the solutions in full: expected payoffs are always uniquely determined, some parameter values require randomized updating procedures, and in Piccione and Rubinstein's original example the rationally absent-minded driver strictly outperforms the standard solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对不完美记忆（imperfect recall）下决策者的决策问题（如Piccione和Rubinstein的"心不在焉的司机"问题），提出了一种新的解概念。在该概念中，决策者的有限记忆包含一个行动计划，他在每个决策点根据一个最优更新程序来修订计划，且该更新程序的最优性基于他（正确的）信念：相同的程序在过去支配了他的行为，也将在未来支配他的行为。由于当前选择通过记忆内容约束未来行为，该解概念有别于文献中其他所有解概念。作者进行了明确比较并论证了新概念的优越性。在一个参数化例题族中，作者完整计算了所有解：期望收益总是唯一确定的，某些参数值需要随机化更新程序，并且在Piccione和Rubinstein的原始例子中，"理性心不在焉的司机"严格优于标准解。
AI.research_question: 在不完美记忆条件下，如何为决策者（如Piccione和Rubinstein的心不在焉的司机）提供一个合理且优越的解概念？
AI.motivation: Piccione和Rubinstein的心不在焉的司机问题暴露出标准决策理论在应对不完美记忆时的困难，现有文献中多种解概念存在争议且结果不尽合理。作者试图提出一个基于"自我一致的最优更新程序"的新解概念来克服这些问题。
