AI.theoretical_framework: 不完美记忆（imperfect recall）下的动态决策理论；自我一致信念（self-consistent beliefs）框架；计划更新（plan updating）的序贯最优性。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学分析：定义一个新的解概念（基于最优更新程序与正确信念的一致性），与文献中既有解概念进行显式比较，并在参数化例题族中计算完整解。
AI.findings: （1）新解概念在参数化例题族中期望收益总是唯一确定的；（2）某些参数值需要采用随机化更新程序；（3）在Piccione和Rubinstein的原始例子中，理性心不在焉的司机（采用新解概念）严格优于标准解；（4）新解概念与文献中所有其他解概念均不同，且具有明确优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的、与现有文献中所有解概念不同的不完美记忆决策解概念，通过"记忆内容约束未来行为"这一关键机制弥补了既有理论的不足，为不完美记忆决策理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不完美记忆情境下的实际决策问题（如注意力有限时的行为决策）提供了可计算且结果唯一的求解方法，并能推导出优于标准解的实际决策策略。

title: Water-Related Ecosystem Services for Accounting: Is Another Meta-Regression Needed?
affiliations: , University of East Anglia (UEA) - School of Environmental Sciences and University College London

detail.title: Water-Related Ecosystem Services for Accounting: Is Another Meta-Regression Needed?
detail.abstract: Water-related ecosystems sustain critical ecological and economic functions, but fragmented and methodologically heterogeneous valuation evidence limits the incorporation of water-related ecosystem services (WES) into environmental-economic accounts. The System of Environmental-Economic Accounting -Ecosystem Accounting (SEEA EA) identifies value transfer (VT) as an area for development, yet existing meta-analytic functions combine exchange values with welfare-based estimates that are incompatible with accounting requirements. This study compiles, to our knowledge, the first harmonised global dataset of exchange-compatible WES values. The systematic review identified 271 estimates from 68 studies, of which 144 observations from 62 studies could be standardised to 2024 international dollars per hectare per year. A linear mixed-effects meta-regression identified service category, ecosystem area and monetary proxy as the main sources of value heterogeneity. Leave-one-observation-out and leave-one-study-out validation produced median absolute transfer errors of 70% and 73%, respectively, within the range commonly reported in environmental VT. In an application to Dutch surface-water provisioning, the function underpredicted the reconstructed accounting benchmark by 33.8%. Applying a welfare-inclusive freshwater function to the corresponding Dutch context instead produced an estimate 152 times the benchmark. Although one application cannot establish general predictive superiority, the contrast shows that consistency between the underlying value concept and the accounting purpose materially affects transfer outcomes. The dataset and function provide a replicable basis for filling valuation gaps in monetary WES accounts and strengthening the evidence available for water allocation, ecosystem restoration and environmental management where primary valuation is constrained by limited data and resources.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了首个全球统一的、与生态系统核算（SEEA EA）兼容的水相关生态系统服务（WES）交换价值数据集，包含来自68项研究的271个估值估计（其中144个可标准化）。通过线性混合效应元回归识别价值异质性来源，并验证了价值转移（VT）函数的预测准确性。在荷兰地表水供给案例中，该函数低估核算基准33.8%，而福利导向函数则高估152倍，表明价值概念与核算目的的一致性对转移结果有重大影响。
AI.research_question: 如何构建与SEEA EA核算要求兼容的水相关生态系统服务交换价值数据集，并开发可复制的价值转移函数以填补货币化核算中的估值缺口？
AI.motivation: 水相关生态系统支撑关键的生态和经济功能，但现有估值证据分散且方法异质，难以纳入环境经济核算。SEEA EA将价值转移（VT）视为待发展领域，但现有元分析函数混用了交换价值与福利导向的估计，与核算要求不兼容，亟需建立统一、兼容的估值基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于SEEA EA生态系统核算框架的交换价值概念，运用价值转移（VT）理论与元回归分析，区分交换价值与福利价值的概念差异。
AI.method: 系统综述收集全球水相关生态系统服务估值研究，筛选并标准化至2024年国际美元/公顷/年；采用线性混合效应元回归（meta-regression）识别价值异质性来源；通过留一观测（LOOO）和留一研究（LOSO）交叉验证评估转移误差；以荷兰地表水供给为实证应用案例进行基准对比。
AI.findings: （1）识别出271个估值估计（来自68项研究），其中144个观测值可标准化；（2）服务类别、生态系统面积和货币代理是价值异质性的主要来源；（3）LOOO和LOSO验证的中位绝对转移误差分别为70%和73%，在环境价值转移常见范围内；（4）荷兰案例中，交换价值函数低估基准33.8%，而福利导向函数高估152倍，凸显价值概念一致性的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了与SEEA EA核算要求兼容的全球统一WES交换价值数据集，弥合了交换价值与福利价值在价值转移研究中的概念混淆；通过实证对比展示了价值概念一致性对转移结果的定量影响，为环境经济核算框架下的价值转移方法学提供了理论推进。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的数据集与价值转移函数，填补货币化WES账户中的估值空白；为水资源配置、生态系统恢复和环境管理提供在原始估值受数据与资源限制时的替代证据基础，支持纳入SEEA EA核算实践。

title: The Paradigm Shift in Contract Interpretation: A Comparative Analysis of Indonesia, New Zealand, the CISG, and the UPICC
affiliations: , Airlangga University, ,  and University of Canterbury

detail.title: The Paradigm Shift in Contract Interpretation: A Comparative Analysis of Indonesia, New Zealand, the CISG, and the UPICC

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indonesia Private Law Review, volume 7, issue 1, 2026[10.25041/iplr.v7i1.4681]

detail.abstract: Contract interpretation remains a contested issue in contract law, particularly under the Indonesian Civil Code, which reflects a civil law tradition that prioritizes textual interpretation. Modern commercial practice, however, demands a more contextual approach. This article examines how Indonesia can modernize its interpretive framework through a normative comparative analysis of the Indonesian Civil Code and the contract law of New Zealand, with reference to the United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods and the UNIDROIT Principles of International Commercial Contracts. The study finds that contemporary contract law has shifted toward an objective contextual approach that preserves the primacy of contractual language while incorporating commercial context, reasonableness, and good faith. Incorporating this approach into the Indonesian Civil Code would enhance interpretive consistency, strengthen judicial reasoning, and provide a principled foundation for contract law reform in Indonesia.

AI.tldr: 本文通过规范比较分析，探讨印尼民法典如何借鉴新西兰合同法、CISG和UNIDROIT原则，采用客观情境化解释方法来现代化其合同解释框架。
AI.research_question: 印尼如何通过比较法研究，借鉴新西兰合同法及国际商事合同原则，实现其民法典合同解释框架的现代化？
AI.motivation: 印尼民法典基于大陆法传统，优先采用文本解释方法，但现代商业实践需要更具情境化的解释方法，两者之间存在张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同解释理论；大陆法系文本解释与普通法系情境化解释的比较法框架；CISG与UNIDROIT原则中的客观情境化解释方法。
AI.method: 规范性比较分析方法，对印尼民法典与新西兰合同法进行比较研究，并参考CISG和UNIDROIT原则。
AI.findings: 当代合同法已转向客观情境化解释方法，该方法在保持合同语言优先性的同时，纳入商业情境、合理性和诚信原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大陆法系国家合同解释理论的现代化提供了比较法视角的理论依据，揭示了文本解释与情境化解释之间的兼容路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼民法典合同解释条款的修订提供了具体的改革方向和建议，有助于提升解释一致性、加强司法推理，并为立法改革提供原则性基础。

title: The Measurement Trap: How Backward-looking Measurements Destabilize the Systems they were Designed to Protect

detail.title: The Measurement Trap: How Backward-looking Measurements Destabilize the Systems they were Designed to Protect
detail.abstract:
Institutions routinely make consequential decisions from backward-looking measurements - smoothed averages, trend estimates, and filtered signals meant to separate noise from signal. This paper asks what happens when such a measurement feeds back into the system it measures, and derives a closed-form stability criterion for that loop: a policy that regulates a persistent variable by responding to a uniform trailing average of it is unstable exactly when bg(1 - phi^W)/(1 - phi) exceeds pi^2/2, where phi is the variable's persistence, W the averaging window, and bg the feedback strength. The constant pi^2/2 arises from a half-wavelength resonance at a sharp Neimark-Sacker bifurcation: below the boundary measurement errors decay geometrically and the policy achieves its aim; above it they grow geometrically and the policy delivers the opposite of its aim, with no intermediate regime. We call this the Quantitative Lucas Criterion. A mathematically equivalent boundary arises independently in continuous-time biological feedback with uniform delay kernels (Campbell and Jessop 2009). We then hold the criterion to a single pre-registered specification across six institutional domains and full empirical verification of both theorems.

The Basel III countercyclical capital buffer is classified as unstable in 42 of the 44 economies with sufficient BIS data (median credit persistence 0.9976; United States 0.9996); only the two economies whose past crises broke their credit series fall on the stable side; the classification is stated for the modeled measurement-vs-target kernel; under the buffer guide's literal gap-form reading (Section 5.1) every economy is instead marginally stable. A nonlinear simulation with logistic saturation confirms the instability survives realistic bounds and produces a slow emergent oscillation with a period of about 118 quarters - long enough to span regulatory generations. Three reform options (a shorter window, a maximum stable window, or an exponential kernel) restore stability in every economy, at a largest quarter-to-quarter buffer-volatility difference of 0.20 percentage points - above our pre-registered triviality bound of 0.10, and reported as a real operational cost. Consistent with one prediction of Werner's credit-composition framework, mortgage credit is more persistent than non-mortgage credit in all 18 of 18 economies in the Jorda-Schularick-Taylor database (one-sided binomial p = 3.8e-06), though borrower identity is an imperfect proxy for the productive/speculative axis; and all 5 disaggregated US credit components are individually unstable at the twenty-year window, so the problem is the window, not the credit mix. The European Union's fiscal structural-balance methodology returns a partial result: the loop is stable under lax enforcement and crosses the boundary within the empirically documented crisis-multiplier range, but the crossing point is sensitive to the persistence-estimation window, so we report the direction and withhold a point classification. The Federal Reserve's inflation loop is stable at its short window yet tracked the smoothed inflation measure through 2021-2023 (Taylor-path RMSE against actual inflation 7.59), illustrating that persistence alone does not create instability.

In a compound four-loop model, the US credit block is individually unstable (spectral radius 1.0077) and a synthetic-persistence test confirms that credit's dominance of the unstable mode is a property of its near-unity persistence; but the pre-registered claim that credit dominates in every one of the five economies did not hold, and fixing the credit filter alone leaves the compound system marginally unstable through a near-critical fiscal channel, so we report the measured legs rather than the stronger claim. Finally, a closed, fully disclosed three-test sequence - a regime-dependent VAR, shock-identified state-dependent local projections, and an eight-economy panel with 146 crisis quarters and a materiality bound of delta = 0.005 fixed before estimation - finds no statistical support for the hypothesis that cross-loop coupling strengthens in crises: the panel crisis-vs-normal spectral-radius difference is 0.0080 with a 90% interval of [-0.016, 0.091] that neither excludes zero nor excludes a material effect, and the one significant causal channel runs the opposite way. The question is left honestly open. A dated, falsifiable forward prediction tests the framework out of sample. The archetype is theory-with-proofs with full empirical verification: both theorems are proved in Appendix A, symbolic and numeric machine checks in the verification directory supplement those proofs, and every load-bearing figure is rendered from a hashed ledger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个称为"量化卢卡斯准则"（Quantitative Lucas Criterion）的闭环稳定性判据：当政策通过回应变量的均匀滞后平均来调节一个持久变量时，该闭环不稳定当且仅当 bg(1-φ^W)/(1-φ) 超过 π²/2。该准则源于Neimark-Sacker分岔的半波长共振。作者将这一准则应用于六大制度领域（巴塞尔III逆周期资本缓冲、信贷、财政、通胀等），发现巴塞尔III在44个经济体中有42个被判定为不稳定，并提出三种改革方案可恢复稳定性。文章还通过预注册的实证检验、非线性模拟和复合四环模型验证了定理。
AI.research_question: 当后向测量（如平滑均值、趋势估计、滤波信号）反馈到其所测量的系统时，会发生什么？什么样的闭环条件会导致政策不稳定，甚至产生与政策目标相反的效果？
AI.motivation: 机构经常基于后向测量做出重要决策，但当这些测量反馈到其所测量的系统时，可能产生意想不到的动态不稳定性。作者希望推导出一个封闭形式的稳定性判据，并在多个制度领域进行实证验证，以揭示测量-反馈回路的系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭环控制理论、Neimark-Sacker分岔理论、半波长共振、频谱分析（与Campbell和Jessop 2009的连续时间生物反馈中的均匀延迟核数学等价）
AI.method: 理论推导（封闭形式稳定性判据，附定理证明）；单预注册规格跨六大制度领域的实证检验；非线性模拟（logistic饱和）；复合四环模型（谱半径分析）；制度依赖性VAR、冲击识别的状态依赖局部投影、八经济体面板回归（146个危机季度）；符号与数值机器验证
AI.findings: (1) 巴塞尔III逆周期资本缓冲在44个经济体中42个被判定为不稳定（美国信贷持久性0.9996），非线性模拟显示约118个季度的缓慢振荡周期；(2) 三种改革方案（更短窗口、最大稳定窗口、指数核）可在所有经济体恢复稳定性，但产生0.20个百分点的缓冲波动成本（超过0.10的平凡界）；(3) 抵押信贷在所有18个经济体中比非抵押信贷更持久（二项p=3.8e-06）；(4) 美国5个信贷分项在20年窗口下均不稳定，问题在于窗口而非信贷结构；(5) 欧盟财政结构平衡方法在宽松执法下稳定，但在危机乘数范围内越界；(6) 美联储通胀闭环在短窗口下稳定（Taylor路径RMSE 7.59）；(7) 复合四环模型中美国信贷区块单独不稳定（谱半径1.0077），但信贷主导每个经济体的预注册主张未成立；(8) 无统计证据支持危机中跨环耦合增强的假设（面板差异0.0080，90%区间[-0.016, 0.091]）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了"量化卢卡斯准则"，给出了政策-测量反馈回路的封闭形式稳定性判据；(2) 揭示了π²/2常数源于Neimark-Sacker分岔的半波长共振这一理论机制；(3) 建立了与连续时间生物反馈理论（Campbell & Jessop 2009）的数学等价性；(4) 用双定理完整证明（附录A）加符号/数值机器验证支撑理论。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为巴塞尔III逆周期资本缓冲的稳定性提供了实证诊断（42/44经济体不稳定）；(2) 提出了三种可操作的改革方案（短窗口、最大稳定窗口、指数核）及其成本量化（0.20个百分点）；(3) 为信贷持久性差异（抵押vs非抵押）提供了跨18个经济体的系统证据；(4) 指出美联储通胀测量的稳定性边界，澄清了持久性本身不创造不稳定性的误解；(5) 以日期化的可证伪前瞻预测提供样本外检验框架。

title: The Compound Trap: No Combination of Monetary, Fiscal, or Regulatory Policy can offset the Basel Credit Instability

detail.title: The Compound Trap: No Combination of Monetary, Fiscal, or Regulatory Policy can offset the Basel Credit Instability
detail.abstract:
Basel III's countercyclical capital buffer is steered by the credit-to-GDP gap: credit relative to a one-sided Hodrick-Prescott trend that, at the codified smoothing parameter, behaves like an 80-quarter moving average. A companion paper, The Measurement Trap, showed that a feedback rule built on so long a memory destabilizes the credit loop it regulates whenever credit persistence is high. This paper asks the question that determines whether that result matters: can any other arm of policy - monetary, fiscal, or financial - offset the instability that the regulatory filter creates? We embed the Basel credit loop in a four-loop compound system with monetary, fiscal, and financial-conditions feedback, each parameterized from primary sources and estimated couplings, for the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, the Euro Area, and South Korea. The compound spectral radius exceeds one in all five countries (1.00998 for the US), and the dominant eigenvector loads almost entirely on the credit loop (credit weight US 0.997654; UK 0.997673; JP 0.997716; EA 0.997755; KR 0.997663); the instability is robust to the operative form of the codified kernel - under the literal gap-form trigger the compound radius remains above one in all five countries as well (US 1.000985; UK 1.000864; JP 1.000634; EA 1.000385; KR 1.000956; verdict FORM-ROBUST). No counter-cyclical monetary pass-through within eleven times the observed coupling envelope stabilizes the system (c* = none on [-5, 0] against envelope 0.431042), crisis-time coupling shifts do not rescue it (T = +0.205202, left-tail p = 0.8617), and every disaggregated credit component is individually unstable under the codified window (bg*S ci loans 10.8759; consumer credit 11.8673; cre loans 8.9308; household mortgages 11.8502; nonfin corporate debt 11.725 vs pi^2/2 = 4.9348) - the window, not the credit mix, binds. A zero-DC two-window divergence element stabilizes the credit loop in isolation yet still fails at the system level (best passing point: none (0 of the corridor passes)), and we prove that no such element can ever remove a pure unit root (Theorem 1: p(1) = 1 - phi, machine-verified symbolically (PASS) and numerically (PASS, 735 cells)). What works is quantified: shortening the window stabilizes all five countries (normal US 0.98364; UK 0.98334; JP 0.98284; EA 0.982269; KR 0.983626), and a five-percent level-anchor dose closes the reform menu (lambda* = 0.05 in all 12 cells (max rho 0.999853); 0 cells stable at 0.02). A crisis-prediction horse race on 150 years of data confirms the BIS's own defense of the gap as a sensor (gap 0.684457 vs divergence 0.573777) - which sharpens, rather than softens, the conclusion: the codified gap is the better warning signal and the destabilizing controller; no tested filter wins both roles. Measure with the best sensor; act through a stable control law.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Basel III逆周期资本缓冲（基于信贷/GDP缺口和单边Hodrick-Prescott趋势）所引发的信贷循环不稳定性，并考察货币政策、财政政策和金融条件反馈是否能够抵消这种不稳定性。研究涵盖美国、英国、日本、欧元区和韩国五个经济体，结果表明在五国中复合谱半径均大于1，信贷循环主导了不稳定性特征向量，且没有任何其他政策工具能充分稳定该系统。缩短滤波器窗口可以稳定所有国家，而5%的水平锚定剂量也能关闭改革菜单。文章还通过150年数据的危机预测竞赛验证了BIS对缺口作为传感器的辩护，但结论是：缺口是更好的预警信号，同时是导致不稳定的控制器——没有滤波器能同时胜任两个角色。
AI.research_question: 能否通过货币政策、财政政策或金融条件等其他政策工具，抵消Basel III逆周期资本缓冲中信贷-GDP缺口滤波器（具有80个季度移动平均记忆长度）所引发的信贷循环不稳定性？
AI.motivation: 基础论文《The Measurement Trap》已证明基于如此长记忆的反馈规则在信贷持续性高时会使其所监管的信贷循环失去稳定性。本文的动机是确定这一结果是否具有实际重要性——即是否存在其他政策臂膀能够弥补监管滤波器的内在不稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四环复合系统框架，将Basel信贷循环嵌入包含货币、财政和金融条件反馈的复合系统中；谱半径分析；复合特征向量分解；形式鲁棒性验证（字面缺口形式触发器）。
AI.method: 对五个经济体（美国、英国、日本、欧元区、韩国）构建参数化的四环复合系统，使用初级来源数据和估计耦合参数；计算复合谱半径和主导特征向量；进行形式鲁棒性检验、反周期货币政策传递敏感性分析、危机时期耦合偏移测试、信贷成分分解分析、零直流双窗口发散元素稳定性检验（含符号和数值机器验证）、短窗口替代方案测试、水平锚定剂量分析，以及150年数据的危机预测赛马。
AI.findings: （1）五国复合谱半径均超过1（美国为1.00998），主导特征向量几乎完全加载在信贷循环上（信贷权重均约0.998）；（2）形式鲁棒性验证通过：在字面缺口形式下五国复合半径仍大于1；（3）反周期货币政策传递在观测耦合包络11倍范围内无法稳定系统；（4）危机时期耦合偏移无法挽救系统；（5）所有分解后的信贷成分在编码窗口下均单独不稳定——是窗口而非信贷组合起约束作用；（6）零DC双窗口发散元素在隔离状态下可稳定信贷循环，但在系统层面失败，且数学上证明此类元素无法消除纯单位根；（7）缩短窗口可稳定全部五国；（8）5%水平锚定剂量在12个单元中均有效；（9）缺口在危机预测上优于发散指标，但缺口作为更好的传感器同时也是导致不稳定的控制器。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明监管滤波器固有（持久）记忆所导致的不稳定性无法由其他政策工具补偿，这挑战了政策组合可以抵消单一政策工具缺陷的常规假设；（2）提供了复合谱半径方法在宏观审慎政策分析中的应用；（3）提出并证明了定理1：零DC双窗口发散元素不可能消除纯单位根（符号和数值双重验证）；（4）区分了"传感器"与"控制器"的功能，指出同一滤波工具无法同时最优发挥两种角色。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为Basel III逆周期资本缓冲改革提供了可操作的量化方案：缩短窗口和5%水平锚定剂量；（2）实证说明仅依赖信贷-GDP缺口作为触发器的制度设计存在内在不稳定风险，且BIS自己的数据显示该指标更适合做预警传感器而非控制器；（3）建议"用最好的传感器测量，通过稳定的控制律行动"，为监管设计提供明确指引。

title: Bayes, Computational Complexity, and the Limits of Low-Degree Inference
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayes, Computational Complexity, and the Limits of Low-Degree Inference
detail.abstract: For many canonical problems of high-dimensional statistics, among them planted clique, sparse principal components, tensor estimation, community detection, ranking and seriation, the statistically optimal procedure is computationally intractable, and every known polynomial-time procedure demands polynomially more signal than the information-theoretic threshold. This paper develops the theory of such statistical-computational gaps in explicitly Bayesian terms. The planted model is a prior predictive; the likelihood ratio is the model evidence Z(Y); the second moment method is an annealed replica calculation over two independent draws from the prior; and the low-degree likelihood ratio of Hopkins (2018) and Kunisky, Wein and Bandeira (2019) is the evidence projected onto polynomial chaos of degree D, so that the degree-D advantage is a truncated chi-squared divergence governed by the low moments of the prior overlap. Estimation lower bounds truncate the posterior mean, and the Franz-Parisi criterion is the corresponding free-energy statement. A statistical-computational gap is then a single phenomenon: the evidence diverges, but is invisible at logarithmic chaos depth. We connect this depth calculus to older and newer Bayesian ideas: Young's (1977) treatment of polynomial degree as a parameter with a prior; global-local shrinkage priors, for which we give an exact overlap calculation showing that polynomial-tailed local scales break the annealed second moment and place these priors on a tail-weight dial between the gapless Gaussian and the maximally gapped spike-and-slab; and Bayesian double descent (Polson and Sokolov, 2025), which governs the risk of fitted depth-D statistics at the interpolation depth. We then confront the framework with its failures: noiseless parities fall to Gaussian elimination, noiseless regression and structured clustering fall to lattice basis reduction, and the Holmgren-Wein counterexamples refute the conjecture as formalized. These failures share one Bayesian signature. The posterior concentrates on an algebraic variety of measure zero, where the evidence is singular and invisible to any smooth low-degree projection, revealing the domain of the heuristic to be a statistical condition: stability of the posterior under perturbation of the data.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的贝叶斯理论框架来理解高维统计中的统计-计算差距。该框架将已知的统计-计算差距现象重新表述为单一现象：模型证据（似然比）发散，但在对数混沌深度上不可见。文章还将此框架与更早和更新的贝叶斯思想联系起来，并分析了该框架失败的案例（无噪声奇偶校验、无噪声回归、结构化聚类以及Holmgren-Wein反例），指出其适用域是数据扰动下后验的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何用显式的贝叶斯术语统一解释高维统计中普遍存在的统计-计算差距（即统计最优过程计算上难以处理，而多项式时间过程需要更多信号）这一现象？
AI.motivation: 对于种植团、稀疏主成分、张量估计、社区检测、排序和序列化等经典高维统计问题，统计最优过程在计算上难处理，而所有已知的多项式时间过程需要比信息论阈值多项式更多的信号。这种统计-计算差距在多个问题中普遍存在，但缺乏统一的理论框架来理解其本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯理论框架，具体包括：先验预测（prior predictive）视角下的种植模型、似然比作为模型证据Z(Y)、第二矩方法作为退火复制计算、低度似然比（Hopkins 2018; Kunisky, Wein and Bandeira 2019）作为投影到D次多项式混沌上的证据、Franz-Parisi准则作为自由能陈述、Young (1977)的多项式度作为参数的先验处理、全局-局部收缩先验理论、以及贝叶斯双下降（Polson and Sokolov, 2025）理论。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析方法，通过将统计-计算差距重新表述为贝叶斯框架下的单一现象：证据发散但在对数混沌深度不可见。通过推导度-D优势作为截断卡方散度，给出全局-局部收缩先验的精确重叠计算，并分析框架失败案例的共同贝叶斯特征。
AI.findings: (1) 统计-计算差距可统一理解为：证据发散但在对数混沌深度不可见；(2) 全局-局部收缩先验的多项式尾局部尺度破坏退火第二矩，使得这些先验位于无差距高斯与最大差距尖峰-平板之间的尾部权重拨盘上；(3) 该框架的失败案例（无噪声奇偶校验、无噪声回归、结构化聚类、Holmgren-Wein反例）共同特征是后验集中在一个测度零的代数簇上，证据是奇异且对任何光滑的低度投影不可见；(4) 该启发式方法的适用域是一种统计条件：后验在数据扰动下的稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了统计-计算差距的统一贝叶斯理论，将所有已知差距现象整合为单一机制；(2) 将低度似然比、Franz-Parisi准则等现代计算复杂性工具与经典贝叶斯思想（Young 1977）相连接；(3) 为全局-局部收缩先验提供了精确的重叠计算，揭示了其尾部权重特性；(4) 将贝叶斯双下降理论与拟合深度-D统计量的风险联系起来；(5) 明确界定了该理论的适用域（后验稳定性条件）及其失效的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为判断实际问题中是否可能出现统计-计算差距提供了诊断标准（后验是否在数据扰动下稳定）；(2) 为选择先验分布提供了指导：多项式尾局部尺度收缩先验处于高斯与尖峰-平板之间，可用于调节统计-计算差距的权衡；(3) 有助于识别哪些问题容易受到计算阻碍（后验集中在测度零的代数簇上的问题）。

title: Resolution is not Settlement, Part II: Protocol Finality and Observed Redemption on Polymarket

detail.title: Resolution is not Settlement, Part II: Protocol Finality and Observed Redemption on Polymarket

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with the Research Department of Devnull FZCO and leads the ForesightFlow research programme. No external sponsor influenced the research design, analysis, interpretation, or decision to publish. The article does not evaluate a commercial product or make investment recommendations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex were used for editorial and technical assistance during manuscript preparation. The author made all substantive research decisions, reviewed the final manuscript, and assumes full responsibility for its contents.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
An Oracle result is not yet a protocol payout, a redeemable position is not yet collateral in a holder's account, and a redemption event is not a complete measure of economic entitlement. This companion paper develops an event-sourced framework for Polymarket conditions from preparation through protocol finality and observed holder realization.

     The empirical design uses three Conditional Tokens Framework event families derived from a pinned contract application binary interface (ABI): ConditionPreparation, ConditionResolution, and PayoutRedemption. It separates the contract-wide acquisition universe from the frozen Polymarket adapter-question cohort. The exact bridge contains 108,638 linked conditions. Of these, 99,283 have an observed protocol-resolution event by the fixed snapshot at Polygon block 90,114,204 (2026-07-12T17:11:41Z).

      Among resolved exact-linked conditions, 92,158 have an observed redemption of any amount and 91,817 have an observed positive-payout redemption; condition-specific Kaplan–Meier medians from first protocol resolution are 182 and 200 seconds respectively. The exact-linked payout taxonomy contains 53,847 canonical (0,1) vectors, 45,024 canonical (1,0) vectors, 410 fifty-fifty vectors, two other valid vectors, and 9,355 conditions with no observed resolution. Cross-contract Oracle–adapter–protocol ordering is reported conservatively: 823 conditions have an interval-qualified terminal generation, 48 have multiple candidate generations, 91,638 have no compatible terminal generation in the frozen evidence, and 16,129 are right-censored or otherwise unevaluable.

     The formal results show that Oracle finality does not identify protocol finality, protocol finality does not identify holder realization, and redemption events alone do not identify the fraction of entitlement redeemed without an independent balance-consistent entitlement denominator. The paper therefore reports observed event timing and payout realization without claiming G-VALUE, outstanding winning-token supply, or unredeemed collateral value.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于事件溯源（event-sourced）的框架，用于分析Polymarket条件市场从准备、协议最终性到持有者实现（realization）的全过程。基于Polygon区块链上108,638个链接条件的经验分析显示，预言机最终性、协议最终性与持有者赎回兑现之间存在系统性的不一致，论文审慎地报告观察到的时序和兑现数据，而不声称G-VALUE、未兑现代币供给量等未经验证的指标。
AI.research_question: Polymarket条件市场中，预言机（Oracle）最终性、协议（Protocol）最终性与持有者经济实现（Holder Realization）三者之间如何区分？如何基于事件溯源框架精确刻画从条件准备到赎回兑现的全过程？
AI.motivation: Polymarket的市场数据经常混淆预言机结果、协议结算与持有者实际赎回之间的概念边界，导致对市场价值、未兑现权益等指标的误读。需要一个严格的事件驱动框架来区分不同层面的最终性，并提供经验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件溯源框架（Event-Sourced Framework）、条件代币框架（Conditional Tokens Framework, CTF）、Kaplan-Meier生存分析
AI.method: 基于固定的合约ABI提取三类事件（ConditionPreparation、ConditionResolution、PayoutRedemption），从Polygon区块链快照（区块90,114,204）中分离合约级获取宇宙与冻结的Polymarket适配器问题队列，对108,638个链接条件进行事件追踪与分类统计。
AI.findings: （1）99,283个条件有协议解析事件，其中92,158个有赎回事件、91,817个有正向赔付赎回；（2）条件级Kaplan-Meier中位赎回时间分别为182秒和200秒；（3）赔付分类：53,847个(0,1)向量、45,024个(1,0)向量、410个五五开向量、2个其他有效向量、9,355个无解析事件；（4）跨合约排序中仅823个有条件限定的终代，48个多候选，91,638个无兼容终代，16,129个右截尾。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化证明了三个关键命题：预言机最终性不等于协议最终性；协议最终性不等于持有者实现；仅有赎回事件无法识别赎回权益比例（需要独立的余额一致分母）。为预测市场研究提供了严格的概念分层框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Polymarket数据分析提供了可复现的事件溯源方法论；明确划定了数据可声称范围（G-VALUE、流通代币供给等指标不可仅凭赎回事件推导）；给出了赎回时延的中位数基准（182/200秒），有助于实践者理解市场结算效率。

title: Deepening Intrahousehold Inequalities? Evidence from Floods in Bangladesh
affiliations: College Park

detail.title: Deepening Intrahousehold Inequalities? Evidence from Floods in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: I demonstrate how a climate shock redistributes resources within households by examining its impact on individual-level consumption among men, women, and children over time. Using a structural household model, I estimate the share of the total household budget allocated to members and leverage exogenous variation in flood exposure to study how these resource shares respond. Results show that flood exposure triggers a redistribution of household resources primarily away from women and toward men, accompanied by a reduction in the household's budget. Four years later, this redistribution persists, driven by a decline in women's earnings relative to men's after the flood.

AI.tldr: 本文利用结构性家庭模型（structural household model），估计家庭总预算在成员间的分配份额，并利用洪水暴露的外生变化研究气候冲击如何重新分配家庭内部资源。结果显示，洪水暴露导致资源从女性向男性再分配，同时家庭总预算缩减，且这种再分配在四年后依然持续，其驱动力是洪水后女性相对男性收入的下降。
AI.research_question: 气候冲击如何在家庭内部成员（男性、女性和儿童）之间重新分配消费资源？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注气候冲击对家庭整体福利的影响，但忽略了家庭内部资源分配的不平等问题；理解气候冲击如何影响家庭内部分配对于评估气候冲击的福利后果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性家庭模型（structural household model），用于估计家庭预算在成员间的分配份额（resource shares）。
AI.method: 构建结构性家庭模型估计家庭成员间的资源分配份额；利用洪水暴露作为外生变异来源，追踪个体层面的消费数据，并考察短期与长期（四年后）的资源再分配效应。
AI.findings: （1）洪水暴露引发家庭资源再分配，资源从女性向男性转移；（2）洪水同时导致家庭总预算缩减；（3）这种再分配在四年后仍然持续；（4）长期持续性的机制在于洪水后女性收入相对男性收入下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候冲击引入家庭内部资源分配的实证研究，揭示了气候冲击不仅影响家庭总体福利，还会改变家庭内部权力的均衡与资源分配格局；为理解家庭内部议价能力变化提供了新的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候冲击应对政策提供启示：灾害救助与重建政策应关注家庭内部的不平等分配问题，特别是女性在气候冲击后可能承受更大福利损失，需要针对性的政策干预。

title: State-triggered Margin and Conditional-token Conversion for Event-linked Perpetual Futures

detail.title: State-triggered Margin and Conditional-token Conversion for Event-linked Perpetual Futures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with the Research Department of Devnull FZCO and leads the ForesightFlow research programme. No external sponsor influenced the research design, analysis, interpretation, or decision to publish. The article does not evaluate a commercial product or make investment recommendations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex were used for editorial and technical assistance during manuscript preparation. The author made all substantive research decisions, reviewed the final manuscript, and assumes full responsibility for its contents.
declarations.funderStatement: his research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Ordinary time-to-event controls cannot fully represent the risk of an event-linked perpetual future whose adjudication path may be proposed, disputed, reset, Oracle-final, adapter-terminal, or protocol-final. This paper develops state-triggered margin and settlement controls and formalizes conversion of a synthetic obligation into funded Conditional Tokens Framework claims.

A state-conditioned margin rule combines an adverse-outcome support floor with expected shortfall, execution, finality, and model-risk components. We prove that a common time-only requirement either under-covers the higher-risk state or over-margins the lower-risk state, and that basis funding retains its economic meaning only while an executable mark-index arbitrage loop remains available. The settlement family includes full wait, closing auction, reserve-backed provisional settlement, and claim conversion.

The completed Polymarket finality study supplies an observed calibration layer rather than a hypothetical timing model. Its exact-linked population contains 108,638 conditions. Among 99,283 conditions with an observed protocol resolution, first observed redemption has a Kaplan–Meier median of 182 seconds and first positive-payout redemption a median of 200 seconds under condition-specific right censoring at the 2026-07-12 snapshot. The same data retain long censoring and redemption tails and a large class for which an exact terminal request-generation path is not identified. These findings justify state-qualified controls while sharply limiting any trigger that requires unobserved cross-layer order.

For conversion, a common re-mark and complementary account debits preserve terminal wealth for both long and short positions. The conversion mark cancels, but execution costs and missing collateral remain on an explicit balance sheet. Under the collateral convention inherited from Paper 1, full self-funded conversion above one-times leverage is impossible without top-up, prior deleveraging, reserve capital, credit, or another external funding source. Positionwise feasibility also fails to imply aggregate feasibility when several accounts share one order book or claim inventory.

The empirical closure is a gate result rather than a new seven-configuration performance comparison. An exact condition-ID audit links 837 of the 108,638 Paper 5 conditions to the frozen processed Paper 1 reference layer; within that bridge, 815 have an observed preparation endpoint, 240 an observed condition-resolution endpoint, and 246 a first observed redemption endpoint. The accepted Paper 1 maintenance-path pass, drawdown, P&L, liquidation incidence, and terminal account shortfall tables remain historical mechanical-reference outputs and are not re-estimated here. The available evidence does not contain the path-level PMXT tick/book archive or a recoverable pre-outcome numerical trigger/funding/allocation registry needed to execute the registered configurations C0–C6. Their comparative hypotheses therefore remain not evaluated. This is an evidence-gate disposition, not negative evidence about state-triggered control or conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了状态触发（state-triggered）的保证金和结算控制机制，并将合成义务形式化为已注资的条件代币框架（CTF）索赔。基于Polymarket 108,638个条件的大样本观测，作者证明纯时间性保证金要求会失衡（高险状态覆盖不足或低险状态过度保证金），并系统评估了四种结算途径和索赔转换的可行性边界。
AI.research_question: 当事件关联的未来义务具有多种裁决路径（提出、争议、重置、Oracle终局、适配器终止或协议终局）时，传统时间到事件控制无法充分代表其风险，那么如何设计状态触发的保证金、结算及转换控制机制，并基于实际市场数据验证其必要性？
AI.motivation: 传统仅基于时间的保证金控制无法充分捕获事件关联长期义务中不同状态路径的风险差异，需要用状态条件化的控制机制来替代，并以真实市场数据校准而非假设性时序模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态触发的保证金理论（state-conditioned margin rule）、期望不足（expected shortfall）、套利循环（arbitrage loop）、条件代币框架（Conditional Tokens Framework）、校准层/时序模型对比、Kaplan-Meier中位数与右删失分析。
AI.method: 理论证明与实证结合。理论上证明纯时间性要求在高险/低险状态间失衡；实证使用Polymarket 108,638个条件的完整终局性数据，包含99,283个观测协议解析条件，进行Kaplan-Meier中位数估计和条件特异性右删失分析，并进行837个条件的精确ID桥接审计。
AI.findings: （1）纯时间性保证金要求无法同时覆盖高险状态和避免过度保证金低险状态；（2）首次观测赎回中位数为182秒，首次正支付赎回中位数为200秒；（3）转换中共同重标和账户借记能保持多空双方的终局财富，但1倍以上杠杆的全自筹转换不可行；（4）缺乏路径级PMXT tick/簿档案及数值触发/资金/分配注册表，配置C0-C6的比较假设未评估，属于证据门槛而非负面证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了状态触发保证金与结算控制的理论框架，形式化了合成义务到CTF索赔的转换机制，证明了纯时间性保证金规则的理论缺陷，并扩展了事件关联长期义务风险控制的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 基于Polymarket大规模真实数据提供了校准层证据（而非假设模型），为实践中的保证金设定、结算方案选择和转换可行性提供了量化依据；同时明确指出了证据缺口，设定了一个严格的验证门槛。

title: The (Poly)market Price of Weather Risk
affiliations: University of Bologna

detail.title: The (Poly)market Price of Weather Risk
detail.abstract: Weather derivatives are increasingly growing in importance, as the hedging of climate risk factors becomes a priority not only for regulators, but also for players in the energy sector. Their current market is lacking in liquidity, which complicates the valuation of such instruments, as the non-unique pricing measure used by the market cannot be identified precisely. This paper proposes a method to estimate the market price of weather risk from the event probabilities implied by contracts sold on prediction markets. The methodology is applied to temperature markets, finding that the market price of temperature risk is time-varying and also dependent on the strike: it is positive for high-temperature contracts and negative for low-temperature ones, reflecting asymmetric pricing of warming and cooling risk. This pattern holds across seasons, with the highest premium for high minimum temperature contracts. The results reveal a climate risk smirk that parallels the volatility smile in equity options, and document geographical and temporal variability in the pricing of temperature risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用预测市场隐含事件概率来估计天气风险市场价格的方法，并将其应用于温度市场。研究发现温度风险的市场价格具有时变性和敲定价格依赖性：高温合约风险溢价为正，低温合约为负，呈现出类似股票期权波动率微笑的"气候风险歪笑"（climate risk smirk）现象。
AI.research_question: 如何从预测市场合约隐含的事件概率中估计天气风险的市场价格？温度风险的市场价格具有怎样的特征和规律？
AI.motivation: 天气衍生品重要性日益增长，但其市场流动性不足，导致无法精确识别市场使用的非唯一定价测度，从而难以对天气衍生品进行定价。需要一种新的方法来估计天气风险的市场价格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天气衍生品定价理论、风险中性定价框架、预测市场隐含概率方法
AI.method: 利用预测市场上交易合约的隐含事件概率来估计天气风险的市场价格，并将该方法应用于温度市场。
AI.findings: （1）温度风险的市场价格具有时变性，且依赖于敲定价格；（2）高温合约风险溢价为正，低温合约为负，反映升温和降温风险的不对称定价；（3）该模式在各季节均存在，最高溢价出现在最低温度高合约；（4）存在类似股票期权波动率微笑的"气候风险歪笑"现象；（5）温度风险定价存在地理和时间上的变异性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从预测市场隐含概率角度估计天气风险的市场价格，揭示了温度风险定价的"气候风险歪笑"现象，扩展了天气衍生品定价理论，并与金融期权定价理论建立了类比联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为天气衍生品市场参与者提供了一种在低流动性环境下估计天气风险溢价的实用方法，有助于能源行业更好地对冲气候风险，并为监管机构理解气候风险定价提供参考。

title: The Formation, Maintenance, and Mobility of Status Hierarchy in High School Football Teams: A Sociological Study of Starter and Substitute Positions

detail.title: The Formation, Maintenance, and Mobility of Status Hierarchy in High School Football Teams: A Sociological Study of Starter and Substitute Positions
detail.abstract: American football is a highly popular sport worldwide. A football team consists of starters and substitutes, with the former accounting for the majority of playing time and enjoying greater prestige and influence within the team. Traditional literature suggests that ability-related factors are the most critical determinants of starter/substitute status, but it underestimates the important role of social factors. Based on Social Stratification Theory, and employing questionnaire surveys and one-on-one interviews, this study collected the perspectives of 25 high school and college varsity football players and two team coaches regarding the determinants of starter/substitute positions, and identified a total of 15 relevant influencing factors. These factors exerted differential effects on player mobility between starter and substitute positions at the beginning of a new season and during the season. The 15 factors were further grouped into three domains: Ability-related Factors, Social Factors, and Opportunities. Interview data indicate that, owing to the Matthew Effect, starters are not easily displaced by substitutes: players who hold an initial starting advantage are granted more opportunities, which fosters the development of stronger football-specific competencies and thereby consolidates their starting roles. To mitigate this dynamic, the study identified four approaches to counteract the Matthew Effect-Physical Development, Learning from the Sidelines, Individualized Training, and Trust Building. These findings extend the application of Social Stratification Theory to competitive sport and address how the Matthew Effect can be effectively mitigated in that context. Accordingly, the results possess both theoretical significance and important practical implications.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于社会分层理论，通过对25名高中和大学橄榄球运动员及2名教练的问卷调查与一对一访谈，识别出影响首发/替补地位的15个因素，并将其归类为能力因素、社会因素和机会三个领域。研究发现由于马太效应，首发球员不易被替补取代，并提出了四种缓解马太效应的策略。
AI.research_question: 决定橄榄球运动员首发/替补地位的影响因素有哪些？这些因素如何影响球员在赛季初和赛季中的流动性？以及如何缓解首发/替补地位固化中的马太效应？
AI.motivation: 传统文献认为能力相关因素是决定首发/替补地位的最关键因素，但低估了社会因素的重要作用。本研究旨在填补这一理论空白，从社会分层理论视角全面考察首发/替补地位的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会分层理论（Social Stratification Theory）和马太效应（Matthew Effect）
AI.method: 问卷调查与一对一访谈，样本包括25名高中和大学校队橄榄球运动员及2名球队教练
AI.findings: 共识别出15个影响首发/替补地位的因素，并将其归纳为能力相关因素、社会因素和机会三个领域。这些因素在赛季初和赛季中对球员流动产生差异化影响。因马太效应，首发球员不易被替补取代——初期的首发优势带来更多机会，促进更强橄榄球专项能力发展，从而巩固首发地位。研究提出了四种缓解马太效应的策略：身体发展、场边学习、个性化训练和信任建立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会分层理论的应用扩展到竞技体育领域，并探讨了在该情境下如何有效缓解马太效应，丰富了社会分层理论在运动情境中的理论解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为球队教练和管理者提供了识别首发/替补地位决定因素的系统框架，以及四种可操作的策略来缓解首发地位的固化，促进球员公平竞争和梯队建设。

title: The Evolution and Diversification of Stock-Flow Consistent Modelling: A Bibliometric Review
affiliations: Universidad Central del Ecuador, Students, Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales (FLACSO) - Ecuador, Students,  and Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales (FLACSO) - Ecuador, Students

detail.title: The Evolution and Diversification of Stock-Flow Consistent Modelling: A Bibliometric Review
detail.abstract: This paper presents a bibliometric analysis of the Stock-Flow Consistent (SFC) literature from 1975 to 2026. The corpus includes 479 publications from Scopus, Web of Science, and expert-guided screening. Building on the classification proposed by Nikiforos and Zezza (2017), using keyword-based classification and manual validation, the paper maps the evolution of five major research areas: extensions of the core SFC framework, open-economy models, empirical SFC models, ecological SFC models, and SFC-agent–based models. The results show a clear expansion of the literature after the Global Financial Crisis, followed by further acceleration after 2017. Recent growth is especially visible in empirical and ecological SFC applications, as well as in works combining multiple research areas. The journal mapping also shows that, while SFC research remains strongly rooted in heterodox economics outlets, it has increasingly expanded into interdisciplinary and non-traditional journals. The paper contributes by updating the 2017 survey and documenting the diversification and broader diffusion of SFC research.

AI.tldr: 本文对1975至2026年间存量-流量一致（SFC）文献进行了文献计量分析，基于479篇来自Scopus、Web of Science及专家筛选的出版物，借助关键词分类与人工验证，绘制了五大研究领域（核心框架扩展、开放经济模型、实证SFC模型、生态SFC模型、SFC-基于主体模型）的演化图景。
AI.research_question: SFC文献从1975年至2026年如何演化？五大研究领域的发展趋势与发表载体（期刊）分布如何变化？
AI.motivation: 更新Nikiforos和Zezza（2017）的SFC文献综述，系统记录该领域在金融危机后的扩张、多样化及其向跨学科期刊的扩散。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存量-流量一致（SFC）框架；基于Nikiforos和Zezza（2017）的领域分类体系；文献计量学分析框架。
AI.method: 文献计量分析：从Scopus、Web of Science收集数据并辅以专家引导筛选，构建479篇文献的语料库；采用基于关键词的自动分类结合人工验证进行领域划分；绘制研究领域演化及期刊映射。
AI.findings: 全球金融危机后SFC文献显著扩张，2017年后进一步加速；近期增长尤其体现在实证与生态SFC应用，以及跨领域交叉研究中；SFC研究虽仍以非正统经济学期刊为主阵地，但已日益扩展至跨学科和非传统期刊。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了2017年的SFC文献综述，系统记录了SFC研究的多样化趋势与跨学科扩散，为理解该领域知识结构演化提供了计量证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了SFC五大研究领域的最新全景图谱和期刊分布信息，有助于识别研究热点与发表渠道选择。

title: Climate Change and Education: Evidence from Palestine
affiliations: and Levy Economics Institute of Bard College

detail.title: Climate Change and Education: Evidence from Palestine
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of climate change on women’s education in Palestine, focusing on how climatic factors affect years of schooling. Using pooled data from the Palestinian Labor Force Survey and climate indicators from the Palestinian Meteorological Department, the analysis explores both immediate and lagged effects of climate change on women’s years of schooling. Findings reveal gendered disparities in the effects of rainfall and temperature on schooling, with women facing unique vulnerabilities. Mechanism analysis indicates that agricultural households in Palestine are highly vulnerable to climatic shocks which in turn increases the vulnerability of girls in these households; Climatic shocks negatively impact farming productivity and the overall working environment, exacerbating the challenges faced by these families. The study also identifies regional heterogeneities, with southern districts showing greater resilience compared to central and northern regions, while Jericho faces pronounced adverse impacts.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴勒斯坦劳动力调查和气象部门数据，考察气候变化对巴勒斯坦女性教育年限的影响，发现降雨和温度变化对男女受教育程度存在性别差异，农业家庭中的女孩更易受气候冲击影响，且存在显著的区域异质性。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何影响巴勒斯坦女性的受教育年限？其机制和区域异质性如何？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对教育的影响存在性别差异，而巴勒斯坦这一受气候变化和冲突双重影响的地区尚未得到充分研究，特别是女性教育面临独特脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化与人力资本投资理论；性别与气候脆弱性理论；家庭农业生产与教育决策理论。
AI.method: 利用巴勒斯坦劳动力调查的汇总数据和气象部门的降水、温度数据，分析气候变化对女性教育年限的即时效应和滞后效应，并进行机制分析和区域异质性分析。
AI.findings: 降雨和温度对教育年限的影响存在性别差异；农业家庭对气候冲击高度脆弱，女孩尤为受影响；气候冲击降低农业生产力并恶化整体工作环境；南部地区韧性更强，中部和北部受影响较大，杰里科地区受到显著不利影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候变化与性别教育不平等联系起来，揭示了气候冲击通过农业家庭渠道加剧女孩教育脆弱性的机制，丰富了气候变化与人力资本关系的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴勒斯坦及类似地区的政策制定者提供依据，帮助识别气候脆弱区域和群体，为制定气候适应型教育干预政策提供参考。

title: The Paradox of Strategic Altruism
affiliations: University of Southampton - Faculty of Economic, Social and Political Sciences, University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS) and University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS)

detail.title: The Paradox of Strategic Altruism
detail.abstract: Can altruism serve as the behavioral foundation for efficient institutional design? We study full implementation in Berge equilibrium, the solution concept that formalizes strategic altruism: each agent's opponents collectively maximize her payoff. While Berge equilibrium resolves the Prisoner's Dilemma and can eliminate cooperation failures in social dilemmas, we show that this optimism does not survive the move from individual behavior to institutional design. First, we show that the weak Pareto optimal rule is not implementable in Berge equilibrium. Second, on the unrestricted domain of strict preferences, any social choice rule that is both weakly Pareto efficient and implementable in Berge equilibrium must be dictatorial. Finally, we show that Berge implementability is strictly more demanding than Nash implementability: every social goal achievable under strategic altruism is also achievable under self-interest, but not vice versa. The very feature that makes Berge equilibrium appealing at the behavioral level, that is, opponents protecting each agent's payoff, is precisely what forecloses efficient, non-dictatorial institutions at the design level.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利他主义能否作为有效制度设计的行为基础，考察Berge均衡（战略利他主义的形式化概念）下的完全实施问题。研究发现：弱帕累托最优规则在Berge均衡下不可实施；在严格偏好的无限制域上，任何同时满足弱帕累托效率且可实施的社会选择规则都必须是独裁的；Berge可实施性严格强于Nash可实施性。利他行为层面的优势恰恰在制度设计层面阻碍了有效、非独裁制度的实现。
AI.research_question: 利他主义能否作为有效制度设计的行为基础？具体而言，哪些社会选择规则能够在Berge均衡下被完全实施？
AI.motivation: Berge均衡（战略利他主义）在行为层面展现了吸引力——它能够解决囚徒困境、消除社会困境中的合作失败。但这一乐观结论能否延伸到制度设计层面尚不清楚，本文正是要检验从个体行为到制度设计的跨越中，这一乐观性是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: Berge均衡理论（战略利他主义）、社会选择理论、机制设计理论（完全实施）、Nash均衡实施理论、弱帕累托效率、独裁性规则
AI.method: 理论博弈论分析（公理化方法）。通过形式化证明考察Berge均衡下社会选择规则的可实施性，包括不可实施性结果（弱帕累托最优规则）、不可能性定理（非独裁规则不可能），以及Berge与Nash可实施性的比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）弱帕累托最优规则在Berge均衡下不可实施；（2）在严格偏好的无限制域上，任何同时满足弱帕累托效率和Berge可实施性的社会选择规则必须是独裁的；（3）Berge可实施性严格强于Nash可实施性：战略利他主义下可实现的所有社会目标在自利假设下也可实现，但反之不成立。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统研究Berge均衡下的完全实施问题，填补了战略利他主义在制度设计层面的理论空白；（2）证明了利他行为层面与制度设计层面的根本性矛盾——保护他人收益的机制恰好排除了有效、非独裁的制度；（3）建立了Berge可实施性与Nash可实施性之间的严格排序关系，深化了对不同行为假设下实施能力的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为制度设计者提供警示性结论：不能简单依赖个体的利他行为假设来设计制度，利他主义在行为层面可能促进合作，但在制度层面反而限制了可实现的制度范围；（2）为理解社会困境中的制度选择提供了重要参照，说明即使行为人具有利他倾向，设计有效且非独裁的制度仍面临根本性障碍。

title: Hurdle Rates and Canada's State-Capacity Challenge in the Age of Machine Knowledge Capital

detail.title: Hurdle Rates and Canada's State-Capacity Challenge in the Age of Machine Knowledge Capital

contentType.other: Notes for Remarks at a roundtable

detail.abstract: This note reframes Canada's state-capacity challenge in the era of machine knowledge capital as a problem of heterogeneous hurdle rates. Accelerating technological change, geopolitical uncertainty, large sunk costs and winner-take-most dynamics raise the option value of waiting, while investors differ in their ability to bear risk and capture indirect returns. Large state-led economies and jurisdictions with deep pools of private capital can therefore undertake investments that small open economies cannot. For Canada, the appropriate policy response is not indiscriminate subsidization, but establishing the institutional capacity to identify projects which are sidelined by excessively high hurdle rates for private capital of modest scale, yet make sense at the societal level, and to act on these projects. This requires disciplined project evaluation, public equity and retention mechanisms, and technically capable teams able to structure and implement complex investments.

AI.tldr: 本文重新阐述了加拿大在机器知识资本时代面临的国家能力挑战，将其核心问题归结为异质性资本门槛率（hurdle rates）。由于技术变革加速、地缘政治不确定性和赢者通吃动态推高了等待的期权价值，而投资者在风险承受能力和捕获间接回报方面存在差异，造成大型国家主导经济体和小型开放经济体投资能力的差距。对加拿大而言，合适的政策回应不是不加选择的补贴，而是建立识别被过高门槛率排除但具备社会价值的项目的制度能力，并通过严格的项目评估、公共股权与留存机制以及专业团队来实施。
AI.research_question: 在机器知识资本时代，加拿大面临的国家能力挑战的本质是什么？以及适当的政策回应是什么？
AI.motivation: 加拿大作为小型开放经济体，在加速技术变革和地缘政治不确定性的背景下，面临投资能力受限的国家能力困境，需要重新审视政策应对方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性资本门槛率框架；期权价值理论（投资等待的期权价值）；赢者通吃动态；间接回报捕获理论
AI.method: 注释性/概念性分析（note形式），对加拿大的国家能力挑战进行理论重构和政策论述
AI.findings: 大型国家主导经济体和小型开放经济体在投资能力上存在系统性差距；加拿大的政策回应不应是全面补贴，而应聚焦于识别和推进被过高门槛率排除但具有社会价值的项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国家能力问题重新概念化为异质性资本门槛率问题，为理解小型开放经济体在机器知识资本时代面临的挑战提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大提供具体的政策方向建议：包括建立严格的项目评估机制、公共股权和留存机制，以及组建具备技术能力的专业团队来实施复杂投资。

title: Understanding the Investment Behaviour of Gen Z
affiliations: , Mata Sundri College For Women, Graphic Era Hill University and Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee University

detail.title: Understanding the Investment Behaviour of Gen Z
detail.abstract: Gen-Z is one of the most affected generations because of pandemics, economic uncertainties and geo-political challenges. But a generation with much familiarity and access to the internet and smartphones makes it more interesting to study how they invest and their investment preferences. This study aims to highlight how Gen-Z prefers to invest and if they don't invest what's stopping them from investing.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦Z世代——这一受疫情、经济不确定性和地缘政治挑战影响最严重的世代，同时他们又是对互联网和智能手机高度熟悉的群体。研究旨在揭示Z世代的投资偏好，以及如果他们不投资，背后的阻碍因素是什么。
AI.research_question: Z世代如何进行投资？他们的投资偏好是什么？如果他们不投资，阻碍他们投资的因素又是什么？
AI.motivation: Z世代是受疫情、经济不确定性和地缘政治挑战影响最严重的世代之一，但同时他们对互联网和智能手机有着高度的熟悉度和使用便利性，这使得研究他们的投资行为和偏好具有独特的学术和实践价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未在摘要中明确提及具体理论框架，但隐含涉及世代理论（Generation Theory）、投资行为理论等。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确提及具体研究方法，可能采用问卷调查或实证分析方法。
AI.findings: 未在摘要中呈现具体研究发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 未在摘要中明确说明理论贡献，但可能有助于丰富对Z世代这一特殊群体投资行为的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于金融机构、政策制定者和投资教育者了解Z世代的投资偏好及投资障碍，从而设计更具针对性的投资产品、教育方案和服务。

title: Optimal Selling of Defaultable Assets using the Distribution Builder
affiliations: and Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI) - Department of Mathematical Sciences

detail.title: Optimal Selling of Defaultable Assets using the Distribution Builder
detail.abstract: We consider the problem of when it is best to sell a risky asset in the framework of the distribution builder approach under the consideration of potential ruin. This approach allows investors to express their preferences directly as a desired target distribution without first specifying a risk aversion or utility function. Mathematically, the problem is closely related to the Skorokhod embedding problem, where the goal is to attain a given distribution by stopping a diffusion process. We work in a general framework of one-dimensional diffusion processes and extend existing results to include the possibility of ruin. We first provide a full characterization of the set of distributions that can be attained before ruin occurs. Then, we formulate two optimization problems that tackle the issue of what to do if the originally specified distribution is either not attainable or not optimal: finding the attainable distribution closest to an unattainable distribution and selecting an optimal attainable distribution under first-order stochastic dominance constraints if the originally specified distribution is attainable, but not optimal. We show existence and uniqueness of solutions to these constrained convex optimization problems in an extended f-divergence framework, provide an analytic characterization of solutions and give numerical examples.

AI.tldr: 本文在分布构建器（distribution builder）框架下，研究考虑潜在破产风险时最优出售风险资产的时机问题。该框架允许投资者直接表达偏好为目标分布，而无需预先指定风险厌恶或效用函数。数学上该问题与Skorokhod嵌入问题密切相关。文章在一般一维扩散过程框架下扩展了现有结果以包含破产可能性，首先完整刻画了破产前可达到的分布集合，然后提出两个优化问题：寻找与不可达分布最接近的可达分布，以及在一阶随机占优约束下选择最优可达分布。在扩展f-散度框架下证明了这些约束凸优化问题的解的存在性和唯一性，给出了解析刻画和数值示例。
AI.research_question: 在考虑潜在破产风险的情况下，如何在分布构建器框架下确定最优出售风险资产的时机？具体包括：破产发生前可达到的目标分布集合是什么？当原始指定的分布不可达或非最优时应如何处理？
AI.motivation: 传统的投资决策通常需要指定效用函数或风险厌恶参数，而分布构建器方法允许投资者直接以目标分布形式表达偏好，更为直观。然而，现有研究未充分考虑破产风险的影响，且未解决目标分布不可达或非最优时的处理问题，因此需要扩展理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Skorokhod嵌入问题、一维扩散过程理论、f-散度框架、一阶随机占优理论、约束凸优化理论
AI.method: 本文采用数学建模与理论证明的方法。首先在一维扩散框架下完整刻画破产前可达到分布的集合（基于Skorokhod嵌入问题的扩展），然后构建两个约束凸优化问题模型（最小化f-散度距离的投影问题，以及一阶随机占优约束下的最优选择问题），通过凸分析方法证明解的存在性和唯一性，并提供解析刻画及数值示例验证。
AI.findings: （1）完整刻画了破产发生前可通过停止扩散过程达到的分布集合特征；（2）证明了在扩展f-散度框架下，两个优化问题（寻找最接近不可达分布的可达分布、以及一阶随机占优约束下选择最优分布）的解均存在且唯一；（3）给出了这些优化问题的解析解刻画，并通过数值示例展示了方法的实用性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将Skorokhod嵌入问题扩展到包含破产风险的一般一维扩散过程框架，提供了破产前可达到分布集合的完整理论刻画；（2）在扩展f-散度框架下建立了两个约束凸优化问题，证明了其解的存在性和唯一性，丰富了随机过程最优停止理论与分布选择理论；（3）建立了分布构建器方法与数学优化理论之间的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者提供了一种在考虑破产风险情况下直接表达目标分布偏好的实操工具；（2）当投资者指定的目标分布不可达时，提供方法找到最接近的可行替代方案；（3）当目标分布可达但非最优时，提供在一阶随机占优约束下的最优分布选择方法；（4）数值示例表明该方法在实际投资决策中具有可操作性。

title: Extending Safety Performance Functions with Connected Vehicle Data Using a Random-Parameter Negative Binomial Lindley Model with Spatial Effect
affiliations: University of Central Florida, University of Central Florida, University of Central Florida and University of Central Florida

detail.title: Extending Safety Performance Functions with Connected Vehicle Data Using a Random-Parameter Negative Binomial Lindley Model with Spatial Effect
detail.abstract: Severe crashes remain a critical roadway safety concern, yet traditional Safety Performance Functions (SPFs) primarily rely on traffic exposure and roadway characteristics, often overlooking driving behavior. Leveraging high-resolution connected vehicle (CV) trajectory data, this study derives behavioral measures including hard braking, hard acceleration, radial acceleration, lane changes, operating speeds, and speed variability, and integrates them into an extended SPF framework for segment-level crash frequency modeling. Using data from the Lake–Sumter MPO region in Florida, Bayesian Random Parameter Negative Binomial-Lindley models with spatial effects are estimated separately for two-lane and multilane roadway segments for both severe (KA) and total (KABCO) crashes to account for unobserved heterogeneity and spatial dependence among roadway segments. Results indicate that CV-based behavioral variables significantly improve model fit and predictive performance compared to traditional SPFs. Among the driving behavior variables, the proportion of radial acceleration on two-lane segments and the proportion of lane changes on multilane segments are positively associated with higher KA and KABCO crash frequencies, respectively. From the elasticity analysis, traffic volume (AADT) is identified as the most influential factor across facilities, while over speeding proportion (0-10%) and speed standard deviation show strong effects for two-lane KA and KABCO crashes, respectively, and speed standard deviation remains particularly influential for multilane KABCO crashes. The proposed framework provides a data-driven approach for capturing behavioral risk factors at the network level and offers practical insights for proactive safety management and prioritization. By integrating CV data into SPF modeling, this study advances behavior-informed, data-driven roadway safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用高分辨率网联车辆（CV）轨迹数据，推导出急刹车、急加速、径向加速度、变道、运行速度和速度变异性等驾驶行为指标，并将其整合到扩展的安全性能函数（SPF）框架中，用于路段层面的碰撞频率建模。基于佛罗里达州Lake-Sumter MPO区域的数据，采用带空间效应的贝叶斯随机参数负二项-林德利模型，分别对双车道和多车道道路的严重（KA）和总（KABCO）碰撞进行估计。结果表明，CV行为变量显著提升了模型拟合与预测性能，其中双车道路段的径向加速度比例和多车道路段的变道比例分别与KA和KABCO碰撞频率正相关。弹性分析显示AADT是最具影响力的因素，超速比例（0-10%）和速度标准差对双车道KA和KABCO碰撞有显著影响，速度标准差对多车道KABCO碰撞尤为关键。
AI.research_question: 如何将网联车辆（CV）轨迹数据推导出的驾驶行为指标整合到传统安全性能函数（SPF）中，以更准确地建模路段层面的碰撞频率？
AI.motivation: 传统SPF主要依赖交通暴露量和道路特征，忽视了驾驶行为这一关键风险因素。严重碰撞仍然是道路安全的关键问题，需要一种能够捕捉行为风险因素的数据驱动方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全性能函数（SPF）框架、贝叶斯随机参数负二项-林德利（RPNB-L）模型、空间效应模型，整合了驾驶行为变量与传统交通暴露和道路特征变量。
AI.method: 利用高分辨率CV轨迹数据推导行为指标（急刹车、急加速、径向加速度、变道、运行速度、速度变异性），将其整合到扩展SPF框架中，采用带空间效应的贝叶斯随机参数负二项-林德利模型，分别对双车道和多车道路段的KA和KABCO碰撞进行建模，并进行弹性分析。
AI.findings: 1) CV行为变量显著提升模型拟合和预测性能；2) 双车道路段径向加速度比例与KA碰撞正相关，多车道路段变道比例与KABCO碰撞正相关；3) AADT是最具影响力的因素；4) 超速比例（0-10%）对双车道KA碰撞影响强，速度标准差对双车道KABCO和多车道KABCO碰撞影响显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将驾驶行为变量整合到SPF框架中，提出了行为信息化的SPF建模方法，推进了数据驱动的道路安全分析理论发展，通过CV数据捕捉网络层面的行为风险因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主动安全管理和优先排序提供了数据驱动的方法，帮助交通管理者识别行为风险因素并进行针对性干预，提供了基于CV数据的网络级安全评估工具。

title: Causal Analysis of Road Segment Crashes Using Doubly Robust Estimation
affiliations: Cleveland State University, Cleveland State University, Cleveland State University, University of Central Florida, University of Central Florida and Cleveland State University

detail.title: Causal Analysis of Road Segment Crashes Using Doubly Robust Estimation
detail.abstract: Inadequate roadway infrastructure design can contribute to crash occurrence. Conventional crash-frequency models do not identify causal effects, leaving individual design elements confounded by traffic volume, facility type, and other exposure variables. This study estimates the causal effects of seven roadway infrastructure and operational characteristics traffic volume (AADT), segment length, median width, number of lanes, traffic signal density, posted speed limit, and bike-lane presence on segment-level crash counts across 1,818 segments in Orlando, Florida. We implement a doubly robust augmented inverse probability weighting (DR-AIPW) estimator combining hypothesis-specific propensity-score models with a zero-inflated negative binomial generalized additive outcome model, reporting the average treatment effect (ATE), the effect on the treated (ATT), and the overlap-weighted effect (ATO) with 2,000 bootstrap replications. Traffic volume and segment length show the largest, most consistent effects: crossing ~36,000 vpd raises expected crashes by 1.61 (ATO; p = 0.004), and exceeding ~270 ft by 2.51 (ATE; p < 0.001; +81%). Signal density shows a strong negative association (ATO = −2.79, ~90% below the mean; p < 0.001), reflecting crash allocation between intersections and segments rather than a causal benefit. Number of lanes and median width show no independent effect once exposure is controlled. The posted-limit effect is significant on average (ATE = +1.91) but null within the overlap region (ATO = +0.04; p = 0.916). Bike-lane presence reduces crashes only where installed (ATT = −2.03, a 65% reduction; p = 0.009). Estimand divergence localizes where effects are causally supported versus overlap-driven.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用佛罗里达州奥兰多市1818个路段的交通数据，采用双重稳健的增广逆概率加权（DR-AIPW）估计器，评估七种道路基础设施和运营特征对路段级碰撞次数的因果效应。研究发现交通量和路段长度影响最大且最一致；信号灯密度呈强烈负关联（反映碰撞在交叉口与路段间的分配而非因果益效）；车道数和中间带宽度在控制暴露后无独立效应；限速效应在均值上显著但在重叠区域无效；自行车道仅在安装处减少碰撞。
AI.research_question: 七种道路基础设施和运营特征（交通量AADT、路段长度、中间带宽度、车道数、信号灯密度、限速、自行车道存在性）对路段级碰撞次数的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统碰撞频率模型无法识别因果效应，各设计元素与交通量、设施类型等暴露变量存在混杂，导致个体设计元素的影响被混淆，需要因果推断方法准确量化道路设计对交通安全的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在结果框架（Rubin因果模型）；双重稳健估计（doubly robust）；逆概率加权（IPW）；增广逆概率加权（AIPW）
AI.method: 采用双重稳健的增广逆概率加权（DR-AIPW）估计器，结合假设特异性倾向得分模型与零膨胀负二项广义加性模型（ZINB-GAM），估计ATE、ATT和ATO三种效应量，并使用2000次Bootstrap重抽样进行推断。
AI.findings: （1）交通量达约36,000 vpd使预期碰撞增加1.61（ATO, p=0.004）；（2）路段长度超过约270英尺增加2.51（ATE, p<0.001, +81%）；（3）信号灯密度呈强烈负相关（ATO=-2.79, 约低于均值90%, p<0.001），反映碰撞在交叉口与路段间的分配而非因果益效；（4）车道数和中间带宽度在控制暴露后无独立效应；（5）限速效应均值上显著（ATE=+1.91）但在重叠区域内无效（ATO=+0.04, p=0.916）；（6）自行车道仅在安装处减少碰撞（ATT=-2.03, 减少65%, p=0.009）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果推断方法（DR-AIPW）引入道路安全碰撞频率建模领域，通过ATE、ATT和ATO三种估计量的对比，识别效应在因果支持区域与重叠驱动区域的分歧，深化了对道路设计要素与碰撞之间因果机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为道路基础设施设计决策提供因果层面证据：交通量和路段长度是碰撞的关键驱动因素；信号灯密度的负相关不应被误解为安全措施；自行车道仅在安装路段有效；限速影响需谨慎解读，为交通管理部门优化道路设计、分配安全资源提供数据支撑。

title: Water Scarcity Management and Housing Markets: Evidence from Water Impact Fees in Colorado

detail.title: Water Scarcity Management and Housing Markets: Evidence from Water Impact Fees in Colorado
detail.abstract: This paper studies local water scarcity management policies designed to align privately- and socially-optimal construction of new housing. Using the staggered adoption of water impact fee policies that scale homebuilder fees by expected water use, I find that these variable fees reduce new single-family lot sizes and irrigated areas, decreasing household water use and altering the market's hedonic equilibrium pricing. I then incorporate these builder incentives into an equilibrium model of the housing market. Variable impact fees increase welfare but capture a small share of the welfare gains and water savings compared to first-best corrective water rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究地方水资源稀缺管理政策（累进式水资源影响费），发现按预期用水量收费的建筑商费用减少了新建独栋住宅的占地面积和灌溉面积，从而降低家庭用水量并改变市场特征价格均衡。通过纳入均衡住房市场模型，发现可变影响费能提升福利，但与最优矫正性水价相比仅捕获了较少的福利收益和水节约量。
AI.research_question: 可变水资源影响费政策如何影响新建住房的规模和用水量，以及在住房市场均衡中其福利效果与最优矫正性水价相比如何？
AI.motivation: 地方水资源短缺日益严重，而新建住房的私人最优决策与全社会最优用水决策存在偏差，需要设计合理的政策工具来协调二者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房市场均衡模型、外部性矫正（庇古税）理论、特征价格（hedonic pricing）理论
AI.method: 利用水资源影响费政策的分阶段采用（staggered adoption）作为准自然实验，结合住房市场均衡模型进行实证估计与结构建模。
AI.findings: 可变水资源影响费减少了新建独栋住宅的占地面积和灌溉面积，降低了家庭用水量，并改变了市场的特征价格均衡；可变影响费虽能提升整体福利，但其福利收益和水节约量仅占最优矫正性水价所能实现的一小部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 将水资源管理政策与住房市场均衡模型相结合，揭示了可变影响费这一非线性定价工具在矫正外部性方面的部分有效性及其与最优庇古税之间的差距，拓展了环境经济与城市经济学交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府设计水资源稀缺管理政策提供了实证依据，表明按用水量征收的可变影响费是有效但非最优的政策工具，有助于指导政策制定者理解其局限性并探索更优的水价矫正机制。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Digital Financial Literacy, and Sustainable Investment Behaviour: An Integrated Model of Young Investors in India

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Digital Financial Literacy, and Sustainable Investment Behaviour: An Integrated Model of Young Investors in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki. Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants prior to completing the online survey. The data collection protocol ensured participant anonymity, voluntary participation, and confidentiality of all responses. Institutional review/ethics committee approval was obtained from the author's institution prior to study commencement.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study develops and empirically tests an integrated model examining how Artificial Intelligence (AI) awareness, digital financial literacy, perceived usefulness, and trust influence sustainable investment intention among young investors in India, with Financial Self-Efficacy as mediator and ESG Awareness as moderator. Using primary data from 527 young investors (age 18-35) collected via online survey, we employ SmartPLS 4 to test the proposed model using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). Key findings: (1) AI Awareness significantly predicts Perceived Usefulness (β=0.487, p<0.001) and Sustainable Investment Intention (β=0.234, p<0.001); (2) Digital Financial Literacy strongly predicts Perceived Usefulness (β=0.562, p<0.001) and Intention (β=0.328, p<0.001); (3) Trust moderates the relationship between Perceived Usefulness and Intention (β_interaction=0.189, p<0.01), with stronger effects at high trust levels; (4) Financial Self-Efficacy fully mediates the AI Awareness → Intention relationship (indirect effect=0.156, 95% CI: [0.089, 0.243]); (5) ESG Awareness amplifies Digital Literacy's effect on Intention (β_moderation=0.267, p<0.001); (6) Multi-group analysis reveals gender differences (female investors show stronger ESG preference, β_diff=0.213, p<0.01) and income-level differences (high-income investors more responsive to Trust). Model explains 68.4% of Sustainable Investment Intention variance (R²=0.684). Study contributes to behavioral finance and sustainable investment literature by: (1) examining AI's role in investment decisions among emerging market youth, (2) integrating digital literacy, trust, and self-efficacy in single model, (3) identifying gender and income-based segments for targeted financial inclusion. Findings have implications for fintech platforms, financial advisors, and regulators in India promoting sustainable investment among young investors.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并实证检验了一个整合模型，探讨AI意识、数字金融素养、感知有用性和信任如何影响印度年轻投资者的可持续投资意愿，以金融自我效能感为中介变量、ESG意识为调节变量。基于527名年轻投资者（18-35岁）的调查数据，使用SmartPLS 4进行结构方程建模，模型解释了68.4%的投资意愿方差。核心发现包括：AI意识和数字金融素养显著预测感知有用性与投资意愿；信任正向调节感知有用性与意愿的关系；金融自我效能感完全中介AI意识到投资意愿的路径；ESG意识放大数字素养对投资意愿的影响；多群组分析揭示性别和收入差异。
AI.research_question: AI意识、数字金融素养、感知有用性和信任如何影响印度年轻投资者的可持续投资意愿？金融自我效能感的中介作用和ESG意识的调节作用是什么？不同性别和收入群体之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术普及和可持续投资议题升温，新兴市场中年轻投资者的投资决策行为日益复杂，但现有研究缺乏将AI意识、数字金融素养、信任、自我效能感整合到一个统一框架来解释可持续投资意愿的实证研究。理解这些因素如何交互作用对于推动可持续金融发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术接受模型（TAM）和行为金融理论，整合AI意识、数字金融素养、感知有用性、信任、金融自我效能感（中介）和ESG意识（调节）的整合模型框架。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，通过在线问卷调查收集527名印度年轻投资者（18-35岁）数据，使用SmartPLS 4进行偏最小二乘结构方程建模（PLS-SEM），包括多群组分析以检验性别和收入差异。
AI.findings: (1) AI意识显著预测感知有用性和可持续投资意愿；(2) 数字金融素养强预测感知有用性和投资意愿；(3) 信任正向调节感知有用性与意愿的关系（高信任水平下效应更强）；(4) 金融自我效能感完全中介AI意识到投资意愿的路径；(5) ESG意识放大数字素养对投资意愿的影响；(6) 女性投资者表现更强的ESG偏好，高收入投资者对信任更敏感；模型R²=0.684。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次检验AI在新兴市场青年投资决策中的作用，拓展了技术接受模型在可持续投资领域的应用；(2) 将数字素养、信任和自我效能感整合于单一模型，深化了行为金融与可持续投资的理论整合；(3) 识别性别和收入分层的差异化机制，丰富了投资者异质性理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技平台、财务顾问和印度监管机构提供实证依据：可针对不同性别和收入群体制定差异化的可持续投资推广策略，提升年轻投资者的数字金融素养和AI认知水平，设计增强信任和金融自我效能的干预措施以促进可持续投资。

title: The Unmatched Deduction: Labor Substitution, Cloud Transactions, and the Information Architecture of the Tax Code

detail.title: The Unmatched Deduction: Labor Substitution, Cloud Transactions, and the Information Architecture of the Tax Code
detail.abstract: American tax administration rests on third-party reporting: one person pays another, the payer files an information return, and the Internal Revenue Service checks that return against the payee's own. The same records do a second and less examined job. The Government Accountability Office found in 1993 that a business wage deduction could be corroborated by comparing it against the employer's own wage and employment tax filings, and that the other major categories could not be corroborated as readily: service payments to corporations and bad debts would require information returns that did not exist, while pensions, rents and interest faced data and systems limitations. Wages were the major business deduction most readily susceptible to the operation under the system as it stood. The two jobs differ: relative to the employee the wage statement is a third-party report, while relative to the employer it is a separately filed collateral record supporting a cross-form consistency check. This Article identifies a business input with neither, and names it the unmatched deduction: a deduction, or set of deductions, that displaces a wage expense corroborable in that way and is accompanied by no analogous standardized collateral filing. It traces a descent from the wage, through the purchased cloud service, which generates no transaction-level return because of the corporate-payee exemption, to internal deployment, which generates no payment corresponding to the function performed. Firms have shifted expenditure between payroll and capital for as long as both categories have existed; what is new is the breadth of work a reconfigurable computing substrate can move at once. The Article shows that the 2025 cloud transaction regulations, the Code's first dedicated transactional vocabulary for on-demand computing, could not reach internally deployed compute on any extension, because a transaction requires a counterparty. It concludes that provider reporting can supply genuine counterparty verification for purchased compute, exceeding what the wage deduction ever had, while a first party schedule can restore only cross-form visibility for the internal case, where no independent party exists to stand behind either side of a match.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了美国税制中一种未被充分研究的扣除类型——"无匹配扣除"（unmatched deduction），即企业投入从可验证的工资支出转向云计算服务或内部部署计算时，缺乏对应的第三方或配套申报文件来交叉验证。文章追溯了从工资扣除到云服务购买再到内部部署的演变路径，分析了2025年云交易法规的局限，并提出提供商申报与第一方附表的补救方案。
AI.research_question: 企业支出从工资转向计算（云计算购买及内部部署）后，美国税制中哪些商业扣除失去了可交叉验证的配套申报机制？2025年云交易法规能否覆盖内部部署计算？
AI.motivation: 美国税收管理依赖第三方申报制度，但企业扣除的验证机制存在不平衡：工资扣除可通过雇主的工资与就业税申报进行交叉验证，而其他主要扣除类别缺乏同等验证能力。随着企业将支出从工资转向云计算和内部部署计算，一种新型"无匹配扣除"出现了，亟需系统化分析与政策回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第三方报告理论、交叉表格一致性核查（cross-form consistency check）、税收征管的信息对称性理论
AI.method: 概念分析与法律条文分析相结合，追溯扣除类型的历史演变，分析1993年GAO报告、现行税法框架及2025年云计算交易法规的文本与覆盖范围。
AI.findings: （1）工资是主要商业扣除中最容易通过配套申报交叉验证的项目；（2）购买云服务因企业收款方豁免而缺乏交易层面的信息申报；（3）内部部署计算完全不产生对应功能的付款，任何法规延伸都无法覆盖；（4）2025年云交易法规因"交易需有对手方"而无法触及内部部署；（5）提供商申报可为购买的计算提供真正的对手方验证，内部部署只能依赖第一方附表恢复交叉表格可见性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"无匹配扣除"这一新概念，丰富了第三方报告与税收征管的理论框架；区分了第三方报告与配套文件交叉核查两种不同验证机制，深化了对税收信息基础设施的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务政策制定者提供了针对云计算时代扣除验证的具体政策建议：对购买的计算服务引入提供商申报制度，对内部部署计算采用第一方附表方案，以恢复税基完整性。
