title:
The Lead Zero Standard 

A Governance Protocol for Clinician-As-Originator Architecture in Ai-Assisted Medicine, Version 3.0
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
The Lead Zero Standard 

A Governance Protocol for Clinician-As-Originator Architecture in Ai-Assisted Medicine, Version 3.0

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr. Enam Satti is the Founder of AegisMD and the author of its Clinical AI Red Teaming Framework, an open specification protocol for clinical AI safety evaluation from which the 34 adversarial attack classes documented in this standard originated. The governance framework proposed in this manuscript, if adopted, could benefit organizations providing clinical AI safety and red teaming services, including AegisMD. Dr. Satti asserts that this submission is motivated exclusively by patient safety and physician accountability. The Lead Zero Standard is published as an open specification, freely available to all implementers without licensing restriction or commercial obligation. As of the date of this publication, AegisMD has no clients, has conducted no commercial evaluations, and has generated no revenue. The author has received no financial benefit of any kind from AegisMD to date.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, this paper has not been published anywhere before, it has no existing DOI, this is an original submission.

detail.abstract:
Background
The prevailing human-in-the-loop governance model for clinical AI positions the clinician as a secondary auditor of AI-generated suggestions rather than the primary architect of clinical care. This creates a critical accountability asymmetry and exposes patient populations globally to geographical algorithmic bias. In January 2026, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration codified this model by exempting clinical decision support software from premarket review, provided a clinician can independently review the output. Version 2.0 of the Lead Zero Standard, published on SSRN on May 4, 2026, established the Clinician-as-Originator principle and the 0-1-0 cycle as the foundational governance architecture for clinical AI in individual patient care. Public stress testing following publication identified architectural gaps requiring formal resolution.

Purpose
Version 3.0 strengthens the V2 architecture through six foundational additions: the Admissibility Layer, the Commit Boundary, Tier-Dependent Decision Provenance, Low-Resource and Low-Literacy Deployment Sovereignty, Semantic Drift Behavioral Benchmarking, and Minimum Architectural Requirements. Building on this foundation, Version 3.0 further establishes that clinical authority is not adequately governed as a one-time declaration at the point of intent. It must remain continuously valid through to the point of execution. This distinction, between authority persistence and authority validity, is operationalized through Continuous Authority Validity monitoring, an Output Completeness Verification requirement for compressed clinical outputs, physiologically grounded definitions of irreversibility at the Commit Boundary, a formal Systemic Error State protocol, explicit governance requirements for agentic and multi-component AI architectures, and explicit patient sovereignty protections. The adversarial testing framework was expanded from 24 to 34 verified attack classes across four categories, independently stress-tested against both human governance review and adversarial AI red-teaming.

Scope
Version 3.0 maintains the V2 scope. Adult individual patient care. Pediatric and obstetric extensions remain reserved for future versions.

Status
This is a working paper. It has not been prospectively validated through clinical implementation. Pilot deployment studies are needed.

AI.tldr: 本文是Lead Zero Standard 3.0版本，在V2基础上通过六个基础性新增（Admissibility Layer、Commit Boundary、Tier-Dependent Decision Provenance、Low-Resource and Low-Literacy Deployment Sovereignty、Semantic Drift Behavioral Benchmarking和Minimum Architectural Requirements）强化临床AI治理架构，并提出Continuous Authority Validity monitoring等机制，将攻击测试框架从24类扩展至34类。
AI.research_question: 如何克服现行人机回环（human-in-the-loop）临床AI治理模式中临床医生被降级为次要审核者的问题，并解决Continental authority在从意图到执行的全过程中持续有效性的治理缺口？
AI.motivation: 现行FDA将临床决策支持软件豁免于上市前审查，且人类在环治理模式造成问责制不对称和地理算法偏差。Lead Zero Standard V2.0虽建立了Clinician-as-Originator原则和0-1-0循环，但公开压力测试发现架构性缺口需要正式解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: Clinician-as-Originator原则、0-1-0循环、Continuous Authority Validity（权威持续性vs有效性）、Commit Boundary不可逆性（生理学定义）、Systemic Error State协议、患者主权保护。
AI.method: 架构规范制定；对抗性测试框架从24类扩展至34类攻击类别，覆盖四个类别；独立压力测试（人类治理审查+对抗性AI红队）。
AI.findings: 提出了六项基础性架构新增和多项机制强化，包括Continuous Authority Validity monitoring、Output Completeness Verification requirement、生理学定义不可逆性、Systemic Error State协议、agentic和多组件AI架构治理要求、患者主权保护。对抗性测试框架扩展至34类验证攻击类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 将临床权威治理从一次性声明（意图点）扩展为持续有效至执行点的过程性治理；区分权威持续性（persistence）与权威有效性（validity）；建立生理学基础的不可逆性定义以界定Commit Boundary。
AI.practical_contributions: 响应FDA 2026年1月豁免临床决策支持软件上市前审查的政策现实；为低资源、低识字率环境提供部署主权保障；为agentic和多组件AI架构提供明确治理要求；为未来临床试点部署提供治理标准框架。

title: Machine Learning Applications in Demand Forecasting for Supply Chain Management: A Systematic Literature Review

detail.title: Machine Learning Applications in Demand Forecasting for Supply Chain Management: A Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: Accurate demand forecasting remains a persistent challenge in supply chain management, with poor predictions contributing to bullwhip effects and operational inefficiencies. While machine learning (ML) is increasingly applied to address this challenge, a holistic review focused specifically on ML algorithms for demand forecasting has been lacking. This report conducts a systematic literature review, following Kitchenham and Charters' guidelines and the PRISMA framework, of 27 academic studies and 8 industry reports examining ML applications in demand forecasting across supply chains. The reviewed studies collectively employ 26 distinct ML techniques, spanning traditional machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, and hybrid models, across 18 industry sectors consolidated into five broad categories. Findings show that Retail & Consumer Markets (48%) and Manufacturing & Industrial (30%) sectors dominate current research, with deep learning (33%) and traditional ML (30%) as the most common approaches. Improved forecast accuracy over traditional statistical models emerged as the most frequently cited benefit (37% of studies), alongside gains in handling volatile demand, scalability across large SKU portfolios, and real-time prediction capability. Real-world industry applications, including Coles' AI-enabled fulfilment centers in Australia, illustrate practical adoption but often lack empirical validation or benchmarking depth. Recurring limitations across the literature include small or limited datasets, constrained model scalability, poor generalizability across industries and geographies, and trade-offs between interpretability and model complexity. The review identifies key research gaps, including the need for multi-objective forecasting, cross-domain transfer learning, improved uncertainty quantification, and stronger human-AI collaboration. These findings suggest that while ML offers substantial and industry-tailored improvements in forecasting accuracy and responsiveness, realizing its full potential requires standardized benchmarking, interdisciplinary research, and closer alignment between ML deployment and organizational data infrastructure and readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文遵循Kitchenham和Charters指南及PRISMA框架，对27篇学术研究和8份行业报告进行了系统文献综述，分析了供应链需求预测中机器学习（ML）的应用。研究发现深度学习和传统ML是最常用的方法（各占33%和30%），零售与消费品（48%）和制造与工业（30%）部门主导了当前研究，改进预测准确性是最常被引用的优势（37%）。同时识别出数据有限、模型可扩展性受限、泛化能力不足等挑战，以及多目标预测、跨域迁移学习、不确定性量化和人机协作等研究空白。
AI.research_question: 供应链需求预测中机器学习算法的应用现状如何？包括使用的主要ML技术、行业分布、实际效益和局限性。
AI.motivation: 供应链管理中需求预测不准确会导致牛鞭效应和运营低效率，虽然ML被越来越多地应用于此领域，但缺乏专门针对需求预测中ML算法的整体性综述研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统文献综述方法论（Kitchenham和Charters指南、PRISMA框架）
AI.method: 遵循Kitchenham和Charters指南与PRISMA框架进行系统文献综述，分析了27篇学术研究和8份行业报告，涵盖26种不同的ML技术、18个行业部门（整合为5大类别）。
AI.findings: （1）零售与消费品（48%）和制造与工业（30%）部门主导研究；（2）深度学习（33%）和传统ML（30%）是最常见方法；（3）改进的预测准确性是最常被引用的好处（37%的研究），此外还有处理波动需求、大规模SKU组合的可扩展性和实时预测能力；（4）工业应用（如澳大利亚Coles的AI配送中心）缺乏实证验证或基准测试深度；（5）常见局限包括小数据集、可扩展性受限、跨行业泛化能力差、可解释性与模型复杂度之间的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次提供了专门针对需求预测中ML算法的系统性综述，填补了该领域的研究空白；（2）识别了关键研究缺口，包括多目标预测、跨域迁移学习、改进不确定性量化和更强的人机协作；（3）建立了一个跨行业、跨方法的ML需求预测技术分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为从业者提供了ML需求预测技术的全景概览和行业分布洞察；（2）指出实现ML全面潜力需要标准化基准测试、跨学科研究和ML部署与组织数据基础设施及就绪度的紧密对齐；（3）通过Coles等真实案例为行业应用提供参考。

title: Educating All Retail Investors in a Billion-Euro Market
affiliations: University of Kiel - Institute for Quantitative Business and Economics Research (QBER) and University of Kiel - Institute for Quantitative Business and Economics Research (QBER)

detail.title: Educating All Retail Investors in a Billion-Euro Market
detail.abstract: The German regulator Bafin designed an educational intervention that targets investors trading billions and losing millions in the market for retail structured products. We estimate that the intervention reduces retail losses by 340 million euros per year.

AI.tldr: 德国金融监管机构Bafin设计了一项针对零售结构性产品市场中亏损交易者的教育干预措施，估计该干预每年减少零售投资者损失3.4亿欧元。
AI.research_question: 监管机构设计的教育干预措施能否有效减少零售投资者在结构化产品市场中的交易损失？
AI.motivation: 零售投资者在结构化产品市场中大量交易并蒙受巨额损失，监管机构需要评估教育干预措施的有效性以保护投资者权益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学与投资者保护理论，涉及消费者金融教育干预的有效性评估。
AI.method: 利用德国监管机构Bafin设计的自然实验，对教育干预措施的效果进行因果估计。
AI.findings: 该教育干预措施每年减少零售投资者损失约3.4亿欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管教育干预在保护零售投资者方面的有效性提供了实证证据，补充了投资者保护与行为金融领域的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计和评估投资者教育干预措施提供了量化的政策效果证据，支持监管政策在金融消费者保护中的价值。

title:
Signed-Event Learning and Adaptive Utility:
 A Minimal Model of Endogenous Preferences -Identification, Endogenous Cycles, and First Measurements
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Signed-Event Learning and Adaptive Utility:
 A Minimal Model of Endogenous Preferences -Identification, Endogenous Cycles, and First Measurements
detail.abstract: We propose a minimal learning model in which individuals encode personally realized gains and losses (events E) into action weights W, with learning sensitivity S governing the size and learning period T the timing of updates; W enters choice values as a learned multiplier on baseline utility, V = U⁰•e^W-C, and thereby constitutes utility, expectations, and behavior. The agent-side primitives are domain-general; finance serves as the first closed environment because events, feedback, and data are sharpest there. Events are defined at the Core level as signed reinforcement signals attributed to actions, and are operationally narrowed to realized material returns in the finance application. Fixing the error-correction skeleton W ← W + L•S•(e-W) yields three identification results: macro means identify only S/T; the stationary cross-sectional variance Sσ²/(2-S) identifies S while the excess kurtosis of one-period changes, exactly 3(T-1), identifies T; and learning and forgetting speeds are locked, to leading order in S, into the single rate S/T. Closing the price-feedback loop produces a bubble phase boundary without social imitation, and adding a single environmental anchor α generates endogenous boom-bust cycles through a Neimark-Sacker bifurcation (a Hopf bifurcation in the continuous-time mean-field limit) with onset period P = 2π/√(α•S/T). Inverting this law, we calibrate the model to the 16-year financial cycle (BIS) and to a directly measured scar half-life: in event-quiet windows of Gallup's U.S. stock-ownership series (1998-2025) we estimate a leakage rate of 0.047-0.084 per year (half-life 8-15 years), and an eight-year participation plateau amid a tripling market is difficult to reconcile with a pure common-price-signal benchmark and is consistent with the personal signed-event channel. Korean Securities Depository ownership data (2019-2025) show an entry surge persisting through the 2022 bear market, consistent with the model's entry-exit asymmetry prediction. The contribution is compression, not coverage; an explicit list of falsification conditions is provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个极简的学习模型，个体将个人实现的得失（事件E）编码为行动权重W，学习敏感性S控制更新幅度、学习周期T控制更新时机；W作为基准效用的学习乘数进入选择价值V = U⁰•e^W-C，从而构成效用、预期和行为。在金融环境中进行封闭测试，通过误差修正框架获得三个识别结果，并闭合价格反馈回路后产生无社会模仿的泡沫相边界，加入单一环境锚α可经Neimark-Sacker分岔内生产生繁荣-萧条周期。模型被校准到16年金融周期和疤痕半衰期数据，并提供了明确的证伪条件清单。
AI.research_question: 个体如何通过个人经历的得失（而非社会模仿或共同价格信号）进行学习，从而产生效用、预期和行为？
AI.motivation: 现有模型难以解释诸如美国股票持有率长达八年的平台期（同期市场翻三倍）、韩国投资者在2022年熊市中仍持续涌入等现象，这些现象无法由纯共同价格信号基准解释，需要引入个人符号事件的通道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 错误修正学习模型（W ← W + L•S•(e-W)）；Neimark-Sacker分岔理论（连续时间平均场极限下为Hopf分岔）；泡沫相边界理论
AI.method: 理论建模与实证校准：建立最小学习模型，推导三个识别结果（宏观均值识别S/T、截面方差识别S、单期变化超额峰度识别T）；用Gallup美国股票持有序列（1998-2025）和韩国证券托管局数据（2019-2025）进行校准验证。
AI.findings: 1) 三个识别结果：宏观均值仅识别S/T；截面方差Sσ²/(2-S)识别S；单期变化的超额峰度精确等于3(T-1)识别T；学习与遗忘速度锁定为S/T。2) 闭合价格反馈回路产生无社会模仿的泡沫相边界。3) 加入环境锚α后经Neimark-Sacker分岔产生内生繁荣-萧条周期，起始周期P = 2π/√(α•S/T)。4) 校准结果显示事件安静窗口期泄漏率为每年0.047-0.084（半衰期8-15年）；八年的参与度平台期难以用纯共同价格信号解释，与个人符号事件通道一致。5) 韩国数据显示入市激增持续贯穿2022年熊市，与模型入市-出市不对称预测一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供一个极简、可识别、领域通用的个体学习框架，将效用、预期和行为统一于单一学习机制；2) 证明了无社会模仿条件下泡沫相边界的存在性；3) 连接学习动力学与分岔理论（Neimark-Sacker/Hopf），建立了微观学习参数与宏观周期之间的解析关系；4) 通过识别结果给出了明确的证伪条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了可直接用于金融市场的校准工具（由观测数据反推S、T、α等学习参数）；2) 解释并预测了投资者参与度的持续平台期和入市-出市不对称现象，对理解市场泡沫周期和监管时机有参考价值；3) 通过明确的证伪条件清单增强了模型的可检验性。

title: Beyond the Coupon: Climate Risk and the Quantity-Maturity Design of Chinese Interbank Bonds

detail.title: Beyond the Coupon: Climate Risk and the Quantity-Maturity Design of Chinese Interbank Bonds
detail.abstract: This paper studies two financing terms that coupon regressions leave aside: how much an issuer places and how long it borrows. The data cover 1,468 Chinese interbank medium-term notes from 165 listed legal issuers over 2010-2025. I measure climate exposure in three ways-weather at the registered location, national ETS coverage matched by legal entity and date, and climate-risk language in the latest available annual report-and estimate issuer and issue-month fixed-effects models. None of the nine main coefficients survives issuer-clustered wild-bootstrap inference and multiplicity correction. The nulls are not equally informative: equivalence tests rule out effects beyond ±10% only for the language measure in the issue-size and maturity equations. Most remaining intervals are too wide for such a conclusion, and ETS estimates draw on changes among only 17 transaction-level issuers. In the annual panel, issuance rises before firms enter ETS scope as well as afterward. That lead pattern rules out a causal policy interpretation. Overall, the evidence sets limits on what the current measures and sample can establish; it does not show that climate risk is absent from financing decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国银行间中期票据的融资条款（发行规模和期限）是否受到气候风险的影响。作者采用三种气候暴露度量（注册地天气、国家ETS覆盖、年报气候语言），并使用发行人和发行月份固定效应模型，发现九个主要系数在稳健推断和多重性校正后均不显著。等价检验仅在语言指标上排除了超过±10%的影响；ETS估计仅依赖17家交易层面的发行人。年度面板显示发行在进入ETS之前和之后均增加，排除了因果政策解释。
AI.research_question: 气候风险是否影响中国企业中期票据的发行规模和借贷期限这两个融资条款？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注气候风险对票息（coupon）的影响，而忽略了发行规模和期限这两个重要的融资条款维度。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候金融理论、融资约束理论、政策冲击评估框架
AI.method: 采用三种气候暴露度量方法（注册地天气、国家碳排放交易体系ETS覆盖、年报气候风险语言），构建发行人和发行月份固定效应模型；使用发行人聚类的wild-bootstrap推断和多重性校正；采用等价检验（equivalence test）评估效应大小。
AI.findings: 九个主要系数在稳健推断和多重性校正后均不显著；等价检验仅在语言指标上排除了超过±10%的影响；ETS估计仅基于17家交易层面发行人的变化；年度面板显示发行在进入ETS之前和之后均增加，存在提前效应，排除因果政策解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候风险与融资条款关系的实证研究提供了严谨的方法论边界，展示了在不同度量方式下气候风险效应的显著性差异，并强调了对null结果进行等价检验的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了关于气候风险如何（或未如何）影响中国中期票据融资条款的经验证据，提示需要更精细的数据和方法来评估气候风险在融资决策中的作用。

title: The Services That Pay for Cash Transfers to Women: Evidence from Indian State Budgets
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Services That Pay for Cash Transfers to Women: Evidence from Indian State Budgets
detail.abstract: Twelve Indian states pay unconditional monthly cash transfers to adult women. The 2025-26 provisions total US$19 billion, reaching about 95 million women, making this one of the largest subnational women-targeted cash transfer expansions in the world. These states face centrally enforced borrowing ceilings and heavy salary commitments, so much of the cost falls on other spending. In a validated panel of nineteen states' budgeted spending from 2015-16 to 2026-27, compared across sectors within the same state and year, the displacement follows one measured rule: the larger the central government's co-funding share in a sector, the more state money leaves it, while central releases to that sector hold steady. Salary shares, women's time use, and official gender-budget classifications add nothing once co-funding is controlled. The result survives randomization and wild-bootstrap inference, pre-treatment measurement, drop-one-sector tests, and re-estimation on audited accounts. What a transfer costs in public services depends on which of those services an upper tier of government co-funds. Because the most co-funded sectors are water supply, nutrition, and family welfare, the incidence falls on the services that substitute for women's unpaid work.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了印度12个邦向成年女性提供无条件月度现金转移支付（2025-26财年规模达190亿美元，覆盖约9500万女性）的财政影响。通过2015-16至2026-27年间19个邦的预算面板数据，发现这些女性定向转移支付的资金主要挤出了其他部门支出，且挤出遵循一个规律：中央政府在某个部门的联合出资比例越高，邦政府资金越倾向于撤出该部门，而中央拨款保持稳定。受影响最大的部门是供水、营养和家庭福利——恰是替代女性无偿劳动的服务。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦面向女性的无条件现金转移支付计划，其财政成本如何挤占其他公共部门支出？挤出效应遵循何种规则？
AI.motivation: 印度12个邦实施了规模庞大的女性定向现金转移计划（年度预算达190亿美元），由于邦政府面临中央政府强制的借贷上限和沉重的工资支出承诺，转移支付的大部分成本必须由其他支出来承担，因此需要研究这种财政挤出的模式和决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义下的支出替代/挤出理论——关注不同层级政府联合出资（co-funding）结构与地方支出决策之间的关系。
AI.method: 基于19个邦2015-16至2026-27年预算支出面板数据，采用邦内和年内跨部门比较的固定效应设计，辅以随机化推断、wild-bootstrap推断、干预前测量、逐部门剔除测试以及审计数据再估计等稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 挤出效应遵循单一可测量的规则：中央政府在某个部门的联合共同出资比例越高，邦政府资金越倾向于撤出该部门，而中央对该部门的拨款保持稳定。工资份额、女性时间利用和官方性别预算分类在控制共同出资比例后不再具有解释力。受影响最大的部门是供水、营养和家庭福利——这些正是替代女性无偿劳动的公共服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了现金转移支付的财政成本最终落在哪些公共部门取决于上级政府共同出资的结构——这是对财政联邦主义和转移支付财政归宿理论的重要贡献；同时表明性别预算分类和女性时间利用并非挤出的关键解释变量，共同出资比例才是决定性因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：当设计大规模社会现金转移支付时，必须考虑其财政挤出的部门分布后果；由于受影响最大的是替代女性无偿劳动的服务部门，这一政策可能在改善女性收入的同时损害其时间利用相关公共服务供给，政策设计需统筹考虑。

title: Supramarginal Versus Gross Total Resection in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma: A Post-hoc Pooled Individual-Participant Analysis of Two Randomised Surgical Trials
affiliations: University of Toronto - Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre, University of Gothenburg - Sahlgrenska University Hospital, University of Turku - Division of Clinical Neurosciences, University of Southern Denmark, Medical University of Vienna - Department of Neurosurgery and Pennsylvania State University - Penn State Hershey Medical Center

detail.title: Supramarginal Versus Gross Total Resection in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma: A Post-hoc Pooled Individual-Participant Analysis of Two Randomised Surgical Trials

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Each trial received ethics approval from the responsible national, regional, or institutional committee, and all participants provided written informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: Canadian Institutes of Health Research, Norwegian Cancer Society, and Nordic Cancer Union.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: We did a post-hoc pooled individual-participant analysis of G-SUMIT and the European trial at four Canadian and 12 European academic neurosurgery centres. The trials are registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04737577 and NCT04243005

detail.abstract:
Background: Resection beyond the contrast-enhancing margin could remove infiltrating glioblastoma but might increase neurological risk. Retrospective comparisons suggest benefit but are vulnerable to anatomical and prognostic selection bias. We assessed pooled randomised evidence comparing supramarginal resection (SMR) with gross total resection (GTR).

Methods: We did a post-hoc pooled individual-participant analysis of G-SUMIT and the European trial at four Canadian and 12 European academic neurosurgery centres. Adults with anatomically favourable presumed high-grade glioma or glioblastoma were randomly assigned (1:1) to GTR or SMR. The primary cohort comprised 67 patients with histopathologically confirmed glioblastoma. Outcomes were overall and progression-free survival. Cox models adjusted for age, Karnofsky performance status, and trial; Bayesian analyses estimated posterior probabilities of benefit. The trials are registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04737577 and NCT04243005.

Findings: Between July 1, 2020, and June 30, 2025, 82 patients were randomised; 67 entered the primary cohort (33 GTR and 34 SMR). Median follow-up was 23·6 months. There were 25 deaths and 39 progression-free survival events. For SMR versus GTR, unadjusted hazard ratios were 1·08 (95% CI 0·49–2·38) for death and 0·67 (0·36–1·27) for progression or death; adjusted hazard ratios were 0·79 (0·33–1·89) and 0·43 (0·21–0·87), respectively. Under the data-informed prior, posterior probabilities of benefit were 0·83 for death and 0·97 for progression or death. New neurological deficits occurred in three of 33 patients (9%) assigned to GTR and four of 32 (13%) assigned to SMR; no deaths occurred within 30 days.Interpretation SMR was feasible and associated with a lower adjusted hazard of progression or death; overall-survival benefit was not established. These findings support a definitive event-driven trial but not routine adoption of SMR. Funding: Canadian Institutes of Health Research, Norwegian Cancer Society, and Nordic Cancer Union.

AI.tldr: 本研究对两项随机对照试验（G-SUMIT和欧洲试验）进行了事后汇总个体参与者分析，比较了胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）患者接受超边缘切除（SMR）与全切除（GTR）的疗效。主要队列包含67例经病理确诊的GBM患者，结果显示SMR与较低的调整后进展或死亡风险相关（调整后HR=0.43），但总生存获益未能确立。该研究支持开展确定性的终事件驱动试验，但不支持常规采用SMR。
AI.research_question: 对于胶质母细胞瘤患者，超边缘切除（SMR）相较于全切除（GTR）是否能改善总生存期和无进展生存期？
AI.motivation: 超出对比增强边缘的切除可能去除浸润性胶质母细胞瘤，但可能增加神经功能风险。既往回顾性比较虽提示获益，但易受解剖学和预后选择偏倚影响，缺乏随机对照试验的汇总证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 胶质母细胞瘤的浸润性生长理论——肿瘤细胞在对比增强边缘之外浸润，扩大切除范围可能清除残留肿瘤细胞从而延长生存。基于Cox比例风险回归模型和贝叶斯分析框架评估治疗获益的后验概率。
AI.method: 对G-SUMIT和欧洲试验进行事后汇总个体参与者分析（pooled individual-participant analysis）。主要队列为67例经组织病理学确诊的胶质母细胞瘤患者，随机分配至GTR或SMR组。采用Cox模型（校正年龄、KPS和试验）及贝叶斯分析估计获益后验概率。研究在北美和欧洲16个学术神经外科中心进行。
AI.findings: 82例患者被随机化，67例进入主要队列（33例GTR、34例SMR），中位随访23.6个月。SMR与GTR相比：未校正死亡HR=1.08（95%CI 0.49–2.38），未校正进展/死亡HR=0.67（0.36–1.27）；校正后死亡HR=0.79（0.33–1.89），校正后进展/死亡HR=0.43（0.21–0.87）。在数据信息先验下，死亡获益后验概率为0.83，进展或死亡获益后验概率为0.97。新发神经功能缺损：GTR组3/33（9%），SMR组4/32（13%），30天内无死亡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个汇总随机对照试验证据，证实SMR在可控的神经功能风险下与较低的进展或死亡风险相关，为胶质母细胞瘤切除范围理论提供了随机化层面的证据支撑。同时揭示了手术获益的统计学不确定性，明确了现有证据的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 临床实践方面，研究不支持在常规临床中立即采用SMR，但支持开展更大规模的确定性终事件驱动试验。为神经外科医生提供了关于SMR可行性和安全性（神经功能缺损率不显著高于GTR）的重要参考，并明确了当前证据不足以改变手术标准。

title: Optimal Grading: A Unified Approach
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Grading: A Unified Approach
detail.abstract: We develop a unified approach to optimal grading in an all-pay contest in which a designer assigns a fixed vector of heterogeneous prizes to maximize expected total effort. The approach covers two information regimes and identifies a common principle: iron locally misordered incentive returns and assign prizes assortatively across the resulting grades. Under rank-only grading, assignments depend only on ordinal ranks. Ironing cumulative rank coefficients-via the least concave majorant or the pool-adjacentviolators algorithm-determines which adjacent ranks are pooled and which prizes are randomized within each grade. Under performance-contingent grading, assignments may depend on numerical effort. The optimum irons virtual ability, forms endogenous type grades, and assigns prize blocks assortatively across grades. A failing grade below a minimum passing effort and a collection of effort brackets implement the direct optimum while preserving full prize assignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的方法来优化全支付竞赛（all-pay contest）中的等级评定（grading），设计者分配固定的异质性奖品向量以最大化预期总努力。该方法涵盖两种信息机制（仅排名等级制和绩效条件等级制），并识别出一个共同原则：局部熨平错序的激励回报，并按等级分类分配奖品。
AI.research_question: 在全支付竞赛中，设计者应如何分配固定的异质性奖品向量（即如何进行最优等级评定）以最大化参与者的预期总努力？
AI.motivation: 已有的竞赛设计文献大多关注奖品结构设计，但针对固定奖品向量下的最优等级评定（grading）问题的统一分析较为缺乏。此外，不同信息机制（仅排名 vs. 绩效条件）下的最优分配原则尚未被统一揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全支付竞赛理论（all-pay contest）、最优等级评定理论、熨平（ironing）方法（最小凹包络least concave majorant、池相邻违例算法pool-adjacent-violators algorithm）、机制设计理论。
AI.method: 理论研究与数学建模。在两种信息机制（仅排名等级制和绩效条件等级制）下，利用最优化方法推导最优奖品分配方案，并通过熨平技术（least concave majorant或PAVA算法）确定哪些相邻排名被合并为同一等级，以及等级内如何随机分配奖品。
AI.findings: （1）两种信息机制下存在统一原则：熨平局部错序的激励回报，并按等级分类（assortatively）分配奖品。（2）仅排名等级制下，分配仅取决于序数排名，通过熨平累积排名系数确定合并的相邻排名及等级内随机化方案。（3）绩效条件等级制下，分配可取决于数值努力，最优点熨平虚拟能力，形成内生类型等级，并跨等级分类分配奖品块。（4）包含最低通过努力以下的失败等级及一系列努力档位（effort brackets）的实施机制可实现直接最优解，同时保留完整的奖品分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次为全支付竞赛中的最优等级评定提供了统一的理论框架，揭示了两种不同信息机制下共享的最优分配原则（熨平+分类分配），并建立了与统计文献（如熨平技术、PAVA算法）的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞赛设计者（如考试评分、员工激励、研发竞赛等场景）提供了可操作的等级评定规则指导：如何根据排名或绩效表现将参赛者分层并分配奖品，包括失败等级和努力档位的具体实施建议。

title: Knowing Who to Lend To - What the Accounts and Filings of Ten Digital Banks in Five Markets Show About Why Some of Them Reach Profit and Others Do Not

detail.title: Knowing Who to Lend To - What the Accounts and Filings of Ten Digital Banks in Five Markets Show About Why Some of Them Reach Profit and Others Do Not

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author participated in the Nafis Leadership Programme, Cohort III, organised by the Emirati Talent Competitiveness Council in partnership with the UAE Government Leaders Program. The Korea immersion within that programme was delivered by the National University of Singapore Business School Executive Education. The challenger bank counts that open this paper were first encountered in a session on that immersion. Jungkiu Choi, who taught that session, subsequently provided peer review of this paper across four rounds; he is acknowledged accordingly and received no compensation. The author visited KakaoBank in Pangyo as a guest of that programme in July 2026 and met members of its management. He is a national of the United Arab Emirates, one of the markets examined. No funding was received for this research. The author holds no financial interest in any institution examined.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It is based entirely on published financial statements, regulatory disclosures and supervisory records. No ethics approval was required. A site visit to one institution took place during a leadership programme and is declared as an interest; no data from that visit is used in the paper.

detail.abstract:
Boston Consulting Group, the management consultancy, counts 92 profitable challenger banks worldwide out of roughly 650, up from 23 of 453 two years earlier. Profitability is arriving in the sector; scale is not. This paper asks what separates the banks reaching profit from those that have not, reading the accounts, regulatory filings and supervisory records of ten digital banks across Singapore, Korea, Australia, the United Arab Emirates and Brazil for 2024 and 2025.

There is a survival threshold, illustrated by the Australian failures of 2020 to 2022, but it sits on earning assets rather than on lending: a bank holding deposits against nothing does not survive, while one holding securities and earning fees can lend almost nothing and prosper. The loan-to-deposit ratio, the measure usually applied, is a proxy for that threshold which stops working once a bank earns from anything else, and above the floor it no longer orders outcomes at all, though it continues to bear on them through funding cost.

What separates the banks already lending is the annual credit charge. Measured against the average loan book it runs from 0.51 per cent to 12.6 across the nine for which it is comparable, and in Singapore the two lowest belong to the only two banks at or near profit. That ordering holds within a market. It does not travel across pricing environments: Nubank, the largest challenger bank in the world, runs a credit charge near nine per cent and a return on equity of 33, because Brazilian yields carry it. A charge is half a sentence, and the yield is the other half.

Across two years four of the five reduced that charge and one did not. Whether those movements reflect improving judgement or losses not yet recognised on rapidly growing books cannot be settled from a ratio alone. The paper attempts a correction from disclosures banks already publish under IFRS 9, using opening balances, origination volumes and the coverage held against loans that have deteriorated but not yet defaulted, and sets out how far that gets. Five objections are put to the finding and tested against the same accounts, among them the cost-to-income ratio conventionally used in its place, and the collateral behind the lowest charges.

The pattern follows where each bank's credit judgement comes from. It can be bought, built, or borrowed from a position where transactions and repayments are already visible. Which source a bank draws on, and how far through it the bank has progressed, explains more about its trajectory than either its distribution or its deployment ratio. K bank marks the boundary: a low charge on the asset side, on a book more than half of which carries collateral or a guarantee, and a profit that fell anyway because its funding cost moved against it.

Three patterns appear only when the five markets are read together. These banks are acquiring collateral rather than moving further from it, in three markets at once. Defaults in their books leave by write-off rather than by cure. And the share of a year's charge resting on lending originated within it tracks how fast a bank is growing rather than where it operates.

Two years is the whole of the record these banks have. The paper sets out what that permits and what it does not.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析新加坡、韩国、澳大利亚、阿联酋和巴西十个数字银行2024-2025年的账目、监管文件和监管记录，识别了盈利银行与未盈利银行之间的关键差异。研究发现生存门槛在于盈利资产而非贷款本身；贷款存款比率在银行有其他收入来源时失效；信用成本率（credit charge）是区分已放贷银行的核心指标，但需结合收益率（yield）共同解读。论文还利用IFRS 9披露数据试图从比率层面校正判断，并提出五个反驳进行检验。
AI.research_question: 什么因素区分了达到盈利的数字银行与尚未盈利的数字银行？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内盈利的挑战者银行数量从两年前的23/453增长到92/650，盈利正在到来但规模并未扩大。理解什么因素区分盈利与非盈利银行具有重要实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存门槛理论（基于盈利资产而非贷款）、贷款存款比率作为代理指标的局限性、信用成本与收益率双因素框架、IFRS 9披露下的信用风险评估框架。
AI.method: 对十个数字银行进行多案例深度分析，阅读其账目、监管申报和监管记录；采用跨市场比较方法（新加坡、韩国、澳大利亚、阿联酋、巴西）；利用IFRS 9披露的开户余额、发起量和已减值但未违约贷款的覆盖率进行校正分析；对核心发现提出五个反驳并逐一用相同账目检验。
AI.findings: 1）生存门槛在盈利资产而非贷款，贷款存款比率在银行有其他收入来源时失效；2）信用成本率是区分已放贷银行的核心指标，在同一市场内排序成立但跨定价环境不成立（需与收益率结合）；3）两年内五家银行中四家降低了信用成本；4）信用判断来源（购买、构建或借用）比分销或部署比率更能解释银行轨迹；5）三个跨市场模式：银行在获得抵押品而非远离、违约通过注销而非治愈退出、年度信用成本中当年发起贷款所占份额与增长速度相关而非与所在地相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出生存门槛应基于盈利资产而非贷款的理论修正；指出贷款存款比率作为代理指标的适用边界；构建信用成本与收益率双因素分析框架；引入信用判断来源（购买/构建/借用）作为解释银行轨迹的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字银行管理者识别生存关键指标提供指导；为投资者和监管者评估数字银行盈利能力提供更精确的分析工具（超越传统贷款存款比率）；展示如何利用IFRS 9已有披露数据进行信用质量校正分析；指出跨市场比较时需结合定价环境的启示。

title: Robust Scientific AI Agents Under Noisy, Data-Scarce Conditions: Adaptive Model Selection, Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning, and Noise-Robust Surrogate Learning

detail.title: Robust Scientific AI Agents Under Noisy, Data-Scarce Conditions: Adaptive Model Selection, Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning, and Noise-Robust Surrogate Learning
detail.abstract: Scientific AI systems are increasingly expected to reason over scarce observations, noisy measurements, unstable simulators, and heterogeneous model families. Existing work usually treats these difficulties separately: robust surrogate models address noisy regression, routing systems select among language models, and control-theoretic allocation methods adapt traffic under non-stationary workloads. This paper argues that noisy, data-scarce scientific workflows require an integrated agent architecture rather than a single fixed predictor. We introduce Robust Scientific AI Agents (RSA-Agents), a framework that represents scientific problem solving as a closed-loop decision process over candidate surrogate models, symbolic tools, validation signals, uncertainty estimates, and execution constraints. The agent maintains a portfolio of candidate scientific models, estimates their task-conditioned reliability from limited evidence, and allocates future calls through a validation-weighted selection rule with persistent exploration. Noise-robust models such as ER-KAN provide the agent with a safer surrogate option when clean-data accuracy is misleading, while adaptive routing and feedback-control principles prevent static model commitments under regime change. In a synthetic pilot benchmark spanning eight analytic functions, three data budgets, and three noise levels, a validation-weighted RSA-Agent reduces mean squared error by 7.7% relative to the best static surrogate overall and by 27.7% in the high-noise setting, while underperforming on clean regimes. These results support the central thesis: robust scientific AI should be evaluated as an adaptive agentic system under uncertainty, not only as a collection of isolated predictors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSA-Agents框架，将科学问题求解构建为闭环决策过程，在候选代理模型、符号工具、验证信号、不确定性估计和执行约束之间动态分配调用，通过验证加权选择规则和持久探索来应对噪声、数据稀缺和非平稳场景。在合成基准中，该智能体在高噪声设置下相比最优静态代理降低27.7%的均方误差，但在清洁数据情境下表现略逊。
AI.research_question: 如何在噪声大、数据稀缺、模拟器不稳定且模型族异构的科学工作流中，构建一个能够自适应决策的智能体系统，而非依赖单一固定预测器？
AI.motivation: 现有工作分别处理噪声回归（鲁棒代理模型）、模型选择（路由系统）和非平稳负载（控制论分配），但缺乏一个统一框架来同时应对科学工作流中的多种不确定性挑战，因此需要集成式智能体架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于闭环决策过程、验证加权选择规则、持久探索、自适应路由和反馈控制原理，整合代理模型组合（portfolio）管理与不确定性估计。
AI.method: 设计RSA-Agents框架：维护候选科学模型组合，从有限证据中估计任务条件可靠性，通过验证加权选择规则进行未来调用分配，并引入ER-KAN等噪声鲁棒模型作为安全代理选项。在包含8个解析函数、3种数据预算和3种噪声水平的合成基准上进行评估。
AI.findings: 验证加权的RSA-Agent相比最优静态代理，在总体上降低7.7%的均方误差，在高噪声设置下降低27.7%，但在清洁数据情境下表现不及静态方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将科学AI评估范式从"孤立预测器集合"转向"自适应智能体系统"，强调在不确定性下应将鲁棒性视为系统级而非模型级属性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科学AI实践者提供了一个可部署的智能体框架，能够在高噪声和数据稀缺的科学场景中自适应地分配计算资源并选择最优代理策略，同时提醒在清洁数据场景下静态方法仍具竞争力。

title: Equivalence Testing for Risk-Compute Engines Beyond Terminal Metrics: Path Functionals and Attribution Summaries
affiliations: Association for Financial Professionals (AFP)

detail.title: Equivalence Testing for Risk-Compute Engines Beyond Terminal Metrics: Path Functionals and Attribution Summaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and chief executive officer of Scientific Analytics Alliance Inc., which develops the software harness under test in this paper. To mitigate this interest, all acceptance thresholds were declared before execution and all inputs, code revisions, and outputs are sealed under SHA-256 digests published with the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is computational research involving no human participants, patients, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as internal research of Scientific Analytics Alliance Inc.

detail.abstract: Institutional risk controls consume more than terminal loss quantiles: investment mandates cap maximum drawdown, committee reporting tracks time underwater and recovery, and remediation decisions are ranked by attribution. Validation practice, however, concentrates on terminal metrics. This paper extends a pre-declared equivalence-testing protocol for risk-compute engines from terminal tail metrics to two further object classes: path functionals (maximum drawdown, time underwater, recovery completion day, jump count) and attribution summaries (portfolio loss, gross attribution, top-family share, attribution concentration). The protocol compares a deterministic low-discrepancy stream against a seeded pseudo-random Monte Carlo reference at 10,000,000 paths per method under acceptance thresholds declared before execution. As instantiated, it is a pre-declared tolerance benchmark rather than a formal inferential equivalence test; the distinction, and the migration path to confidence-bounded margins, are stated explicitly. Two design contributions arise. First, a two-standard split: deterministically replayed quantities (published stress rows) are held to numerical exactness at an absolute tolerance of 10-9 , while sampled quantities are held to sampling-scale agreement; mixing the two standards would weaken both. Second, an explicit treatment of integer-valued functionals, whose quantile agreement presents as exact zeros at scale; we argue these are quantization effects, not anomalies-and, conversely, not evidence of distribution-level identity. Across 180 pre-declared checks-96 path-functional rows, 24 terminal-metric cross-check rows, 12 exact stress-replay integrity rows, and 48 stochastic attribution-summary rows-every check passes, with minimum headroom of 1.67× over threshold. The largest gaps concentrate in the empirical-bootstrap family, where inversion of a coarse 199-observation empirical distribution function, not the sampler, drives the difference. All inputs, code revisions, and outputs are sealed under SHA-256 digests, runs are CPU-only with bounded memory, and each experiment is reproducible from two commands when executed against the sealed artifact packs.

AI.tldr: 本文将一个预先声明的等价性测试协议从终端尾部指标扩展到路径函数（最大回撤、水下时间、恢复完成日、跳跃次数）和归因摘要（组合损失、总归因、top家族份额、归因集中度），通过比较确定性低差异序列与种子伪随机蒙特卡洛参考方法，在10,000,000条路径下、预先声明的接受阈值内，全部180项检查通过，最小余量为1.67倍。
AI.research_question: 如何将一个预先声明的等价性测试协议从终端尾部指标扩展到路径函数和归因摘要这两类风险计算对象，以更全面地验证机构风险控制引擎的计算正确性？
AI.motivation: 机构风险控制消耗的不仅仅是终端损失分位数，还包括投资授权中的最大回撤上限、委员会报告中的水下时间和恢复追踪、以及按归因排序的补救决策。然而，现有的验证实践集中在终端指标上，缺乏对路径函数和归因摘要的系统性验证方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 等价性测试协议、确定性低差异序列与伪随机蒙特卡洛方法、量化效应（quantization effects）、经验分布函数反演、容忍度基准
AI.method: 采用预先声明的等价性测试协议，将确定性低差异序列与种子伪随机蒙特卡洛参考方法进行比较，每条方法1000万条路径。采用双重标准拆分：确定性重放量要求10-9的绝对数值精度，抽样量要求抽样尺度一致性。全部数据、代码修订和输出使用SHA-256摘要密封，CPU-only且内存有界，可复现。
AI.findings: 在180项预先声明的检查中（96项路径函数行、24项终端指标交叉检查行、12项精确压力重放完整性行、48项随机归因摘要行），所有检查全部通过，最小余量超过阈值的1.67倍。最大差距集中在经验自助法族中，差异来源是粗糙的199个观测值的经验分布函数反演，而非抽样器本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出双重标准拆分原则：确定性重放量与抽样量应分别采用数值精确性和抽样尺度一致性标准，混合两种标准会削弱两者。提出对整数值函数量的显式处理，论证其在规模上的分位数一致性表现为精确零值属于量化效应而非异常，同时也不构成分布级同一性的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构风险计算引擎提供了一套可复现、可密封的验证协议，涵盖路径函数和归因摘要两类此前未被系统验证的对象类。该协议采用CPU-only和有界内存部署，可通过两个命令复现实验结果，具有实际可操作性。
