detail.abstract:
Distributed ledgers commonly place irreversible history under one dominant control resource: computation, stake, configured validator authority, or an operator-controlled ordering service. Hybrid protocols may diversify resources while permitting them to compensate for one another in an aggregate score. This paper develops a different architecture: asymmetric non-substitutable finality (ANSF). One independently constituted domain pre-locks the prior-final history and a transaction-availability commitment; a second domain executes the committed input and supplies economic or institutional accountability; and a separately sampled closing function verifies correspondence between the committed input, resulting state, and prior lock. Finality exists only when all typed certificates match. Excess stake, work, signatures, or institutional authority in one domain cannot replace a missing certificate from another.

Therefore, the architecture converts safety failure from capture of one resource into a
conditional intersection of failures across required domains. Its cost is equally important:
liveness failure becomes a union, because any required domain can pause full finality.
Three refinements address the dominant practical risks in the basic formulation. First, a
graduated finality policy allows different transaction classes to require different subsets of
domains, so that the liveness tax is not uniform while the non-substitution core is
preserved for high-value irreversible settlement. Second, domain independence is treated
as a continuously evaluated residual-risk predicate rather than a binary assumption; the
probability of full safety failure is bounded by the intersection of domain failures plus the
residual common-mode term. Third, the non-bypass recovery rule and the formal kernel
are strengthened so that reconstitution remains strictly prospective and no single domain
can manufacture a missing certificate.

The paper corrects an intuitive but erroneous two-thirds attack claim, distinguishes
certificate formation from conflicting-quorum safety, models random personhood-derived
committees, and shows why common software, infrastructure, credential, and
jurisdictional dependencies can dominate apparently spectacular committee probabilities.
The paper grounds the architecture in the 2024-2026 record: it positions ANSF against the
fast-finality and asymmetric-trust research lines, adds a documented common-mode case
study, anchors the institutional application in live tokenized-settlement programmes, maps
the graduated finality classes onto legal settlement-finality frameworks, and quantifies the
post-quantum cost argument. The proposal remains a research architecture, not a
completed consensus proof. Its value lies in a precise program for formal verification,
adversarial simulation with correlated failures, and institutional experimentation in
tokenized settlement systems where no single constituency should determine irreversible
history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"非对称不可替代最终性"(ANSF)的分布式账本架构。与现有混合协议允许不同资源(算力、权益、验证者权威、操作者控制的排序服务)在聚合评分中相互补偿不同，ANSF要求多个独立构成的领域各自生成类型化证书，只有当所有必需领域的证书都匹配时才能达成最终性。该架构将安全失败从单一资源被俘获转变为多个必需领域失败的条件交集，但代价是活性失败成为并集(任何必需领域都可暂停完整最终性)。论文还提出了三项改进：渐进式最终性策略(不同交易类别要求不同领域子集)、领域独立性作为持续评估的残余风险谓词、以及非绕过恢复规则。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种分布式账本最终性架构，使得安全失败依赖于多个独立领域的条件失败交集（而非单一资源或可替代资源的聚合），同时控制不对等的活性成本？
AI.motivation: 现有分布式账本将不可逆历史置于单一主导控制资源下（计算、权益、配置的验证者权威或操作者控制的排序服务）。混合协议允许多样化资源在聚合评分中相互补偿，但这意味着一个资源上的超额权重可以替代另一个资源的缺失，本质上仍是可替代的。本文旨在构建一种非替代性的最终性架构，实质性降低安全失败风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式账本最终性理论、安全-活性权衡分析、非替代性安全模型、条件交集/并集失败概率框架、残余共同模式风险模型、委员会采样理论、后量子安全成本分析。
AI.method: 架构设计与理论分析。包括：(1) 提出ANSF基本架构（预锁定-执行-关闭验证三段式流程）；(2) 形式化安全性（交集失败）和活性（并集失败）的转换关系；(3) 提出三项实际风险改进方案（渐进式最终性、残余风险谓词、非绕过恢复）；(4) 纠正关于2/3攻击的错误直觉；(5) 基于2024-2026年的实际记录，包括共同模式案例研究、实时代币化结算项目的机构应用锚定、法律结算最终性框架映射、后量子成本量化。
AI.findings: (1) ANSF架构将安全性失败从单一资源捕获转变为跨必需领域的条件失败交集，但活性失败成为并集；(2) 渐进式最终性策略允许不同交易类别要求不同领域子集，避免统一活性税；(3) 领域独立性应作为连续评估的残余风险谓词而非二元假设，全安全失败概率由领域失败交集加上残余共同模式项界定；(4) 非绕过恢复规则确保重组严格前瞻性，任何单一领域无法制造缺失证书；(5) 纠正了直观但错误的2/3攻击主张，区分了证书形成与冲突法定人数安全；(6) 常见软件、基础设施、凭证和管辖权依赖可能主导表面上看显著的委员会概率。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了非替代性最终性的新架构理论，区别于现有可替代性资源聚合的混合协议；(2) 形式化了安全/活性失败在非对称多域架构下的交集与并集转换关系；(3) 将领域独立性从二元假设重构为连续评估的残余风险谓词；(4) 纠正了关于2/3攻击的错误理论主张，区分了证书形成与冲突法定人数安全；(5) 建模了随机人格衍生委员会；(6) 揭示了共同模式依赖对委员会概率的主导效应。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为高价值不可逆结算提供了不依赖单一资源控制权的最终性架构方案；(2) 渐进式最终性策略为不同交易类别提供了差异化安全性-活性权衡；(3) 将架构锚定在2024-2026年实时代币化结算项目上，提供机构应用落地路径；(4) 将最终性类别映射到法律结算最终性框架，支持监管对接；(5) 量化了后量子成本参数，为量子时代的安全设计提供参考；(6) 提供了共同模式案例研究和形式化验证、对抗性模拟与制度实验的精确研究计划。

detail.abstract: This essay covers a controversial provision of Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 which is section 330, where I strategically found whether or not this provision of the law which requires early disclosure of money laundering incidents to enforcement authorities, impose unfair burden on the regulated professionals i.e. bankers, solicitors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了英国《2002年犯罪收益法》第330条中一个有争议的规定，该规定要求受监管专业人士（如银行家、律师）在发现洗钱事件时须尽早向执法机构披露，文章分析该规定是否对这些专业人士施加了不公平的负担。
AI.research_question: 《2002年犯罪收益法》第330条要求受监管专业人士（如银行家、律师）尽早披露洗钱事件的规定，是否对这些专业人士施加了不公平的负担？
AI.motivation: 《2002年犯罪收益法》第330条是一项具有争议性的法律规定，它要求在受监管的行业（银行业、法律行业）从业者及时向执法机构披露可疑的洗钱活动。这一规定可能对专业人士造成额外的工作负担和责任风险，因此需要审视其公平性与合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪收益法（Proceeds of Crime Act 2002）中的反洗钱监管框架及相关法律义务理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（战略性质的法律条文分析），对第330条规定的条款进行批判性审视与评估。

title: Macroeconomic Distortions and Economic Growth: Analysis of Income and Temporal Heterogeneity
affiliations: Western Washington University - College of Business & Economics and

detail.title: Macroeconomic Distortions and Economic Growth: Analysis of Income and Temporal Heterogeneity
detail.abstract: This paper examines how macroeconomic policy distortions shape economic growth using a global panel spanning 1961-2022. Combining standard macroeconomic indicators with subcomponents of the Economic Freedom of the World (EFW) index, we estimate fixed effects and system GMM models to address unobserved heterogeneity and endogeneity. We document substantial heterogeneity in the growth effects of distortions across income groups and time. The black market premium emerges as a robust and pervasive drag on growth across all specifications. In contrast, the effects of inflation and trade distortions are conditional on both the income level and the period. Notably, in the post-1999 sample, under-trading becomes a significant and broadly shared constraint on growth across all income cohorts. These findings indicate that the growth consequences of policy distortions are neither uniform nor stable over time, underscoring the importance of context-specific and income-sensitive policy design rather than onesize-fits-all reform strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1961-2022年的全球面板数据，结合宏观经济指标与经济自由指数（EFW）的子成分，运用固定效应和系统GMM模型，考察了宏观经济政策扭曲对经济增长的影响。研究发现政策扭曲的增长效应在不同收入群体和不同时期存在显著异质性：黑市溢价在所有设定中都是稳健且普遍的增长阻力；通胀和贸易扭曲的影响则取决于收入水平和时期；1999年后，贸易不足成为所有收入群体的显著增长制约。这表明政策扭曲的增长后果既不统一也不随时间稳定，政策设计应注重情境和收入敏感性。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济政策扭曲如何影响经济增长？这种影响在不同收入群体和不同时期是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设政策扭曲对增长的影响是同质的、稳定的，而忽略了收入水平和时间维度的异质性。本文旨在填补这一空白，为"一刀切"的制度改革策略提供实证挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长理论、制度经济学（经济自由指数框架）、宏观经济政策扭曲理论
AI.method: 利用1961-2022年全球面板数据，结合标准宏观经济指标与经济自由指数（EFW）子成分，采用固定效应模型和系统GMM模型处理未观测异质性和内生性问题，并按收入群体和时期进行分组估计。
AI.findings: （1）政策扭曲的增长效应存在显著的跨收入群体和跨时期异质性；（2）黑市溢价在所有设定中都是稳健且普遍的增长阻力；（3）通胀和贸易扭曲的影响取决于收入水平和时期；（4）在1999年后的样本中，贸易不足成为所有收入群体共同面临的显著增长制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了政策扭曲对增长影响同质性和稳定性的传统假设，揭示了政策扭曲增长效应在收入和时间维度上的条件性，为情境敏感性经济理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了收入敏感性和时期敏感性的政策设计依据，表明"一刀切"的制度改革策略并不可取，需根据各国收入水平和时代背景制定差异化改革方案。

title: Diagonal Frog Meets ADI: Trading Matrix Exponentials for Rational Maps in the Fokker-Planck Equation
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - NYU Tandon School of Engineering and

detail.title: Diagonal Frog Meets ADI: Trading Matrix Exponentials for Rational Maps in the Fokker-Planck Equation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No potential conflict of interest was reported by the authors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received.

detail.abstract: A companion paper [Itkin, 2026a] introduced the Diagonal Frog (DF) positivity-preserving schemes for anisotropic Fokker-Planck equations, advancing each directional substep by a Krylov-computed matrix exponential, which dominates the cost. Replacing that exponential by a rational map r(γL) reduces the substep to a banded solve, but the positivity argument no longer applies. We prove that for eventually exponentially positive generators the entrywise sign of r(γL) at large steps is decided by a single number, the value r(∞) taken on infinitely stiff modes. Nonnegativity holds above a computable threshold when 0 ≤ r(∞) < 1, and at most on a bounded interval, empty or vanishingly narrow in all our tests, when r(∞) < 0. The criterion rejects the Crank-Nicolson (trapezoidal) method, where r(∞) =-1, and selects the subdiagonal Padé(0, 2) method, which is second order, L-stable and provably positive above an explicit threshold. The resulting DF-ADI scheme costs O(N) per step, keeps the implicit factorized mixed derivative unchanged, is second order in space and time, and conserves discrete mass exactly. In the strong cross-diffusion regime, however, the directional factors demand a step larger than the mixed derivative permits, so the composite second-order scheme is only empirically positive there, and the criterion serves to discriminate the well-behaved multiplicative factors from the stabilizing-correction schemes rather than to guarantee positivity. Against the Krylov exponential it runs ten to thirty-two times faster at matched accuracy in our tests with the gain growing with the mesh. We extend the construction to the backward Kolmogorov equation and to jump-diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于有理映射替代Krylov矩阵指数的DF-ADI（对角蛙-交替方向隐式）格式，用于各向异性Fokker-Planck方程的保正性数值求解。通过证明大步长下r(γL)的逐项符号由r(∞)决定，建立了可计算的非负性阈值判据，从而筛选出次对角Padé(0,2)方法（二阶L-稳定且显式可证保正），使得每步计算复杂度降至O(N)，相比Krylov指数方法提速10-32倍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种计算高效且保持正性的数值格式，以替代计算成本高昂的Krylov矩阵指数方法求解各向异性Fokker-Planck方程？
AI.motivation: 前期工作中提出的DF格式虽能保正，但每个方向子步都依赖Krylov计算的矩阵指数，计算成本占主导。用有理映射r(γL)替代矩阵指数可将子步简化为带状矩阵求解，但原有的正性论证不再适用，需要新的理论来保证格式的保正性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 矩阵指数的有理逼近理论、最终指数正生成元的谱理论、Padé逼近的稳定性分析、L-稳定性理论。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明对于最终指数正生成元，r(γL)在大步长下的逐项符号由r(∞)唯一决定，建立可计算的非负性阈值。数值方法：将DF格式中的Krylov矩阵指数替换为有理映射，构造DF-ADI格式，采用次对角Padé(0,2)方法，并在强交叉扩散区进行经验性验证。
AI.findings: (1) 当0≤r(∞)<1时非负性在可计算阈值以上成立；当r(∞)<0时非负性最多在（测试中为空或极窄的）有界区间成立；(2) 该判据拒绝了Crank-Nicolson方法(r(∞)=-1)，选择了次对角Padé(0,2)方法；(3) 所得DF-ADI格式每步O(N)复杂度，二阶时空精度，精确守恒离散质量；(4) 在强交叉扩散区格式仅经验保正，但判据可用于区分良态乘性因子与稳定化修正格式；(5) 在匹配精度下相比Krylov指数方法提速10-32倍，增益随网格加密增大；(6) 构造推广至倒向Kolmogorov方程和跳扩散模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了有理映射替代矩阵指数后保正性的理论判据，揭示了r(∞)符号与大步长非负性之间的本质联系，为L-稳定有理逼近方法的选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了计算高效（O(N)每步）且二阶精度的DF-ADI保正格式，数值加速10-32倍，可推广至倒向Kolmogorov方程和跳扩散模型，适用于强交叉扩散等复杂场景。

title: Deflation and Financial Stress in the Great Recession
affiliations: The University of Austin

detail.title: Deflation and Financial Stress in the Great Recession
detail.abstract: In the Great Recession of 2007-2009, the US economy experienced deflation and a concurrent financial crisis. Did tight money cause a credit crunch, or did the credit contraction cause monetary tightness? I test for Granger causality between monetary tightness implied by Treasury Inflation Protected Securities (TIPS) and financial stress indicated by the Treasury-Eurodollar (TED) spread and the St. Louis Fed's Financial Stress Index. Prior to the crisis, changes in inflation Granger cause changes in financial stress, but changes in financial stress do not Granger cause changes in inflation, providing preliminary evidence that tight money may have triggered the financial crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2007-2009年大衰退期间的美国经济数据，通过格兰杰因果检验探讨了货币紧缩（以TIPS隐含的通胀预期衡量）与金融压力（以TED利差和圣路易斯联储金融压力指数衡量）之间的因果关系，初步证据表明货币紧缩可能先于并触发了金融危机。
AI.research_question: 在大衰退期间，是货币紧缩导致了信贷紧缩（信用紧缩），还是信贷收缩导致了货币紧缩？即货币紧缩与金融压力之间的因果方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 2007-2009年大衰退期间美国同时经历了通货紧缩和金融危机，但关于危机根源存在两种相互竞争的解释：一是紧缩货币政策引发了信贷危机，二是信贷收缩反过来造成了货币紧缩。厘清因果关系对于理解危机成因和政策应对至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 格兰杰因果关系检验框架；基于TIPS的通胀预期理论与货币紧缩测度；金融压力指数理论（TED利差和圣路易斯联储金融压力指数）
AI.method: 采用格兰杰因果检验方法，以TIPS隐含的通胀变化作为货币紧缩的代理指标，以TED利差和圣路易斯联储金融压力指数作为金融压力的代理指标，检验两者之间的双向因果关系。
AI.findings: 在危机前，通胀变化是金融压力变化的格兰杰原因，而金融压力变化不是通胀变化的格兰杰原因，提供了货币紧缩可能触发金融危机的初步证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融危机起源的理论争论提供了实证证据，支持了"紧缩货币政策引发金融危机"的传导机制假说，丰富了货币政策与金融稳定性关系的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者有重要启示：货币政策的紧缩操作可能通过金融市场渠道诱发系统性金融风险，提示在制定货币政策时需要更加关注其对金融稳定的潜在溢出效应。

reference: Journal of Ethnic and Migration Studies, 0[10.1080/1369183X.2026.2639888]
title: Merit as a Racial Device: The Ambiguous Case of Citizenship and Residence by Investment

detail.title: Merit as a Racial Device: The Ambiguous Case of Citizenship and Residence by Investment

declarations.ethicsApproval: NA

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Ethnic and Migration Studies, 0[10.1080/1369183X.2026.2639888]

detail.abstract: This article interrogates the role of merit as a criterion for allocating public and social goods, with particular emphasis on immigration and citizenship regimes in the Global North. Although portrayed as a vehicle of de-ethnicisation/-racialisation, merit in practice operates through implicit and indirect mechanisms of ethnicisation and racialisation – which I term ‘neo-racialisation’. As such, merit proves both legally and normatively problematic, perpetuating historical ‘blood hierarchies’ under a modern and ostensibly neutral guise. Analysing citizenship-by-investment (CBI) and residency-by-investment (RBI) programmes in the European Union, the Article reveals a paradox at the heart of meritocracy critiques: while merit-based selection schemes are embedded in ethno-racial hierarchies, opposition to such schemes is itself frequently embedded in such logics – an aspect largely neglected in existing scholarship. This tension calls for deeper examination of the neo-racialisation entrenched in the broader global citizenship regime. Focusing on the European Union as a case study, the article advances the argument that, despite their flaws, CBI and RBI schemes might represent the ‘lesser evil’, justified on four grounds: being egalitarian, anti-racist, anti-colonial and human rights-based.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视"功绩"（merit）作为分配公共和社会资源标准的角色，聚焦北半球国家的移民与公民身份制度。文章提出"新种族化"（neo-racialisation）概念，指出功绩虽被描绘为去族裔化/去种族化的工具，实际上却通过隐性和间接机制运作，延续历史性的"血统等级制"。通过分析欧盟的投资入籍（CBI）和投资居留（RBI）项目，文章揭示功绩制批判中的悖论：反对功绩筛选的立场本身也常嵌入族裔-种族等级逻辑。最终，文章论证尽管CBI和RBI存在缺陷，但在平等主义、反种族主义、反殖民和人权四个维度上，它们可能构成"较小的恶"。
AI.research_question: 功绩作为分配公共和社会资源的标准，如何通过隐性和间接机制实现"新种族化"？投资入籍（CBI）和投资居留（RBI）项目是否构成较佳选择？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对功绩制的批判多聚焦于其嵌入族裔-种族等级体系的一面，却忽视了反对功绩制的立场本身也常嵌入相同的种族化逻辑。这一被忽视的悖论需要更深入的考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: "新种族化"（neo-racialisation）概念；功绩制批判理论；去族裔化/去种族化理论；公民身份制度理论
AI.method: 以欧盟为案例研究，对投资入籍（CBI）和投资居留（RBI）项目进行理论分析与批判性制度审视
AI.findings: 功绩在实践中通过隐性和间接机制运作，实现"新种族化"；功绩在法律和规范层面均有问题，以现代且看似中立的表象延续历史性的"血统等级制"；功绩制批判存在悖论：反对功绩制的立场本身也常嵌入种族化逻辑；CBI和RBI项目尽管有缺陷，但在平等主义、反种族主义、反殖民和人权四个维度上可被论证为"较小的恶"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"新种族化"（neo-racialisation）概念，揭示功绩制在现代外壳下延续历史血统等级制的机制；首次系统揭示功绩制批判自身存在的种族化悖论，填补现有学术空白；将分析从功绩制本身拓展到更广泛的全球公民身份制度中的新种族化问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民和公民身份政策的制定与评估提供新的规范性框架（平等主义、反种族主义、反殖民、人权四个维度）；对欧盟CBI和RBI项目的政策评估提供辩护性论证，为相关政策的存续和改进提供学理依据。

title: Mobile Internet and Mental Health
affiliations: University of Rochester and

detail.title: Mobile Internet and Mental Health
detail.abstract: Has the expansion of mobile internet improved or worsened mental health? We study the rollout of 3G mobile internet across the United States by combining coverage data from 2007 to 2020 with the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System. Exploiting geographic and temporal variation in 3G availability, we find that access to mobile internet significantly worsens mental health. A 10 percentage point increase in 3G coverage increases the number of poor mental health days by 0.02 per month (0.6 percent), with larger effects among younger adults and women. Evidence on mechanisms points to increased social media use, reduced offline social interaction, and lower physical activity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国2007-2020年3G移动互联网覆盖数据与行为风险因素监测系统数据，通过地理和时间变异识别移动互联网扩张对心理健康的因果效应。研究发现，移动互联网接入显著恶化心理健康：3G覆盖率每提高10个百分点，每月心理健康不良天数增加0.02天（0.6%），且对年轻人和女性的影响更大。机制分析表明，社交媒体使用增加、线下社交减少和身体活动降低是主要传导渠道。
AI.research_question: 移动互联网的扩张是改善还是恶化了人们的心理健康？
AI.motivation: 移动互联网的快速扩张对心理健康的影响方向尚不明确，既有文献对此缺乏因果证据。作者希望利用3G网络在美国各地区的逐步铺开这一自然实验，为移动互联网与心理健康之间的因果关系提供可靠识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文没有明确引用单一理论框架，但隐含了技术扩散对个体福利影响的因果推断框架，以及社交媒体替代效应（替代线下社交和体育活动）影响心理健康的机制逻辑。
AI.method: 利用2007-2020年美国3G移动互联网覆盖数据，结合行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS）调查数据，采用地理和时间双重变异进行因果识别（类似双重差分设计），并进行了机制分析。
AI.findings: （1）移动互联网接入显著恶化心理健康，3G覆盖率每提高10个百分点，每月心理健康不良天数增加0.02天（0.6%）；（2）对年轻成年人和女性的负面影响更大；（3）机制上，社交媒体使用增加、线下社交互动减少以及身体活动降低是主要传导渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 为移动互联网扩张与心理健康之间的因果关系提供了全国性的因果证据，补充了数字技术对个体福祉影响的研究文献，并识别了具体的机制渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解和应对移动互联网普及带来的心理健康风险提供了实证依据，提示需要在数字基础设施建设的同时关注其可能带来的心理健康成本，尤其是对年轻人和女性群体。

title: The Value of a Transcript: The Price of Exposure in Sequential Elicitation

detail.title: The Value of a Transcript: The Price of Exposure in Sequential Elicitation
detail.abstract: Institutions compute a mandated public output from inputs elicited one at a time. The rule and type distribution are fixed; query order and stopping are not, and they leave an identitylinked record a later decision may use. This paper prices that record against the output for a downstream problem fixed when the protocol is chosen: leakage is the gain in Bayes value of the observable transcript. Two protocols can implement the same rule exactly, at the same expected query cost, and still leave records worth different amounts. One component statistic is common to every exact protocol; transcript value splits into what the rule forces and what the query tree adds. Zero leakage holds exactly when one output-only action stays optimal after every transcript, so non-use is sequentially rational; recursive partitions into decisioncompatible rectangles characterize existence. For Boolean rules the least probability of querying a designated coordinate is its biased influence, binding whatever the downstream problem is. For single-coordinate targets under independent types leakage is affine and increasing in that probability, so the same bound prices it. The base-polytope description of first-success orderings is known; here it prices a protective ordering. Target-last is free exactly for the coordinate least likely to be positive, and otherwise costs a rate in queries per unit of exposure set by two success probabilities. Institutions pricing queries and exposure must exceed that rate to move the target one place later. Purpose limitation becomes a property of the protocol, not of the promise, and has a price.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机构在逐一收集输入数据并计算强制性公共输出时，查询顺序和停止规则会留下身份关联的记录，这些记录可能被后续决策使用。作者为这些记录对下游问题的价值定价，发现两个能以相同预期查询成本精确实现同一规则的不同协议，可能留下价值差异巨大的记录。零泄漏（即记录不被利用）需满足特定的条件，本文通过偏向影响力等概念为协议的保护性排序定价。
AI.research_question: 在协议设计（查询顺序与停止规则）可自由选择、但规则和类型分布固定的情况下，查询过程留下的身份关联记录对下游问题的价值（泄漏）如何定价？何种协议能实现零泄漏？保护性查询排序的成本是多少？
AI.motivation: 机构通常需要逐一询问输入并计算公共输出，但查询过程会留下可被后续使用的记录。由于协议设计者可以自由选择查询顺序和停止规则，这些"记录泄漏"成为目的限制（purpose limitation）能否实现的关键问题。本文试图系统地为这些记录定价，并刻画何种协议能实现零泄漏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯决策理论、精确协议实现理论、偏向影响力（biased influence）、基多面体（base polytope）的首次成功排序描述。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析：将协议定义为树结构（查询顺序+停止规则），计算可观测转录本的贝叶斯价值，证明转录本价值可分解为规则强制部分与查询树附加部分；利用递归划分为决策相容矩形的结构刻画零泄漏条件；应用布尔函数的偏向影响力建立查询概率下界。
AI.findings: （1）两个精确实现同一规则的协议即使有相同预期查询成本，留下的记录价值也可能不同；（2）零泄漏当且仅当某个仅利用输出的动作在每个转录本后仍保持最优，即非使用是序贯理性的；（3）布尔规则下查询某一指定坐标的最小概率等于其偏向影响力；（4）单坐标目标且类型独立时，泄漏是查询概率的仿射递增函数；（5）保护性排序（target-last）对最不可能为正的坐标免费，否则需按两个成功概率设定的费率支付查询成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将记录泄漏与协议结构的语义学联系起来，证明转录本价值可分解为规则强制部分与查询树附加部分；建立零泄漏与序贯理性之间的等价关系；将布尔函数的偏向影响力概念引入查询协议的泄漏定价，并利用基多面体刻画保护性排序的成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构在"查询成本"与"记录暴露"之间进行权衡提供了定价工具：机构若想将目标坐标后移一位，需支付超过某一费率（由两个成功概率决定）的查询成本。目的限制从"承诺"层面转化为"协议"层面的可验证属性，具有明确的价格标签。

title: Loot Box Design for Vertically Differentiated Products: The Role of Sub-Additive Valuations
affiliations: , University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) - School of Management and University of Tennessee, Knoxville - Haslam College of Business

detail.title: Loot Box Design for Vertically Differentiated Products: The Role of Sub-Additive Valuations
detail.abstract: Loot box selling allows consumers to repeatedly purchase probabilistic virtual products. We study its optimal design for vertically differentiated goods comprising high-and low-value components. We characterize the optimal allocation probability and pricing strategy that segments consumers that low-valuation consumers purchase once, whereas high-valuation consumers repurchase until obtaining the high-value component. Compared to transparent selling, loot box selling is profitable only when the components exhibit sub-additive valuations, i.e., the bundle is valued less than the sum of individual valuations. Under this condition, the optimal loot box design reduces the allocation probability of the high-value component, which mitigates the cannibalization of profits from repeat purchases by the single-purchase option. While conventional wisdom attributes the profitability of loot box selling to repeated purchases, we identify an alternative driving force: The optimal design extracts greater surplus from low-valuation consumers through a higher unit price in their single purchase. Contrary to intuition that loot box selling exploits consumers, we show that it may achieve a win-win outcome by improving firm profit and consumer surplus. We also find that this strategy is attractive for physical goods due to its environmental sustainability from reducing offerings, and a pity system can further enhance its profit advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纵向差异化商品（由高价值组件和低价值组件组成）的「战利品箱」销售（loot box selling）最优设计问题。研究发现，最优的分配概率和定价策略能够实现消费者细分：低价值消费者购买一次，高价值消费者重复购买直至获得高价值组件。战利品箱销售只有在组件估值呈次可加性（bundle价值低于各组件价值之和）时才比透明销售更有利可图。其盈利驱动力并非传统认知中的重复购买，而是通过对低价值消费者单次购买设定更高单价来提取更多剩余。研究还发现该策略可能实现企业与消费者双赢，对实体商品具有环境可持续性优势，「保底系统」（pity system）能进一步增强利润优势。
AI.research_question: 纵向差异化商品（由高、低价值组件构成）的最优战利品箱设计是什么？其最优分配概率和定价策略如何实现消费者细分？战利品箱销售在何种条件下比透明销售更有利可图，其盈利机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 战利品箱销售在数字和实体商品领域日益普遍，但现有文献对其最优设计（特别是纵向差异化产品情境下的分配概率与定价策略）缺乏系统研究。传统观点认为其利润来源于消费者重复购买，但这一判断缺乏理论检验，且对消费者福利和社会影响的讨论存在争议（普遍认为该模式剥削消费者）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直差异化产品定价理论、消费者细分与价格歧视理论、概率性销售（probabilistic selling）理论、次可加估值（sub-additive valuations）理论。
AI.method: 基于消费者效用最大化和企业利润最大化构建分析模型，刻画纵向差异化产品（高价值组件与低价值组件组成的bundle）下战利品箱的最优分配概率和定价策略，并与透明销售（transparent selling）进行利润和社会福利比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）最优策略实现消费者细分：低价值消费者单次购买，高价值消费者重复购买直至获得高价值组件；（2）战利品箱销售仅在组件估值呈次可加性时优于透明销售；（3）在此条件下，最优设计降低高价值组件分配概率，以缓解单次购买选项对重复购买利润的侵蚀；（4）盈利主要驱动力是对低价值消费者单次购买设定更高单价以提取剩余，而非传统认知中的重复购买；（5）战利品箱可能实现企业与消费者的双赢；（6）该策略对实体商品具有环境可持续性优势（减少供应量），保底系统可进一步增强利润优势。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将概率性销售理论拓展至垂直差异化产品情境，首次刻画了纵向差异化下战利品箱的最优设计与消费者细分机制；（2）识别出与传统认知不同的盈利驱动力——通过对低价值消费者提高单次购买价格提取剩余，而非依赖重复购买；（3）理论上证明战利品箱销售在次可加估值条件下可超越透明销售，并可能实现企业利润与消费者剩余双赢，修正了「战利品箱必然剥削消费者」的直觉判断。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业提供战利品箱最优设计指导，包括最优分配概率设定和定价策略的选择条件（次可加估值情境）；（2）表明战利品箱应用于实体商品可减少产品供应量，具有环境可持续性价值；（3）为平台和企业在保底系统设计上提供理论依据，说明其可增强利润优势；（4）为政策制定者和消费者权益保护者提供更全面的福利分析框架，改变对战利品箱模式的单一负面认知。

title: Concentrated Asset Management and Financial Stability: A Structured Synthesis of Four Transmission Channels

detail.title: Concentrated Asset Management and Financial Stability: A Structured Synthesis of Four Transmission Channels

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed in quantitative risk at a large financial institution. This paper draws on the author's doctoral research, was prepared independently, and does not represent the views of any employer. No proprietary or confidential material was used.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants; the study used publicly available documents only. It doesn't apply.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The three largest asset managers collectively hold significant positions across the majority of large-capitalization equities in developed markets. The consequences of this concentration have been examined extensively, but along separate lines: a corporate governance literature concerned with voting and stewardship, a market microstructure literature concerned with passive flows and price formation, a political economy literature concerned with structural power and policy influence, and a sustainable finance literature concerned with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) integration. These literatures rarely speak to one another, and each tends to conclude that its own channel is of limited systemic consequence in isolation. This paper synthesizes evidence from those four literatures and argues that isolation is the problem. Drawing on a structured synthesis of regulatory filings, firm disclosures, official-sector reports, market data, and peer-reviewed research, it identifies four channels through which concentrated asset management exerts influence on financial markets: allocation and price formation, corporate governance, regulatory engagement, and norm-setting. It then argues that these channels are mutually reinforcing rather than independent, and that the financial-stability significance of asset manager concentration lies principally in their interaction. Common governance positions amplify correlated allocation behavior; governance positions are protected by regulatory engagement; regulatory engagement is legitimized by norm-setting; and norm-setting redirects allocation. The paper sets out the implications of a channel-interaction view for supervisory practice, and identifies where the current evidence base is thinnest.

AI.tldr: 本文综合企业治理、市场微观结构、政治经济学与可持续金融四大文献，论证集中化资产管理对金融市场的影响源于四大渠道（配置与价格形成、公司治理、监管参与、规范制定）之间的相互强化作用，而非单一渠道的孤立效应，并探讨了该渠道互动视角对监管实践的启示。
AI.research_question: 集中化资产管理对金融市场系统性影响的核心机制是什么？其各影响渠道之间是否存在相互强化关系，而非相互独立？
AI.motivation: 三大资产管理公司集中持有发达市场多数大盘股，但现有研究在四条独立文献线上各自展开（公司治理、市场微观结构、政治经济学、可持续金融），每个文献都倾向于得出自己关注的渠道在孤立情况下系统性后果有限的结论。作者认为这种孤立研究本身即是问题所在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渠道互动视角（channel-interaction view）：将资产管理集中的影响分解为配置与价格形成、公司治理、监管参与、规范制定四大渠道，并论证这些渠道相互强化而非独立。具体机制包括：共同治理立场放大关联配置行为；治理立场受监管参与保护；监管参与通过规范制定获得合法性；规范制定反过来引导资源配置。
AI.method: 结构化综合（structured synthesis）：整合监管申报文件、公司披露、官方部门报告、市场数据与同行评审研究，对四大文献进行系统性分析与综合。
AI.findings: 资产管理的集中化通过四大渠道（配置与价格形成、公司治理、监管参与、规范制定）对金融市场施加影响，且这些渠道之间存在相互强化的互动关系：共同治理立场放大关联配置行为，治理立场被监管参与保护，监管参与被规范制定合法化，规范制定重新引导资源配置。资产管理集中的金融稳定重要性主要在于各渠道的相互作用，而非单一渠道的孤立效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次跨四个独立文献体系进行综合，提出"渠道互动"框架，论证各影响渠道的相互强化机制而非孤立效应，挑战了各文献各自认为其渠道在孤立情况下影响有限的结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管实践（supervisory practice）提供基于渠道互动视角的政策启示，并明确指出当前证据基础最薄弱的领域，为未来研究方向提供指引。

title: Adapting to High Heat, Failing at the Extreme: Newborn Heat Mortality over Four Decades in Bangladesh
affiliations: Yale University and MIT

detail.title: Adapting to High Heat, Failing at the Extreme: Newborn Heat Mortality over Four Decades in Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare that we have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Damage functions in climate economics typically assume that rising income and cooling technology steadily reduce the mortality cost of extreme heat. We test this in Bangladesh using 239,563 births from eight BDHS rounds (1994–2022) merged with ERA5 daily-maximum temperature, in a cohort decomposition of neonatal heat mortality. At 30–40°C, only the 1980s cohort carries a significant positive response ( bβ1980 = +0.0036); it is statistically larger than every later cohort’s, each at the 1 % level, and falls to essentially zero from the 1990s onward — the signature of adaptation. A Sun and Abraham (2021) interaction-weighted estimator ties this flattening to the staggered Rural Electrification Board (REB) rollout; applied to realized 1990–2010 exposure, the program-induced slope change implies roughly 328,000 neonatal deaths averted. At the extreme tail (≥ 40°C) adaptation is absent: the 2010-cohort effect is large and precise ( bβ2010 = +0.041, p = 0.003) and driven by heat waves, and the cohort profile shows no decline over time. While we cannot provide direct evidence on why adaptation stops above 40°C, and we leave it as an open question, the patterns in cooling technology penetration are suggestive: electric fans in 96 % of households and air conditioning—a cooling technology crucial for extreme temperature—is adopted by just 1.4 % households. Realized exposure implies about 5,220 neonatal deaths over the 2010s; combined with a 13-GCM CMIP6 ensemble (Mishra et al., 2020), the extreme tail effect implies 815 to 2,540 deaths per year by 2060 across emissions and air-conditioning scenarios, with air-conditioning penetration moving the projection about twice as much as the emissions pathway.

AI.tldr: 本文利用孟加拉国239,563个出生记录（1994-2022年）与ERA5逐日最高温度数据，检验气候变化经济学中"升温伴随适应"的核心假设。研究发现：在30-40°C区间，只有1980年代出生队列对新生儿热死亡率有显著正效应，之后急剧下降至零，呈现适应特征，且这一平坦化与农村电气化委员会（REB）的推广相关，估计避免了约32.8万新生儿死亡。但在极端温度（≥40°C）下适应完全缺失：2010年代队列效应显著且由热浪驱动，空调普及率仅1.4%是可能原因，预示着2060年每年815-2540例死亡。
AI.research_question: 气候变化经济学中"收入上升和降温技术持续降低极端高温死亡率成本"这一假设是否成立？特别是在极端高温下适应效应是否存在？
AI.motivation: 现有气候经济学损失函数普遍假设适应是持续且线性的，但这一假设缺乏对极端温度下适应边界的实证检验。孟加拉国作为最容易受热应激影响的国家之一，提供了检验适应异质性的理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应理论（adaptation theory）；气候经济学损失函数框架（damage function）；队列分解法（cohort decomposition）
AI.method: 利用八轮BDHS调查（1994-2022年）中239,563个出生记录，与ERA5逐日最高温度数据合并，采用出生队列分解方法估计新生儿热死亡率的队列异质性效应；使用Sun and Abraham (2021)交互加权估计器识别农村电气化（REB）推广的因果效应；结合CMIP6的13个GCM模型进行未来极端温度暴露与死亡预测。
AI.findings: （1）30-40°C区间仅1980年代队列有显著正效应（+0.0036），此后降至近零，呈适应特征；（2）适应效应与REB电气化推广同步；（3）REB项目在1990-2010年实际暴露下避免约32.8万新生儿死亡；（4）极端温度（≥40°C）下适应完全缺失，2010年代队列效应+0.041（p=0.003）且由热浪驱动；（5）空调普及仅1.4%，成为适应瓶颈；（6）2010年代实际暴露导致约5,220例新生儿死亡，到2060年预测每年815-2,540例，空调普及的影响是排放路径的约两倍。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次实证检验了气候经济学损失函数中"持续适应"假设的边界，证明适应在极端温度下失效；（2）揭示了适应的非线性与阈值特征，对气候-健康损失函数建模具有修正意义；（3）提供了适应机制（电气化/降温技术）与气候损失因果联系的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为孟加拉国及类似低收入国家制定极端高温应对政策提供依据，强调空调等主动降温技术对适应至关重要；（2）量化了电气化推广的健康收益（避免约32.8万新生儿死亡），支持农村电力基础设施投资；（3）揭示适应缺口，呼吁气候适应政策需覆盖极端温度区间而不仅是平均升温场景。

title: The Gravity of the Market and the Degeneracy of Finance: m = 2σ²

detail.title: The Gravity of the Market and the Degeneracy of Finance: m = 2σ²

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has business interests in wealth-management lending and financial-planning technology.

detail.abstract: Great papers answer one question. This one takes on a large one: what can you rationally expect through time? The answer requires little more than high-school algebra and geometry—the geometry of wealth through time. • Part 1: 10 pages are about you. You choose the portfolio, assumptions, and boundaries. Time adds its own. The paper shows what can be recovered, what cannot, and how process changes outcomes. You may accept the stochastic fan or use a dynamic process to narrow the path toward an outcome. The choice is yours. The geometry is not. • Part 2: 10 pages ask the same question of the market. Investors may disagree about assets, safety, valuation, and return. That disagreement makes a market. Yet approached from risk and return, both roads lead to the same wall: m = 2σ². • Part 3: 10 pages of evidence. Placement in literature, formal math, 121 million simulations. The result is Outcome Portfolio Theory: portfolio, admissibility, and process separated. Armed with your view, the market’s disagreement, and the boundaries imposed by time, you can make better decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结果组合理论"（Outcome Portfolio Theory），将投资组合、可采性与过程分离，通过几何和代数框架回答"随时间推移理性预期什么"这一核心问题。论文分为三部分：个人视角的资产配置、市场视角的投资者分歧，以及包含1.21亿次模拟的实证证据。
AI.research_question: 随时间推移，理性投资者可以预期什么？如何将投资组合选择、可采性与时间过程分离以做出更好的决策？
AI.motivation: 投资者在时间维度上对投资结果存在根本性的不确定性，需要将组合构建、可采性约束与随机过程分开考虑，以更清晰地理解理性预期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结果组合理论（Outcome Portfolio Theory），基于财富的时间几何，利用高中代数和几何学推导；关键结论为 m = 2σ²（均值与方差的限制关系）。
AI.method: 理论推导（代数与几何）、文献定位、形式化数学分析，以及1.21亿次蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.findings: 收益与风险（回报与方差）两个路径都通向同一限制条件 m = 2σ²；投资者可以接受随机扇形（stochastic fan）或使用动态过程来收窄结果路径；组合、可采性与过程三者需要分离考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出结果组合理论（Outcome Portfolio Theory），将投资组合、可采性与过程进行三重分离，为时间维度下的投资理性预期提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者结合自身观点、市场分歧和时间约束做出更优决策，理解哪些信息可以恢复、哪些不能，以及过程如何改变结果。

title: New Stadiums, More Fans? Match-Level Evidence from Brazilian Professional Football
affiliations: Fundação Getulio Vargas,  and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics

detail.title: New Stadiums, More Fans? Match-Level Evidence from Brazilian Professional Football
detail.abstract: Twelve World Cup venues and four other modern arenas entered service in the Brazilian Série A between 2012 and 2015. Using 1,476 match-level observations with home-club and year fixed effects, we find that matches played in these venues draw 55% more paying spectators than matches played by the same club at older venues. Audited gate revenue is observed for every match, which allows the premium to be split into its two components: paid attendance rises 49% and the realized ticket price rises 47%, so gross revenue rises 119%. The price margin is nearly as large as the volume margin and has not previously been measured, since no study in the novelty-effect literature observes match revenue. A Callaway-Sant'Anna estimator built on a 2008-2011 pre-period returns a premium of 37% at opening, and the pre-treatment coefficients are jointly indistinguishable from zero. Fan membership programs expanded alongside several openings and cannot be separated from the infrastructure effect, so these figures are an upper bound on the return to the building itself. Five seasons of incremental gate revenue recover roughly 9% of the construction cost per venue.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2012-2015年间巴西足球甲级联赛12座世界杯场馆和4座现代化场馆投入使用的自然实验，基于1,476场匹配层面的观测数据（包含主场俱乐部和年份固定效应），发现新场馆比赛比同俱乐部在旧场馆的比赛多吸引55%的付费观众。通过审计的门票收入数据，将溢价分解为两个部分：付费上座率上升49%，实现票价上升47%，总门票收入上升119%。价格溢价与数量溢价几乎相当，这是新颖性效应文献中首次测量到价格维度。Callaway-Sant'Anna估计器（基于2008-2011年前期）显示开幕式时溢价为37%，且预处理系数联合与零无法区分。球迷会员计划与部分场馆开放同时扩张，无法与基础设施效应分离，因此这些数字是建筑本身回报的上限。五个赛季的增量门票收入可回收每座场馆建设成本的约9%。
AI.research_question: 新建体育场馆（世界杯场馆及其他现代化场馆）对门票收入（包括付费上座率和实际票价两个维度）有何短期新颖性效应？
AI.motivation: 现有新颖性效应文献仅关注上座率变化，缺乏对收入（特别是票价维度）的直接观察。本文利用巴西联赛独特的数据条件——每场比赛都有审计的门票收入数据——首次将新颖性溢价分解为数量（上座率）和价格（实际票价）两个组成部分，弥补了文献空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新颖性效应（novelty effect）理论；体育场馆基础设施对需求的影响的经济学框架。
AI.method: 使用2012-2015年间巴西甲级联赛1,476场逐场比赛观测数据，采用包含主场俱乐部和年份固定效应的面板回归模型；使用Callaway-Sant'Anna双重差分估计器构建2008-2011年前期，检验预处理趋势并估计动态处理效应。
AI.findings: (1) 新场馆比赛比旧场馆多吸引55%的付费观众；(2) 门票溢价可分解为：付费上座率上升49%，实际票价上升47%，总门票收入上升119%；(3) 价格溢价与数量溢价几乎相同大小，为文献首次测量；(4) Callaway-Sant'Anna估计显示开幕式时溢价为37%，预处理系数联合与零不可区分（支持平行趋势假设）；(5) 五个赛季的增量门票收入仅能回收约9%的建设成本，表明场馆投资的直接门票回报有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在新颖性效应文献中利用逐场审计收入数据，将场馆新颖性溢价分解为上座率（数量）和票价（价格）两个维度，揭示了价格维度与数量维度几乎同样重要，拓展了对场馆投资的收益机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为场馆投资决策提供直接的财务回报评估——即使世界杯级场馆，门票收入增量也仅能覆盖约9%的建设成本，提示政策制定者需要依靠其他收益渠道（如赛事举办、商业开发、城市更新等）来论证大型体育场馆投资的合理性。

title: When is Volatility Roughness Identifiable? A Simulation-Grounded Audit of Hurst Estimation From Realised Variance, With Application to Cryptocurrency

detail.title: When is Volatility Roughness Identifiable? A Simulation-Grounded Audit of Hurst Estimation From Realised Variance, With Application to Cryptocurrency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The rough-volatility paradigm holds that log-volatility behaves as a fractional process with Hurst exponent H ≈ 0.1, an estimate obtained from realised-volatility (RV) proxies of latent volatility. A parallel literature argues that this roughness is partly or wholly an artefact of estimating H through a noisy, discretely sampled proxy. We do not adjudicate fact versus artefact. We ask a prior question: for what region of model and sampling parameters is H identifiable from RV at all? Using a verified rough-Bergomi simulator as ground truth — and, crucially, a smooth (semimartingale) null — we audit the operating characteristics of three roughness estimators (a structure-function regression, a model-free p-variation index, and multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis) and formalise their behaviour into an identifiability map over the vol-of-vol η and the proxy sampling window Δ. We then pin η to data rather than assuming it, by matching the model's daily-log-RV variability to each asset's. Applied to BTC and ETH (Binance, 2019–2025; n = 2,557 daily observations) and to the S&P 500 (n = 1,759), the calibration forces η to roughly 1.5 or above, and at that calibrated η none of the three estimators returns an identified reading from daily RV: the inversion is non-identified, undefined, or beyond the model's range. The identifiable region is non-empty — multifractal DFA recovers roughness across roughly 30% of the grid, concentrated at fine sampling — but the real assets do not fall in it. For these estimators at daily sampling, the "rough" and "artefact" readings are two answers to a single ill-posed inverse problem. Code, data tooling, and figures are open and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文使用rough-Bergomi模拟器作为基准，审计了三种粗糙度估计量（结构函数回归、p-变差指数、多重分形去趋势波动分析）的可识别性，并绘制了关于波动率波动η和代理采样窗口Δ的可识别性图谱。将η校准到真实数据后（BTC、ETH、S&P 500），发现日度RV下三种估计量均无法给出可识别的粗糙度读数——"粗糙"和"伪影"两种解读实际上是同一个病态反演问题的两个答案。
AI.research_question: 在什么模型和采样参数区域下，赫斯特指数H可以从已实现波动率（RV）中被可识别地估计出来？真实资产是否落在这个可识别区域内？
AI.motivation: 粗糙波动率文献声称H≈0.1，但另一派认为这是RV代理噪声导致的伪影。两派争论"事实vs伪影"，但在此之前需要回答一个更基本的问题：H本身在给定参数下是否可识别？如果反演问题本身是病态的，那么两种解读都无意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粗糙波动率范式（fractional process, Hurst index）、rough-Bergomi模型、半鞅（平滑）基准模型、估计量操作特性（operating characteristics）
AI.method: 使用verified rough-Bergomi模拟器作为ground truth，并以平滑半鞅作为零假设，审计三种粗糙度估计量（结构函数回归、p-变差指数、多重分形去趋势波动分析）的操作特性；绘制关于vol-of-vol η和采样窗口Δ的可识别性图谱；通过匹配每日对数RV变异性将η校准到真实数据。
AI.findings: 校准后η被推向约1.5或更高；在该η水平下，三种估计量均无法从日度RV获得可识别的粗糙度读数（非识别、未定义或超出模型范围）。可识别区域非空（多重分形DFA在细采样网格约30%的区域可恢复粗糙度），但BTC、ETH和S&P 500的真实数据不落在该区域内。
AI.theory_contributions: 将粗糙波动率之争从"事实vs伪影"上升到"可识别性"层面，形式化了H从RV中可识别的参数边界，表明"粗糙"与"伪影"两种解读是同一病态反演问题的两个侧面，而非两个互斥的事实。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务界提供了一套可复现的开源代码和工具；明确了在日度采样频率下，使用RV代理估计粗糙度参数存在根本性的识别限制，研究者应警惕基于日度RV的粗糙度结论；提供了可识别性图谱作为实践参考。

title: Beyond Output: First Amendment Implications of Regulating Frontier AI
affiliations: Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: Beyond Output: First Amendment Implications of Regulating Frontier AI

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Greenwall Foundation's Faculty Scholars Program.

detail.abstract:
Governing AI foundation models will likely require regulating the full scope of AI production and distribution, from the creation of specialized chips to the actions of AI agents. These regulations may implicate the Free Speech Clause of the First Amendment. But they do so in different ways. Scholars have largely focused on the question of how the First Amendment affects regulation of AI output. Doing so misses a vast swath of relevant AI regulation and collapses the distinctions that matter most for assessing a law’s constitutionality. No single test can tell us whether a law regulating AI foundation models comports with the First Amendment.

 

Rather than start by analyzing AI output as a constitutional abstraction, we are better served by assessing regulation retail, as it applies to the particulars of AI creation, distribution, and action. Disentangling what part of the AI process a regulation targets, and how it does so, dissolves much of what seems mysterious about applying the First Amendment to this new technology. The retail approach reveals that the constitutionality of most AI regulation can be sensibly assessed by looking to the principles behind the caselaw, especially an anti-censorship principle, a public-information principle, and rules for purportedly low-value speech. These principles leave a broad field of AI regulation open to government action. They also fail to solve a core of constitutional puzzles, such as those involving AI training, model mens rea, and model-to-model communication. For these, I propose functionalist answers designed to advance the First Amendment’s goals of guarding against censorship and protecting the flow of publicly important information to human listeners.

AI.tldr: 本文主张对AI基础模型的宪法性监管不应仅从AI"输出"视角进行抽象分析，而应采用"零售式"（retail）方法，逐一审视监管所针对的AI生产、分配和行动的具体环节，并借助既有判例法原则（反审查原则、公共信息原则、低价值言论规则）来评估其合宪性，同时为训练、模型主观意图、模型间通信等核心难题提出功能主义解决方案。
AI.research_question: 针对AI基础模型的监管如何与第一修正案言论自由条款相适应？如何更准确地评估不同类型AI监管的合宪性？
AI.motivation: 现有学术研究过度聚焦于第一修正案如何影响对AI输出的监管，忽视了AI监管的广泛范围（从芯片制造到智能体行为），且未能区分对合宪性评估至关重要的不同监管类型。没有任何单一测试能够判断所有AI监管是否合宪。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一修正案言论自由条款；反审查原则（anti-censorship principle）；公共信息原则（public-information principle）；低价值言论规则；功能主义分析框架（functionalist approach）
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（normative legal analysis），采用"零售式"（retail）方法逐项考察AI监管的各个具体环节，结合既有判例法原则进行分类分析，并对典型难题提出功能主义解决方案。
AI.findings: 第一，大多数AI监管的合宪性可通过既有判例法原则（反审查原则、公共信息原则、低价值言论规则）进行合理评估，且这些原则为政府行动留下了广泛的监管空间；第二，这些原则无法解决部分核心宪法难题，包括AI训练、模型主观意图（model mens rea）以及模型间通信（model-to-model communication）；第三，作者针对这些难题提出了旨在推进第一修正案目标（防止审查、保护向人类听众传递重要公共信息）的功能主义答案。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以往将AI输出作为宪法抽象起点进行分析的范式，提出"零售式"（retail）评估方法，将AI监管按生产、分配、行动环节拆解分析；引入反审查原则、公共信息原则和低价值言论规则作为评估框架；对AI训练、模型mens rea和模型间通信提出功能主义理论回答。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和监管者提供了评估AI基础模型监管合宪性的实用分析框架；澄清了哪些类型的AI监管更容易通过宪法审查、哪些领域存在核心宪法难题；为完善AI治理法律设计提供指导，帮助监管者避免违宪风险。

title: The Agricultural Footprint of the US-China Trade War: Evidence from Brazilian Microregions
affiliations: , Fundação Getulio Vargas, Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Agricultural Footprint of the US-China Trade War: Evidence from Brazilian Microregions
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of the 2018-2021 US-China trade war on land-use change in Brazil. China's retaliatory tariffs on US soybeans redirected import demand toward Brazilian exporters, differentially exposing regions with greater historical soy intensity. Using satellite land-cover data from MapBiomas across 557 microregions (2012-2023), we find that more-exposed regions experienced significant soy area expansion after 2018, with corresponding pasture declines. An IV strategy using 2006 soy area as instrument yields a strong first stage; IV estimates exceed OLS, consistent with attenuation bias. The margin of adjustment depends on the agricultural frontier stage: in established soy municipalities, conversion of pasture to cropland accounts for the entire adjustment, with no forest clearing; in frontier municipalities with no prior soy production, the trade shock induced new entry accompanied by forest loss, amplified by weak property rights in areas with high shares of undesignated public forest.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018-2021年中美贸易战作为准自然实验，估计其对巴西土地利用变化的因果效应。研究发现，中国对美国大豆的报复性关税将进口需求转向巴西出口商，历史上大豆密集度更高的地区在2018年后经历了显著的大豆面积扩张和牧场面积减少。调整方式取决于农业边疆阶段：在成熟大豆产区，牧场转为农田而森林未被砍伐；在边疆地区，贸易冲击引发新进入者并伴随森林损失，且在不明确公有森林比例高的地区，产权保护薄弱放大了森林砍伐效应。
AI.research_question: 2018-2021年中美贸易战对巴西土地利用变化（特别是大豆扩张和森林砍伐）的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解全球贸易冲击如何通过农业供应链传导至土地覆盖变化，特别是在热带雨林地区。中美贸易战提供了一个独特的准自然实验，可以检验贸易政策冲击对第三国土地利用和环境的影响，这对评估贸易自由化的间接环境影响和森林保护政策具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易冲击传导理论、农业边疆扩张理论、产权制度与土地分配理论
AI.method: 使用差分法（DID）框架结合工具变量（IV）策略。基于2012-2023年MapBiomas卫星土地覆盖数据，覆盖557个微观区域。用2006年大豆面积作为工具变量，识别中美贸易战冲击对不同大豆密集度地区土地利用的差异化影响。
AI.findings: 1）贸易战暴露程度更高的地区在2018年后经历了显著的大豆面积扩张和相应牧场面积减少；2）IV估计值超过OLS，表明存在衰减偏误；3）调整边际取决于农业边疆阶段：成熟大豆产区通过牧场转农田完成全部调整且无森林砍伐，而边疆地区出现新进入并伴随森林损失；4）不明确公有森林占比高的地区产权保护薄弱，放大了森林砍伐效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文贡献于国际贸易与土地利用变化交叉领域，首次将中美贸易战这一重大贸易冲击与巴西土地利用的直接因果效应联系起来，揭示了贸易冲击对土地利用调整边际的异质性影响，并阐明了产权制度在贸易冲击传导中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了贸易政策气候外部性的实证证据，表明贸易冲击可能通过需求转移导致第三国森林砍伐，这对贸易协定中的环境条款设计和森林保护政策（如巴西的森林法执行）具有直接启示意义。同时也表明产权明确化（减少不明确公有森林）能够有效缓解贸易冲击引发的森林砍伐。

title: U.S. Monetary Policy, Macroeconomic News, and the Global Secular Decline of Interest Rates *
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen - School of Management and Economics and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics

detail.title: U.S. Monetary Policy, Macroeconomic News, and the Global Secular Decline of Interest Rates *
detail.abstract: The global secular decline in long-term interest rates since the 1990s has been largely driven by cumulative yield changes during U.S. monetary policy announcement windows (FOMC windows). We document this FOMC-window effect for a group of ten major advanced economies. Based on a term structure model, we show that the effect operates through the expected path of future short-term interest rates rather than term premia. We further find that the global secular decline in interest rates has been concentrated in FOMC windows preceded by macroeconomic news. We interpret this pattern as a "Fed response to news" channel and provide empirical evidence to support this interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现自1990年代以来全球长期利率的长期下降主要由美联储货币政策公告窗口（FOMC窗口）内的累积收益率变动所驱动，这种效应存在于十个主要发达经济体。基于期限结构模型，作者证明该效应通过未来短期利率的预期路径发挥作用而非期限溢价，且全球利率下降集中在有宏观经济新闻发布的FOMC窗口之前，作者将此解释为"美联储对新闻的反应"渠道。
AI.research_question: 全球长期利率自1990年代以来的长期下降是否以及如何通过美联储货币政策公告窗口驱动？
AI.motivation: 全球长期利率持续下降是一个重要宏观经济现象，但对其驱动机制的理解尚不充分。识别FOMC窗口效应及其传导渠道有助于理解美国货币政策对全球利率格局的深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期限结构模型（term structure model），用于区分预期短期利率路径与期限溢价对长期利率变动的贡献。
AI.method: 对十个主要发达经济体的长期利率在FOMC公告窗口内的累积变动进行分析，结合期限结构模型进行分解，并通过宏观经济新闻发布窗口的分组对比检验"美联储对新闻的反应"渠道。
AI.findings: 1）FOMC窗口效应存在于十个主要发达经济体；2）该效应通过未来短期利率的预期路径而非期限溢价发挥作用；3）全球长期利率的下降集中在有宏观经济新闻的FOMC窗口之前，支持"Fed response to news"渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将全球长期利率长期下降与FOMC窗口效应联系起来，并识别出其传导渠道为预期短期利率路径而非期限溢价；提出了"美联储对新闻的反应"这一新的解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国货币政策对全球利率的溢出效应提供了实证依据，对投资者、政策制定者关注全球利率走势和央行政策传导具有参考价值。

title: Implementation-Management Gaps in State Home Energy Rebate Programs: A Comparative Review of Four Department of Energy Inspector General Inspections

detail.title: Implementation-Management Gaps in State Home Energy Rebate Programs: A Comparative Review of Four Department of Energy Inspector General Inspections

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this technical note.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This technical note is based solely on analysis of publicly available government inspection reports and does not involve human participants, patient data, interviews, surveys, or other human-subject research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This technical note compares four 2026 U.S. Department of Energy Office of Inspector General inspections of state entities administering Home Energy Rebate programs in Georgia, Indiana, New Mexico, and California. The reports identify recurring implementation-management issues involving implementer monitoring, risk assessment, documentation of control activities, and alignment between approved program arrangements and actual delivery. The comparison distinguishes between controls that were absent and controls that may have existed in practice but were not documented in a form sufficient to establish consistent operation. It argues that the central practitioner question raised by the inspections is not simply whether implementation activity occurred, but what evidence establishes that a control operates. The note concludes with implications for implementation readiness, monitoring, sequencing, institutional continuity, and management response in publicly funded energy programs.

AI.tldr: 本文技术说明比较了美国能源部监察长办公室2026年对乔治亚州、印第安纳州、新墨西哥州和加利福尼亚州四个州家庭能源回扣计划管理实体的四次检查报告，识别出实施管理中的常见问题，并区分了"控制缺失"与"控制存在但缺乏充分文档证明"两种情况，提出核心实践问题不仅在于实施活动是否发生，更在于何种证据能证明控制措施有效运作。
AI.research_question: 四个州的家庭能源回扣计划实施管理中存在的共性问题是什么？核心实践问题究竟是实施活动是否发生，还是有什么证据能证明控制措施在持续运作？
AI.motivation: 通过对四个州的监察检查报告进行系统性比较，揭示公共资助能源计划实施中反复出现的治理与管理缺陷，为从业者提供可操作的改进方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部控制与合规管理理论；实施管理框架；证据与文档化在控制有效性验证中的作用。
AI.method: 对四份美国能源部监察长办公室检查报告进行跨案例比较分析，识别共性实施管理问题，并区分控制缺失与控制存在但文档不足两种情况。
AI.findings: 四个州存在四类反复出现的实施管理问题：实施者监控不足、风险评估欠缺、控制活动文档化不充分、批准的方案安排与实际交付不一致。核心问题是证据层面——何种证据能证明控制措施持续运作，而非仅仅关注实施活动是否发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"控制存在但未文档化"与"控制完全缺失"之间的概念区分，丰富了内部控制在公共项目实施中的理论理解，强调证据充分性作为控制有效性的判定标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共资助能源项目的实施准备、监控机制、操作顺序安排、机构连续性和管理层响应提供了具体的实践启示，帮助从业者建立可验证的控制证据体系。

title: Weak Convergence is Faster Than Strong: The Weak Order of a Direct Rough Heston Discretisation, Measured Against Gaussian-Volatility Theory

detail.title: Weak Convergence is Faster Than Strong: The Weak Order of a Direct Rough Heston Discretisation, Measured Against Gaussian-Volatility Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The hybrid scheme of Bennedsen, Lunde and Pakkanen is the standard simulator for rough stochastic volatility, and its strong (pathwise) convergence order is known to be H, the Hurst exponent — so at the empirically relevant H ≈ 0.1, pathwise accuracy nearly stalls. Whether prices stall too is a question about the weak order α, and there the theory is model-specific: for Gaussian-volatility models (rough Bergomi and its relatives), recent work establishes weak rates of min{3H+1/2, 1} for left-point discretisation — proven optimal, with a phase transition at H = 1/6 — and H+1/2 for the weighted hybrid scheme. No such result covers rough Heston, whose square-root Volterra dynamics fall outside these theorems; known rough-Heston weak-rate evidence concerns Markovian-approximation schemes, not the direct discretisation. We measure the weak order of the direct hybrid-type discretisation of rough Heston against a simulation-free characteristic-function reference, committing before measurement to the prediction that α exceeds H. Estimation is made feasible by Romano–Touzi conditioning, which is bias-preserving by construction and turns the payoff into a smooth functional of the discretised variance integrals — the object class the theory rates. We find α far above H throughout: α ≈ 1 at H = 0.20, and a genuine penalty only at the rough extreme, α ≈ 0.74 at H = 0.05 (below 1 at eight standard errors) — reproducing, in a model the theorems do not cover, the qualitative phase structure they prove, with the sub-transition exponent somewhat above the Gaussian-theory line. The intermediate H = 0.10 (theory target 0.80) is not resolvable at the explicit scheme's O(n²) cost; a multifactor Markovian lift, built as the natural remedy, cannot settle it — its noise approximation perturbs the measured rate itself, a negative result we characterise precisely.

AI.tldr: 本文对粗糙Heston模型的直接混合型离散化方案的弱收敛阶进行了数值测量。作者使用Romano–Touzi条件化方法（该方法保持偏差且将支付转化为离散化方差积分的平滑泛函），以无模拟的特征函数参考为基准进行估计。研究发现弱阶α远高于Hurst指数H：在H=0.20时α≈1，在H=0.05时α≈0.74（低于1达8个标准误差），再现了高斯理论中的相位结构定性特征。但中间值H=0.10（理论目标0.80）无法在显式方案的O(n²)成本下解决，多因子马尔可夫提升也无法解决——其噪声近似本身扰动了被测量的速率。
AI.research_question: 粗糙Heston模型的直接混合型离散化方案的弱收敛阶α是多少？是否高于Hurst指数H？
AI.motivation: Bennedsen-Lunde-Pakkanen混合方案是粗糙随机波动率的标准模拟器，其强收敛阶仅为H（Hurst指数），在H≈0.1时路径精度几乎停滞。但价格是否停滞取决于弱阶α。现有弱阶理论只覆盖高斯波动率模型（如粗糙Bergomi），不覆盖粗糙Heston的平方根Volterra动力学，因此需要实证测量直接离散化的弱阶。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱收敛阶理论：高斯波动率模型的左点离散化弱阶为min{3H+1/2, 1}（在H=1/6处存在相变），加权混合方案的弱阶为H+1/2；粗糙Heston模型的平方根Volterra动力学；Romano–Touzi条件化方法。
AI.method: 数值实验方法：以无模拟的特征函数参考为基准，使用Romano–Touzi条件化（偏差保持且将支付转化为离散化方差积分的平滑泛函）来测量直接混合型离散化粗糙Heston的弱阶α。在多因子马尔可夫提升方案中也进行了测试。
AI.findings: 弱阶α在整个参数范围内远高于H：H=0.20时α≈1；仅在极端粗糙情形H=0.05时出现真正惩罚，α≈0.74（低于1达8个标准误差）。这在高斯定理未覆盖的模型中再现了定理证明的定性相结构，亚相变指数略高于高斯理论线。中间值H=0.10（理论目标0.80）无法在显式方案的O(n²)成本下解决；多因子马尔可夫提升也无法解决，其噪声近似扰动了被测速率本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对粗糙Heston直接离散化方案的弱收敛阶进行精确测量；在非高斯模型（高斯定理不覆盖的平方根Volterra动力学）中实证验证了高斯理论的定性相结构；精确刻画了多因子马尔可夫提升方案作为补救措施的负面结果（噪声近似扰动速率测量本身）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为粗糙Heston模型的数值模拟提供了弱收敛阶的实证基准，指导实践者在不同Hurst指数下选择合适的离散化方案和步长；揭示了显式方案在中间H值（如H=0.10）面临的计算成本瓶颈（O(n²)）及多因子马尔可夫提升的局限性。

title: Water Scarcity Management and Housing Markets: Evidence from Water Impact Fees in Colorado

detail.title: Water Scarcity Management and Housing Markets: Evidence from Water Impact Fees in Colorado

declarations.funderStatement: I thank the Zell/Lurie Real Estate Center at The Wharton School and the Babbitt Center for Land and Water Policy at the Lincoln Land Institute for financial support. All views expressed here are of the author alone do not reflect the views of any institutional affiliations.

detail.abstract: This paper studies local water scarcity management policies designed to align privately- and socially-optimal construction of new housing. Using the staggered adoption of water impact fee policies that scale homebuilder fees by expected water use, I find that these variable fees reduce new single-family lot sizes and irrigated areas, decreasing household water use and altering the market's hedonic equilibrium pricing. I then incorporate these builder incentives into an equilibrium model of the housing market. Variable impact fees increase welfare but capture a small share of the welfare gains and water savings compared to first-best corrective water rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究地方水资源短缺管理政策如何协调私人最优与社会最优的住房建设决策。利用水影响费政策在不同地区的交错实施（该政策按预期用水量对建筑商收费），发现可变费用减少了新建独户住宅的地块面积和灌溉面积，从而降低家庭用水量并改变市场特征价格均衡。作者进一步将建筑商激励纳入住房市场均衡模型，发现可变影响费能提升福利，但相比最优矫正水价，其捕获的福利收益和水资源节约份额较小。
AI.research_question: 基于预期用水的可变水影响费政策如何影响住房建设决策（地块面积、灌溉面积）、家庭用水量以及住房市场的福利效应？
AI.motivation: 水资源短缺日益严峻，而传统的住房建设监管往往忽视新住房的用水外部性。作者试图检验一种针对建筑商的可变费用工具能否有效内部化用水外部性，并评估其相对于最优矫正水价的效率差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境外部性矫正理论、住房市场均衡模型、特征价格理论（hedonic pricing）
AI.method: 利用水影响费政策交错采用（staggered adoption）作为准自然实验，结合双重差分等方法进行实证估计；随后构建住房市场均衡模型，将建筑商激励纳入模型进行福利分析。
AI.findings: 可变水影响费显著减少了新建单户住宅的地块面积和灌溉面积，降低了家庭用水量，并改变了住房市场的特征价格均衡。均衡模型表明可变影响费能提高社会福利，但与第一最优矫正水价相比，其捕获的福利增益和水资源节约份额较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将水影响费视为一种间接矫正工具引入住房市场均衡分析，量化了其在用水外部性内部化方面的效率上限，揭示了次优政策工具与最优价格工具之间的福利差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府设计水资源管理政策提供实证依据，表明可变水影响费是缓解水资源短缺的有效工具，但政策制定者应认识到其相对局限性，需考虑与更直接的矫正价格（如水费）配合使用。

title: Competition Enforcement Timelines in Denmark (2026)
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Competition Enforcement Timelines in Denmark (2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to declare

detail.abstract: Only limited data are available on the time required to approve mergers or to issue infringement decisions under the Danish Competition Act. Nevertheless, drawing on indirect sources and acknowledging an inherent degree of uncertainty, it is possible to estimate that merger reviews in 2025 took an average of 66 calendar days, whereas investigations into potential infringements of the Danish equivalents of Articles 101 and 102 TFEU between 2012 and 2026 required, on average, 884 calendar days. Moreover, the average time between receiving a complaint and initiating an inspection was 188 calendar days during this period, suggesting that the Authority does not take such a decision lightly.

AI.tldr: 本文基于间接来源数据，估算了丹麦竞争法下并购审查和侵权调查所需的时间。研究发现，2025年并购审查平均耗时66个日历日，而2012至2026年间针对丹麦版TFEU第101条和102条对应条款的侵权调查平均耗时884个日历日；从收到投诉到启动检查平均间隔188天，表明丹麦竞争局在作出相关决定时较为审慎。
AI.research_question: 丹麦竞争法下，并购审批和侵权裁决程序分别需要多长时间？从收到投诉到启动检查的平均间隔是多久？
AI.motivation: 目前关于丹麦竞争法下并购审批和侵权裁决所需时间的公开数据非常有限，本文旨在通过间接来源填补这一信息空白，为相关利益方提供时间维度的参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文属于行政程序效率与竞争执法时效性的实证描述性研究，未依赖特定正式理论框架，主要基于竞争执法程序的制度逻辑进行分析。
AI.method: 基于间接来源（二手数据）进行估算，承认存在固有一定程度的不确定性，对并购审查与侵权调查的时间数据进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1) 2025年并购审查平均耗时66个日历日；2) 2012至2026年间侵权调查（对应TFEU第101和102条）平均耗时884个日历日；3) 从收到投诉到启动检查平均间隔188天，显示当局对启动检查持审慎态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文补充了丹麦竞争执法程序时间效率方面的实证数据，为竞争执法时效性的比较研究提供了丹麦案例的参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业及其他利益相关方提供了丹麦竞争执法程序时间成本的估算参考，有助于并购交易的时间规划以及投诉预期的管理；同时提示丹麦竞争局在启动检查方面较为谨慎。

title: Ubuntu As Economic Architecture From Cultural Philosophy to Measurable Institutional Design

detail.title: Ubuntu As Economic Architecture From Cultural Philosophy to Measurable Institutional Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract:
Ubuntu - the Nguni Bantu philosophy expressed as "I am because we are" - has been extensively theorised in African philosophy, ethics, and psychology, but has never been fully operationalised as an economic institution design system with measurable parameters, predictive validity, and explicit neurobiological mechanisms, nor connected with precision to original institutional economics (OIE). This paper remedies both gaps. We argue that Ubuntu is not merely a cultural preference for collectivism but a coherent economic architecture in a specific structural sense drawn from OIE's concept of instituted process: a system whose components - production coordination, credit allocation, risk pooling, governance, and surplus distribution - are interdependent and load-bearing, organising economic activity in ways that are neurobiologically calibrated to communities organised around communal identity and mutual obligation.

The paper makes five original contributions. First, it derives seven Ubuntu Economic Principles (UEPs) from the philosophical literature and operationalises each as a specific institutional design parameter measurable in economic research. Second, following Lawson's social positioning theory and Dugger's radical institutionalist account of role, it repositions the paper's underlying agent theory - the Contextual Agent and Ubuntu Agent - as agents occupying an institutionally constituted social position, rather than merely a person located in a particular context, relocating causal weight in economic outcomes from the individual in isolation to the position the individual occupies. Third, it identifies the neurobiological mechanism through which Ubuntu-aligned institutions outperform individualist alternatives in high-stress, trauma-affected communities: oxytocin-dopamine trust loops activated by collective participation, extending at the level of a specific institutional form Avsar's original-institutionalist argument that economic cooperation rests on evolved social instincts. Fourth, it introduces the Cultural Appropriateness Score (CAS) and its biometric companion, the Ubuntu Social Capital Multiplier (USCM), as measurement tools for assessing Ubuntu alignment. Fifth, it proposes the Ubuntu Institutional Design Framework (UIDF): a three-tier architecture of primary cooperatives, secondary federations, and regional development banks.

Drawing on evidence from South Africa's stokvels and burial societies, Kenya's Harambee and chama systems, Ethiopia's iqub and idir cooperatives, West Africa's tontines, Bangladesh's Grameen groups, and India's Self-Help Groups, the paper demonstrates that Ubuntu-aligned economic institutions consistently outperform individualist alternatives across four dimensions - participation, repayment, savings mobilisation, and income resilience - with the advantage most pronounced precisely where mainstream development economics has most consistently failed.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将非洲Ubuntu哲学（"我因我们而存在"）系统性地操作化为一个可测量的经济制度设计体系，从原始制度经济学（OIE）的"制度化过程"视角出发，推导出七项Ubuntu经济原则（UEPs），识别其神经生物学机制（催产素-多巴胺信任回路），并提出了文化适配评分（CAS）和Ubuntu社会资本乘数（USCM）等测量工具，以及三层级的Ubuntu制度设计框架（UIDF）。基于南非、肯尼亚、埃塞俄比亚、西非、孟加拉国和印度等地的经验证据，论文证明了Ubuntu对齐的经济制度在高压力、受创伤社区中优于个人主义替代方案。
AI.research_question: Ubuntu哲学如何被系统地操作化为具有可测量参数、预测效度和明确神经生物学机制的经济制度设计系统，并与原始制度经济学（OIE）精确连接？
AI.motivation: Ubuntu哲学在非洲哲学、伦理学和心理学中已被广泛理论化，但从未被完全操作化为经济制度设计系统——缺乏可测量参数、预测效度和明确的神经生物学机制，也未能与原始制度经济学精确连接。本文旨在弥补这两个理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以原始制度经济学（OIE）的"制度化过程"概念为核心，结合Lawson的社会定位理论、Dugger的激进制度主义角色理论，以及Avsar关于经济合作植根于进化社会本能的原始制度主义论证。
AI.method: 理论分析与多案例证据综合：从哲学文献推导Ubuntu经济原则，将其操作化为制度设计参数，并利用南非stokvels、肯尼亚Harambee、埃塞俄比亚iqub/idir、西非tontines、孟加拉国Grameen小组和印度自助小组等案例进行比较分析。
AI.findings: Ubuntu对齐的经济制度在四个维度（参与、还款、储蓄动员和收入韧性）上持续优于个人主义替代方案，且这种优势在最需要的地方（高压力、受创伤社区）最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 第一，将Ubuntu操作化为七项可测量的经济制度设计参数；第二，将代理理论重新定位为占据制度性社会地位的代理者，将因果权重从个体转移到个体所占据的位置；第三，识别了Ubuntu对齐制度优于个人主义替代方案的神经生物学机制（催产素-多巴胺信任回路），在具体制度形式层面扩展了Avsar的原始制度主义论证；第四，引入CAS和USCM作为测量工具；第五，提出UIDF三层制度设计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在主流发展经济学持续失败的社区提供了一套可操作的、经验验证的经济制度设计方案，包括测量工具（CAS、USCM）和具体的制度架构（UIDF），可用于指导发展政策、扶贫项目和社区经济重建。

title: Chained Indices Unchained: Structural Transformation and the Welfare Foundations of Income Growth Measurement
affiliations: University of Nottingham and University of Nottingham - School of Economics

detail.title: Chained Indices Unchained: Structural Transformation and the Welfare Foundations of Income Growth Measurement
detail.abstract: This paper examines how to measure welfare-relevant growth in economies undergoing structural transformation, where persistent changes in relative prices and expenditure patterns can lead to aggregation biases in standard output measures. We address this issue within a continuous-time dynamic general equilibrium model featuring non-homothetic preferences, sector-specific productivity trends, and investment-specific technical change. We compare two welfare-based measures of real income growth: a current-base equivalent variation measure and a chained Fisher-Shell index. The chained Fisher-Shell index coincides with the chained Divisia index, providing strong theoretical foundations for national accounting methodology and requiring the growth rates and nominal expenditure shares of major expenditure components as sufficient statistics for a welfare-based output index. In contrast, the current-base index is more informationally demanding, requires systematic revisions, and introduces base-dependent biases that distort the evaluation of past growth. Our quantitative analysis reveals that these biases are substantial, increase over time, and conflict with key stylized facts in the structural transformation literature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经济结构转型过程中如何衡量福利相关的增长。在具有非齐次偏好、部门特定生产率趋势和投资特定技术变革的连续时间动态一般均衡模型中，比较了当期基期等价变化指数和链式Fisher-Shell指数两种福利型实际收入增长衡量方法。链式Fisher-Shell指数与链式Divisia指数重合，为国民账户核算方法提供了坚实的理论基础；而当期基期指数存在信息需求高、需系统修正和基期依赖偏差等缺陷。量化分析表明这些偏差显著且随时间增大。
AI.research_question: 在经济结构转型过程中，如何正确衡量福利相关的实际收入增长率？不同福利型衡量指标（当期基期等价变化指数与链式Fisher-Shell指数）之间的差异及其对增长评估的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 经济结构转型过程中，相对价格和支出模式的持续变化会导致标准产出衡量指标产生加总偏差。需要一种能正确反映福利变化的增长衡量方法，并评估不同方法间的偏差程度及其对结构转型文献中关键事实的解释能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间动态一般均衡模型，包含非齐次偏好、部门特定生产率趋势和投资特定技术变革；等价变化（EV）衡量方法；Fisher-Shell指数与Divisia指数的理论联系。
AI.method: 构建连续时间动态一般均衡模型；推导并比较当期基期等价变化指数与链式Fisher-Shell指数两种福利型实际收入增长衡量方法；通过量化分析评估不同衡量方法产生的偏差大小及其演变趋势。
AI.findings: 链式Fisher-Shell指数与链式Divisia指数重合，仅需主要支出组成部分的增长率与名义支出份额作为充分统计量；当期基期指数信息需求更高、需系统性修正，并引入基期依赖偏差。量化结果显示这些偏差显著、随时间增大，且与结构转型文献中的关键典型事实相冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 为链式Fisher-Shell（Divisia）指数作为福利型产出衡量指标提供了严格的动态一般均衡理论基础；明确了福利型产出指数所需的最小充分统计量；系统阐明了当期基期指数的方法论缺陷及其理论后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国民账户核算方法提供理论支撑，支持使用链式Fisher指数衡量实际收入增长；警示政策制定者和研究者在结构转型背景下避免使用当期基期等价变化指数，因其会造成对过去增长的扭曲评估。

title: Beyond the Checkbox: Algorithmic Bias Outsmarting Compliance

detail.title: Beyond the Checkbox: Algorithmic Bias Outsmarting Compliance
detail.abstract:
Beyond the Checkbox: Algorithmic Bias Outsmarting Compliance: 326,000 Jobs, $37 Billion in GDP, and the Algorithmic Bias Behind It All examines the escalating unemployment crisis affecting Black women in the United States, documenting the loss of an additional 326,000 jobs in 2025 and the broader economic consequences, including an estimated $37 billion reduction in US GDP. This opinion piece explores how historical bias, AI-driven employment systems, and evolving legal and policy landscapes are converging to reshape workforce outcomes.

‍
The analysis addresses the following key areas:
- Presents evidence from US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data, federal litigation, and news reporting to illustrate the scale and economic impact of the crisis.
- Examines how artificial intelligence accelerates job displacement through algorithmic bias and automation, with an outsized impact on Black women who are heavily concentrated in AI-vulnerable occupations, including office and administrative support, healthcare support, and sales-related roles.
- Introduces Causal Fairness as the gold standard first step in an AI Fairness Intervention Workflow, explaining how it moves beyond identifying what disparate outcomes are occurring to understanding why they occur, through techniques such as mapping hidden bias pathways, identifying proxy variables, and providing mathematical proof of direct versus indirect discrimination.
- Recommends five actionable priorities for industry leaders, including intersectional bias testing, embedding fairness into AI systems from the outset, and aligning with emerging governance frameworks such as the Colorado AI Act and the EU AI Act.

‍
Ultimately, this paper highlights that organizations can lead the way in developing responsible AI by making intersectional fairness a fundamental design principle rather than an afterthought. Those who act now can mitigate litigation risks, strengthen AI governance, recover lost economic productivity, and establish themselves as employers of choice for highly skilled, high-performing talent. Advancing intersectional AI fairness is both an ethical obligation and a measurable competitive advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国黑人女性面临的失业危机，指出2025年将额外失去32.6万个工作岗位，导致美国GDP减少约370亿美元。文章认为历史偏见、AI驱动的就业系统和不断演变的法律政策环境正在共同重塑劳动力市场结果，并提出了"因果公平"（Causal Fairness）作为AI公平干预工作流程的黄金标准第一步，建议行业领导者将交叉性公平作为根本设计原则。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的就业系统如何通过算法偏见加剧黑人女性的失业危机，以及如何通过因果公平框架和负责任AI实践来应对这一问题？
AI.motivation: 黑人女性在美国面临日益严重的失业危机（2025年额外损失32.6万个工作岗位），且其高度集中在AI易替代的职业中（行政支持、医疗保健支持、销售相关岗位），这一问题对GDP造成370亿美元的负面影响，亟需系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果公平（Causal Fairness）理论框架，AI公平干预工作流程（AI Fairness Intervention Workflow），交叉性偏见（intersectional bias）理论，AI治理框架（Colorado AI Act和EU AI Act）
AI.method: 这是一篇观点性文章（opinion piece），综合运用美国劳工统计局（BLS）数据、联邦诉讼案例和新闻报道作为证据基础，进行定性的政策分析与框架构建。
AI.findings: 1）黑人女性在AI易受影响的职业中高度集中；2）算法偏见通过隐藏偏见路径和代理变量放大就业歧视；3）因果公平方法能区分直接与间接歧视并数学证明；4）提出了五个可操作的行业优先行动事项，包括交叉性偏见测试、从源头嵌入公平性、与新兴治理框架对齐等。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入因果公平（Causal Fairness）作为AI公平干预工作流的黄金标准第一步，将其从"识别结果差异"推进到"理解差异成因"，通过映射隐藏偏见路径、识别代理变量和数学证明直接与间接歧视，扩展了AI公平性理论的分析深度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供五项可操作的优先行动建议（交叉性偏见测试、系统设计初期嵌入公平、与Colorado AI Act和EU AI Act等治理框架对齐），帮助组织降低诉讼风险、加强AI治理、恢复经济生产力，并将交叉性公平转化为竞争优势。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Poppy Seed (Papaver somniferum): Comprehensive Insights into Phytochemistry, Pharmacology, Nutrition, Safety, and Industrial Uses
affiliations: Kulumsa agricultural Research center, Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural research, Ethiopia.

detail.title: Unlocking the Potential of Poppy Seed (Papaver somniferum): Comprehensive Insights into Phytochemistry, Pharmacology, Nutrition, Safety, and Industrial Uses
detail.abstract: Poppy seed (Papaver somniferum), a plant of high ethnobotanical and economic significance, is widely valued for its rich phytochemical profile and multifaceted applications. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the seed's phytochemistry, pharmacological attributes, traditional uses, nutritional value, safety concerns, and industrial relevance. Poppy seeds are abundant in essential fatty acids, minerals, and bioactive compounds-particularly alkaloids and polyphenols-which contribute to their functional and medicinal benefits. Traditionally, P. somniferum has been used in culinary, therapeutic, and ceremonial contexts across diverse cultures. Pharmacologically, its derivatives exhibit analgesic, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties. Despite these benefits, the presence of psychoactive alkaloids raises safety and regulatory concerns, necessitating stringent monitoring and standardization. Recent biotechnological advances, including metabolic engineering and improved processing techniques, aim to enhance the safety and efficacy of poppy-derived products. The plant's industrial applications span food and beverage production, pharmaceutical formulations, nutraceuticals, and cosmetics, demonstrating its versatility and market potential. This analysis underscores the importance of Papaver somniferum as a multifunctional resource with significant implications for health, nutrition, and sustainable industry. However, the complexity of its chemical composition calls for continued interdisciplinary research to optimize utilization while ensuring consumer safety and regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了罂粟籽（Papaver somniferum）的植物化学、药理学特性、传统用途、营养价值、安全性问题及工业应用，强调其作为多功能资源的巨大潜力，同时指出精神活性生物碱带来的监管挑战，呼吁跨学科研究以优化利用并确保消费者安全。
AI.research_question: 罂粟籽的植物化学组成、药理属性、传统用途、营养价值、安全性问题及工业相关性如何综合性地被理解和评估？
AI.motivation: 罂粟籽具有高度的民族植物学和经济重要性，但缺乏对其多维度属性（化学、药理、营养、安全、工业）的全面综合评述，需要系统整合现有知识以指导安全、可持续的开发利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 植物化学分析框架；药理学作用机制理论；民族植物学传统知识体系；食品安全与监管框架；生物技术工程理论
AI.method: 综述性研究方法，系统梳理和整合罂粟籽的植物化学、药理学、传统应用、营养学、安全性评估及工业应用等领域的现有文献和研究成果。
AI.findings: 罂粟籽富含必需脂肪酸、矿物质及生物活性化合物（尤其是生物碱和多酚）；具有镇痛、抗氧化、抗炎和镇静等药理特性；精神活性生物碱的存在引发安全与监管关切；代谢工程和改进加工技术有望提升产品安全性和功效；其工业应用涵盖食品饮料、制药、营养保健品及化妆品等多个领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个整合罂粟籽多维度属性的综合框架，将化学组成、药理机制、传统知识和工业应用置于统一分析体系中，深化了对该植物多功能价值的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食品、制药、营养保健和化妆品行业的罂粟籽产品开发利用提供了系统性的知识基础；强调安全监测和标准化的重要性，为监管政策制定和产品安全提升提供参考依据。

title: Penalizing Fragmentation: Training-Free RegularizedDecoding for Reliable ECG Wave Delineation
affiliations: University of Maia, Universidad San Francisco de Quito USFQ, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Maia and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Penalizing Fragmentation: Training-Free RegularizedDecoding for Reliable ECG Wave Delineation
detail.abstract: Deep learning-based electrocardiogram segmentation is usually decoded witha per-sample Argmax that ignores the temporal grammar of the cardiac cycle,fragmenting true waves into spurious short episodes. State-transitionconstraineddecoders, such as Viterbi and conditional random field, enforcethe grammar only softly, at the sample level, and leave this fragmentation unsolved,since they place no cost on the number of transitions. We address thisthrough three contributions. We first propose a mixed-integer program thatcombines soft physiological transition constraints with a single transitioncountpenalty, solved in polynomial time by a regularized Viterbi algorithm.A Karush-Kuhn-Tucker analysis identifies the penalty as the shadow price ofa transition, which dual feasibility forces to be non-negative, so only penalization,not reward, can achieve the optimal solution. The penalty is fixedin the validation data and applied unchanged in the test. Across three discriminators(a Transformer, a U-Net and a BiLSTM) on the QT databaseit improves every wave over Argmax. For the BiLSTM the mean F1-score reaches 0.798, 0.891 and 0.839 for the P-wave, QRS complex and T-wave,whereas a conditional-random-field baseline does not surpass Argmax. Appliedwithout retraining to the external LUDB database (a different cohortand lead), it still improves over Argmax on all waves, and downstream cutsthe mean absolute error in heart-rate from 5.73 to 0.99 beats per minute andin the QT-interval from 26.9 to 18.6 milliseconds. The decoder attaches toany sample-level model, needs no retraining or annotation, adds negligibleoverhead, and generalizes across architectures and datasets, making electrocardiogramdelineation more reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于正则化Viterbi算法的混合整数规划方法，通过添加单次转换计数惩罚来解决深度学习心电图分割中波形碎片化的问题。该方法不依赖重训练，可附加到任何样本级模型上，在QT数据库和外部LUDB数据库上均优于Argmax基线，显著降低了心率估计和QT间期测量的误差。
AI.research_question: 如何解决深度学习心电图分割中因逐样本Argmax解码导致的真实波形被碎片化为虚假短片段的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习心电图分割通常使用逐样本Argmax解码，忽略了心动周期的时序语法，导致真实波形被分割成虚假的短片段。虽然Viterbi和条件随机场等状态转换约束解码器可以强制执行语法约束，但它们仅在样本级别软性约束，对转换次数不施加成本，因此无法真正解决碎片化问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数规划（Mixed-Integer Programming）、正则化Viterbi算法、Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件分析、影子价格（Shadow Price）理论、对偶可行性（Dual Feasibility）
AI.method: 本文提出一个混合整数规划方法，将软生理转换约束与单次转换计数惩罚相结合，通过正则化Viterbi算法在多项式时间内求解。KKT分析确定惩罚项为转换的影子价格，对偶可行性要求其为非负值，因此只有惩罚（而非奖励）才能达到最优解。惩罚参数在验证集上固定，并在测试中保持不变应用。
AI.findings: 在QT数据库上，该方法在三种判别器（Transformer、U-Net、BiLSTM）上均在所有波形上优于Argmax。对于BiLSTM，P波、QRS复合波和T波的F1分数分别达到0.798、0.891和0.839，而条件随机场基线未能超越Argmax。在不重新训练的情况下应用于外部LUDB数据库（不同队列和导联），该方法仍能在所有波形上优于Argmax，并将心率平均绝对误差从5.73降至0.99次/分钟，QT间期误差从26.9降至18.6毫秒。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过KKT分析揭示了转换惩罚项的本质是转换的影子价格，并从对偶可行性角度证明了只有惩罚（非负值）而非奖励才能实现最优解，为状态转换约束解码提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法可附加到任何样本级模型上，无需重新训练或标注，计算开销可忽略不计，并能在不同架构和数据集上泛化，使得心电图分割更加可靠。在心率估计和QT间期测量等下游任务中显著提高了准确性。

title: Detection and Quantification of Metastatic Lesions on Whole-body 18F-FDG PET/CT in Radioiodine-Refractory Thyroid Cancer Using a Hybrid Deep Learning and Iterative Thresholding Approach
affiliations: VNU University of Engineering and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, 108 Military Central Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, VNU University of Engineering and Technology, VNU University of Engineering and Technology, Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Department of Radiology and Nuclear Medicine, Yeshiva University - Albert Einstein College of Medicine and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Detection and Quantification of Metastatic Lesions on Whole-body 18F-FDG PET/CT in Radioiodine-Refractory Thyroid Cancer Using a Hybrid Deep Learning and Iterative Thresholding Approach
detail.abstract: Background: Metabolic tumor burden indices from 18F-FDG PET/CT are prognostic markers in recurrent radioactive iodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer (RAIR-DTC). Metastatic thyroid lesions are often small, making them challenging to detect and precisely quantify their burden. This study proposes and assesses a deep learning-based framework for highly accurate lesion detection and quantification of metastatic thyroid tumors.Materials and Methods: The study was carried out on two datasets. A public dataset of 1014 whole-body 18F-FDG PET/CT images from 900 subjects with multiple cancer types and an internal dataset of 235 whole-body 18F-FDG PET/CT images from 220 thyroid cancer subjects. The proposed framework used an nnU-Net with a weighted BCE-plus-Dice (DwBCE) loss to emphasize the detection and segmentation accuracy of small lesions. The model was initially trained on the public dataset. Subsequently, the pretrained model was fine-tuned using 188 18F-FDG PET/CT thyroid cancer images from an internal dataset. In addition, an iterative thresholding algorithm was applied as an interactive correction method to compensate for the incorrect segmented lesions.Results: The framework was assessed using 47 18F-FDG PET/CT RAIR-DTC images from the internal dataset. Lesion detection sensitivity and precision were used as criteria to evaluate the trained model, achieving scores of 85.6% and 81.2%, respectively. In addition, dice similarity coefficient (DSC) was used to quantify the lesion segmentation, obtaining whole-body DSC scores of 0.76 vs. 0.88 for before and after the interactive correction, respectively (p-value <0.001, Wilcoxon test). Furthermore, metabolic activity-based scores such as metabolic lesion volume (MTV), total lesion glycolysis (TLG), the maximum of standard uptake value (SUVmax), and the total-body TLG (tTLG) are quantitatively estimated, obtaining median errors of 0.27 (mL), 0.64 (g), 0 (g/mL) and 0.53 (g), respectively, and meadian relative errors of 18.4%, 11.3%, 0% and 12.3%, respectively when 1% outliners are excluded (n=1).Conclusion: By enabling reliable measurements with minimal manual effort, the proposed approach addresses a key barrier for the use of metabolic tumor burden for prognosis and treatment in RAIR-DTC. It accurately quantifies small lesions while keeping clinicians in control of the final segmentation, providing an efficient method for metabolic burden assessment of metastatic thyroid lesions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于深度学习的框架，用于对转移性甲状腺癌病灶（尤其是RAIR-DTC中的微小病灶）进行高精度的检测与量化。该框架采用带加权BCE-plus-Dice损失函数的nnU-Net，先在公共数据集上预训练，再用内部甲状腺癌数据集微调，并辅以迭代阈值算法进行交互式校正。结果显示病灶检测灵敏度和精确率分别达85.6%和81.2%，交互校正后全身DSC从0.76提升至0.88，代谢负荷指标（MTV、TLG、SUVmax、tTLG）的中位相对误差均较低。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习框架实现对转移性甲状腺癌病灶（尤其是难以检测和量化的微小病灶）的高度准确的检测与代谢肿瘤负荷量化？
AI.motivation: 代谢肿瘤负荷指标（如MTV、TLG等）在放射性碘难治性分化型甲状腺癌（RAIR-DTC）中是重要的预后标志物，但转移性甲状腺病灶往往体积较小，难以检测和精确量化其负荷，这成为临床应用代谢肿瘤负荷进行预后判断和治疗决策的关键障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的分割网络理论，包括nnU-Net架构、加权二元交叉熵加Dice损失函数（DwBCE）以强调小病灶的检测与分割精度，以及迭代阈值算法作为交互式校正方法。
AI.method: 研究使用了两个数据集：公共数据集（1014张全身18F-FDG PET/CT图像，来自900名多种癌症类型受试者）和内部数据集（235张全身18F-FDG PET/CT图像，来自220名甲状腺癌受试者）。框架采用nnU-Net配合加权BCE-plus-Dice（DwBCE）损失函数，先在公共数据集上预训练，再用188张内部甲状腺癌图像微调。同时应用迭代阈值算法作为交互式校正方法补偿错误分割的病灶。最终用47张RAIR-DTC图像进行评估。
AI.findings: 病灶检测灵敏度和精确率分别为85.6%和81.2%；交互校正后全身Dice相似系数从0.76提升至0.88（p<0.001，Wilcoxon检验）；代谢负荷指标MTV、TLG、SUVmax和tTLG的中位误差分别为0.27 mL、0.64 g、0 g/mL和0.53 g，排除1个离群值（n=1）后中位相对误差分别为18.4%、11.3%、0%和12.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究验证了加权损失函数（DwBCE）在深度学习分割框架中有效提升小病灶检测和分割精度的理论可行性，并通过预训练-微调的迁移学习策略证明了跨数据集（多癌种到甲状腺癌）训练的泛化能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架能以最少的人工操作实现可靠的代谢肿瘤负荷测量，准确量化微小病灶的同时保留临床医生对最终分割结果的控制权，为RAIR-DTC的预后判断和治疗方案制定提供了高效、实用的代谢负荷评估工具。

title: SafeRecall: A BI-RADS-Guided Uncertainty Framework for Safe Mammography Recall Reduction
affiliations: University of Minnesota, University of Florida, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: SafeRecall: A BI-RADS-Guided Uncertainty Framework for Safe Mammography Recall Reduction
detail.abstract: Background and Objective:Screening mammography has a persistently high false-positive recall rate: over 10% of women are recalled while fewer than 6% receive a malignancy diagnosis, causing unnecessary patient anxiety and an estimated $4 billion in annual expenditure. Existing AI approaches treat recall reduction as binary classification, overlooking two clinically critical realities: ambiguous grey-zone cases cannot be safely dismissed by a single probability threshold, and the asymmetric cost of missed cancers demands optimization beyond standard objectives.Methods:We propose SafeRecall, an uncertainty-guided framework integrating three components: (i) a missing-view-robust longitudinal architecture with Gated Temporal Fusion (GTF) that handles incomplete multi-view and prior-exam data via a learned validity mask; (ii) a BI-RADS-aware composite loss with asymmetric penalties, BI-RADS 3 confidence regularization, and fairness regularization to limit racial true positive rate (TPR) disparities; and (iii) an uncertainty-guided three-zone decision framework via Monte Carlo Dropout that routes uncertain negatives to recall as an explicit safety net. All experiments use the demographically diverse EMBED dataset (>50k exams, 46.2% Black patients) under a clinically realistic natural-distribution protocol without class rebalancing or view-completeness filtering.Results:SafeRecall achieves AUROC 0.860 and specificity 54.5% at 95% sensitivity, safely reducing unnecessary recalls by 29.5% (Safe Recall Reduction Rate) with a cancer miss rate of 0.37%. Some prior methods degrade substantially under realistic conditions (e.g., -0.131 AUC for Hwang et al.). The three-zone framework exhibits emergent alignment with BI-RADS risk categories without explicit zone-level supervision.
