Sensitivity gap across racial groups is 3.7%, with all groups meeting the 95% sensitivity floor.Conclusions:SafeRecall provides a clinically deployable framework that unifies uncertainty quantification, BI-RADS-informed training, and missing-data robustness for safe recall reduction under realistic screening conditions. Future work will focus on ensemble-based uncertainty calibration and prospective clinical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeRecall框架，通过不确定性引导的三区决策、BI-RADS感知的复合损失函数以及缺失视图鲁棒的纵向架构，在真实临床筛查条件下实现安全召回率降低29.5%，同时保持癌症漏诊率仅0.37%和AUROC 0.860，并有效控制种族间敏感度差异。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持高癌症检出敏感度的前提下，利用不确定性量化和临床知情设计来安全降低筛查性乳腺X线摄影的假阳性召回率？
AI.motivation: 筛查性乳腺X线摄影的假阳性召回率持续高于10%，但恶性确诊率不足6%，造成患者焦虑和每年约40亿美元的支出。现有AI方法将召回减少视为二元分类问题，忽略了两个临床关键现实：灰色地带模棱两可的病例不能仅凭单一概率阈值安全排除，且漏诊癌症的不对称成本要求超越标准目标的优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性量化（蒙特卡洛Dropout）、BI-RADS风险分层理论、不对称损失函数理论、公平性正则化理论、纵向时间融合架构（门控时间融合）
AI.method: SafeRecall框架包含三个组件：(i)缺失视图鲁棒的纵向架构，采用门控时间融合（GTF）通过学习的有效性掩码处理不完整的多视图和既往检查数据；(ii)BI-RADS感知的复合损失函数，包含不对称惩罚、BI-RADS 3置信度正则化和公平性正则化以限制种族间真阳性率差异；(iii)基于蒙特卡洛Dropout的不确定性引导三区决策框架，将不确定的阴性病例路由至召回作为显式安全网。实验采用人口统计学多样化的EMBED数据集（超5万次检查，46.2%黑人患者），在临床真实的自然分布协议下进行，无类别重平衡或视图完整性过滤。
AI.findings: SafeRecall实现AUROC 0.860，在95%敏感度下特异性为54.5%，安全降低不必要的召回29.5%，癌症漏诊率为0.37%。部分先前方法在现实条件下显著退化（如Hwang et al.的AUC下降0.131）。三区框架在无显式区域级监督下与BI-RADS风险类别表现出涌现对齐性。种族间敏感度差距为3.7%，所有群体均达到95%敏感度下限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首先，提出不确定性引导的三区决策框架，证明不确定性量化可与BI-RADS临床风险类别自发对齐，无需显式区域级监督；其次，将不对称损失、置信度正则化和公平性正则化整合为BI-RADS感知的复合损失，为临床AI训练提供新的范式；最后，通过门控时间融合机制解决缺失视图和既往检查数据不完整这一真实临床场景中的关键问题。
AI.practical_contributions: SafeRecall在真实临床筛查条件下可实现29.5%的不必要召回降低，癌症漏诊率仅0.37%，可直接部署于临床环境。框架显式考虑种族公平性（敏感度差距仅3.7%），所有种族群体均达到95%敏感度下限。研究还揭示了现有方法在现实条件下性能大幅退化的现象，为临床AI模型的鲁棒性评估提供了重要参考。

title: HierarchicalDAEW: Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted Graph Convolution with Evidential Uncertainty for Multi-Section Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from H&E Histology
affiliations: National Institute of Technology Durgapur, National Institute of Technology Durgapur, University of Hradec Králové and Jadavpur University

detail.title: HierarchicalDAEW: Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted Graph Convolution with Evidential Uncertainty for Multi-Section Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from H&E Histology
detail.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics assays remain costly and technically demanding, restricting transcriptomewide profiling to specialist settings and preventing routine clinical deployment. Predicting spatially resolved gene expression from H&E histology could close this gap, yet current methods largely ignore the underlying tissue architecture and rarely quantify how their predictions can be trusted. We introduce HierarchicalDAEW, a dual-graph architecture that addresses both gaps. On the spot graph, a Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted convolutional operator learns separate projections for interdomain, intra-domain, and boundary edges derived from Leiden clustering, allowing the model to treat tissue heterogeneity as an explicit structural signal rather than an implicit one. A second gene-level graph then fuses protein-protein interaction priors from STRING-DB with tissue-specific coexpression through learned attention gating, propagating predictions from a landmark gene set to a broader gene panel. Reliability is handled through evidential uncertainty estimation, which produces far better calibrated confidence intervals than Monte Carlo dropout under identical conditions. Across six human Visium sections spanning breast, colorectal, prostate, and cerebellar tissue, and against thirteen published baselines, HierarchicalDAEW achieves the strongest correlation with ground-truth expression, with gains that hold up under multi-seed reproducibility checks and negative controls that rule out positional shortcuts. Ablations further confirm that both the domain-aware edge typing and the hierarchical depth are necessary to this improvement, and calibrated uncertainty estimates identify low-confidence predictions for pathologist review before clinical action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HierarchicalDAEW，一种双图架构的深度学习模型，用于从H&E组织学图像预测空间分辨的基因表达。该模型通过域感知边缘加权卷积算子显式建模组织异质性，利用基因级图融合蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用与组织特异性共表达，并通过证据性不确定性估计提供良好校准的置信区间。在六个人类Visium组织切片和十三个基线模型的对比中取得最优性能。
AI.research_question: 如何从H&E组织学图像准确预测空间转录组基因表达，并量化预测的不确定性？
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学检测成本高昂且技术要求高，限制了其临床部署。从H&E组织学预测基因表达可以弥合这一差距，但现有方法忽略底层组织结构且缺乏可靠的置信度量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双图架构（spot图+基因级图）、域感知边缘加权卷积、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用先验、证据性不确定性估计
AI.method: HierarchicalDAEW采用双图架构：1）spot图上使用Domain-Aware Edge-Weighted卷积算子，基于Leiden聚类区分inter-domain、intra-domain和boundary边，分别学习投影；2）基因级图通过注意力门控融合STRING-DB蛋白质相互作用与组织特异性共表达，从地标基因集传播到更广泛的基因面板；3）使用证据性不确定性估计（evidential uncertainty）实现预测可靠性量化。
AI.findings: 在涵盖乳腺、结直肠、前列腺和小脑组织的六个人类Visium切片上，与十三个已发表基线相比，HierarchicalDAEW取得与真实表达最强的相关性。提升在多种子可重复性检验和排除位置捷径的阴性对照中保持稳定。消融实验证实域感知边缘类型和层次深度均对提升必要，校准的不确定性估计可识别低置信度预测供病理学家审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将组织异质性（通过Leiden聚类定义的域）作为显式结构信号纳入预测模型，而非隐式处理；2）提出域感知边缘加权卷积算子，对三种类型的边分别学习投影；3）将证据性不确定性估计引入空间转录组预测领域，实现比MC dropout更好的校准；4）通过注意力门控融合PPI先验与组织特异性共表达。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）降低了空间转录组学对昂贵检测的依赖，使从常规H&E染色中预测基因表达成为可能；2）提供校准的不确定性估计，可识别低置信度预测供病理学家审查后再做临床决策；3）该方法在多个组织类型上验证，具有临床部署潜力。

title: Development and Evaluation of an HE-Enhanced ConvNeXt Model for Breast Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Classification in H&E Histopathology Patches
affiliations: Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University, Fudan University and Fudan University

detail.title: Development and Evaluation of an HE-Enhanced ConvNeXt Model for Breast Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Classification in H&E Histopathology Patches
detail.abstract: Background: Invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) accounts for an important proportion of breast cancer and is one of the most common histological types of breast cancer. Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained slides are the most basic image source in pathological diagnosis. Identification of IDC-related regions usually depends on the experience of pathologists. This study constructed an improved ConvNeXt-based deep learning model for binary classification of IDC-positive and IDC-negative histopathology patches. Methods: This study used the public Kaggle Breast Histopathology Images dataset. The dataset was derived from 162 breast cancer whole mount slide images. These images were scanned at 40× and divided into 277,524 patches of 50 × 50 pixels. After screening, 86 patients were included. They were divided at the patient level into training, validation, and test sets, containing 60, 13, and 13 patients, respectively. For each patient, 200 patches were randomly sampled, including 100 IDC-positive patches and 100 IDC-negative patches. The model used ImageNet-pretrained ConvNeXt-small as the backbone. The enhancement part included multi-scale feature fusion, feature calibration, attention modules, frequency-domain enhancement, and a classification head. The training set used random horizontal flip, HEAugmentation, and random masking. The validation and test sets did not use random augmentation. Training was run for up to 100 epochs under a three-phase training schedule. The final checkpoint was selected according to validation AUC. The held-out patient-level test set was only used for final evaluation. Results: On the held-out patient-level test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.9370, accuracy of 87.12%, F1-score of 87.04%, sensitivity of 86.54%, and specificity of 87.69%. Conclusions: This study established a patient-level split binary classification experiment on the public Kaggle IDC patch dataset. The improved ConvNeXt model can automatically distinguish IDC-positive and IDC-negative histopathology patches. Ablation experiments and random seed experiments support that the model has a certain degree of stability. This study mainly presents a reproducible breast IDC pathology patch classification workflow.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Kaggle公开的乳腺组织病理图像数据集，构建了一个改进的ConvNeXt深度学习模型，用于浸润性导管癌（IDC）阳性与阴性组织病理切片的二分类。模型在患者级别划分的测试集上取得了AUC 0.9370、准确率87.12%的良好性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用改进的ConvNeXt深度学习模型对乳腺浸润性导管癌（IDC）阳性与阴性的组织病理切片进行准确的二分类？
AI.motivation: IDC是乳腺癌中最常见的组织学类型之一，H&E染色切片是病理诊断中最基本的图像来源。IDC相关区域的识别通常依赖病理学家的经验，主观性强且耗时，需要自动化深度学习模型来辅助诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于改进的ConvNeXt-small架构，融合多尺度特征融合、特征校准、注意力机制、频域增强等模块的深度学习模型。
AI.method: 使用Kaggle公开数据集（162例全切片图像，277,524个50×50像素补丁），经筛选纳入86例患者，按患者级别划分为训练集（60例）、验证集（13例）和测试集（13例）。每例随机采样200个补丁（100阳性+100阴性）。以ImageNet预训练的ConvNeXt-small为骨干网络，训练采用三阶段策略，最多100个epoch，根据验证AUC选择最优模型。
AI.findings: 在独立的患者级别测试集上，模型取得AUC为0.9370，准确率87.12%，F1分数87.04%，灵敏度86.54%，特异度87.69%。消融实验和随机种子实验支持模型具有一定稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种改进的ConvNeXt模型架构，整合了多尺度特征融合、特征校准、注意力和频域增强等多种技术，为乳腺IDC组织病理切片的自动分类提供了新的模型方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立了可复现的乳腺IDC病理切片分类工作流程，采用患者级别划分避免数据泄漏，可为病理学家提供辅助诊断工具，减少人工判断的主观性和工作量。

title: GeoCorNet: Geometry-Aware Boundary Supervision for Accurate Corneal Segmentation in Anterior Segment OCT
affiliations: Beni-Suef University, Beni-Suef University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Beni-Suef University

detail.title: GeoCorNet: Geometry-Aware Boundary Supervision for Accurate Corneal Segmentation in Anterior Segment OCT
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Corneal opacity is a major cause of preventable blindness, and accurate delineation of the corneal contour in anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) is essential for opacity grading and disease staging. The cornea's thin, continuously curved, low-contrast geometry exposes a limitation shared by most segmentation pipelines: region-overlap objectives such as Dice are dominated by the correctly classified bulk interior and under-penalize boundary-level error, regardless of encoder capacity. A systematic comparison across CNN, hybrid, and transformer encoder families confirms this directly: boundary error diverges sharply between architectures while region-overlap accuracy remains comparatively stable, indicating that the supervision objective, not feature extraction, is the binding constraint for thin anatomical structures. This motivates supervision that explicitly encodes boundary location and continuous distance-to-boundary as geometric constraints on the learned solution, rather than as auxiliary signals subordinate to region overlap.Methods: We propose GeoCorNet, a geometry-aware, boundary-supervised segmentation network built around an EfficientNet-B4 encoder and a dual-pathway decoder, in which a dedicated boundary decoding pathway is fused into the segmentation pathway via Boundary Attention Gates at every decoder stage, refined by a Boundary Refinement Block, and jointly optimized with an auxiliary Signed Distance Map (SDM) regression head through a hybrid multi-task loss.Results: The resulting supervision strategy is evaluated on the public MCOA benchmark (2,992 AS-OCT images), exceeding the best previously reported Dice under an identical five-fold protocol and substantially reducing boundary error (HD95, ASD). A replicated ablation across MCOA and the independently collected AIDK dataset shows that individual geometric constraints contribute in a statistically validated, complementary, dataset-dependent manner, and external validation under zero-shot and fully supervised transfer confirms the strategy generalizes beyond a single dataset.Conclusions: Explicit geometric supervision of boundary location and distance-to-boundary yields consistent gains in boundary-level accuracy for thin, low-contrast anatomical structures, supporting a supervision paradigm applicable beyond the cornea.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoCorNet，一种几何感知、边界监督的分割网络，针对前节OCT图像中角膜透明度分级所需的角膜轮廓精确描绘问题。通过专用边界解码通路、边界注意力门控和符号距离图回归头，实现比区域重叠目标更好的边界级精度。在公共MCOA基准（2,992张AS-OCT图像）上超越此前最优Dice，并显著降低边界误差（HD95, ASD）。消融实验与跨数据集验证表明几何监督策略具有泛化性。
AI.research_question: 对于薄、低对比度的解剖结构（如角膜），区域重叠目标（如Dice）是否构成分割精度的根本瓶颈？显式编码边界位置和连续距离-边界作为几何约束的监督策略能否带来一致的边界级精度提升？
AI.motivation: 角膜混浊是可预防失明的主要原因，AS-OCT中角膜轮廓的精确描绘对混浊分级和疾病分期至关重要。然而角膜的薄、连续弯曲、低对比度几何特征暴露了大多数分割管道的局限：Dice等区域重叠目标被正确分类的内部体素主导，对边界级误差惩罚不足。系统比较CNN、混合和Transformer编码器家族证实边界误差在不同架构间显著发散，而区域重叠精度相对稳定，表明监督目标而非特征提取才是薄解剖结构的根本约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域重叠监督目标（Dice）对薄结构边界误差惩罚不足的理论分析；几何监督（边界位置+符号距离图）作为显式约束的学习框架；多任务学习中的混合损失设计。
AI.method: GeoCorNet架构：EfficientNet-B4编码器 + 双通路解码器（专用边界解码通路通过边界注意力门控在每个解码器阶段融合进分割通路，并由边界精化块精化），辅以符号距离图（SDM）回归头的混合多任务损失联合优化。在公共MCOA基准（2,992张图像）上与较CNN/混合/Transformer编码器家族系统比较，并通过MCOA和AIDK数据集的复制消融及零样本/全监督迁移外部验证。
AI.findings: GeoCorNet在MCOA基准的五折协议下超过此前最优Dice，并显著降低HD95和ASD边界误差。消融实验表明各几何约束在统计验证上互补且依数据集而异；外部验证（零样本和全监督迁移）证实策略可泛化到单一数据集之外。核心结论：显式几何监督（边界位置+距离-边界）对薄、低对比度解剖结构产生一致的边界级精度提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统证明对于薄解剖结构，监督目标（而非特征提取能力）是根本约束；2. 提出边界位置与连续距离-边界应作为几何约束被显式编码到学习解中，而非作为从属于区域重叠的辅助信号；3. 验证几何监督范式可泛化到角膜之外的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供GeoCorNet这一开源可复现的几何感知边界监督分割网络；2. 在MCOA基准上取得最优Dice和显著更低的边界误差，可直接用于角膜混浊分级和疾病分期；3. 跨数据集（MCOA、AIDK）验证表明方法具备临床部署和迁移的实用性。

title: Perverse Trade Sanction Effects
affiliations: Austrian Institute of Economic Research (WIFO), , Drexel University and Drexel University - Department of Economics & International Business

detail.title: Perverse Trade Sanction Effects
detail.abstract: Using established econometric techniques and disaggregated data that include intra-national trade flows, we estimate the direct and extraterritorial effects of complete trade sanctions on international trade. Across sectors, the direct effects of complete trade sanctions are negative, as expected. However, their extraterritorial effects are predominantly positive, working in the opposite direction of the direct effects. At the extreme, the extraterritorial effects of complete trade sanctions may fully offset their direct effects and lead to a perverse scenario in which the target’s overall trade rises in the aftermath of sanctions.

AI.tldr: 本文使用成熟的计量经济学方法和包含国内贸易流的细分数据，估计了全面贸易制裁对国际贸易的直接效应和域外效应。研究发现，全面贸易制裁的直接效应为负，但域外效应主要为正，与直接效应方向相反。在极端情况下，域外效应可能完全抵消直接效应，导致制裁目标国的总体贸易在制裁后反而上升的悖论性结果。
AI.research_question: 全面贸易制裁对国际贸易的直接效应和域外效应分别是怎样的？域外效应是否可能抵消直接效应？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注贸易制裁的直接效应，对域外效应（extraterritorial effects）关注不足；且本文使用包含国内贸易流的细分数据，可以更全面地评估制裁对贸易的真实影响，特别是可能出现的"适得其反"（perverse）结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易制裁理论、国际贸易重力模型及相关的计量经济学方法
AI.method: 使用成熟的计量经济学技术，基于包含国内贸易流（intra-national trade flows）的细分数据（disaggregated data）进行估计。
AI.findings: （1）全面贸易制裁的直接效应在各行业均为负；（2）域外效应主要为正，与直接效应方向相反；（3）在极端情况下，域外效应可能完全抵消直接效应，导致制裁目标国的总体贸易在制裁后上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统估计全面贸易制裁的域外效应，揭示其与直接效应方向相反的机制，并识别出域外效应可能完全抵消直接效应的极端情景，丰富了贸易制裁的经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估贸易制裁的实际效果提供依据，特别是提示制裁可能产生的非预期后果（制裁目标国贸易反而上升），有助于更理性地设计和使用制裁工具。

title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management and

detail.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing financial or non-financial interests to declare. The commercial systems evaluated in this study were accessed through standard, publicly available paid interfaces. The authors have no financial or advisory relationship with any of the model providers whose systems are evaluated, and received no funding, preferential access, compensation, or pre-publication review from them.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external grant funding. Computational resources were provided by the Columbia Business School Research Grid. Commercial API inference costs were borne by the authors.

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型在长上下文财务分析中普遍存在"检索-整合鸿沟"：即使模型能够准确检索到风险披露信息，这些信息对投资判断的影响也会随着上下文长度增加而消失。研究通过因果记忆干预和不同的工作流架构实验证明，信息的检索成功并不等同于信息被整合进判断，模型能力与工作流架构共同决定了AI分析师的表现。
AI.research_question: 在长上下文财务分析中，大语言模型检索到的信息是否真正影响其投资判断？检索能力与信息整合能力之间是否存在鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 现有AI分析师评估体系主要关注模型"能检索到什么"，而非"检索到的信息是否影响判断"。这种评估方式可能导致系统虽然通过检索测试，但在实际投资决策中忽略关键信息，构成系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索-整合鸿沟（Retrieval-Integration Gap）理论框架；信息处理与判断决策理论；长上下文注意力稀释理论。
AI.method: 实验设计：控制焦点公司信息不变，仅变化无关上下文长度（2,000至128,000 token）；跨多模型家族和判断任务进行复制验证；从真实10-K文件中移除真实披露进行实验；实施因果记忆干预（压缩摘要与源文本查找）；对比不同工作流架构（分块-摘要流水线 vs 目标结构化重述）的效果。
AI.findings: （1）风险披露对投资判断的影响随上下文长度增加降至实验噪声水平，即使直接检索仍然准确；（2）该现象跨模型家族、跨任务类型稳定复现，在真实10-K文件实验中同样存在；（3）更强能力的模型仅推迟但无法消除裂口；（4）因果记忆干预显示压缩摘要与源文本查找共同将披露传递到判断中；（5）分块-摘要流水线会逐出相关信息，而决策点附近的目标化结构化重述能恢复信息影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将"检索能力"与"判断整合能力"分离，提出并验证了"检索-整合鸿沟"这一概念，揭示了单纯基于检索的评估框架的根本缺陷，为长上下文LLM信息处理理论提供了新的实证维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI财务分析系统的评估标准提出新要求（应从检索导向转向判断导向）；为工作流架构设计提供具体指导（避免分块-摘要流水线，采用决策点附近的结构化重述）；对金融监管和AI分析师部署实践具有警示意义，防止系统表面合规而实际失效。

title: A Student Perspective on Peer Leadership: Building a Campus Community from Zero to One Hundred Members

detail.title: A Student Perspective on Peer Leadership: Building a Campus Community from Zero to One Hundred Members
detail.abstract: Peer leadership is a practical way for students to close knowledge gaps that formal coursework often leaves unaddressed. This paper presents a student perspective on building a campus community around IBM Z, a mission-critical computing platform that most undergraduates have never encountered. Drawing on the author's experience as an IBM Z Student Ambassador and on a talk delivered at the IBM Z and LinuxONE Community Academic Symposium, the paper describes how a student-led club grew from zero to more than one hundred members around a technology that was initially unfamiliar to the group. The account is situated in literature on peer leadership, communities of practice, and the mainframe skills gap. The paper argues that student ambassadors can function as near-peer translators between industry platforms and campus life, and that community growth depends less on prior technical prestige than on consistent invitation, shared learning, and visible pathways into skills and careers.

AI.tldr: 本文从学生视角探讨了围绕IBM Z大型机平台建立校园社区的实践，描述了学生主导的社团如何从零发展到一百多名成员，论证了学生大使作为行业平台与校园生活之间"近同行翻译者"的角色价值。
AI.research_question: 学生大使如何围绕一个大多数本科生从未接触过的大型机平台（IBM Z）建立校园社区？社区成长的关键驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 大型机技能缺口严重，正规课程通常无法弥补学生对关键任务计算平台的知识空白，亟需探索替代性的社区学习路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同伴领导力（Peer Leadership）、实践社区（Communities of Practice）、大型机技能缺口理论
AI.method: 基于作者作为IBM Z学生大使的一手经验，结合在IBM Z和LinuxONE社区学术研讨会上的演讲内容，采用叙述性案例分析方法。
AI.findings: 学生大使可以充当行业平台与校园生活之间的近同行翻译者；社区成长的主要驱动力不是技术声誉，而是持续的邀请、共同学习和通往技能与职业的可见路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将同伴领导力和实践社区理论扩展到大型机/企业计算教育领域，提出"近同行翻译者"概念，挑战了社区成长依赖技术最初声望的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校学生如何建立围绕非主流技术的社区提供了可复制的实践框架；为行业（如IBM）与校园合作弥合技能缺口提供了学生主导的模式参考。

title: From Scope 3 Inventory Reductions to Grounded Emissions Consequences: A Reachability-and Evidence-Constrained Accounting Framework

detail.title: From Scope 3 Inventory Reductions to Grounded Emissions Consequences: A Reachability-and Evidence-Constrained Accounting Framework
detail.abstract:
Scope 3 accounting converts heterogeneous value-chain activities into additive greenhouse-gas inventory quantities. That achievement is operationally important, but it does not by itself establish how much global physical emissions changed because a company acted. The two quantities may share the unit tCO2e while belonging to different semantic categories: an inventory change is defined by an accounting boundary and attribution rule; a consequence claim concerns a transition in the physical, market, institutional, and temporal system in which the company operates. The central problem addressed here is therefore not arithmetic error but an unlicensed inference from an accounting representation to a real-world consequence.

This paper develops a calculation layer that preserves the familiar Scope 3 workflow while requiring consequence claims to be grounded in admissible real-world outcomes. For item i, the firm first computes its conventional inventory reduction ∆Qi. It then records the action ai that generated the accounting change, specifies the set Ri of outcomes reachable under stated physical, contractual, market, policy, and temporal constraints, evaluates the emissions consequence ei(y) associated with each reachable outcome y, and attaches auditable evidence to those outcomes. When evidence supports singleton outcome weights mi(y), the grounded consequence estimate iŝ ∆Ei = ∑ y∈Ri mi(y)ei(y), or, when ∆Qi 6 = 0,̂ ∆Ei = ∆QiGi with Gi = ∑ y mi(y)ri(y) and ri(y) = ei(y)/∆Qi. When evidence supports sets of outcomes rather than a unique probability distribution, the framework retains set-valued evidence and reports lower and upper consequence bounds before any optional decision transform is applied.

Four numerical scenarios—supplier exit, energy-attribute procurement, logistics efficiency with rebound, and material substitution with indirect market effects—show how identical or similar inventory reductions can support materially different consequence estimates. The main text is designed for managerial and interdisciplinary use. The formal machinery—reachability preorders and Alexandroff upper sets, incidence algebra and Möbius inversion, capacities, and belief functions—is placed in appendices. These tools are not offered as substitutes for consequential LCA, econometrics, equilibrium models, engineering analysis, or local causal models. They provide a semantic and evidential interface that constrains what those quantitative tools are allowed to aggregate. The paper also develops a cost-efficiency and ROI layer that uses tiering and materiality thresholds to prevent routine Scope 3 lines from triggering unnecessary system modeling, while reserving higher-cost analysis for material consequence claims. It concludes with a compact enterprise rule: retain Scope 3 for inventory accounting, but do not report an inventory reduction as an emissions consequence unless the action, reachable outcomes, evidence, physical consequence model, and aggregation conditions are explicitly supplied.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Scope 3核算将异质价值链活动转化为可加总的活动温室气体清单量，但清单变化并不等同于实际的全球排放变化。作者开发了一个计算层，在保留传统Scope 3工作流程的同时，要求后果声明必须基于可允许的真实世界结果，通过可达结果集、证据权重和上下界报告来约束从核算表示到现实后果的推断。
AI.research_question: Scope 3清单核算的变化量能否以及在何种条件下可以被视为真实的排放后果？如何构建一个计算层，使企业的后果声明有充分证据和理论依据？
AI.motivation: Scope 3核算中的清单变化（inventory change）与真实排放后果（consequence）属于不同的语义类别，前者由核算边界和归因规则定义，后者涉及公司运营所在的物理、市场、制度和时间系统的转变。当前存在从会计表征到现实后果的未经授权的推断问题，这不是算术错误，而是一个语义和认识论问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可达性预序与Alexandroff上集、关联代数与Möbius反演、容量与信任函数（belief functions）、证据理论
AI.method: 本文提出一个计算层框架：对企业每一项行动ai，计算传统清单减少量ΔQi，记录产生核算变化的行动，指定在物理、合同、市场、政策和时间约束下可达的结果集合Ri，评估每个可达结果y的排放后果ei(y)，并附上可审计证据。当证据支持单一结果权重时使用加权估计；当证据仅支持结果集时保留集值证据并报告上下界。通过四个数值场景（供应商退出、能源属性采购、反弹效应的物流效率、间接市场效应的材料替代）进行验证。
AI.findings: 四个数值场景表明，相同或相似的清单减少量可以支持实质上不同的后果估计。框架提出了分层的成本效率和ROI设计，通过分层和重要性阈值防止常规Scope 3项目触发不必要的系统建模，将高成本分析保留给重大后果声明。最终提出企业规则：保留Scope 3用于清单核算，但除非明确提供行动、可达结果、证据、物理后果模型和加总条件，否则不得将清单减少报告为排放后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将Scope 3清单核算与真实排放后果之间的语义区分理论化，提出了一个严格的形式化框架（可达性预序、Möbius反演、信任函数），为后果声明提供了语义和证据接口，约束了哪些量化工具（如后果LCA、计量经济学、均衡模型等）被允许加总什么。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了一个可直接操作的计算层，在不颠覆现有Scope 3工作流程的前提下，确保后果声明的可信度；通过分层和重要性阈值控制分析成本；提供了可审计的证据要求，有助于提升企业ESG报告和碳披露的可信度与合规性。

title: An Optimization Framework for Algorithmic Explainability, Calibrated Trust, and Decision Quality in AI-Enabled Enterprise Decision Support Systems

detail.title: An Optimization Framework for Algorithmic Explainability, Calibrated Trust, and Decision Quality in AI-Enabled Enterprise Decision Support Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki. Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants prior to completing the online survey. The data collection protocol ensured participant anonymity, voluntary participation, and confidentiality of all responses. Institutional review/ethics committee approval was obtained from the author's institution prior to study commencement.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Enterprise Computing. JEL Classification: O33 (Technological Change: Choices and Consequences
and Cognitive Factors on Decision Making)

detail.abstract: AI-enabled Decision Support Systems (AI-DSS) increasingly function as critical infrastructure within contemporary enterprises, yet their contribution to the quality of executive decision-making remains constrained by structural barriers to user trust and system adoption. Extending the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), UTAUT2, and Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) research streams, this study develops and empirically validates an integrated structural model linking system transparency (Explainability), Perceived Ease of Use, Calibrated Trust, and Perceived Usefulness to multi-dimensional Managerial Decision Quality. Primary survey data were collected from corporate managers (N = 328) across the banking and financial services, information technology, and manufacturing sectors, and analysed through a two-stage methodology comprising Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) with permutation-based multi-group analysis (MGA), followed by a multi-layer perceptron artificial neural network (ANN) to capture non-linear dependencies. Explainability and Perceived Ease of Use emerged as the two critical structural antecedents, explaining substantial variance in Trust (R² = 0.331) and Perceived Usefulness (R² = 0.258) respectively, while Trust was the strongest predictor of Decision Quality (β = 0.422, p < 0.001; 58.3% relative importance in the neural sensitivity analysis). Permutation-based MGA confirmed structural invariance across managerial hierarchy levels. The findings offer a validated, replicable blueprint for designing transparent, high-performing AI decision infrastructure in enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于TAM、UTAUT2和XAI理论，构建并实证验证了一个整合结构模型，考察系统可解释性、感知易用性、校准信任和感知有用性对多维管理决策质量的影响。通过对328名企业管理者（横跨银行金融、IT和制造业）的调研数据，采用PLS-SEM与多层感知器神经网络的两阶段分析，发现可解释性和感知易用性是关键前置因素，信任是决策质量最强的预测因子。
AI.research_question: AI支持的决策支持系统（AI-DSS）如何通过系统可解释性、信任和感知有用性等机制提升企业高管决策质量？
AI.motivation: AI-DSS日益成为企业关键基础设施，但其对高管决策质量的贡献仍受制于用户信任和系统采纳的结构性障碍，需要系统性地建模和实证验证其影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）、UTAUT2、可解释人工智能（XAI）理论，以及校准信任理论。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：第一阶段使用偏最小二乘结构方程建模（PLS-SEM）结合基于置换的多组分析（MGA）；第二阶段使用多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN）捕捉非线性依赖关系。数据来自328名企业管理者。
AI.findings: ①可解释性和感知易用性是两个关键结构前因，分别解释了信任（R²=0.331）和感知有用性（R²=0.258）的显著方差；②信任是决策质量最强的预测因子（β=0.422, p<0.001；神经网络敏感性分析中相对重要性占58.3%）；③基于置换的MGA确认了不同管理层级间的结构不变性。
AI.theory_contributions: ①整合TAM、UTAUT2与XAI研究流，构建了AI-DSS决策质量的统一理论框架；②将校准信任作为关键中介机制引入决策质量模型，深化了对AI采纳中信任动态的理解；③证实了可解释性作为信任的核心驱动力的理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为企业设计透明、高性能的AI决策基础设施提供了经过验证且可复制的蓝图；②为不同管理层级的管理者提供了统一的AI-DSS设计指导；③为企业优化AI系统采纳和信任管理提供了实证依据。

title: Persistent Semantic Scaffolds and the Pay-It-Forward Record: Reconstruction Cost and Reasoning Lineage in Long-Horizon Human-AI Systems

detail.title: Persistent Semantic Scaffolds and the Pay-It-Forward Record: Reconstruction Cost and Reasoning Lineage in Long-Horizon Human-AI Systems
detail.abstract: This paper introduces two architectural concepts for sustaining reasoning continuity in long-horizon institutional and human-AI systems: the Persistent Semantic Scaffold (PSS), a structured substrate for containing semantic mutation as systems grow in complexity, and the Pay-It-Forward Record (PIFR), a minimal artifact for carrying reasoning lineage forward across reasoning vehicles. Building on Paper 3's account of Interpretive Entropy (Mayoh, 2026a) and Paper 4's account of the Continuity Threshold (Mayoh, 2026b), this paper formalises the mechanism by which growing systems become harder to reconstruct-what it terms Semantic Surface Area and Mutation Blast Radius-and proposes structural responses grounded in organisational memory theory, distributed cognition, and software architecture erosion research. The argument is presented as a navigational hypothesis: the central claim is that beyond certain thresholds of complexity and institutional duration, structured reasoning scaffolding shifts from optional design preference to structural requirement. Neither PSS nor PIFR are proposed as software products or governance ideology, but as candidate layers of reasoning infrastructure for systems-human, institutional, or AI-that must remain coherent across long stretches of time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两个架构概念——持久语义支架（PSS）和"传递善意的记录"（PIFR），用于维持长期机构及人机系统在长周期中的推理连续性。论文基于此前的"解释熵"和"连续性阈值"理论，形式化阐释了系统复杂性增长导致其难以重建的机制（语义表面积与突变爆炸半径），并提出结构化支架从可选设计偏好转变为结构性需求的核心主张。
AI.research_question: 在长期运行的机构与人机AI系统中，如何通过结构化推理支架来维持推理连续性，并防止系统规模增长带来的语义突变与重建困难？
AI.motivation: 系统随时间增长和复杂度提升后变得越来越难以重建（即"突变爆炸半径"扩大），现有理论缺乏对这种现象的机制性解释和结构性应对方案。当系统跨越特定复杂度与制度存续阈值后，推理连续性不再能依赖偶然或非正式机制维持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织记忆理论、分布式认知理论、软件架构侵蚀研究，以及前文提出的解释熵（Interpretive Entropy）与连续性阈值（Continuity Threshold）概念。
AI.method: 概念性/理论建构研究。通过提出两个新构念——语义表面积（Semantic Surface Area）和突变爆炸半径（Mutation Blast Radius）——形式化描述系统增长导致的推理丢失机制，并基于多学科理论基础提出结构性应对方案（PSS与PIFR）。
AI.findings: 研究表明，在复杂度和制度存续时间超过特定阈值后，结构化推理脚手架从可选设计偏好转变为结构性必要条件。PSS作为结构化基底用于遏制系统的语义突变，PIFR作为最小化工件跨推理载体传递推理脉络，两者共同构成支持系统长期连贯性的推理基础设施层。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化提出了语义表面积与突变爆炸半径两个新概念，丰富了系统演化与推理连续性的理论框架；将软件架构侵蚀、组织记忆与分布式认知理论整合到推理基础设施的讨论中，提供了一个"导航假说"层面的理论主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人类机构、AI系统及人机混合系统提供了两个具体可用的架构概念（PSS与PIFR），作为推理基础设施的候选层，帮助此类系统在长期运行中保持语义稳定与推理可追溯性。明确这些概念不是软件产品或治理意识形态，而是一般性的推理基础设施设计原则。

title: Revelatory and Substitutional Scaffolds: Architecture as a Moderator in the Media Psychology of AI
affiliations: Astrala Advisory Services Ltd

detail.title: Revelatory and Substitutional Scaffolds: Architecture as a Moderator in the Media Psychology of AI
detail.abstract: There are at least two classes of AI-mediated reasoning scaffold, and current mediapsychology critiques of AI treat them as one. Substitutional scaffolds-typically transformer language models shaped by next-token prediction and reinforcement learning from human feedback-produce outputs that stand in for the user's next thought. Revelatory scaffolds hold open an aim-perception-action loop and refuse to close reasoning the user has not closed. Where the first class is continuous with the systems that empirical work on offloading, metacognitive laziness, and cognitive debt already describes well, the second class inherits from the Wiener-Ashby-Powers cybernetic lineage and requires separate analysis. This paper steel-mans four recent critique moves-metacognitive bypass, algorithmisation of thought, cognitive exoskeleton and atrophy, and architectural restriction of autonomy-and shows why each applies to substitutional scaffolds while inviting different predictions for revelatory ones. A reference implementation of revelatory design intent is described in the abstract terms needed for the argument, not as an outcome study. The contribution is a moderator variable that the media-psychology critique currently lacks, together with a five-part empirical programme that would falsify the typology on either side.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI中介推理支架应分为两类：替代性支架（如基于next-token预测和RLHF的Transformer语言模型）和揭示性支架（保持目标-感知-行动循环开放）。当前媒体心理学对AI的批判混淆了两者。作者认为四大批判论据（元认知绕过、思维算法化、认知外骨骼与萎缩、自主性的架构限制）对替代性支架成立，但对揭示性支架需作出不同预测，并提出了调节变量和五部分实证研究纲领。
AI.research_question: AI中介推理支架是否应区分为替代性和揭示性两类？当前媒体心理学批判在多大程度上只适用于替代性支架而忽视揭示性支架的独特性？
AI.motivation: 当前媒体心理学对AI的批判将两类本质上不同的AI中介推理支架混为一谈，导致批判框架对某一类支架（揭示性支架）的分析失效，需要建立更精确的类型学区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wiener-Ashby-Powers控制论传统（揭示性支架）；替代性支架延续现有的卸载（offloading）、元认知懒惰（metacognitive laziness）和认知债务（cognitive debt）理论。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论论证——通过钢人法（steel-manning）审视四大批判论点，并给出揭示性设计意图的参考实现（以抽象术语描述，非实证结果研究），提出五部分实证纲领。
AI.findings: 四大批判论点（元认知绕过、思维算法化、认知外骨骼与萎缩、自主性架构限制）有效适用于替代性支架，但对揭示性支架会产生不同的预测；揭示性支架通过拒绝关闭用户未完成的推理，保持了认知自主性。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"支架类型"作为调节变量，弥补媒体心理学批判框架中缺失的关键变量；将控制论传统与AI认知研究连接起来；提出可证伪的二分类型学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI设计者提供区分性的设计意图参考实现；为实证研究者提供五部分可操作的研究纲领以检验该类型学。

title: Who Qualifies to Watch Science? Authority, Expertise and Accountability in Independent Post-Publication Criticism
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Who Qualifies to Watch Science? Authority, Expertise and Accountability in Independent Post-Publication Criticism
detail.abstract: Self-appointed post-publication critics can acquire considerable influence over researchers, journals and institutions despite having no common appointment process, jurisdiction, qualification standard, evidentiary protocol, conflictdisclosure rule or independent oversight body. This commentary examines the legitimacy deficit created when public comments, blogs and pseudonymous accounts move from informal criticism into investigations, corrections and retractions. It rejects the assumption that visibility, professed intentions, nonprofit status, moderator acceptance, technical tools, prolific output or earlier adverse outcomes establish authority. It distinguishes directly reproducible observations from field-dependent interpretations, misconduct allegations and formal editorial findings; examines financial, professional and reputational incentives; and questions whether high-volume, crossdisciplinary and tool-assisted commenting can be relied upon without transparent validation and error-rate evidence. PubPeer is examined through its own public policies, including its moderation claims and its disclaimer that comments are not scientifically reviewed or warranted as true. A WATCH burden-of-justification test is proposed, not to accredit self-appointed watchdogs, but to identify when journals and institutions must refuse to treat their claims as authoritative. Public expression does not confer scientific authority; institutional reliance is unjustified unless the evidence, competence, transparency, correction record and independent adjudication required for the particular claim are demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 本文审视了自发形成的发表后批评者（如PubPeer等平台上的评论者）在期刊和机构决策中的权威性缺失问题，提出WATCH举证责任检验框架，主张公众表达不构成科学权威，机构在缺乏充分证据、能力、透明度和独立裁决的情况下不应采信其主张。
AI.research_question: 自发形成的发表后批评者如何获得对研究者、期刊和机构的影响力？其权威性是否存在合法性赤字？期刊和机构在何种条件下应（不）将其主张视为权威？
AI.motivation: 发表后的非正式批评（公共评论、博客、匿名账户）正在从非正式的评论转化为调查、更正和撤稿的驱动力量，但这些批评者缺乏正式的任命程序、管辖范围、资格标准、证据协议、利益冲突披露规则和独立监督机构，产生了严重的合法性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权威合法性理论；举证责任（burden of justification）框架；证据等级与可验证性区分框架
AI.method: 评论性分析（commentary）：通过概念分析、区分框架构建（直接可复现观察 vs 领域依赖解释 vs 不当行为指控 vs 正式编辑裁决）以及PubPeer公共政策的案例审视，提出WATCH举证责任检验标准
AI.findings: 1. 可见性、声称的意图、非营利身份、版主接受度、技术工具、高产产出或先前的负面结果均不能确立权威；2. 不同类型的评论主张需要不同的证据和验证标准；3. PubPeer自身声明其评论未经科学审查且不保证真实；4. 提出WATCH（Warranted Authority Through demonstrated evidence, Competence, transparency, correction record, and independent adjudication）检验框架，用于识别期刊和机构何时必须拒绝将自发批评者的主张视为权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统性地驳斥了将可见度、意图、非营利性等表面特征等同于权威的常见假设；2. 提出权威获得的举证责任框架（WATCH），丰富了科学治理与学术监督领域的理论；3. 区分了不同类型的批评主张及其相应的证据要求，为理解发表后评论的合法性边界提供了概念工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为期刊编辑和科研机构提供了明确的决策框架，指导其何时应拒绝将自发批评者的主张视为权威；2. 通过对PubPeer政策的具体案例审视，揭示现有平台的治理漏洞；3. 帮助学术界建立对发表后批评的审慎采信机制，防止未经充分验证的评论不当影响学术记录。

title: The Architecture of Private Wealth: Dependency, Diversification and the Architecture Audit

detail.title: The Architecture of Private Wealth: Dependency, Diversification and the Architecture Audit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest relevant to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical research, or experimental subjects and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Conventional measures of private wealth tend to treat net worth, portfolio diversification and institutional access as proxies for financial strength. These measures, however, may obscure a deeper form of concentration: dependence on the institutions through which ownership is recorded, custody is provided, transactions are settled, authority is exercised and institutional knowledge is preserved.

This paper develops a framework for analysing private wealth as an institutional architecture rather than solely as a portfolio of assets. It distinguishes four analytically separate states of wealth: declared wealth, realizable wealth, controllable wealth and independent wealth. The distinction highlights the possibility that a fortune may retain substantial market value while becoming progressively less realizable, less controllable or more dependent on discretionary institutional cooperation.

The paper then introduces the concept of architectural diversification. Unlike conventional asset diversification, architectural diversification evaluates whether apparently separate assets, institutions and jurisdictions remain exposed to common failure modes. Multiple banks, custodians, funds or legal structures may therefore provide limited diversification if they ultimately depend on correlated settlement infrastructure, regulatory regimes, counterparties, decision-makers or information systems.

To operationalize the framework, the paper develops two further concepts: failure-mode concentration and escape capacity. Escape capacity describes the extent to which ownership, authority, transfer, settlement and institutional knowledge remain functional when critical dependencies become unavailable or cease to cooperate.

Finally, the paper proposes an Architecture Audit consisting of seven tests: Ownership, Custody, Settlement, Correlation, Authority, Memory and Simultaneity. The audit is designed to identify whether critical wealth functions survive the removal of important institutional, jurisdictional or human dependencies.

The central argument is that private wealth cannot be adequately evaluated by asking only what assets are owned or how diversified they appear. A more complete analysis must also ask whether ownership can be proved, authority preserved, value settled, knowledge retained and alternatives exercised when the surrounding institutional architecture changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分析私人财富的新框架，将私人财富视为一种"制度架构"而非单纯的资产组合。文章区分了财富的四种状态（申报财富、可变现财富、可控制财富和独立财富），引入"架构多样化"概念替代传统资产多样化，并提出失效模式集中度与逃离能力两个操作化概念，最终设计了包含七项测试的"架构审计"框架，用以评估财富在关键制度依赖失效时的存续能力。
AI.research_question: 私人财富的传统衡量方式（净资产、投资组合多样化、机构准入）是否掩盖了更深层次的集中风险——即对财富记录、托管、结算、权力行使和制度知识所依赖的机构的依赖？如何构建一个能够系统评估这种制度架构依赖性的分析框架？
AI.motivation: 传统私人财富度量方法将净资产、投资组合多样化和机构准入视为财务实力的代理指标，但这些方法可能掩盖一种更深层次的集中形式：对所有权记录、托管、交易结算、权力行使和制度知识保存所依赖机构的依赖。这种依赖可能导致财富在保留市场价值的同时，变得难以变现、难以控制或更加依赖机构的自由裁量合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文从宏观制度经济学与财富管理理论的交叉视角出发，将私人财富概念化为"制度架构"而非仅仅视为"资产组合"。核心理论区分包括四种财富状态（申报、可变现、可控制、独立），以及架构多样化、失效模式集中度、逃离能力等分析性概念。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性/理论性分析框架构建方法。作者通过逻辑推演提出财富的四种状态分类，定义架构多样化与失效模式集中度的分析维度，将"逃离能力"操作化为衡量所有权、权威、转移、结算和制度知识在关键依赖失效时是否仍然运转的指标，并最终提出由七项测试构成的架构审计工具。
AI.findings: 本文的核心发现是：传统资产多样化可能造成虚假的安全感——多个银行、托管人、基金或法律结构若最终依赖相关的结算基础设施、监管制度、交易对手、决策者或信息系统，则实际提供的多样化极为有限。财富可能在保有可观市场价值的同时，变得越来越难以变现、越难以控制或越依赖机构的自由裁量合作。完整评估私人财富必须同时考察所有权可证明性、权威可维持性、价值可结算性、知识可保留性和替代方案可行使性。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：其一，将私人财富分析从"资产组合观"转向"制度架构观"，提供了新的理论透镜；其二，提出四种财富状态（申报、可变现、可控制、独立）的概念区分，揭示了市场价值与可控性/变现性之间的脱节可能；其三，引入"架构多样化"概念，对传统多样化理论构成重要修正与补充；其四，提出"失效模式集中度"和"逃离能力"等原创性概念，为财富风险分析提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于：提供了可操作的"架构审计"框架，包含所有权、托管、结算、相关性、权威、记忆和同步性七项测试，帮助财富管理从业者、高净值个人及家族办公室系统性地识别财富对机构、司法管辖区和关键人物的依赖风险，从而在制度架构变化（如监管冲击、机构失败、地缘政治事件）面前评估并增强财富的韧性与独立性。

title: Simulation-Based Redesign of a Perishable Retail Supply Chain: A Case Study of Coles' Egg Supply Chain in New South Wales

detail.title: Simulation-Based Redesign of a Perishable Retail Supply Chain: A Case Study of Coles' Egg Supply Chain in New South Wales
detail.abstract: This report presents a simulation-based redesign of Coles' egg supply chain across five retail stores in New South Wales, using SCM Globe to evaluate and improve network performance in three progressive stages. Stage 1 modelled the baseline supply chain—two upstream factories, one Western Sydney distribution centre, and five stores—under a centralised, single-drop daily delivery structure. This configuration met customer demand but proved operationally inefficient, with excessive inventory (12.57 days of supply against a target of 8), high vehicle costs, low storage utilisation (18%), and a monthly loss of $42,430. Stage 2 introduced operational improvements, including multi-stop delivery every 48 hours, adjusted inventory positioning, and reduced factory production, which lowered inventory days of supply to 9.15, cut vehicle costs by roughly 52%, and reduced the operating loss to $24,974, though the network remained oversized in storage capacity. Stage 3 implemented structural changes—direct shipment from Factory 1 to Store 3, resized storage capacity, and a standardised 30% retail mark-up—achieving the strongest overall outcome: inventory days of supply fell to 8.96, vehicle costs and carbon footprint dropped by roughly 65% relative to Stage 1, storage utilisation rose to 45%, and the supply chain became profitable for the first time, with a monthly profit of $13,939. The overall performance dashboard score improved from 49.2 (Stage 1) to 76.0 (Stage 2) to 102.5 (Stage 3). These findings demonstrate that simulation-based redesign, integrating transport consolidation, demand-aligned inventory management, and structural network adjustments, can substantially improve the operational, environmental, and financial performance of a perishable retail supply chain. Recommendations include formalising multi-stop delivery planning, maintaining demand-aligned inventory practices, periodically reassessing centralised versus direct-shipment lanes, and strengthening supply chain resilience through contingency sourcing and flexible capacity planning.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用SCM Globe模拟工具，对新南威尔士州Coles超市鸡蛋供应链进行了三阶段渐进式重新设计。从基线模型（单点配送、过高库存、月亏$42,430）出发，通过运营改进（多停靠配送、库存调整）和结构性变革（直运、存储容量调整、标准化加价），最终实现库存天数降至8.96、成本与碳足迹下降65%、存储利用率升至45%，并首次实现月度盈利$13,939，综合绩效评分从49.2提升至102.5。
AI.research_question: 如何通过基于模拟的供应链重新设计，系统性地提升易腐品零售供应链在运营效率、环境表现和财务绩效方面的综合表现？
AI.motivation: Coles的鸡蛋供应链存在严重的运营低效问题：库存过量（12.57天vs目标8天）、车辆成本高昂、存储利用率仅18%且每月亏损$42,430，亟需通过系统性的供应链重构来改善整体绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链网络设计理论、库存管理理论（需求对齐的库存定位）、运输整合与配送路径优化理论、易腐品供应链可持续性框架
AI.method: 基于SCM Globe的计算机仿真模拟，采用三阶段渐进式重新设计方案：（1）基线模型建模与诊断；（2）运营改进（多停靠48小时配送、库存重定位、工厂产量调整）；（3）结构性变革（直接运输、存储容量重设、标准化零售加价）。通过绩效仪表盘多维评估运营、环境与财务指标。
AI.findings: 三阶段改进效果显著：库存供应天数从12.57降至8.96；车辆成本与碳足迹相对Stage 1下降约65%；存储利用率从18%升至45%；月度亏损$42,430转为盈利$13,939；综合绩效评分从49.2升至102.5。Stage 2虽降低了成本但存储仍过剩，Stage 3通过结构变革实现全面最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了仿真模拟在易腐品零售供应链网络设计中的系统化应用价值，验证了运输整合、需求对齐库存管理与结构性网络调整三者协同对供应链多维绩效（运营、环境、财务）的综合改善效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Coles及其他易腐品零售商提供了可操作的供应链实践建议：正式化多停靠配送规划、维持需求对齐的库存管理、定期评估集中配送与直运路线、通过应急采购和弹性产能规划增强供应链韧性。

title: Reducing Procurement Lead Time in TJX’s Off-Price Retail Supply Chain: An AHP-QFD Based Strategy Selection Approach

detail.title: Reducing Procurement Lead Time in TJX’s Off-Price Retail Supply Chain: An AHP-QFD Based Strategy Selection Approach
detail.abstract: This study investigates strategies for reducing procurement lead time in TJX’s off-price retail supply chain, where opportunistic buying, rapid inventory turnover, global sourcing, and changing consumer demand make procurement responsiveness a critical competitive capability. An integrated Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Quality Function Deployment (QFD), resilience efficiency, and budget-constrained optimisation framework is developed to identify key lead-time vulnerabilities, translate them into practical strategies, and select an optimal implementation portfolio. The analysis draws on secondary evidence from TJX and relevant supply chain literature, supported by simulated judgement-based inputs representing key procurement and supply chain decision-makers. The AHP results identify weak cross-functional coordination, inconsistent supplier responsiveness, customs and compliance delays, delayed internal approvals, and limited supplier readiness as the most significant procurement lead-time vulnerabilities. QFD prioritises supplier collaboration and information sharing, followed by digital procurement visibility and other capability-building initiatives. When implementation cost and resilience efficiency are incorporated, supplier lead-time key performance indicators, supplier collaboration and information sharing, and standardised supplier onboarding documents emerge as the most effective strategy portfolio. Under an assumed first-year budget of USD 12 million, the selected portfolio has a gross implementation cost of USD 13.5 million but achieves a USD 3.5 million cost-saving synergy, resulting in a net cost of USD 10 million. The findings demonstrate that procurement lead-time reduction should be managed as a cross-functional and strategic supply chain capability rather than solely as an operational purchasing issue. The study contributes a structured decision-support framework for prioritising and selecting lead-time reduction strategies in dynamic off-price retail environments while highlighting implications for supply chain responsiveness, resilience, and sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对TJX低价零售供应链中采购前置时间的缩短问题，开发了一个集成的AHP-QFD-弹性效率-预算约束优化框架，识别关键前置时间脆弱点并将其转化为可实施的策略组合。研究发现供应商协作与信息共享、数字化采购可见度等是最有效的策略，在1200万美元预算下通过协同效应实现净成本1000万美元的实施方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在TJX低价零售供应链中识别采购前置时间的关键脆弱点，并选择最优的策略组合以缩短采购前置时间？
AI.motivation: 低价零售（off-price retail）的商业模式具有机会性采购、快速库存周转、全球采购和不断变化的消费者需求等特征，使得采购响应能力成为关键的竞争能力。缩短采购前置时间需要系统化的决策支持框架，而不仅仅是运营层面的采购问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成分析层级过程（AHP）、质量功能展开（QFD）、弹性效率（resilience efficiency）和预算约束优化四个理论/方法框架。
AI.method: 基于TJX和供应链文献的二手证据，辅以模拟的专家判断输入（代表关键采购和供应链决策者），运用AHP识别前置时间脆弱点、QFD转化为策略、再结合弹性效率和预算约束进行优化选择。
AI.findings: （1）AHP识别出五大最显著前置时间脆弱点：跨职能协调薄弱、供应商响应不一致、海关与合规延误、内部审批延迟、供应商准备不足；（2）QFD优先排序供应商协作与信息共享，其次是数字化采购可见性等能力建设举措；（3）在考虑实施成本和弹性效率后，供应商前置时间KPI、供应商协作与信息共享、标准化供应商准入文件是最有效的策略组合；（4）在1200万美元第一年预算下，所选组合毛成本1350万美元，但通过350万美元成本协同实现净成本1000万美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结构化的决策支持框架，将AHP、QFD、弹性效率和预算约束优化整合起来，用于动态低价零售环境中的前置时间缩短策略优先级排序与选择，拓展了供应链响应性和弹性的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为采购和供应链管理者提供了一套系统化工具，证明采购前置时间缩短应作为跨职能的战略性供应链能力来管理，而非仅作为运营采购问题；同时突出了对供应链响应性、弹性和可持续性的实际启示。

title: Inspection-Chain Legality in AI-Assisted Regulatory Inspection: The INSPECT Framework for UAE Private-School Regulation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Inspection-Chain Legality in AI-Assisted Regulatory Inspection: The INSPECT Framework for UAE Private-School Regulation
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence can redistribute administrative discretion before a formal enforcement decision is issued. In regulatory inspection, algorithmic systems may shape who is scrutinised, which anomalies are pursued, how records are evaluated, and which enforcement options become practically salient. Building on established scholarship on upstream design and distributed digital decision-making, this article develops Inspection-Chain Legality as an inspection-specific public-law synthesis. It argues that legality must remain effective across three linked functions-targeting, investigation and evidence, and enforcement-and proposes a legal-interruption test for determining when a later process genuinely displaces an earlier unlawful or unreliable contribution. Using technology-sensitive doctrinal analysis, functional comparison, and regulatory mapping, the article applies the theory normatively to United Arab Emirates private-school regulation, with particular reference to Sharjah. It further separates the permissible evidentiary weight of an algorithmic output from the governance intensity required by the use case, and operationalises these distinctions through the seven-element INSPECT Framework. The resulting architecture shows why risk may justify inquiry without becoming proof, why nominal human approval cannot by itself cure an unauthorised or unreliable pathway, and why distributed technical arrangements do not displace the competent authority's responsibility for a reviewable inspection chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"检查链合法性"（Inspection-Chain Legality）这一公法综合理论，用于分析人工智能如何在正式执法决定作出之前重新分配行政裁量权。文章通过七要素INSPECT框架，区分算法产出的可采证据权重与使用场景所需的治理强度，并以阿联酋（特别是沙迦）私立学校监管为规范应用案例。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何在监管检查过程中重新分配行政裁量权？合法性原则应如何在检查的三个关联功能（靶向定位、调查与证据、执法）中保持有效？何时一个后续程序真正取代先前非法或不可靠的贡献？
AI.motivation: 既有研究关注算法系统的上游设计及分布式数字决策，但缺乏针对监管检查场景的、系统性的公法综合框架。需要回答算法如何塑造"何人被审查、哪些异常被追查、记录如何评估、哪些执法选项变得实际突出"等问题，并处理算法输出作为证据的权重与治理强度之间的张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检查链合法性（Inspection-Chain Legality）理论，整合上游设计理论与分布式数字决策理论，提出合法性须贯穿靶向定位（targeting）、调查与证据（investigation and evidence）、执法（enforcement）三个关联功能；并引入"法律中断测试"（legal-interruption test）判断后续程序是否真正取代先前非法或不可靠的贡献。
AI.method: 技术敏感性教义分析（technology-sensitive doctrinal analysis）、功能比较（functional comparison）、监管图谱分析（regulatory mapping），并将理论规范性地应用于阿联酋（特别是沙迦）私立学校监管的具体场景。
AI.findings: 风险可以证明调查的正当性但不能成为证据本身；名义上的人类批准无法单独治愈未经授权或不可靠的算法路径；分布式技术安排不能取代主管机构对可审查检查链的责任。通过将算法产出的可采证据权重与使用场景所需的治理强度分离，并以七要素INSPECT框架操作化这些区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对监管检查场景的"检查链合法性"公法综合理论，将既有上游设计与分布式决策研究整合为三个功能环节的合法性框架；引入"法律中断测试"作为判断程序替代性的法律标准；提出证据权重与治理强度的概念性区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了七要素INSPECT框架作为操作化工具，指导监管机构在AI辅助检查中合法使用算法输出；明确了风险触发调查与作为证据证明之间的边界；强调主管机关不可因分布式技术安排而推卸可审查责任。

title: Why Disclosure Regimes Fail to Produce Accountability: A Theory of Transparency Architecture
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - School of Media and Journalism

detail.title: Why Disclosure Regimes Fail to Produce Accountability: A Theory of Transparency Architecture
detail.abstract: Contemporary governance regimes rely on disclosure mandates to render complex organizations accountable, yet the expansion of transparency reporting in platform governance, financial markets, and environmental policy has produced no commensurate expansion in oversight capacity. This persistent gap between disclosure volume and accountability motivates the present study. This Article argues that the gap arises because prevailing approaches misspecify transparency as a binary or scalar property, obscuring a structural problem: the systematic decoupling of disclosure breadth, informational resolution, and reporting institutionalization. This misspecification is not incidental but structural, since the measurement frameworks used to evaluate transparency actively incentivize the failure modes they are designed to detect. To address this problem, the Article develops a general theory of transparency architecture failure and proposes the Transparency Architecture Typology, which disaggregates transparency into three analytically distinct dimensions and identifies the mechanisms (compliance optimization, template rigidity, and informational cost asymmetry) that systematically drive disclosure regimes toward formally compliant but informationally inadequate configurations. From this framework, six theoretical propositions are derived, each specifying falsifiable conditions that anchor an empirical research program. The account is grounded in illustrative evidence drawn from platform disclosure episodes and financial reporting, which confirms that the framework's structural predictions correspond to identifiable patterns in the observable record. The Article concludes by reframing transparency as an epistemic design problem and by specifying the architectural conditions under which disclosure can generate the informational basis that accountability requires, with direct implications for the design of mandatory disclosure regimes such as the European Union's Digital Services Act.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当代治理中的强制性披露制度虽不断扩张，但问责能力并未同步提升，原因在于现有框架将透明度错误地视为二元的或标量的属性，忽视了披露广度、信息分辨率与报告制度化之间的系统性脱耦。文章提出"透明度架构类型学"，将透明度分解为三个分析维度，并识别出合规优化、模板僵化和信息成本不对称三种机制，推导出六个可证伪的理论命题，并通过对平台披露与财务报告的例证分析验证其结构预测，最终将透明度重新定义为一种知识设计问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么透明度报告在平台治理、金融市场和环境政策等领域的扩张并未带来相应问责能力的提升？即"披露量-问责力"之间的持续鸿沟的结构性根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 当代治理体制依赖强制披露来让复杂组织负责，但透明度报告规模扩张与监督能力增长严重不对等。现有研究未能揭示这一困境的结构性原因，需要重新审视透明度概念本身的理论设定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 透明度架构失败理论（Transparency Architecture Failure）；透明度架构类型学（Transparency Architecture Typology），将透明度分解为披露广度、信息分辨率和报告制度化三个维度；三种失败机制：合规优化、模板僵化、信息成本不对称。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析：提出透明度架构类型学框架，推导六个可证伪的理论命题，并以平台披露案例和财务报告作为例证性证据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) 现有透明度评估框架存在系统性错误设定，将透明度视为二元或标量属性；2) 错误设定并非偶然而是结构性的——测量框架本身激励了其旨在检测的失败模式；3) 三种机制（合规优化、模板僵化、信息成本不对称）系统性地将披露制度推向"形式上合规但信息上不充分"的配置；4) 六个理论命题均具有可证伪性条件；5) 例证证据支持框架的结构预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一般性的"透明度架构失败理论"，将透明度问题从概念属性问题重构为架构设计问题；建立三维度的透明度架构类型学分析框架；识别出驱动披露制度失效的三种系统性机制；提出六个可证伪命题，为实证研究奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为强制披露制度的设计提供架构层面的指导，明确问责所需的信息基础产生的架构条件；直接适用于欧盟《数字服务法》（DSA）等强制披露制度的设计与改进。

title: Evaluating India's Emerging Energy-Development Pathway: Evidence from Renewable Electricity, Coal Use and Energy Intensity

detail.title: Evaluating India's Emerging Energy-Development Pathway: Evidence from Renewable Electricity, Coal Use and Energy Intensity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Historically, industrial expansion has often been accompanied by substantial growth in fossil-fuel consumption, particularly where coal supported large-scale manufacturing, infrastructure development and electricity generation. China’s economic transformation during the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries represents a prominent recent example of this relationship. That historical pattern does not necessarily mean contemporary emerging economies must follow the same energy-development sequence.
The technological conditions confronting today’s emerging economies differ from those faced by earlier industrializers. Declining renewable-energy costs, the increasing scalability of solar generation and advances in electrification technologies have expanded the range of energy options available during economic development. These changes raise the possibility that electricity demand and low-carbon generation could expand simultaneously, reducing—but not necessarily eliminating— the fossil-fuel intensity historically associated with industrial growth.
This study evaluates whether recent changes in India’s energy system are consistent with the emergence of a less fossil-intensive development pathway. Using comparative descriptive analysis, it examines solar electricity generation, coal consumption per capita, electricity consumption per capita and energy intensity across India, China and the United States. The analysis uses publicly available data from Ember, the Energy Institute and the World Bank.
The results reveal three notable patterns. India’s solar electricity generation increased more than twenty-fold between 2015 and 2024; its coal consumption per capita remained substantially below China’s level in the latest year examined; and its comparatively low electricity consumption per capita indicates considerable scope for future demand growth. India also recorded lower energy intensity than China in the latest comparable data used in the study. 
Taken together, these indicators provide qualified support for the possibility that India could expand electricity use without reproducing the scale of coal dependence associated with China’s industrial expansion. The findings are consistent with aspects of Ember’s “Electrotech Fast-Track” proposition but do not establish that India has already bypassed a fossil-fuel-intensive stage of development. The durability of such a pathway will depend on whether renewable generation, electricity networks, storage, energy efficiency and low-carbon industrial technologies expand sufficiently to meet future demand.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较分析印度、中国和美国的太阳能发电量、人均煤炭消费量、人均电力消费量和能源强度等指标，评估印度能源系统是否正在走向一条较少依赖化石燃料的发展路径。结果显示印度太阳能发电量在2015-2024年间增长超过20倍，人均煤炭消费量远低于中国，且能源强度低于中国，为印度可能摆脱高碳发展路径提供了有条件的支持，但尚不能确认印度已完全绕过化石燃料密集型发展阶段。
AI.research_question: 印度能源系统的最新变化是否表明其正在走向一条较不依赖化石燃料的发展路径？新兴经济体是否可以在扩大电力需求的同时同步发展低碳发电，从而减少工业增长历史上的化石燃料强度？
AI.motivation: 历史上工业扩张通常伴随着化石燃料消费的大幅增长，但当代新兴经济体面临的技术条件（可再生能源成本下降、太阳能可扩展性提升、电气化技术进步）与早期工业化国家不同，这为探索一条更低碳的发展路径提供了可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"电气技术快速通道"（Electrotech Fast-Track）命题的能源转型框架，以及工业增长与化石燃料消费关系的传统发展路径理论。
AI.method: 采用比较描述性分析方法，利用来自Ember、能源研究所和世界银行的公开数据，对印度、中国和美国在太阳能发电量、人均煤炭消费量、人均电力消费量和能源强度四个指标上进行跨国比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）印度太阳能发电量在2015-2024年间增长超过20倍；（2）印度人均煤炭消费量在最新年份仍远低于中国水平；（3）印度人均电力消费量较低，表明未来需求增长空间大；（4）印度在最新可比数据中能源强度低于中国。这些指标为印度可能在不复制中国煤炭依赖程度的情况下扩大电力使用提供了有条件的支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"电气技术快速通道"命题提供了印度案例的经验证据，表明当代新兴经济体可能突破传统"工业增长必然伴随高化石燃料消费"的历史路径，但同时也强调了该路径的不确定性和条件性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了印度能源转型现状的实证参考，指出实现低碳发展路径的关键取决于可再生能源发电、电网、储能、能源效率和低碳工业技术是否能够同步扩张以满足未来需求，对新兴经济体的能源政策规划具有借鉴意义。

title: Accountability Asymmetry in Post-Publication Research Integrity: Why Data, Financial and Institutional Opacity Defeat Presumptive Watchdog Authority
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Accountability Asymmetry in Post-Publication Research Integrity: Why Data, Financial and Institutional Opacity Defeat Presumptive Watchdog Authority
detail.abstract: Post-publication research-integrity activity now moves through websites for comments, private consultancy, publisher investigations, journalism, databases, nonprofit programmes, fundraising and professional awards. This convergence has produced a serious accountability asymmetry: researchers are expected to disclose interests, preserve evidence and distinguish allegation from finding, while influential critics and intermediary organisations can affect reputations and editorial decisions without comparably inspectable controls. This documentary case study examines Elisabeth M. Bik's 2016 mBio image-duplication study, later derivative datasets, paid consulting disclosures, public engagement with Springer Nature, links involving Ferric C. Fang and the Center for Scientific Integrity (CSI), Retraction Watch, PubPeer and the Elisabeth Bik Science Integrity Fund. The 2016 study reported screening 20,621 papers and classifying 782 as containing inappropriate image duplication, but the original public supplementary record reviewed for this article did not provide a complete paper-level file identifying every screened record and its final classification. Later studies released a subset dataset and anonymised data with code, narrowing but not eliminating the reproducibility deficit. Paid consulting for publishers and research institutions is disclosed at category level, yet the identity of relevant clients is generally unavailable because most cases are confidential. Public records also document overlapping research, board, reporting, award and funding relationships, while failing to establish bribery, covert coordination or publisher control. Those limits do not restore presumptive authority. They show that awards, repetition and institutional proximity cannot substitute for reproducible evidence, client-specific conflict management, provenance and independent review. The article concludes that these actors may speak and publish, but their outputs should be disqualified from presumptive institutional authority unless independently verified.

AI.tldr: 本文通过纪录片案例研究，分析了以Elisabeth M. Bik为代表的科研诚信领域的"声誉影响者"（包括评论网站、私人顾问、出版社调查、新闻、数据库、非营利组织、筹款和专业奖项等）所面临的责任不对称问题。研究发现，研究人员被要求披露利益、保存证据并区分指控与事实，而有影响力的批评者和中介组织却能影响声誉和编辑决策，却无需接受同等程度的可核查约束。文章以Bik 2016年的mBio图像重复研究及其后续衍生数据集、付费咨询披露、与Springer Nature的互动、与Ferric C. Fang及科学诚信中心（CSI）、Retraction Watch、PubPeer和Elisabeth Bik科学诚信基金的关系为案例，指出其证据可复制性不足、客户身份不透明等问题，最终结论认为这些行为者可以发言和出版，但其产出在未经独立核实前不应被赋予推定性的制度权威。
AI.research_question: 在科研诚信（research integrity）领域，具有影响力的批评者和中介组织（如Bik、Retraction Watch、PubPeer等）在缺乏可核查控制的情况下影响声誉和编辑决策，是否应当被赋予推定性的制度权威？其证据基础、利益冲突管理和独立审查机制是否足以支撑这种权威？
AI.motivation: 后发表阶段的科研诚信活动已经高度产业化，形成了评论网站、咨询、出版方调查、新闻、数据库、非营利项目、筹款和专业奖项等复杂生态。然而，这种生态中出现了严重的责任不对称：研究人员受到严格的行为规范约束，而有影响力的批评者和中介组织却能在缺乏同等可核查约束的情况下影响学术声誉和编辑决策。这种不对称对学术界的公信力构成威胁，亟需审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任不对称理论（accountability asymmetry）；推定权威（presumptive authority）概念；可复制性/可再现性（reproducibility）原则；利益冲突管理（conflict-of-interest management）理论
AI.method: 纪录片案例研究方法（documentary case study），通过公开档案分析：审查Bik 2016年mBio图像重复研究及其原始补充材料、后续衍生数据集和匿名化数据代码、付费咨询披露记录、与Springer Nature的公开互动、与Fang和CSI/Retraction Watch/PubPeer及科学诚信基金的关系网络等公开记录。
AI.findings: 1) 2016年mBio研究声称筛查20,621篇论文并将782篇分类为含不当图像重复，但原始公开补充记录未提供完整的论文级文件以识别每篇被筛查记录及其最终分类；2) 后续研究发布了子集数据集和匿名化数据（含代码），缩小但未消除可复制性缺陷；3) 为出版商和研究机构提供的付费咨询仅按类别披露，相关客户身份因保密协议通常不可获得；4) 公开记录显示Bik与研究生态中的各方存在重叠的研究、董事会、报道、奖项和资助关系，但未证明贿赂、秘密协调或出版商控制；5) 这些限制并不能恢复推定权威，奖项、重复和制度接近性不能替代可复制的证据、特定客户冲突管理、来源溯源和独立审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文在理论上提出了"推定权威"不应对科研诚信中介组织自动适用的论点，将可复制性、利益冲突管理和独立审查确立为制度权威的正当性基础，挑战了在科研诚信领域中"名声即权威"的逻辑，丰富了责任不对称理论在学术治理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期刊编辑、出版商、资助机构和学术共同体提供了评估科研诚信批评者产出的具体标准（独立核实、可复制证据、客户特定冲突管理、来源溯源），提示学术界在采纳相关指控和处理决策时不应默认赋予推定权威，而应建立审慎的核实机制。

title: When Digital Gold Meets Operational Stress: Resilience Planning for Market Volatility, Cyber Incidents, and Delivery Surges

detail.title: When Digital Gold Meets Operational Stress: Resilience Planning for Market Volatility, Cyber Incidents, and Delivery Surges
detail.abstract: Online gold platforms are digital front-ends onto physical market infrastructure, and their distinctive operational weakness is that stress propagates across the asset–physical boundary. Frameworks developed for pure-digital fintech or wholesale bullion dealers do not fully cover the hybrid case: customer demand can surge discontinuously, while the redeemable asset remains physical, finite, and dependent on vaulting, assay, insurance, logistics, and payment rails. This conceptual working paper contributes a resilience framework organized around three stress families—market volatility, cyber incidents, and delivery or redemption surges—within a nested mitigation model based on critical operations, dependency mapping, impact tolerances, and tested recovery capabilities. The method synthesizes the Basel Committee’s Principles for Operational Resilience (March 2021), the European Union’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (Regulation [EU] 2022/2554, applicable from January 17, 2025), the National Institute of Standards and Technology’s Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 (February 2024), and the Financial Stability Board’s Format for Incident Reporting Exchange (FIRE, April 2025), integrating those instruments with operational-risk and trust research. The central finding is that the decisive resilience constraint for digital gold is the physical delivery channel: demand spikes cannot be met by cryptographic or cloud scaling. Vaulting, reconciliation, and delivery must therefore be treated as Tier-1 critical infrastructure rather than as back-office functions. The framework is normative and conceptual; it is not tested on live platform data or used to quantify optimal thresholds. Future research should examine disclosure, delivery-surge data, buffer optimization, user trust, and insolvency allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个针对在线黄金平台的运营韧性框架，识别出三大压力族（市场波动、网络事件、交付/赎回激增），并基于关键运营、依赖映射、影响容忍度和经过测试的恢复能力构建嵌套缓解模型。核心发现是物理交付渠道是数字黄金的韧性瓶颈，保管、对账和交付应被视为一级关键基础设施。
AI.research_question: 在线黄金平台作为面向物理市场基础设施的数字前端，如何在资产—物理边界上建立运营韧性？现有纯数字金融科技或批发金条交易商框架为何不适用于混合型案例，以及应如何构建适应性的韧性框架？
AI.motivation: 在线黄金平台兼具数字前端与物理资产属性，其独特的运营弱点是压力会跨越资产—物理边界传播。客户需求可能不连续激增，而可赎回资产仍是物理的、有限的，且依赖保管、鉴定、保险、物流和支付通道。现有的纯数字金融科技或批发金条交易商框架无法完全覆盖这种混合情形，亟需专门的韧性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 巴塞尔委员会《运营韧性原则》（2021年3月）、欧盟《数字运营韧性法案》（EU 2022/2554，2025年1月17日生效）、美国国家标准与技术研究院《网络安全框架2.0》（2024年2月）、金融稳定理事会《事件报告交换格式》（FIRE，2025年4月），并结合运营风险与信任研究。
AI.method: 规范性概念性工作论文，综合多份国际监管与行业韧性标准，构建嵌套缓解模型（关键运营—依赖映射—影响容忍度—经测试的恢复能力），并围绕三大压力族（市场波动、网络事件、交付/赎回激增）组织韧性框架。未使用实时平台数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 数字黄金的决定性韧性约束在于物理交付渠道：需求激增无法通过密码学或云扩展来满足。保管、对账和交付必须被视为一级关键基础设施，而非后台办公功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了数字金融科技与实物商品交易商框架之间的空白，提出混合型"数字前端+物理资产"场景下的运营韧性概念框架，将监管标准整合为可操作的韧性分析框架，并识别出物理交付渠道作为关键韧性约束这一理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线黄金平台管理者提供了三大压力族下系统的韧性评估与缓解框架；明确建议将保管、对账和交付功能升级为一级关键基础设施；为未来研究中披露、交付激增数据、缓冲优化、用户信任和破产分配等领域指明方向。

title: Gregory X: The Pope Who Changed the Rules of Power
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Gregory X: The Pope Who Changed the Rules of Power
detail.abstract:
Amid one of the most turbulent periods in the history of the medieval papacy, Gregory X: The Pope Who Changed the Rules of Power reconstructs, with historical rigor and narrative clarity, the life and legacy of Teobaldo Visconti, an unexpected occupant of the throne of Saint Peter. His election after the longest papal election in history (nearly three years of internal divisions, enforced confinement, and external pressure) marked a turning point in thirteenth-century ecclesiastical politics.

From his beginnings as a cleric from Piacenza, archdeacon of Liège, and crusader in the Holy Land to his decisive role at the Second Council of Lyon, the pontificate of Gregory X (1271–1276) was brief yet profoundly reformist. This book examines his attempt at reconciliation with the Greek Orthodox Church, his promotion of the institutionalization of the conclave as the system for papal election, and his efforts to establish an equilibrium between the European powers and Rome’s spiritual authority. Combining political, ecclesiological, and diplomatic analysis, the work offers a portrait of a pontiff whose historiographical reception has been uneven and, above all, a study of a government that left enduring institutional instruments to the medieval Church.

This series brings together independent studies that explore power, ideology, legitimacy, and history from a cross-disciplinary perspective. Each volume is an autonomous work, yet all form part of a common thread: the critical analysis of how power is configured, exercised, and sustained over time. From ancient Egypt to twentieth-century totalitarianism, Working Papers presents, with academic rigor and clear prose, the historical and discursive mechanisms that shape our societies. Each installment is numbered to indicate its place within this evolving series.

AI.tldr: 本书以历史严谨性和叙事清晰度重建了教宗格里高利十世（特奥巴尔多·维斯孔蒂）的生平与遗产。在历史上最长（近三年）的教宗选举之后当选，其短暂但深刻的改革宗座（1271-1276）在十三世纪教会政治中标志着一个转折点。本书考察了他与东正教的和解尝试、推动枢机选举会议制度化的努力，以及在欧洲列强与罗马精神权威之间建立平衡的举措。
AI.research_question: 格里高利十世的宗座统治如何改变了中世纪教宗的权力规则？其改革在制度、外交和教会学层面产生了哪些持久的遗产？
AI.motivation: 格里高利十世在位时间短暂但改革深刻，然而其史学接受度并不均衡，缺乏一部系统性的、跨学科视角的研究来重建其生平与政治遗产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治学、教会学与外交分析的跨学科框架，涉及权力、意识形态、合法性与历史的批判性分析。
AI.method: 综合政治、教会学与外交分析的历史重建方法，结合叙事性历史写作与学术严谨性。
AI.findings: 格里高利十世的宗座任期为中世纪教会留下了持久的制度工具：枢机选举会议（conclave）的制度化、与希腊东正教会的和解尝试、以及在欧洲列强与罗马精神权威之间建立均衡的努力。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过跨学科视角（政治、教会学、外交）重新审视一位史学接受度不均衡的教宗，补充了关于中世纪教宗权力制度化的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解教会选举制度的起源与演变（枢机选举会议的制度化）提供历史参照，也为研究宗教与政治权力平衡问题提供案例。

title: Institutional Operators and the Structural Reconstruction of Higher-Education Costs

detail.title: Institutional Operators and the Structural Reconstruction of Higher-Education Costs
detail.abstract: Debates concerning higher-education costs, accessibility, permanence, and redistribution frequently appear as disagreements regarding empirical estimation. However, the quantities under dispute are often reconstructed through heterogeneous admissibility configurations and distinct institutional operators. We develop a structural framework for reconstructing higher-education costs as operator-dependent institutional objects rather than as a primitive observable directly extractable from expenditure data. The analysis distinguishes explicitly between admissibility construction and operator reconstruction, treating each as a channel through which institutional systems undergo structural change. Persistent disagreement may emerge either because distinct approaches preserve different admissible institutional partitions or because distinct operators act over partially equivalent institutional structures. Using the permanence and assistance structure of the University of São Paulo (USP) as an empirical instance of this class of institutional systems, the paper reconstructs multiple operators over the same institutional system using publicly available budgetary and administrative documentation. Our examination further contrasts infrastructure-coupled institutional operators with simplified transfer-centered systems associated * This is a preprint and has not been peer reviewed. Current version: August 2026. 1 with Negative Income Tax formulations, and interprets these systems as structurally distinct admissibility operators preserving different accessibility geometries over partially comparable resource spaces. The contribution of the paper is to make explicit the admissibility structures through which institutional outcomes become observable, reachable, and interpretable, and to situate operator reconstruction as a mechanism of structural change in institutional systems more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结构框架，将高等教育成本重构为依赖制度操作者的制度对象，而非可直接从支出数据中提取的原始可观测变量。通过区分"可容许性建构"与"操作者重构"两个渠道，论文以圣保罗大学（USP）为实证案例，基于公开预算和行政文件重构了多个操作者，并对比了基础设施耦合型制度操作者与简化的负所得税转移中心系统，揭示了不同制度系统如何作为结构性不同的可容许性操作者，保留着部分可比资源空间上不同的可达性几何结构。
AI.research_question: 高等教育成本应如何被重构为依赖制度操作者的制度对象？不同可容许性建构与操作者重构如何导致关于成本的持续争议？
AI.motivation: 关于高等教育成本、可及性、持久性和再分配的辩论经常表现为经验估计的分歧，但这些争议涉及的量往往通过异质的可容许性配置和不同的制度操作者被重构，而非简单地直接提取自支出数据。现有研究缺乏一个结构框架来系统理解这些重构过程中的差异及其对制度变迁的含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出一个结构框架，将高等教育成本视为"依赖操作者的制度对象"（operator-dependent institutional objects），明确区分"可容许性建构"（admissibility construction）与"操作者重构"（operator reconstruction）两个渠道，将二者视为制度系统发生结构性变迁的通道。
AI.method: 以圣保罗大学（USP）的持久性与援助结构作为实证案例，使用公开可获得的预算和行政文档，对同一制度系统重构多个操作者。对比基础设施耦合型制度操作者与基于负所得税（Negative Income Tax）公式的简化转移中心系统。
AI.findings: 持续的争议可能产生于两种情形：一是不同方法保留了不同的可容许制度划分（admissible institutional partitions）；二是不同操作者在部分等价制度结构上运作。基础设施耦合型操作者与转移中心系统被解释为结构性不同的可容许性操作者，它们保留着部分可比资源空间上不同的可达性几何结构（accessibility geometries）。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文使制度结果变得可观测、可达和可解释的可容许性结构得以显性化，并将操作者重构定位为制度系统结构性变迁的一般机制，从而为理解制度系统的结构变化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了一种系统化的方法，使他们能够识别和比较不同高等教育成本重构框架背后的制度假设与分配逻辑，从而更清晰地理解争议根源，并更审慎地评估不同制度方案（如基础设施投资vs.直接转移支付）的公平性与可达性后果。

title: Onward Transfer: Leakage as an Access Constraint

detail.title: Onward Transfer: Leakage as an Access Constraint
detail.abstract: Disclosure regimes are written in two clauses: the first says who may see a document, the second what a recipient may do with it. The second clause-onward transfer-exists because permissions attach to documents while information attaches to people. We model the difference as a designer's choice of a continuous, directed, stochastic leakage matrix, and price it. The first result bounds the paper's own subject: when every audience prices its posterior through a Blackwell-monotone read, the designer is exactly indifferent between the two readings, and-when every read is belief-convex-remains so when sealing is costly. Indifference fails in four places, and only one of them-a constraint on who may reach whom-is written in the language of institutions. Under the information-set reading such a constraint is not a seal on a channel but a quarantine: everyone inside the protected audience's field of view must also be denied the protected source. We give the loss in closed form as the cost of the cheapest admissible quarantine, of which there are exactly 2 n-2 ; with three audiences there are two, each closes exactly one channel beyond the one the requirement itself closes, and they buy opposite things. We also show that the scalar seal used in the companion papers cannot express the question at all, and that the indifference result fails once the sender rewrites its documents against the design-a limitation we state as a result because that is what it is.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个连续的、有向的、随机的泄漏矩阵来建模信息披露制度中"谁可以看"和"接收者可以做什么"（即向前转移）两个条款的区别，发现当每个受众通过Blackwell单调读取对其后验定价时，设计者对两种解读恰好无差异；这种无差异在四种情况下失效，其中只有一种是以制度语言表述的约束——信息集解读下的"隔离"（quarantine）约束。
AI.research_question: 信息披露制度中"谁可以看"（第一条款）与"接收者可以做什么"（第二条款，即向前转移）两个条款之间的本质区别是什么？设计者如何在二者之间做出选择，这种选择何时无差异、何时有差异？
AI.motivation: 信息披露制度由两个条款构成：第一个条款规定谁能查看文件，第二个条款规定接收者可以对其做什么（即向前转移）。之所以存在第二个条款，是因为权限附着于文件，而信息附着于人。作者试图将这种区别形式化，并为之定价，以理解两种条款设计的差别及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Blackwell单调读取（Blackwell-monotone read）、信念凸性（belief-convexity）、随机泄漏矩阵（stochastic leakage matrix）、信息集读取（information-set reading）、隔离（quarantine）概念。
AI.method: 理论建模：将信息披露制度建模为设计者对连续、有向、随机泄漏矩阵的选择，并对其定价。通过分析不同读取方式（后验定价）下的设计者选择，推导无差异结果及其失效条件，并以闭式解给出隔离成本。
AI.findings: (1) 当每个受众通过Blackwell单调读取对其后验定价时，设计者对两种条款解读恰好无差异；当读取为信念凸时，即使密封有成本，无差异仍然成立。(2) 无差异在四种情况下失效，其中只有"谁可以接触谁"这一约束是以制度语言表述的。(3) 在信息集读取下，该约束不是密封一个渠道，而是隔离：受保护受众视野内的所有人都必须被拒绝受保护的来源。(4) 给出了隔离成本的闭式解，最小成本的可接受隔离恰好有2^(n-2)个；三个受众时有两个，每个都额外关闭一个渠道，但购买的对象相反。(5) 伴随论文中使用的标量密封无法表达该问题。(6) 一旦发送者针对设计重写文件，无差异结果就会失效。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 形式化区分了信息披露制度中"谁能看"与"能做什么"两个条款的本质差异，将权限附着于文件与信息附着于人的区别建模为泄漏矩阵的选择问题。(2) 给出了在何种条件下两种条款解读无差异的精确刻画，以及失效的四种情况。(3) 引入"隔离"（quarantine）概念，区别于简单的渠道密封，并给出了最小可接受隔离的闭式解（恰好2^(n-2)个）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为制度设计者提供了密封成本视角下的条款选择指导，说明在何种条件下两种条款设计等价、何时必须区分。(2) 指出标量密封无法表达隔离问题，为实际制度设计中需要更精细的约束刻画提供了依据。(3) 揭示了在信息集读取下，保护某受众需要对"其视野内所有人"施加约束，而非仅密封单一渠道。

title: Authenticating the Hobby: Technology, Trust, and the Evolution of Sports Card Grading
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Authenticating the Hobby: Technology, Trust, and the Evolution of Sports Card Grading
detail.abstract: Sports-card grading has evolved from an informal, local practice into a technology-intensive institution of the modern collectibles market. This article traces that development across three technological eras: the pre-digital period of visual inspection and subjective condition descriptions; the digital-assisted era of online databases, certification tracking, and computerassisted measurement; and the emerging age of automated and artificial-intelligence-assisted authentication and grading. Drawing on the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework, the article evaluates the trustworthiness characteristics-validity and reliability, transparency, explainability, and management of harmful bias-that automated grading systems must demonstrate to gain market acceptance. The analysis examines imaging technologies including ultraviolet, infrared, and multispectral examination; laser-based dimensional measurement and thickness detection; and card fingerprinting for provenance and resubmission tracking. By 2025, PSA graded 19.26 million cards, while PSA, SGC, and Beckett together accounted for approximately four-fifths of major grading volume. The article concludes that automation will probably supplement, rather than replace, human expertise by 2030. Its most consequential effects may arise from standardized imaging, card fingerprinting, alteration detection, and the data advantages held by firms that operate grading, pricing, and marketplace services.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯体育卡片评级从非正式地方实践演变为现代收藏品市场中技术密集型制度的发展历程，跨越三个技术时代（前数字时代、数字辅助时代、自动化与AI辅助时代），并基于NIST人工智能风险管理框架评估自动化评级系统的可信赖性特征及其市场接受前景。文章预计到2030年自动化将补充而非取代人类专家，其最重要影响可能来自标准化成像、卡片指纹识别、篡改检测以及运营评级、定价和市场服务企业的数据优势。
AI.research_question: 体育卡片评级如何从非正式的地方实践演变为技术密集型制度？自动化与AI辅助评级系统需要展现哪些可信赖性特征才能获得市场接受？
AI.motivation: 体育卡片评级已从非正式实践演变为现代收藏品市场的重要制度，且正经历自动化与AI技术的深刻转型。理解这一技术演进路径及自动化系统的可信赖性要求，对评估行业未来发展方向具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: NIST人工智能风险管理框架；技术时代分期（前数字、数字辅助、自动化与AI）；可信赖性特征（有效性与可靠性、透明度、可解释性、有害偏见管理）
AI.method: 历史追踪分析；技术分类与评估；基于NIST AI风险管理框架的可信赖性分析；行业数据统计
AI.findings: 到2025年，PSA评级了1926万张卡片，PSA、SGC和Beckett合计约占主要评级量的五分之四；自动化到2030年将补充而非取代人类专业知识；自动化最重要影响可能来自标准化成像、卡片指纹识别、篡改检测和运营评级、定价及市场服务企业的数据优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将NIST AI风险管理框架应用于体育卡片评级这一特定行业场景，丰富了AI可信赖性在收藏品市场领域的理论应用；提出三个技术时代的演进框架，为理解技术制度变迁提供了分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动化评级系统的开发者和市场参与者提供了可信赖性标准框架（有效性与可靠性、透明度、可解释性、有害偏见管理）；揭示了评级、定价与市场服务一体化企业的数据优势，为行业竞争格局提供了洞察。

title: Hope, Resilience and Faith at the National Scale: A Multi-Level Framework for Understanding State Capacity and Citizen Adaptation

detail.title: Hope, Resilience and Faith at the National Scale: A Multi-Level Framework for Understanding State Capacity and Citizen Adaptation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: approved
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This paper develops a multi-level heuristic framework for understanding how hope, resilience, and faith manifest at the national level, constructs that resist simple aggregation from individual psychology. We argue that nation-states present fundamentally different analytical challenges than individuals or organizations, requiring distinct theoretical and methodological approaches. The framework organizes analysis around three interdependent dimensions: institutional capacity, citizen trust and differentiated social cohesion, and shared national narrative. We establish theoretical foundations distinguishing collective from individual constructs, introduce a fundamental distinction between descriptive resilience (systems that persist) and normative resilience (systems worth preserving), and situate our approach within ecological systems theory. We document systematic biases in existing measurement approaches, including OECD-centric assumptions, social desirability effects, and perception-behavior gaps and propose behavioral and material alternatives. The framework's empirical validity is examined through comparative case analysis, including Ukraine's sustained mobilization under existential threat and Israel's complex post-October 7, 2023 trajectory, which provides both confirmation (rapid civil society activation, cohesion transformation) and complication (resilience decay over time) for our theoretical propositions. We argue that national resilience emerges from the alignment of these three dimensions across ecological system levels, and that divergence between local and national institutional trust (the "Exo-Gap") may serve as a leading indicator of adaptive failure or success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多层次的理论框架，用于理解希望、韧性和信念在国家层面的表现。该框架围绕三个相互依存的维度展开：制度能力、公民信任与差异化社会凝聚力、以及共享的国家叙事。通过乌克兰和以色列的案例比较分析，文章论证国家韧性产生于三个维度在生态系统层面的对齐，并提出"外部差距"（Exo-Gap）可作为适应性成败的领先指标。
AI.research_question: 希望、韧性和信念等心理建构如何超越个体心理学，在国家层面被概念化和测量？国家层面的韧性与个体或组织层面的韧性有何根本不同？
AI.motivation: 现有的韧性研究多聚焦于个体或组织层面，缺乏对国家层面韧性建构的系统性理论框架。同时，现有测量方法存在系统性偏差（如OECD中心假设、社会期望效应、感知-行为差距），亟需建立区分集体与个体建构的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统理论（Ecological Systems Theory）；集体vs个体建构的区分；描述性韧性（系统持续存在）vs规范性韧性（系统值得保留）的区分；多层次框架（制度能力、公民信任与社会凝聚力、共享国家叙事）
AI.method: 理论构建与比较案例分析。通过乌克兰（存在性威胁下的持续动员）和以色列（2023年10月7日后的复杂轨迹）两个案例检验框架的实证有效性，同时使用行为性和物质性替代指标来弥补现有测量方法的偏差。
AI.findings: 国家韧性产生于三个维度（制度能力、公民信任与社会凝聚力、共享国家叙事）在生态系统层面的对齐；案例研究提供了确认性证据（快速公民社会激活、凝聚力转型）和复杂化证据（韧性随时间衰减）；地方与国家制度信任之间的分歧（Exo-Gap）可能作为适应性成败的领先指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国家层面韧性研究的多层次启发式框架，建立了描述性韧性与规范性韧性的根本区分，将集体建构（国家韧性）与个体建构（个体韧性）进行了理论上清晰的界分，并识别了"Exo-Gap"作为新的理论概念和领先指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了现有国家韧性测量方法的系统性偏差（OECD中心假设、社会期望效应、感知-行为差距），并提出行为性和物质性替代测量方案，为政策制定者和国际组织评估国家韧性提供了更准确的分析工具。

title: Incomplete Insurance and Open-Economy Spillovers of Labor Market Reforms
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg and University of Erlangen-Nuremberg-Friedrich Alexander Universität Erlangen Nürnberg

detail.title: Incomplete Insurance and Open-Economy Spillovers of Labor Market Reforms
detail.abstract: This paper studies how an unemployment-benefit reform in one member state of a monetary union affects savings, net foreign asset positions, and fiscal space across member states when households face incomplete insurance. Lower benefits reduce unemployment and increase fiscal space in the reforming country. Employed workers increase their precautionary savings to compensate for reduced public insurance. A portion of these savings is invested abroad, pushing the non-reforming country into a negative net foreign asset position and lowering its long-run consumption. Despite raising fiscal space and long-run average consumption in the reforming country, the reform may decrease ex-ante welfare because it reduces insurance and depresses consumption during the transition as households self-insure through higher savings. We discipline our proposed model with firm-level evidence on Germany’s post-reform tradable-sector expansion following the Hartz IV reform of unemployment benefits. In our simulation, this reform accounts for a substantial share of the observed post-reform open-economy adjustment, whereas the earlier wage moderation cannot explain most of the observed patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究货币联盟中一国失业保险改革如何通过不完全保险下的预防性储蓄渠道影响各国储蓄、净外国资产头寸和财政空间。降低失业福利虽减少失业并扩大改革国财政空间，但工人增加预防性储蓄并部分投资国外，使非改革国陷入负净外国资产头寸并降低其长期消费。改革虽提升改革国财政空间和长期平均消费，但因减少保险且转型期消费受抑，可能降低事前福利。作者用德国Hartz IV改革后的企业层面证据校准模型，发现该改革解释了观察到的开放经济调整的大部分，而早前的工资节制不能解释大部分现象。
AI.research_question: 在一国失业保险福利改革（如德国Hartz IV改革）背景下，货币联盟内改革如何通过不完全保险渠道影响成员国之间的储蓄、净外国资产头寸和财政空间，以及这些效应如何影响各国福利？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注失业福利改革对国内劳动市场的影响，但缺乏对货币联盟内开放经济层面溢出效应的系统分析。德国Hartz IV改革后出现了显著的贸易部门扩张和外部头寸调整，需要一个能够连接国内社会保险改革与跨国资本流动的理论框架来解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全保险模型（incomplete insurance）、预防性储蓄理论、开放经济宏观经济学（货币联盟内的跨国资本流动分析）。
AI.method: 建立两国货币联盟的不完全保险模型，结合德国Hartz IV改革后企业层面的贸易部门扩张证据进行模型校准，并通过数值模拟量化改革对储蓄、净外国资产头寸和财政空间的贡献，与早前工资节制（wage moderation）的情景进行对比。
AI.findings: (1) 降低失业福利减少改革国失业并扩大其财政空间；(2) 就业工人增加预防性储蓄以补偿公共保险减少，部分储蓄投资国外，使非改革国面临负净外国资产头寸和长期消费下降；(3) 改革虽提高改革国长期平均消费和财政空间，但因降低保险程度且转型期消费受抑，可能降低事前福利；(4) 模型模拟显示Hartz IV改革解释了观察到的开放经济调整的显著部分，而工资节制无法解释大部分观察模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将失业保险改革的劳动市场效应拓展至货币联盟的开放经济维度，揭示社会保险改革通过预防性储蓄渠道产生跨国溢出效应的机制；明确了"国内改革"与"国际再平衡"之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币联盟内成员国失业保险改革提供了跨国政策溢出效应的量化评估，提示政策制定者关注改革带来的跨国福利再分配效应及财政空间变化的复杂性。
